Abakozi b' urubuga nkoranyambaga rwa Twitter bahaye amafaranga arenga miliyoni y' amadolari ya Amerika ( $ 1 ) ikigo giharanira uburenganzira bw' ikiremwamuntu cyo muri Amerika " American Civil Liberties Union " ( ACLU ) , ngo kirwanye icyemezo Perezida Donald Trump aherutse gufata kibuza abimukira n' abanyagihugu bava mu bihugu birindwi byiganjemo iby' abayislamu kwinjira muri Amerika .
Ikigo ACLU cyatangaje ko gifite intego yo kurwanya cyivuye inyuma icyo cyemezo , aho kivuga ko kimaze kwegeranya amafaranga agera ku miliyoni 24 z' amadolari mu mpano zatangiwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga muri ino minsi ishize .
Ni mu gihe kandi andi mashyirahamwe nka Taxi , Lyft , nayo yavuze mu minsi ishize ko azaha ACLU imfashanyo ya miliyoni imwe y' amadolari ( $ 1 ) mu gihe cy' imyaka ine iri imbere .
Abakozi bashya 1 000 ba Twitter batanze imfashanyo irenga ibihumbi magana atanu by' amadolari ( $ 500 000 ) .
Ku butumwa bwacishijwe kuri Twitter , umuhanga mu by' amategeko Vijaya Gadde yagize ati : "
Igikorwa cyacu ntikirarangira , mu mezi ari imbere , abantu bazigaragambya bamagane icyo cyemezo , babikurikirane bisunze amategeko , bongere basohore n' amatangazo . "
Umunyamategeko Vijaya Gadde avuga ko ibikorwa bitararangira ko mu minsi iri imbere bazanigaragambya !
Ibiro ntaramakuru bya Bloomberg nabyo byatangaje ko hari ibindi bigo bikomeye mu by' ubuhanga birimo gutegura inyandiko zizashyikirizwa Trump , bamugaragariza impungenge bafite kuri icyo kibazo cy' abimukira , banamugire inama ku buryo yagikemura .
Ku rundi ruhande , ikindi kigo gifasha mu kohererezanya ubutumwa Viber , cyafunguye umurongo wa telefoni w' ubuntu ku bifuza guhamagara mu bihugu byakozweho nicyo cyemezo aribyo Iraki , Syria , Irani , Libiya , Somalia , Sudani na Yemeni .
Niba utarabikora !
Dukunde unadukurikire ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ukomeze ubone amakuru mu buryo utamenyereye .

Amakuru | Mu Ntara | Intara Burera :
Dasso irishimira ko yatesheje abacuruzi bashakaga kurigisa miliyoni 14 z' imisoro Abagize urwego Rushinzwe umutekano mu karere ka Burera , Dasso , barishimira ko bashoboye kugaruza miliyoni zirenga cumi n' enye z' amafaranga y' u Rwanda , yari agiye kurigiswa na bamwe mu bacuruzi .
DCO Ndahumba Jean Pierre , umuhuzabikorwa w' urwego Dasso mu karere ka Burera , avuga ko bashyize imbaraga mu kubungabunga umutekano w' abaturage n' ibyabo , ariko bakanakumira abashaka kubangamira iterambere ry' igihugu bakora ubucuruzi bwa magendu bakarigisa imisoro .
Yagize ati " K ' ubufatanye n' abaturage , tugenda turwanya ibiyobyabwenge , aho badutungiye agatoki , ku bacuruza magendu na bo bamwe dukubitanira mu mayira , abandi na bo twamara kubona amakuru tukabereka inzira banyura bajya gusora .
Aha rero ni ho twahereye tugaruza imisoro igera ku mafaranga 14 , 941 , 545 , aya yose yari agiye kunyerezwa ariko k' ubufatanye ziriya miliyoni zaragarutse , aha ariko nanone nakubwira ko nanone twebwe ntabwo twemerewe gusaka , ahubwo dutanga inama cyangwa se tugaherekeza abasoresha .
Ikindi ni uko uru rwego dufatanya mu bikorwa by' iterambere n' abaturage , aho tworoza bamwe , abandi tubaha ubwisungane mu kwivuza , turwanya kandi inzira zose zakoreshwa mu gukoresha no kwinjiza ibiyobyabwenge mu gihugu " .
Uyu muhuzabikorwa wa Dasso avuga ko mu rwego rwo kwiteza imbere kuri ubu bashyizeho ikigega Twiheshe agaciro Dasso Burera , aho bagenda bashyiramo amafaranga abaagoboka nk' igihe hari uwitabye Imana , uwakoresheje ubukwe , n' ibindi .
Kuri ubu kikaba kimaze umwaka umwe kuko cyatangiye mu Gushyingo 2015 , kimaze kugeramo agera kuri miliyoni 2 , 509 , 693 , muri iki gikorwa buri mudaso yigomwa amafaranga 2000 ku kwezi k' umushahara we akajya muri icyo kigega , ibintu basanga ari ingirakamaro .
Umuyobozi w' akarere ka Burera Uwambajemariya Marie Florence , asaba Dasso kwirinda ruswa , kwiyandarika , kugira isuku bambara neza , ikinyabupfura , gutanga amakuru cyane ku bijyanye n' icuruzwa ry' abantu , no kurangwa n' ubunyangamugayo muri byose , agahamya kandi ko uru rwego ko rwahinduye byinshi mu mutekano n' imibereho myiza y' abaturage .
Akarere ka Burera kuri ubu gafite abadaso bagera kuri 92 , ariko ngo biteganijwe ko uyu umubare wiyongera .
Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko abaturage babafitiye icyizere ku gipimo cya 86 , 1 % .
Abaturage bo muri aka karere bashimira Leta y' u Rwanda ubushishozi yiganye umushinga wo kubashyiriraho urwego rwa Dasso , kuko ngo ubu basigaye bafite umutekano usesuye , bityo nabo bakaba bariyemeje gukomeza gukorana bya hafi na Dasso , bahanahana amakuru yabafasha gukumira ibyaha bitaraba .

Umwami wa Arabie Saoudite yagendereye Indonesia aherekejwe n' abantu 1500 Yanditswe na Evariste Nsengimana Kuya 1 Werurwe 2017 saa 09 :
22 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
2 0 Mu ruzinduko rw' iminsi icyenda , Umwami Salman bin Abdul Aziz al - Saud wa Arabia Saoudite ari kugirira muri Indonesia kuva kuri uyu wa gatatu , yagiye aherekejwe n' abantu basaga 1500 barimo abaminisitiri 10 , ibikomangoma 25 , abahagarariye imiryango itandukanye basaga 800 n' abandi , hamwe n' imitwaro ipima toni zisaga 500 , mu ngendo yakoreye mu ndege inshuro zigera kuri 36 .
Perezida w' Ikompanyi ishinzwe imirimo yo ku kibuga cy' Indege yitwa PT Jasa Angkasa Semestar ikorera i Jakarta , Adji Gunawan , aho izo ndege zimaze ibyumweru bitatu zibajyana niwe washyize ahagaragara aya makuru nkuko Jakarta Post yabitangaje .
Muri uru ruzinduko agiriye muri iki gihugu mu myaka 50 ishize , biteganyijwe ko azasura ibice bitandukanye by' umurwa mukuru Jakarta na Java y' Uburengerazuba , akazakomereza mu kirwa cya Bali kizwi nk' agace nyaburanga muri Indonesia .
Muri gahunda y' urugendo ari kugirira ku mugabane wa Aziya , biteganyijwe ko azava yerekeza mu Bushinwa , u Buyapani na Maldives .
Igitangaje kuruta ibindi ni uko uyu mwami , muri iyo mitwaro harimo Ascenseurs ebyiri ndetse n' imodoka zo mu bwoko bwa Mercedes Benz S600 .
Ascenseur ya mbere yagejejwe mu murwa mukuru kuwa 21 , indi igezwa i Denpasar mu Kirwa cya Bali ku ya 22 Gashyantare .
Ibinyamakuru byo muri Indonesia bivuga ko kubera urwo ruzinduko , umutekano wakajijwe bidasanzwe , aho mu murwa mukuru no kuri icyo kirwa hashyizwe abapolisi barenga ibihumbi 10 .
Adji Gunawan yatangaje ko yari yashyizeho abayobozi bagera kuri 572 bazafasha mu gutegura uruzinduko rw' Umwami wa Arabia Saoudite azagirira muri iki gihugu .
Uyu Mwami umenyereweho udushya twinshi mu ngendo akora , si ubwa mbere akoze uruzinduko akajyana n' ibikoresho umuntu yumva agatungurwa kuko mu 2015 ubwo yajyaga mu Bufaransa , ascenseur zari zashyizweho zakuruye imvururu nyuma y' uko abantu bigaragambije bamagana ifungwa ry' ubwogero rw' aho zari zashyizwe .

Bulldogg afite tattoo imwibutsa urukundo rwayoyotse BullDogg Umuraperi Ndayishimiye Malik Bertrand uzwi cyane nka Bulldogg n' andi mazina menshi , yagize icyo avuga ku gishushanyo yishyize ku kuboko cyanditseho ' Tough ' aho avuga ko ari igishushanyo areba buri gihe akibuka urukundo rwa bagenzi be yabuze .
Uyu musore wari umwe mu bagize itsinda rya " Tuff Gang " , yavuze ko nubwo igihe cyageze we na bagenzi be ntibacane uwaka , hari igihe bakundanye , baba inshuti magara ndetse bigera naho yandika iri zina ku kuboko kwe .
Yagize ati " buriya rero nubwo hari igihe cyageze ibintu bikivanga , hari igihe twari dufitanye umubano mwiza cyane .
Iyi tattoo rero nibwo nayishyizeho kuko iyo nayirebaga yampaga motivation ( yanyongereraga imbaraga ) ariko ubu iyo nyirebye nyine inyibutsa ibyo bihe . "
Yakomeje ati " wa mugani wa wa muhanzi waririmbye ngo ' urukundo ni nka bombo rusaza rushonga ' .
Buriya hari igihe urya akabombo wumva karyoshye ariko uko kagenda gashira mu kanwa hari n' ubwo kagukeba , kakaguca igisebe mu kanwa , cyangwa ukarya sikarete iryoshye hanyuma ukiruma mu kanwa cyangwa se bwa buryohe bwashira ukayicira . "
Yabajijwe niba yaba yicuza ibyo bihe , maze asubiza , ati " hoya simbyicuza kuko byari ibihe byiza pe .
Nubwo nyine byageze igihe bikivanga , ariko rwose buriya bihe byari byiza . "
BullDogg yasoje avuga ko nubwo batandukanye kandi hakaba harimo bamwe bagize intege nke kuko bagiraga abafana bahuriraho , ariko we agikomeje urugamba , ati " urabona tukiri kumwe twagiraga abafana duhuriyeho , ugasanga ni benshi , ariko ubu usanga twarabagabanye , hakabamo n' abafite intege nke usanga basigara inyuma .
Gusa njye nubwo ntavuga ko mfite intege nyinshi cyane , ndacyarwana no gukomeza gukora kandi bizangendekera neza . "
Muri iyi minsi , BullDogg yashyize hanze indirimbo nshya yise ' Méchamment ' avuga ko irimo ubutumwa azagenderaho mu mishinga ye yo muri uyu mwaka wa 2017 .

Nyuma yo kugirwa inama abakoraga filime bakanazicuruza bagiye kumesa kamwe Ikibazo cy' icuruzwa rya filime nyarwanda gikomeje kuba ikibazo ku bakora uyu mwuga aho usanga ikorwa ry' izi filime rigenda riyoyoka kubera kubura isoko ry' izakozwe .
Ni muri urwo rwego abakora filime bakanazicuruza biyemeje kumesa kamwe nyuma yo kugirwa inama n' urugaga nyarwanda rwa Sinema .
Nyuma yaho abacuruzi ba filime nyarwanda bakanazikora bakomeje guhura n' ibihombo bikabije kubera kubura abagura ibyo bakoze , ni muri ubwo buryo bahisemo kwihuriza hamwe batangira gushakisha uko bahuza imbaraga kugirango barebe ko bazahura iri soko maze biyemeza gukora koperative ijyanye no gucuruza ibihangano byabo .
Nyuma y' uko bamaze gukora iyi koperative biyemeje kuyimurikira Urugaga nyarwanda rwa Sinema ndetse rwahise rubagira n' inama y' icyo bagomba gukora .
Mu nama bagiriwe zitandukanye harimo :
- Gushinga ihuriro ry' abacuruzi ba filime , kuko Urugaga ( federation ) rudakorana na za Koperative ( Cooperatives ) , ahubwo Koperative yaba umunyamuryango w' ihuriro .
- Kuba baba abacuruzi ba filime gusa , bakareka kubikora byose ( Kuba ba producers bakanacuruza ) ahubwo bagakorana n' abakoze amafilime bazibagurira .
Abacuruzi bamaze kugirwa izi nama biyemeje kuzubahiriza ari naho kuri ubu bamaze gutegura inama izabahuza bagahitamo kimwe bakora banashinga ihuriro ryabo Munyawera Augustin uhagarariye koperative y' abacuruza filime nyarwanda Mu kiganiro Inyarwanda . com yagiranye na Munyawera Augustin uhagarariye koperative y' abacuruzi yagize ati " Twari koperative ariko twabonye tugomba kugira ihuriro tubarizwamo ari naryo twiyemeje kujyamo nk' abacuruzi ba filime tukareka kuzikora kuko twasanze tutabikora ari bibiri , ari nayo mpamvu navugako tuje gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo federasiyo ishaka kugirango tubashe kubaka bikomere . "
Munyawera akomeza yemeza ko hatazabaho ibibazo hagati yabo n' abaziyemeza guhitamo kujya bakora filime kuko bazajya bagura filime zemewe n' uru rugaga kuko hari gahunda yo kujya bubahiriza ibisabwa bivuze ko mbere y' uko filime ijyanwa ku isoko igomba kuzajya iba yanyuzemo .
Aha bakaba bahise banatumiza n' inama yo gushyira mu bikorwa iyi migambi aho kuri uyu wa mbere tariki ya 13 Gashyantare 2017 , hateganyijwe gushyiraho ihuriro ry' Abacuruza filime no gutora inzego z' ubuyobozi zaryo aho batumiye abifuza kujya muri iri huriro bose .

Abamugariye ku rugerero bazahabwa miliyoni 400 ku munsi w' amakoperative Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ayo mafaranga azatangwa n' Urugaga rw' amakoperative mu Rwanda ( National Cooperatives Confederation of Rwanda ) , akazahabwa amakoperative atandukanye yashinzwe n' abari ingabo bamugariye ku rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu , ibi ngo bizaba ari ukwesa umuhigo bahize mu mwaka ushize imbere ya Perezida Paul Kagame .
Francois Kanimba Minisitiri w' Ubucuruzi n' Inganda ni we mushyitsi mukuru uzaba uri mu munsi mpuzamahanga w' amakoperative Mu kiganiro n' abanyamakuru cyari kiyobowe na Minisitiri w' Ubucuruzi n' Inganda , Francois Kanimba , yavuze ko umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe amakoperative uzizihizwa kuri uyu wa kabiri tariki ya 28 Nyakanga ku nshuro ya 11 mu Rwanda .
Yavuze ko koperative ari umuyoboro mwiza wo guhuza ingufu ku baturage kandi ngo ni n' umurongo w' iterambere ugamije gusangiza inyungu abanyamuryango nta busumbane .
Ibyo ngo nibyo byashingiweho insanganyamatsiko y' uyu munsi igira iti ' Hitamo koperative uraba uhisemo ubukungu butarimo ubusumbane bwinshi .
' Katabarwa Augustin ukuriye Urugaga rw' amakoperative mu Rwanda , NCCR yavuze ko mu Rwanda umubare w' amakoperative ugeze ku 7500 aho afite abanyamuryango bagera kuri miliyoni eshatu .
Uyu mubare wavuye ku 6500 mu mwaka ushize , icyo ngo ni icyerekana ko Abanyarwanda baha agaciro amakoperative kandi bazi akamaro kayo .
Katabarwa yabwiye abanyamakuru ko mu mwaka ushize ubwo uyu munsi mpuzamahanga wizihizwaga , NCCR yagize amahirwe yo kuwizihizanya n' Umukuru w' igihugu , Perezida Paul Kagame , biyemeza ko bazaremera koperative z' abari abasirikare bamugariye ku rugamba .
Yavuze ko kuri uyu wa kabiri hazabaho guhemba amakoperative yitwaye neza , aho muri buri karere hazaturuka koperative imwe , ku rwego rw' Intara hakava imwe muri SACCOs , nyuma hakazatangwa sheik iriho amafaranga y' u Rwanda miliyoni 400 azashyigikira koperative z' abamugariye ku rugamba .
Bimwe mu bibazo byabajijwe n' abanyamakuru harimo n' icyo kuba abenshi bumva ko Koperative ari umurima bagomba gusaruramo ubukungu ku banyamuryango , ariko ibi ngo si ko bigomba kumera nk' uko Minisitiri Kanimba abivuga .
Minisitiri Kanimba yavuze ko mbere hari uburyo amakoperative yajyagaho nta mategeko ariho , ugasanga uwo ' muco mubi ' wo kugira koperative akarima abaziyobora bazifata gutyo , n' abaturage bakumva ko ari uko .
Yagize ati " Mbere amakoperative yashyirwagaho n' ubuyobozi , abaturage bakumva ko ari urundi rwego rwa Leta ruri hariya , abantu bakumva ko Atari ayabo , nta ruhare bafitemo .
Ubu , uko igihugu kiva mu bujiji , iki kibazo kiragenda gikemuka . "
Mugabo Damien umuyobozi mukuru w' Ikigo cy' Igihugu gishinzwe amakoperative , RCA , yavuze ko kuba inyungu za koperative ziharirwa n' umuntu umwe ari ikibazo kuko ngo iyo koperative iba itabaho .
Umunsi mpuzamahanga w' amakoperative wizihizwa ku Isi hose mu cyumweru cya mbere cy' ukwezi kwa Nyakanga buri mwaka , ariko mu Rwanda ngo ntibyakunze kubera indi minsi mikuru .
U Rwanda rwatangiye kwizihiza uyu munsi kuva mu 2005 , mu gihe ku rwego rw' Isi watangiye kwizihizwa mu 1995 .
Umuyobozi wa RCA Mugabo Damien Katabarwa Augustin umuyobozi w' Impuzamashyirahamwe y' amakoperative mu Rwanda Ikiganiro n' abanyamakuru Amafoto / HATANGIMANA / UMUSEKE HATANGIMANA Ange Eric UMUSEKE .

Nubwo ibimenyetso by' amasezerano byaba byarasibamye guma mu Ijambo – Pasiteri Kalisa Emmanuel Posted by :
Donat Niyitanga February 18 , 2017 in AMAKURU YO MU RWANDA Leave a comment Umushumba w' Itorero rya Pantekoti mu Rwanda ADEPR ururembo rw' Amajyepfo Pasiteri Emmanuel Kalisa yatanze ijambo rihumuriza imitima ubwo kuri iki cyumweru yigishaga uko isezerano Imana itanga nta kintu cyarikuraho nubwo umuntu we yabona ko nta n' ikimenyetso cyaryo gihari .
Pasiteri Kalisa ari mu iteraniro ry' abanyeshuri b' Ababpantekoti biga muri kaminuza y' u Rwanda i Huye ( CEP ) ryo ku wa 12 Gashyantare yavuze ko nta muntu ukwiye kwihebeshwa n' ibyo ahura nabyo muri iyi si cyane cyane iyo hari icyo yavuganye n' Imana .
Asanga hari ubwo abantu biheba kuko ibyo Imana yababwiye byatinze kubaho ndetse bakabona n' ibimenyetso byabyo byarasibanganye ariko abibutsa ko ari Imana ivuga idahubutse .
Aha yibukije abantu inkuru za Aburahamu na Sara bari barabwiwe ko bazabyara kandi ko urubyaro nrwabo ariho isi yose izaturuka ariko ibimenyetso byose bigasibangana kuko ubusanzwe imyaka Sara yari agezemo umugore aba atakibyara .
Yagize ati " Nubwo ibimenyetso by' amasezerano byaba byarasibanganye , guma mu ijambo , hari ubwo umuntu akwizeza kugukorera ikintu ariko ejo bigahinduka , Sara na Elizabeth ibimenyetso by' amasezerano yabo byari byarasibanganye ariko Ijambo ry' Imanaryarasohoye " .
Pasiteri kalisa kandi yibukije abumva hari aho bari bamaze gutentebuka ko bakwibuka n' ibyo Imana yakoreye Elizabeti na Zakariya bakabyara bashaje .
Ubusanzwe abantu benshi bakunda ubuhanuzi kuko baba bashaka kumva icyo Imana ibavugaho bityo bigatuma rimwe na rimwe banakunda ubuhanuzi , iyo ubuhanuzi buturutse ku Mana koko bituma ububwiwe wese atiheba iyo ahuye n' ibimugeregeza kandi si ibya no mu gihe cyo hambere Imana yavuganaga n' abantu ikabakomeza imitima .
Bamwe mu banyeshuri ba CEP UR Huye Campus 5 total views , 5 views today 2017 - 02 - 18 Donat Niyitanga Share !

Mutesi Jolly yabuze umwanya wo kuzahagararira u Rwanda muri Malaysia Yanditswe na Dusabimana Aimable Kuya 4 Werurwe 2017 saa 10 :
06 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
6 0 Nyampinga w' u Rwanda umwaka wa 2016 , Mutesi Jolly , yabuze umwanya wo kuzajya guhagararira u Rwanda mu irushanwa rya Miss United Countries riteganyijwe kubera muri Malaysia .
Mu ntego z' iri rushanwa rya Miss United Countries harimo guhuza ba Nyampinga bakomoka mu bihugu bitandukanye ku Isi , hagamijwe kwagura iterambere ryabo , gusangira ubunararibonye mu gushaka ubumwe bw' ibihugu n' ibindi bitandukanye .
Nubwo amatora y' abahatanye muri Miss United Countries yatangiye gukorerwa kuri internet , mu kiganiro Miss Mutesi Jolly yagiranye na IGIHE , yavuze ko bitewe n' ibintu byinshi arimo n' ibyo ari gutegura bigoranye ko yazaryitabira .
Yagize ati " Biracyari mu nzira ntabwo turabitegura neza [ … ] Baduhaye ubutumire mu mwaka ushize , gusa bitewe n' ibintu byinshi ndimo , njyewe biragoye ko nanajyayo . "
Asobanura impamvu yumva bimugoye kuba yakwitabira iri rushanwa , yagize ati " Ni inshingano nyinshi , mfite ishuri , mfite imishinga yanjye ndimo gutegura , mfite akazi gashyashya [ … ] Ni ibintu byinshi bidashobora kunyemerera ko njyayo ariko ibyo ari byo byose hari umukandida uzaturuka mu Rwanda . "
Mutesi Jolly yakomeje avuga ko muri iki gihe ari kwitegura gutangira gufata amasomo ya kaminuza , byiyongera ku nshingano z' akazi yahawe n' ikompanyi y' indege ya RwandAir , nk' uko byemejwe mu birori byo gutora Nyampinga mushya ahererekanya ikamba na Iradukunda Elsa wamusimbuye .
Umuyobozi wa Rwanda Inspiration BackUp , Ishimwe Dieudonne , yabwiye IGIHE ko abashyizeho iryo rushanwa ' hari ibintu bari gutegura ' bataratangira mu buryo buhamye , yongeraho ko hari ibyo bakiganiraho na bo .
Uyu mukobwa ngo nta mwanya afite wo kuzaserukira u Rwanda muri iri rushanwa Yagize ati " Jolly ashobora kutaryitabira cyangwa akaryitabira bitewe n' ibyo tukiri kuganira n' abariteguye .
Dushaka ko tubanza kubyigaho na bo tukanabiganiraho . "
Bimwe mu byaranze Mutesi Jolly akiri Nyampinga w' u Rwanda birimo kwitabira ibikorwa bihuza ba Nyampinga bo mu bihugu bitandukanye , anaba uwa mbere waserukiye u Rwanda mu irushanwa rya Miss World ubwo ryabaga ku nshuro ya 65 mu mpera z' umwaka ushize ndetse n' ibindi yagiye akora bijyanye n' imihigo yari yarihaye .
Yambitse ikamba rya Nyampinga w' u Rwanda Iradukunda Elsa watorewe kumusimbura mu birori byabereye mu ihema rinini rya ' Kigali Conference & Exhibition Village ' mu ijoro ryo ku wa 25 rishyira 26 Gashyantare 2017 .
Miss Iradukunda Elsa ni we wasimbuye Mutesi Jolly Gutora Miss United Countries kuri internet byatangiye Kwamamaza Kwamamaza Izindi nkuru wasoma Imyidagaduro Chris Brown yagarutse ku munabi avugwaho n' ibiyobyabwenge ashinjwa gukoresha 3 0 0 Imyidagaduro Britney Spears mu buryohe bw' urukundo n' umusore arusha imyaka 12 6 0 0 Imyidagaduro Inzu ya Michael Jackson yagabanyirijwe igiciro nyuma y' imyaka ibiri yarabuze umuguzi 5 0 0 Imyidagaduro Stromae uherutse guhagarika kuririmba yasubukuye ibikorwa by' umuziki mu bundi buryo 2 0 0 Inkuru ziheruka - Imyidagaduro Gasumuni yongeye gutegura igitaramo gikomeye cy' urwenya 03 / 03 / 17 - 11 :

Sudani y' Epfo : Ibiganiro by' amahoro byatangiye Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Minisitiri w' ububanyi n' Amahanga w' igihugu cya Ethiopia yatangaje ko kuri uyu wa gatanu tariki 02 Mutarama 2014 ibiganiro hagati y' impande zitavuga rumwe mu gihugu cya Sudani y' Amajyepfo byatangiye .
Aha bari berekeje mu gihugu cya Ethiopia aho bazaganirira Radio Ijwi ry' Amarika dukesha iyi nkuru itangaza ko abitabiriye ibiganiro bigamije guhosha imirwano imaze ibyumweru bitatu ihitana abantu muri Sudani y' Amajyepfo bageze muri iki gihugu kuwa gatatu ahagana mu ma saa kumi n' imwe na 40 ( 17h40 ) .
Yagize ati : " Ibiganiro hagati yabari ku ruhande rwa Perezida Salva Kiir nabari ku ruhande rw' uwo bahangene Riek Machar byatangiye " .
Uyu mu Minisitiri yatangaje ibihugu biri mu muryango wa IGAD byatangaje ko byiteguye gufasha aho byashoboka hose .
Kugeza ubu imirwano ishyamiranyije Perezida Kiir na Machar imaze gutwara ubuzima bw' abantu basaga 1000 n' aho abasaga ibihumbi 200 bamaze kuva mu byabo .
Imirwano ikaba igikomeje n' ubwo ibiganiro byatangiye .
Daniel MacIsaac , Umuvugizi w' Umuryango w' Abibumbye yatangaje ko abanyasudani y' Amajyepfo basaga ibihumbi 10 ari bo bamaze guhungira mu bihugu by' ibituranyi .

Kenya : Hoteli zikomeye zakodeshejwe n' abashinzwe umutekano wa Obama Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ubu muri Kenya hotel zose ziri Nairobi zicunzwe n' abashinzwe umutekano wa Obama .
Perezida Barack Obama wa USA atagerejwe muri Kenya mu minsi icumi iri imbere .
Biteganyijwe ko Obama azagera muri Kenya ari naho akomoka mu minsi icumi iri imbere Serena Hotel , Hotel InterContinental , Laico , Safari Park , Crowne Plaze , Holiday Inn , Norfolk , Sankara na Kempiski ni zimwe muri Hotel ubu ziri gucungwa n' abashinzwe umutekano wa Obama bamaze kuzikodesha zose .
President Obama azaba ari muri Kenya ku italiki ya 24 , uku kwezi mu nama mpuzamahanga ya ba rwiyemezamirimo izitabirwa n' abantu 3 , 000 .
Kugeza ubu nta muntu n' umwe uzi Hotel Obama azacumbikirwamo .
Abantu bakomeye basuye Kenya barimo Vice - President Joe Biden na Hillary Clinton bakunze gucumbikirwa muri Hotel InterContinental ariko ubu ntawe uzi niba nawe ariyo azacumbikirwamo .
Inama izakurikiranwa n' abanyamakuru 150 barimo 20 bazaza baherekeje Obama ubwe .
Abashinzwe umutekano wa Obama bamaze kugeza muri Kenya imodoka azagendamo ubwo azaba ari mu ruzinduko rwe .
Ubu bamaze kuhageza imbwa zizi kumenya ahateze ibisasu kugira ngo umutekano wa Obama uzabe ari ntamakemwa nk' uko Nairobi News yabyanditse .
Ibiro bya USA bishinzwe ububanyi n' amahanga bivuga ko kuri gahunda biteganyijwe ko Obama azasura pariki yitwa Nairobi National Park .

Bumbogo : Ikibazo cy' amazi cyari cyarabaye akari aha kajyahe cyakemutse Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Nyuma yo kwinuba no kwijujuta by' abaturage bo mu Murenge wa Bumbogo , Akarere ka Gasabo kubera kutagira amazi meza , kuri uyu wa 29 Nyakanga ikibazo cyabo cyakemutse .
Abaturage bagiye kujya bakura amazi hafi .
Amazi yari asanzwe yarabaye akari aha kajyahe Abaturage bahawe umuyoboro w' amazi wa kilometero 17 watwaye miliyoni zisaga maga cyenda ( 900 000 0000 Frws ) , wubatswe ku bufatanye n' abaturage .
Abatuye Umurenge wa Bumbogo n' ibyishimo byinshi bashimiye ubuyobozi bw' igihugu muri rusange kuko ngo ubwabanje butigeze bwita ku kibazo cyabo .
Umuturage witwa Uwiduhaye Theodore yatangarije Umuseke ko aho atuye kubona amazi byari ikibazo kuko ngo byabasabaga kujya kuvoma mu mu birometero bitatu , mu gihe kuyagura ijerikani bagucaga amafaranga 200 .
Ndizeye Willy umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Gasabo nawe mu ijambo yavuze yashimiye abaturage uruhare bagize bafatanya n' ubuyobozi kwikemurira ibibazo .
Yagize ati " Iri ni itandukaniro ry' ubuyobozi , bari barabemereye amazi muri za 79 na n' ubu mwari mutarayabona ariko nyuma y' igihe gito mwongeye kuyemererwa mubonye ko imvugo ariyo ngiro . "
Akomeza abashishikariza gufata neza ibikorwa remezo bahawe no kubicungira umutekano kugira ngo hatazagira ubyononona kuko yaba ahemukiye abaturage bose babikoresha .
Umuyobozi w' Umujyi wa Kigali , Ndayisaba Fidel nawe wari witabiriye umuhango wo gufungura uyu muyoboro ku mugaragaro yibukije abaturage ko byose babikesha ubuyobozi bwiza .
Agira ati " Iki n' igihango mwahanye na Perezida wa repuburika kandi mubonye ko imvugo ariyo ngiro , izi ni impinduka zo kuva mu buzima bugoye mujya mubworoshye byose bikorwa kubera urukundo ubakunda si uwabasize mu bibazo by' ingutu akajya kuvugira i Bwotamasimbi , ubakunda n' uwemeye mukanambana . "
Umuyobozi w' Umujyi wa Kigali , Ndayisaba Fidel afungura uyu muyoboro w' amazi ku mugaragaro Aya mazi umurenge wa Bumbogo uhawe bayemerewe na Perezida Paul Kagame ubwo yahasorezaga gahunda yo kwiyamariza mu matora ya 2010 .
Aje asanga ibindi bikorwa remezo nk' umuriro w' amashanyarazi ahamaze imyaka ibiri .
Ubu ngo ikibazo basigaranye ni ukuvugurura imihanda ihuza uyu Murenge n' igice cy' Umujyi kugira ngo abaturage barusheho guhahirana .
Uretse uyu muyoboro w' amazi watashye , hanatashywe ku mugaragaro amazu yubakiwe abacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi batishoboye n' inzu y' icumbi ry' abarimu .
Nyuma abayobozi batandukanye bari bitabiriye uyu muhango nacinye akadiho hamwe n' abaturage bishimira ibikorwa remezo bamaze bamaze kugeraho Birori Eric UMUSEKE .

Nyabihu : Police yangije ibiyobyabwenge by' agaciro ka za miliyoni Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Polisi y' u Rwanda ikomeje irasaba abantu kutishora mu bikorwa byo gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge birimo urumogi n' ibindi , haba mu kubinywa no kubicuruza .
Iyi nama bayigiriwe nyuma y' uko hari ibyafatiwe mu karere ka Nyabihu bigizwe n' udupaki 22 5135 tw' inzoga itemewe yitwa Blue Sky , ibiro 137 by' urumogi , litiro 70 za kanyanga n' amacupa 85 y' ikinyobwa kitwa kalgazoke .
Police ubwo yangizaga ibi biyobyabwenge i Nyabihu Umuyobozi wa Polisi mu karere ka Nyabihu , Superintendent of Police ( SP ) Alex Fata yavuze ko uretse kuba bishobora gutera uburwayi ubinywa , amafaranga abishorwamo apfa ubusa kuko iyo bifashwe birangizwa kandi bagacibwa amande .
Yagize ati : " Nk' uko bivugitse , biriya byangijwe kimwe n' ibindi biyobya ubwenge bw' uwabinyoye maze agakora cyangwa akagira uruhare mu byaha birimo ubujura , urugomo , gufata ku ngufu , gusambanya abana , n' ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina . "
SP Fata yagize ati : " Ubinywa , uretse kumuteza ubukene we ku giti cye n' umuryango we , ahungabanya ituze ry' abo abana nabo ndetse n' abandi muri rusange , akaba ariyo mpamvu buri wese akwiye kutabinywa , kutabitunda no kutabicuruza , kandi agatanga amakuru ku gihe y' ababikora . "
Yagiriye inama abaturage yo kunywa no gucuruza ibintu byemewe n' amategeko no gukomeza gutanga amakuru ku gihe y' umuntu wese wakoze cyangwa utegura gukora ikintu cyose kinyuranyije n' amategeko .
Umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Nyabihu , Twahirwa Abdoulatif yashimiye Polisi y' u Rwanda ku bikorwa byayo , maze aha ubutumwa abaturage , bwo kwirinda kunywa no gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge kuko byangiza ubuzima bwabo kandi n' ababiguze bakaba bazajya bahomba kuko Polisi iri maso mu kubihashya burundu .

Rusizi : Inkuba yakubise abagabo babiri nta mvura iri kugwa Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa kabiri abagabo babiri umwe uvuka i Nyamasheke undi i Rusizi bakubiswe n' inkuba ubwo bariho babaaza ( kubaaza ) mu murenge wa Nkungu .
Umwe yahise ahasiga ubuzima , byatangaje benshi kuko imvura yari itaranagwa , gusa hari imirabyo ya hato na hato .
Aba bagabo ni uwitwa Timothée Nzabobimpa wo mu murenge wa Rusizi na Theophile Habimana wo mu karere ka Nyamasheke , Timothée niwe wahise Yuma arapfa , naho Theophile agwa igihumure ajyanwa kuri Poste de Sante iri hafi ngo agarure ubuyanja .
Vincent de Paul Nsengiyumva Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w' Umurenge wa Nkungu yavuze ko ibi biza by' inkuba bikunze kwibasira cyane uyu murenge .
Ati " Aba bagabo babiri bariho babaaza bakubiswe n' inkuba nta n' imvura igwa gusa hari imirabyo ya hato na hato nkaho imvura igiye kugwa .
Ubusanzwe twigisha abaturage uburyo bwo kwirinda inkuba nicyayikurura cyose " Aka gace gakunze kurangwamo inkuba nyinshi zijya zinahitana ubuzima bw' abaturage , aba bagahora basabwa kwirinda kugama munsi y' ibiti no kwirinda gukora kubikoresho bikoreshwa n' amashanyarazi mu gihe cyose imvura igwa .
Mu karere ka Rusizi Francois Nelson NIYIBIZI UMUSEKE .

Ubufaransa bushobora kuzakomeza guhakana Jenoside muri manda itaha Mu gihe François Fillon yaramuka atorewe kuyobora Ubufaransa muri manda y' imyaka itanu iri imbere , icyo gihugu cyakomeza kurangwa n' ibitekerezo bipfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda , kuko umujyanama wa Fillon yongeye guhakana uruhare rw' Ubufaransa muri Jenoside , akanemeza ko habaye Jenoside ebyiri .
Bernard Debré umujyanama wa François Fillon ( photo internet ) Ibi byavuzwe na Bernard Debré , wahoze ari minisitiri ushinzwe ubutwererane mu Bufaransa muri 1994 na 1995 , ubu akaba ari umujyanama wa François Fillon mu birebana na politiki ya Afurika .
Uyu Bernard Debré yabwiye ikinyamakuru Jeune Afrique ko ntawe ukwiye gushinja Ubufaransa uruhare na rumwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda kubera ko nta kibi Ubufaransa bwakoze mu bihe bya Jenoside .
Muri icyo kiganiro na Jeune Afrique , Bernard Debré yavugaga ko hari ibyo mu mateka y' Ubufaransa na Afurika abantu badakwiye gutindaho , kuko byataye igihe .
Umunyamakuru wa Jeune Afrique ati « Mu mateka ya vuba aha ariko hari ibyo Ubufaransa bwagizemo uruhare kandi bikiri bibisi .
Ku bwawe hari uruhare ubona leta y' Ubufaransa yaragize muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda ? "
Atajijinganyije , bwana Bernard Debré yagize ati " Ntabyo .
Nta byaha Ubufaransa bwakoze muri Jenoside , nta n' ubwo bishoboka ko ingabo z' Ubufaransa zari mu Rwanda zaba zarafashije uruhande rw' Abahutu bakoraga Jenoside .
Ibyo ntabyo nemera . "
Ingabo z' Ubufaransa zivugwa , ni izoherejwe mu Rwanda mu gikorwa bise " Operation Turquoise " bavugaga ko zije mu bikorwa byo gutabara abicwaga muri Jenoside , nyamara zikaba zarijanditse mu bikorwa byo gutiza umurindi abakoraga Jenoside , ndetse bamara no gutsindwa izo ngabo zikabakingira ikibaba bahunga bajya hanze y' igihugu .
Bernard Debré wemera ko mu Rwanda habaye Jenoside , yagaragaye muri icyo kiganiro nk' uwemera ko mu Rwanda habaye Jenoside ebyiri kuko yavuze ko " … Abahutu bishe Abatutsi , ariko nyuma , Abatutsi nabo bakaba barishe Abahutu mu bikorwa byo kwihorera … " Debré afite icyemeza ko Jenoside itatewe n' ihanurwa ry' indege ya Habyarimana Muri iki kiganiro , Debré yemereye Jeune Afrique ko na mbere ya Jenoside perezida Yuvenali Habyarimana ubwe yamubwiye ko mu Rwanda hategurwaga " amahano " .
Aha Bernard Debré yagize ati " Ubwo nahuraga na Perezida Habyarimana yambwiye ko mu gihugu cye hari hagiye kuba ibintu by' amakuba byategurwaga n' uruhande rumwe rw' abahezanguni kandi Habyarimana yambwiraga ko atari agishoboye kubuza abo bantu umugambi wabo mubisha . "
Kuva ingabo zari iza FPR Inkotanyi zihagaritse Jenoside yakorerwaga Abatutsi mu 1994 , hakomeje kugaragazwa ibimenyetso bishinja ingabo z' Ubufaransa kuba zaragize uruhare mu gushyigikira leta yateguye Jenoside ikanayishyira mu bikorwa .
Ubufaransa ariko buhora bubihakana n' ubwo hari bamwe mu basirikari bari mu Rwanda icyo gihe bajya batanga amakuru y' ibikorwa bimwe na bimwe bishimangira urwo ruhare .
Mu mwaka ushize wa 2016 , Komisiyo y' u Rwanda ishinzwe kurwanya Jenoside yashyize ahagaragara urutonde rw' abayobozi 22 bakomeye muri politiki no mu gisirikari cy' Ubufaransa bagize uruhare muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi .
Aba ngo bashobora kuzagezwa imbere y' ubutabera igihe icyo ari cyo cyose .
Bernard Debré wize iby' ubuvuzi akaba ari umuganga wazobereye mu kuvura indwara z' imitsi , yabaye minisitiri ushinzwe ubutwererane bw' Ubufaransa n' ibindi bihugu hagati ya 12 Ugushyingo 1994 na 11 Gicurasi 1995 .
Kuri ubu ni umudepite mu nteko ishinga amategeko y' Ubufaransa akaba ari n' umujyanama wihariye wa François Fillon wiyamamariza kuyobora Ubufaransa .
François Fillon wiyamamariza kuyobora Ubufaransa ( photo internet ) Amatora François Fillon yiyamamariza azaba kuwa 23 Mata no kuwa 7 Gicurasi uyu mwaka , akaba ari umwe mu bahabwa amahirwe yo kuzatsinda akaba perezida w' Ubufaransa muri manda itaha izamara imyaka itanu .

Ese Padiri Nahimana ntiyaba yatinye ibirego by' umuryango Ibuka ?
Ubushize umuryango Ibuka wari watangaje ko akwiye kubazwa ibyaha akekwaho byo gupfobya Jenoside Umuryango urengera inyungu z' abarokotse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ( IBUKA ) wasabye ko Padiri Nahimana Thomas nagera mu Rwanda akurikiranwa n' ubutabera .
Nahimana umaze imyaka 11 mu buhungiro mu Bufaransa yamenyekanye cyane kubw ' urubuga rwe Leprophete . fr rwanyuzwagamo ibitekerezo binenga ubuyobozi buriho mu Rwanda .
Hari abavuga ko bimwe mu byacishwaga kuri urwo rubuga birimo amagambo apfobya akanahakana Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi .
Prof Dusingizemungu Jean Pierre , Umuyobozi wa IBUKA yabwiye itangazamakuru ko bimwe mu byandikwaga ku kinyamakuru cya Nahimana bipfobya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi , agasaba ko yagezwa mu butabera naramuka ageze mu Rwanda .
Yagize ati " Ziriya nyandiko abantu bakwiriye kuzireba hanyuma inzego z' ubutabera zigakora .
Ariko tukanavuga duti turanifuza yuko inzego zose zafatanya , na Kiliziya gatolika ubwayo ntihere gusa mu kuvuga ngo twamaganye , tugize dute .
Kiliziya ubwayo ifite inzego zireba nuko ikora ubutabera bwayo yewe ifite n' inkiko burya . "
IBUKA kandi yasabye n' ubutabera mu Rwanda gukora akazi kabwo hirindwa uwashaka gukingira ikibaba Nahimana .
Dusingizemungu ati " Hari amategeko u Rwanda rugenderaho no kuri ibyo ngibyo avugwaho , ubutabera nibukoreshe ubushishozi bwabwo n' ubwigenge bwabwo .
Twe icyo twifuza nuko bikorwa atavuga ngo akingiwe ikibaba n' urwego uru n' uru , hanyuma ubutabera niba hari icyo bumubaza bubimubaze kuko atari hejuru y' amategeko .
Ntabwo yakwitwaza ko ari umupadiri cyangwa ikindi cyose " Ubutabera bukora iyo hari uwabushyikirije ikirego .
Prof Dusingizemungu yavuze ko bakiri kwiga ku nyandiko zacishijwe mu kinyamakuru cya Nahimana , ngo " igihe tuzabona ko amakuru ahagije tuzakora ibyo tugomba gukora . "
Padiri Nahimana w' imyaka 45 , yari kuza mu Rwanda kwiyamamaza ku izina ry' ishyaka Ishema Party yashinze mu mwaka wa 2013 .
Akaba yashakaga no kuryandikisha kugira ngo ryemererwe gukorera mu Rwanda .

Abagore ku isonga rya ba kabuhariwe mu gucuruza inzoga zitemewe mu gihugu Yanditswe na IGIHE Kuya 16 Gashyantare 2017 saa 07 :
43 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
0 0 Polisi y' u Rwanda ikorera mu Karere ka Musanze na Gatsibo , kuwa Kabiri tariki ya 14 Gashyantare yafashe abantu batandatu barimo babiri bafatiwe muri Musanze binjizaga inzoga zitemewe mu Rwanda , n' abandi bane bafatiwe muri Gatsibo bafite udupfunyika tw' urumogi .
Abafatiwe muri Musanze ni umugore w' imyaka 23 wafatanywe amapaki 192 y' inzoga itemewe gucuruzwa mu Rwanda ya Blue Sky , n' undi w' imyaka 30 , we akaba yari afite amaduzeni atatu ya Blue Sky .
Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu Ntara y' Amajyaruguru IP Innocent Gasasira , yavuze ko aba bagore bari hamwe n' abandi bagenzi mu modoka yavaga mu Karere ka Musanze yerekeza mu ka Rubavu .
Yavuze ati " Polisi y' u Rwanda ikorera mu Karere ka Musanze yari ifite amakuru ko aba bagore binjije izi nzoga zitemewe mu Rwanda muri iyi modoka berekeje muri Rubavu , nibwo bashyizeho bariyeri ihageze barayisaka bazisangamo , niko guhita bafatwa , ubu bakaba bafungiye kuri sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Busogo . "
IP Gasasira yakomeje avuga ati " Bimaze kugaragara ko abagore aribo benshi basigaye bishora mu bucuruzi bw' izi nzoga zitemewe .
Turabasaba kubuvamo kuko ubucuruzi butemewe ubwo aribwo bwose iyo ufashwe urahomba kandi ugacibwa n' amande . "
Yasabye abantu bose gukora ubucuruzi bwemewe n' amategeko kuko ubukora nta ngaruka ahura nazo .
Mu Karere ka Gatsibo ho hafatiwe umugabo w' imyaka 41 , undi wa 23 , uwa 27 n' uwa 22 , bakaba bafatanywe udupfunyika 304 tw' urumogi , ubu bakaba bafungiye kuri sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Kiramuruzi .
Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu ntara y' Uburasirazuba IP Emmanuel Kayigi , yavuze ko abaturage babahaye amakuru ko hari umwe mu baturage utuye mu kagari ka Rubona Umurenge wa Kiramuruzi ucuruza urumogi , kandi ko hari abantu bagiye kurugurayo , nibwo Polisi yagiyeyo ihasanga aba uko ari bane , bahasanga na turiya dupfunyika twarwo .
Yasabye abaturage gukora akazi kemewe aho kwangiza ubuzima bw' abantu bataretse n' ubwabo .
Ati " Iyo ucuruza cyangwa ukanywa ibiyobyabwenge uhomba kabiri ; urafungwa ikindi abantu bagufata nk' aho nta kamaro ufitiye umuryango nyarwanda . "
Yashimiye abaturage batanze amakuru ngo aba bagizi ba nabi bafatwe , asaba n' abandi kwihutira gutanga amakuru y' icyahungabanya umutekano kuko nta ngaruka zibamo .
Ingingo ya 594 yo mu gitabo cy' amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda ivuga ko umuntu ukoresha ibiyobyabwenge n' urusobe rw' imiti ikoreshwa nka byo bitemewe n' amategeko ahanishwa igifungo kiri hagati y' imyaka 3 kugera kuri 5 n' ihazabu y' amafaranga ibihumbi magana atanu kugera kuri miliyoni eshanu z' amafaranga y' u Rwanda .

Rubavu , Nyabihu , Ngororero na Rutsiro naho ba gitifu benshi beguye Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Nyuma y' uko kuri uyu wa gatatu abanyamabanga nshingwabikorwa b' Imirenge igera kuri irindwi beguye mu turere twa Nyamasheke ( 5 ) na Rusizi ( 2 ) beguye ku mirimo yabo , amakuru agera k' Umuseke muri iki gitondo ni uko abandi bayobozi b' Imirenge mu turere twa Rubavu , Nyabihu , Ngororero na Rutsiro naho beguye ku mirimo yabo .
Mu turere twa Rutsiro , Ngororero , Nyabihu na Rubavu haravugwa abayobozi b' imirenge beguye Aba bayobozi beguye cyangwa begujwe mbere y' amasaha macye ngo inama y' igihugu y' Umushyikirano itangire , iyi nama ikaba ari imwe mu nama nkuru zisuzuma ku bibabazo bivugwa mu miyoborere kugera ku nzego zo hasi , aho abayobozi babazwa ku mikorere yabo mu buryo butaziguye ndetse n' abaturage bahawe ijambo .
Umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Rubavu waje i Kigali mu nama y' Umushyikirano we yatangaje ko abo yasize ku buyobozi bw' Akarere bamumenyesheje ko kuri uyu wa gatatu bakiriye amabaruwa ane y' abanyamabanga nshingwabikorwa b' imirenge ine basaba guhagarika imirimo yabo .
Abo ngo ni Abanyamabanga nshingwabikorwa ni ab' umurenge wa Kanzenze witwa Kabera Eric , Haguma Pascal wayoboraga Umurenge wa Kanama , Clarisse Manizabayo wayoboraga uwa Rubavu na Sebikari Munyanganizi Jean wayoboraga Umurenge wa Nyamyumba .
Umuyobozi w' akarere ka Rubavu Jeremie Sinamenye avuga ko nabo byabatunguye kuko ntacyo bakekaga ko aba bayobozi bakwegura .
Mu karere ka Nyabihu ho abayobozi b' imirenge ya Mukamira , Jenda , Rurembo , Shyira na Rambura nabo beguye .
Mu karere ka Ngororero heguye umuyobozi w' Umurenge umwe w' Umurenge wa Nyange , uyu ngo yeguye avuga ko ari impamvu ze bwite .
Hari amakuru agera k' Umuseke ko no mu turere twa Rutsiro naho heguye Bitegetsimana Evariste wari Umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w' Umurenge wa Murunda ngo weguye ku mpamvu ze bwite .
Umuseke wagerageje kuvugana n' abayobozi b' utu turere kugeza ubu bikaba bitarashoboka .
Intara y' Iburengerazuba imaze iminsi ihawe umuyobozi mushya Guverineri Alphonse Munyantwali .
Turakomeza gukurikirana iyi nkuru … UMUSEKE .

Ikindi ni uko nabo ari abakozi ba Leta bagengwa n' amategeko y' abakozi ba Leta ariko uku kuntu bisezerera cyangwa bagasezererwa nk' abakozi umenya uko ibintu byanditse atari ko bikora .
Nashyugumbwaga kwerekera mu nzego z' ibanze ariko ndabona nta security iriyo reka nigumire aho nari ndi nzarya duke noze akarenge ndyame kare nibucya nigire mu misa da !

Nokia igiye gusubiza ku isoko telefoni yakanyujijeho izwi nka ' Bagorebeza ' Yanditswe na Umwali Zhuri Kuya 15 Gashyantare 2017 saa 11 :
59 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
4 0 Nokia , Ikompanyi yo muri Finland ikora telefoni zigendanwa igiye gusubiza ku isoko imwe mu zakanyujijeho mu Rwanda mu myaka ya 2005 yari izwi nka ' Bagorebeza ' .
Nokia 3310 yamamaye nka Bagorebeza yashyizwe ku isoko bwa mbere tariki ya 1 Nzeri 2000 , yari izwiho kubika umuriro ku buryo mu gihe yari igezweho mu Rwanda , uyitunze yamaraga iminsi irindwi atarayishyira ku muriro .
Iyi telefoni ku isi hose yabashije gukundwa ku rwego rwo hejuru inayobokwa cyane ndetse ubu burambe bwa batiri yayo ni kimwe mu byo Nokia igiye kugenderaho iyisubiza ku isoko .
Iyi telefoni mu gihe yabicaga bigacika , wasangaga itunzwe n' abagore b' abasilimu cyane ab' i Kigali kandi iyo umugabo yayihaga umugore nk' impano yasigaraga amwirahira .
Nokia 3310 zamenyekanye nka ' Bagorebeza ' mu Rwanda , ni zimwe mu zakunzwe ku buryo bukomeye hamwe n' izindi zari zariswe Merci ' Cheri ' Inshya izajya ku isoko izaba igura ama - euro 59 asaga gato ibihumbi 50 by' amafaranga y' u Rwanda ndetse byitezwe ko ishobora kuzagurwa cyane n' abantu basanzwe bafite smartphone ariko bakeneye indi ya kabiri yo kwifashisha .
Muri uku kwezi mu nama yiga ku bijyanye na Telefoni , Mobile World Congress , izabera i Barcelone muri Espagne kuva kuwa 27 Gashyantare kugera kuya 2 Werurwe 2017 nibwo ibya Bagorebeza bizatangazwa .
Nokia yagowe cyane no kwinjira mu isi ya telefoni zigezweho kubera inkundura y' andi makompanyi akomeye nka Apple na Samsung byatumye igurwa na Microsoft ya Bill Gates ihita itangira gushyira ku isoko izizwi nka Lumia .
Gusa mu myaka ibiri ishize yakoze amateka igurisha telefoni ihendutse aho yakoze ubwoko bushya bwa Nokia 215 irimo na internet , hanyuma iyigurisha amadolari 29 asaga gato ibihumbi 20 by' amanyarwanda ikaba yarabikaga umuriro nibura iminsi 29 .
Iyi telefoni ikoranye porogaramu zirimo Opera Mini , Facebook Messenger , Twitter n' izindi .
Nokia 215 ni imwe muri telefoni zihendutse uru ruganda ruherutse gushyira ku isoko Telefoni za Nokia kuri ubu zicuruzwa n' ikompanyi yo muri Finland yitwa HMD Global .
Mu minsi iri imbere , Nokia izashyira ahagaragara izindi telefoni zirimo Nokia 3 , 5 na 6 zose zizaba zigezweho gusa zizagumana umwihariko wo guhenduka .

Abaganga bo mu mujyi wa Nairobi biriwe mu myigaragambyo Abaganga bo mu mujyi wa Nairobi biriwe mu myigaragambyo Abaganga ba Nairobi bihaye imihanda kuri uyu wagatatu bigaragambya kubera ibrarane by' imishahara by' amezi agera kuri 6 Leta ibafitiye .
Hafi abaganga 250 b' inzobere bagize amashyirahamwe atandukanye y' abavuzi , abakora muri farumasi , abaganga b' amenyo n' abandi Bahagaritse akazi binubira itinda ry' imishara yabo banavuga ko Leta itabongerera umushahara ikananirwa kwemeza uduhimbaza musyi twabo yabemereye mu mezi 8 ashize .
Ibindi aba baganga bavugako baharanira ni ibyo kuba Leta itabaha imodo zibatwara ndetse ntinabasuzibe ibyo bakoresha mu ngendo zabo igihe bajye mu kazi dore ko ngo ntanamabaruwa abemerera gukora benshi muribo barahabwa .
Abaganga binzobere bigaragambya ni benshi Guveriniri wabonanye n' aba baganga Evans Kidero yabwiye aba baganga ko ibyo kubishyira biri munzira ko mu minsi mike baraba babonye amafaranga yabo " sinibaza imapamvu abaganga batinda kwishyurwa uwagize uruhare wese mu gutinda kwishyurwa kwabo azirukanwa " Governor Kidero . "
ndabizi ntimwishimye ariko ndabasabye mu subire ku kazi " Kuri uyu wambere nibwo amakuru yatangiye guhwihwiswa ko bashobora kureka akazi , nuko umwe mu bayobozi b' umujyi wa Nairobi Robert Ayisi yahise yihanganishije aba baganga abasaba gukomeza akazi ababwira ko ku kareka ari icyemezo kitubahirije amategeko .

Perezida Kagame yeretse amahanga intambwe y' u Rwanda mu ngendo z' ikirere Perezida w' u Rwanda Paul Kagame yeretse abitabiriye inama y' ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere I Kigali ko ibikorwa bya RwandAir n' ikibuga gishya cya Bugesera ari zimwe mu ntambwe u Rwanda ruri gutera mu bwikorezi bw' ikirere .
Mu nama iteraniye I Kigali yiga ku bwikorezi bw' ikirere niho Perezida yagaragarije ibibazo by' ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere muri Afurika .
Perezida yasabye abitabiriye iyi nama gukora ibishoboka byose Afurika ikazamuka muri uru rwego .
Perezida yavuze ko ibibazo n' amahirwe biri mu bwikorezi bwo mu kirere byose bizwi .
Ati : " Ibibazo Afurika ifite muri uru rwego birazwi , ariko n' amahirwe ahari mu gutwara abantu n' ibintu mu ndege ni menshi … .
tugomba gukora ibirenze ibyo dutegerejweho kugira ngo dushobore guhangana ku rwego rw' isi " Perezida Kagame ariko yeretse abitabiriye iyi nama yabereye muri Kigali Convetion center intambwe u Rwanda ruri gutera muri uru rwego harimo ikibuga gishya cy' indege cya Bugesera ndetse no kwagura ibikorwa kwa RwandAIR sosiyete nyarwanda ikora ubwikorezi bwo mu kirere .
Ati : " RwandAir ikomeje kongera ingendo mu bihugu bitandukanye muri Afurika n' ahandi hirya no hino ku Isi .
Turi mu bikorwa byo gushora imari no kwagura Ikibuga cy' Indege cya Kigali ndetse no kubaka ikibuga gishya mu Bugesera .
Turanakorana n' abandi hirya no hino muri Afurika ngo turusheho korohereza abifuza gushora imari muri uru rwego . "
U Rwanda ruherutse kugura indege 2 nini zo gukoresha RwandAIR yagure ingendo hirya no hino ku Isi .

Aflewo - Rwanda ku nshuro ya gatatu izabamo n' igikorwa cyo gusengera i gihugu Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ijoro ngaruka mwaka ryo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana rizwi nka " Aflewo ( Africa Lets Worship ) " rigiye kongera kugaruka , kuri iyi ncuro rizaba kuwa gatanu tariki ya 28 Werurwe 2014 , rikazabera i Nyarutarama ku rusengero rwa Christian Life Assembly .
Umuhuzabikorwa wa Aflewo mu Rwanda , Buntu Luc yadutangarije ko iki gikorwa gitegurwa n' abashinzwe kuramya no guhimbaza Imana mu matorero atandukanye mu Rwanda , aho bishyira hamwe bagasengera igihugu .
Ni ku ncuro ya gatatu iki gitaramo giteguwe kuko yatangiye mu mwaka wa 2011 , muri uyu mwaka kikaba cyarahawe insanganyamatsiko igira iti " Mana amaso yacu tuyahanze wowe " .
Buntu ati " Ubundi dufite intego yo kuzahuriza hamwe Abanyafurika ku buryo ijoro rimwe bazajya bafata umwanya bagasenga . "
Muri iki gikorwa hazahurizwa hamwe amatorero 25 , ndetse hazaba hanatumiwe abahanzi batandukanye bazwi mu ndirimbo zihimbaza Imana .
Aflewo yatangiye mu mwaka wa 2004 , itangijwe n' abanyeshuri bigaga muri Kaminuza mu gihugu cya Kenya biza kugenda bikwira mu bihugu bitandukanye , gusa ubu aho bitegurwa hose no mu Rwanda harimo nta ruhare Abanyakenya babigiramo .
Uko byari byifashe mu gitaramo cy' umwaka ushize .

I Gitwe bibutse abaganga , abarwayi n' abarwaza bazize Jenoside Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abakozi , abarwayi n' abarwaza bo mu bitaro bya Gitwe n' ikigo nderabuzima cya Gitwe biri mu karere ka Ruhango , umurenge wa Bweramana , akagari ka Murama bibutse abaganga , abarwayi n' abarwaza bazize Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu 1994 .
Ku rwibutso ahashyinguwe imibiri y' abapasitoro hashyizwe indabo .
Uyu muhango wo kwibuka wabereye muri centre ya Bienvenue ku rwibutso rushyinguyemo imibiri isaga 70 y' abapasitoro n' imiryango yabo bazize Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi .

Africa : Urukiko rw' Ikirenga rwatesheje agaciro ibyo kuva muri ICC Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Urukiko rw' Ikirenga muri Africa y' Epfo rwavuze ko umwanzuro wafashwe na Guverinoma ya kiriya gihugu wo kwivana mu bihugu byasinye amasezerano yo kuba mu Rukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha ( ICC ) nta shingiro ufite .
Ngo wagombaga kubanza kwemezwa n' Inteko ishinga amategeko mbere y' uko utangazwa .
Mu ukwakira umwaka ushize Africa y' Epfo yatangaje ko igomba kuva muri ICC kubera ko ngo ari urukiko rubereyeho guhana Abirabura gusa , ngo nta butabera rugira .
Urukiko rw' Ikirenga rwasabye Leta gukuraho uriya mwanzuro kuko ngo udashingiye ku itegeko nshinga .
Uru rukiko kandi rwavuze ko ibyo abatavuga rumwe na Leta bavuga by' uko Guverinoma ya Zuma yagombaga kubanza kubyemererwa n' Inteko ishinga amategeko bifite ishingiro .
Ibiro ntaramakuru by' Abongereza , Reuters , byemeza ariko ko Guverinoma yo ivuga ko itazava ku cyemezo cyayo .
Minisitiri w' ubutabera Michael Masutha yabwiye Reuters ati : "
Guverinoma izareba ibiyireba kuri iyi ngingo kandi mu buryo bwigenga . "
Kwivana muri ICC byatangiye muri 2015 ubwo Africa y' Epfo yangaga guta muri yombi Perezida wa Sudani Omar El Bashir wari wabasuye , ikavuga ko bitemewe gufata umukuru w' igihugu ukiri mu kazi .
Icyo gihe ubutegetsi bwa Zuma bwashinjwe gushyigikira umuntu washyiriwe impapuro mpuzamahanga zo kumuta muri yombi , ariko birakaza ubutegetsi bwe bahita batangira gahunda zo kwivana muri ICC .
Umwaka ushize kandi ibihugu nk' u Burundi na Gambia nabyo byavuze ko bigomba kuzivana muri ruriya rukiko ariko Perezida wa Gambia uherutse gutorwa Adama Barrow we yatesheje agaciro icyemezo cya Yahya Jammeh yasimbuye mu ntangiriro z' uyu mwaka .

Zimbabwe - « Abatsinzwe amatora nibashaka baziyahure … , » Mugabe Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Mu ijambo rye rya mbere kuva yakongera gutorerwa kuyobora Zimbabwe , Robert Mugabe yamaganye ibitangazwa n' ishyaka batavuga rumwe rya Movement for Democratic Cange ( MDC ) riyobowe na Morgan Tsvangirai bari bahanganye mu matora .
Perezida wa Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe ( Photo Internet ) Perezida Mugabe yamaganye ibitangazwa na Ministre w' intebe Morgan Tsvangirai wemeza ko itorwa rye ryaranzwe n' uburiganya bwinshi .
Ibivugwa kuri Mugabe yanatangaje ko bivugwa kugira ngo bamurwanye .
Ishyaka riharanira impinduka za demokarasi MDC , ryo ryatangaje ko ritemera ibikubiye mu ijambo rya Mugabe .
Iri shyaka ntiryahwemye gutangaza ko ibyavuye mu matora ari ubujura bukabije , rikaba ryaranifuje ko amatora yasubirwamo .
Tariki ya 31 Nyakanga , Robert Mugabe yatsinze amatora ku majwi 61 % na ho Tsvangirai aza ku mwanya wa kabiri n' amajwi 35 % mu gihe uwitwa Welshman Ncube yaje ku mwanya wa gatatu n' amajwi 3 % .
Zanu - PF , Ishyaka rya perezida Mugabe ni na ryo ryatsindiye imyanya myinshi mu nteko rikaba rifite ubwiganze bw' imyanya 160 muri 210 igize inteko .
Mu ijambo yavugiye mu muhango wo kuzirikana intwari zaburiye ubuzima bwazo mu ntambara yo kwibohora , yagarutse ku itorwa rye ; aho yemeje ko amatora yaranzwe n' umucyo ndetse anahamagarira abaturajye gukomeza kwishimira itorwa rye .
Yagize ati «Abatsinzwe amatora nibashaka baziyahure , nibumva ari byo bibakwiye ndetse nibanapfa imbwa ntizizarye imibiri yabo » .
Gusa muri iri jambo rye ntaho yigeze avuga izina rya Tsvangirai .
Morgan Tsvangirai witabiriye amatora ku nshuro ya mbere mu mwaka wa 2008 .
Imibare yashyizwe hanze igaragaza ko yatsinzwe amatora ariko , we yemeza ko yari yatsinze n' ubwo atabitangaje .
Ku nshuro ya kabiri Tsvangirai yumvaga ko yagombaga gutsinda amatora kuko nga yari yizeye abamushyigikiye .
Martin NIYONKURU Umuseke . rw Sangiza abandi iyi nkuru :

U Bubiligi : Ambasaderi Nduhungirehe yakanguriye Abanyarwanda kuzitabira amatora y' Umukuru w' Igihugu Yanditswe na Karirima A .
Ngarambe Kuya 20 Gashyantare 2017 saa 07 :
48 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
1 0 Ambasaderi w' u Rwanda mu Bubiligi , Olivier Nduhungirehe , yasoje ingendo mu mijyi itandukanye y' u Bubiligi aho yahuye akaganira n' Abanyarwanda bahatuye ku iterambere bamaze kugeraho n' imbogamizi bahura na zo .
Izi ngendo Ambasaderi Nduhungirehe yazitangiye tariki ya 1 Ukwakira 2016 , i Mons , mu Ntara ya Hainaut , akomereza mu Mujyi wa Charleroi , Grand Liège , Namur , Leuven , Frandre Occidental , Brabant Wallo , Anvers , azisoreza mu mujyi wa Bruxelles tariki ya 14 Mutarama 2017 .
Mu kiganiro cyihariye yagiranye na IGIHE , Amb .
Nduhungirehe yavuze ko yari yarabisezeranyije Abanyarwanda bo mu Bubiligi akigera muri iki gihugu nka Ambasaderi , ko bazaganira ku byo bamaze kugeraho n' imbogamizi bafite , ibishoboka bigashakirwa umuti .
Ati " Uko gahunda zagiye zikurikirana , twaricaraga tukaganira , tukungurana ibitekerezo , mu buryo busesuye , ufite ikibazo akakibaza kigahabwa igisubizo ako kanya . "
Abanyarwanda bo muri Diaspora Nyarwanda mu Bubiligi bifitemo ubukungu bwinshi bashobora gukoresha bakiteza imbere kandi banateza imbere igihugu cyabo , kubegera rero ngo byabaye imbarutso yo kubirebera mu ndorerwamo yo kubibyaza umusaruro no gukumira imbogamizi zabaho nk' uko Amb .
Nduhungirehe yakomeje abisobanura . "
Ibi biganiro mu Mijyi 10 byibanze ku ngingo zitandukanye zirimo serivisi bahabwa muri Ambasade yabo nk' Abanyarwanda , iki kikaba ari ikintu twagarutseho cyane . "
Nduhungirehe yagarutse no ku matora y' umukuru w' igihugu ateganyijwe mu Rwanda aho yongeye gukangurira abanyarwanda kuzayitabira ari benshi bakihitiramo umuyobozi ubabereye .
Ati " Gutora ni inshingano n' uburenganzira bwa buri munyarwanda kandi ni ishema kuko uba ugize uruhare mu guhitamo ukubereye mu buyobozi bw' igihugu cyawe . "
Ambasaderi Nduhungirehe mu kiganiro n' Umunyamakuru wa IGIHE , Karirima Aimable Ngarambe Hagarutswe kandi ku kwita ku bukungu mu gushora imari mu gihugu , gukora imishinga ibyara inyungu , gushyiraho amatsinda y' ishoramari , sosiyete y' ubucuruzi n' ibindi bikorwa bihuriweho n' abishyize hamwe bikabyazwa umusaruro rusange .
Amb . Nduhungirehe ubwo yasuraga umujyi wa Charleroi yatangaje ko yifuza ko mu Bubiligi hazaba mu minsi iri imbere icyiswe " Youth ' s Rwanda Day " mu rwego rwo kwereka urubyiruko birambuye aho u Rwanda rugeze n' aho rwifuza kugana kuko aribo Rwanda rw' ejo .
Amb . Nduhungirehe kandi yasabye ko kugira ngo ibikorwa biteganyijwe bigerweho neza bikwiye gukorera ku mihigo .
Ati " Mu Bubiligi habarizwa Abanyarwanda barenga ibihumbi 35 , turi benshi , twari dukwiye rwose kujyana n' ibikorwa by' intangarugero kurusha izindi Diaspora ziri hano .
Mubimfashemo twubake izina rikomeye nk' Abanyarwanda . "
Ku bijyanye n' umuco , Amb .
Nduhungirehe yavuze ko hagiye kwigwa hazongera gufungurwa inzu ndangamuco ( Centre culturel ) nk' uko yahozeho ikaza kurembera .
Ati " Ntibyumvikana ukuntu abanyarwanda bafite umubare urenga ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitanu tutagira inzu ndangamuco , ikorerwamo ibiganiro mbwirwaruhame , aho amatorero atozwa imbyino , umuco no kwiga ikinyarwanda yajya akorera kandi tukaba twanayibyaza inyungu . "

Yinjiza ibihumbi 500 ku kwezi kubera gusemurira abatumva n' abatavuga Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Irizabimbuto Fidele ni umusore w' imyaka 26 , yavukiye mu karere ka Ngoma ariko yibera i Kigali ku mpamvu z' akazi .
Uyu musore yatangarije Umuseke yinjiza hagati y' amafaranga y' u Rwanda ibihumbi 300 n' ibihumbi 500 ku kwezi kubera gusemura ururimi rw' ibimenyetso rukoreshwa n' abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona , kutavuga cyangwa kutumva .
Irizabimbuto Fidele abeshejweho neza no gusemura ururimi rw' abatumva n' abatavuga Irizabimbuto yize amashuri yisumbuye mu bijyanye n' Ubwubatsi , arangije ajya mu bijyanye no kwamamaza ubutumwa bw' Imana Yehova , dore ko yari umuhamya .
Aha mu idini ni ho yatangiye ibyo kwiga gusemura indimi z' abafite ubumuga bukomatanye mu rwego rwo kubasha kuvugana nabo akababwira ubutumwa bw' umwami Yehova .
Ibi rero ngo yaje kubizoberamo abona ko byamuviramo impano yazamuha umurongo w' ubuzima yifuza .
Yagize ati " Nasanze ibyo gusemura bifite akamaro cyane ndabikuza nk' umwuga birantunze .
Ibaze ubusanzwe ubutekinisiye bugira amafaranga menshi ariko nahisemo kubureka . "
Uyu musore asemura iyi mvugo y' ibimenyetso kuri Televiziyo y' u Rwanda , ngo iyo ateranyije umushahara n' ayo abona mu biraka bigera nibura hagati y' ibihumbi 300 na 500 ndetse ngo byagenze neza ku kwezi na miliyoni imwe ayigezaho ku kwezi .
Irizabimbuto afite impamyabumenyi y' Icyiciro cya mbere cya kaminuza mu by' Ubwubatsi ariko nyuma yaje gukomeza mu cyiciro cya kabiri mu bijyanye n' Itangazamakuru kubera iyo mpamvu y' ubusemuzi , amashuri ye yayarihiwe n' iyo mpano yo gusemura ibimenyetso bikoreshwa n' abafite ubumuga bukomatanye .
Agira inama urubyiruko yo kwiga izo ndimi kuko ngo ni amahirwe akomeye yo kubona akazi ariko kandi ngo birashoboka ko umuntu wo mu muryango yagira ikibazo cy' ubumuga bwamubuza kubona , cyangwa kutavuga akaba yamenya kuvugana n' abandi .
Mu Rwanda kwiga imvugo y' ibimenyetso birashoboka cyane kuko mu muryango w' abafite ubumuga bwo kutavuga bafasha ababishaka .
Irizabimbuto avuga ko amaze imyaka ine muri aka kazi , ndetse ngo arebye neza asanga ku muntu wiga ururimi rwo gusemura ibi bimenyetso byatwara amezi atandatu umuntu akaba afite ubumenyi bw' ibanze .
Uru rurimi ngo ni nk' izindi ndimi zose kuko rugira amategeko y' Ikibonezamvugo nk' uko n' izindi ziyagira .
HATANGIMANA Ange Eric ububiko .

Uganda : Igisirikare kiranyomoza ko Col Makenga yaba yasubiye muri DRC Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Igisirikare cya Uganda kiranyomoza ko uwahoze ari umuyobozi w' abarwanyi ba M23 , Col Sultani Makenga yaba yasubiye muri Congo nk' uko byavuzwe mu mpera z' icyumweru dusoje , kikavuga ko akiri mu gihugu cya Uganda yahungiyemo ndetse ko n' abarwanyi be bose baherereye mu gice cy' Uburengerazuba bw' iki gihugu .
Sultani Makenga yari umugaba w' ingabo za M23 zitaratsindwa Mu mpera z' icyumweru dusoje , muri Repubulika Iharanira Semokarasi ya Congo , hari amakuru yavugwaga ko Col Sultani Makenga wayoboraga M23 yaba yagarutse muri iki gihugu dore ko ngo hafi y' umupaka wa Uganda na DRC humvikanye urusaku rw' amasasu , bagakeka ko ari ingabo ze .
Guverineri wa Kivu ya Ruguru , Julien Paluku yari yatangaje ko ubuyobozi bwa Uganda butazi aho uyu musirikari aherereye , akavuga ko ashobora kuba yagarutse guhungabanya umutekano wa Congo .
Umuvugizi w' igisirikari cya Ugandam Paddy Ankunda yabwiye ibiro Ntaramakuru by' Abongereza , Reuters dukesha iyi nkuru ko aya makuru ari ibinyoma .
Ati " Makenga ari muri Kampala , na M23 bari muri Bihanga ( inkambi ya Gisirikare iri mu burengerazuba bwa Uganda ) . "
Uyu muvugizi wanyomozaga ibyatangajwe ko Makenga yasubiye muri DRC , yakomeje agira ati " Niba hari ufite amakuru atandukanye n' ibi natunyomoze . "
Avuga kandi ko Igisirikare cya Uganda kitigeze kigaba ingabo ku mupaka uhuza Uganda na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo .

Ubuhinde : Umugore munini kw' isi yakorewe ibizamini Gurugram ni ivuriro ryo mu mujyi wa Mumbai mu gihugu cy' Ubuhindi ryakoreye ibizamini umugore munini cyane kwisi Eman Ahmed wo mu gihugu cya Misiri .
Kuri uyu wa kane nibwo Emen Ahmed yakorewe ibizamini ku bijyanye ni misemburo yo mu mubiri we , ibyo bizamini byagaragaje ko igisubizo cyo kugabanuka ibiro kizaboneka hagati y' ibyumweru bine na bitandatu .
Eman Ahmed ufite ibiro 500 yajyanywe mu Buhinde kugirango abagwe kubice bimwe by' umubiri we kugirango ibiro bye bigabanuke .
Eman ahmed ni umugore ufite imyaka 36 y' amavuko ukomoka mu gihugu cya Misiri yari yazanwe mu Buhinde no kwivuza , ku wa Gatatu bamukoreye isuzuma basanga ntayindi miti akeneye uretse kubagwa .
Abaganga binararibonye bakomeje kumukorera ibizamini bitandukanye basanga mu maraso ye , yaravukanye ibibazo bitandukanye .
Muri ayo maraso ye basanzemo na none ubwoko bwa kabiri bwa diyabete , umuvuduko urenze w' amaraso ndetse n' indwara y' umutima .
Gusa icyiza nuko babonye ko naguma kwitabwaho ashobora kugira amahirwe yogutakaza ibiro bigera kuri 80 mu kwezi gutaha .
Isaac Mbitezimana WWW .

Diagne warokoye abantu muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ejo kwa kane , akanama k' umutekano k' umuryango w' Abibumbye kemeje ko hashyirwaho umudari witiriwe umusirikari w' umunyasenegale capitaine Mbaye Diagne wari mu ngabo zari mu butumwa bw' amahoro mu Rwanda ( MINUAR ) , muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 , kubera ubwitange yagaragaje mu rwego rwo kumuha icyubahiro .
Capitaine Mbaye Diagne wari mu ngabo zari mu butumwa bw' amahoro mu Rwanda ( MINUAR ) .
Mu itangazo , akanama k' umutekano k' umuryango w' abibumbye kasohoye rivuga ko gushyiraho uyu mudari witiriwe capitaine Mbaye Diagne ari ukugira ngo bamuhe icyubahiro ariko habeho no kuzirikana umurava udasanzwe w' abasirikare , abapolisi , abakozi b' umuryango w' abibumbye n' abafite aho bahuriye n' ibikorwa byawo bagaragaje umurava n' ubwitange bakemera kujya mu butumwa bw' amahoro bw' umuryango w' Abibumbye mu bice birimo ibibazo bikomeye bazi ko bashobora no kuhaburira ubuzima .
Ambasaderi Eugene Gasana , uhagarariye u Rwanda mu Muryango w' Abibumye yabwiye akanama k' umutekano ko muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi capt . Mbaye Diagne wari ufite imyaka 36 , umugore n' abana babiri , yagaragaje ubwitange budasanzwe arokora benshi , atitaye ku burakari na za bariyeri z' interahamwe .
Nyuma ariko tariki 31 Gicurasi 1994 , Capt . Diagne yaje gupfa ahitanywe n' igisasu cyafashe imodoka y' ivatiri yarimo .
Umunyacanada Général Roméo Dallaire wari uyoboye MINUAR avuga ko Cpt .
Diagne yagiraga umurava cyane muri byose .
Uko uyu mudari uzaba uteye bizagaragarizwa akanama k' umuryango w' abibumbye mu mezi atandatu ari imbere , hanyuma hashyirweho uko abantu bahubwa bazajya batoranywa n' ibizajya bikurikizwa .

Mugabe ati " hari abo mu ishyaka ryanjye bashaka ko mpfa , hari n' abagerageza kundoga " Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Perezida wa Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe w' imyaka 92 muri week end yavuze noneho ku kuba yajya mu kiruhuko cy' izabukuru .
Gusa ati " ariko niba nanakijyamo nibareke nkijyemo neza . "
Robert Mugabe ababajwe n' abadashaka ko yigira muzabukuru neza Yabibwiraga abandi ba ' sekombata ' hafi 400 baharaniye ubwigenge bwa Zimbabwe hamwe na we bo ubu bari kuruhuka kubera izabukuru nk' uko bivugwa na Reuters .
Mugabe yanenze bamwe mu baba mu ishyaka rye rya Zanu - PF ngo bahora bamwifuriza urupfu ndetse ngo bakagerageza kumuroga kugira ngo apfe bamusimbure .
Muri Zimbabwe hari intambara bucece y' abantu benshi bashaka kuzasimbura uyu mukambwe babona nk' uri mu bihe bya nyuma .
Gusa si ubwa mbere Mugabe avuze kubyo kuva ku butegetsi kuko mu 2006 yari yatangaje ko mu 2008 atari bwiyamamaze mu matora yahabaye , gusa yariyamamaje cyane ndetse atsinda mu buryo bw' impaka zikomeye .
Ntawe uzi igihe uyu mukambwe azavura ku butegetsi kuko muri iyi week end inama rusange ya Zanu - PF yateranye yashyigikiye ko Mugabe azarihagararira mu matora ya Perezida ateganyijwe mu 2018 .
Azaba ageze ku myaka 94 y' amavuko .
Mu kwezi gutaha nibwo iri shyaka rizemeza burundu ko uyu musaza azarihagararira mu matora .

Reba ifoto yavugishije benshi amagambo Safi ari mu bwiherero umenye n' icyo ayivugaho .
Mu minsi ishize nibwo Safi Madiba umwe mu bagize itsinda rya Urban boys yashyize ifoto ku rubuga rwe rwa Instagram imugaragaza yicaye mu bwiherero , mu ntoki afite urupapuro rw' isuku rwo mu bwiherero .
Ifoto ya Safi Madiba yavugishije benshi Iyi foto ikaba yaraje gutuma abantu benshi batayivugaho rumwe , bamwe babwira Safi ko ibyo yakoze adakwiye kubikora nk' umuntu wamenyekanye kandi ufite abakunzi batari bake .
Gusa nawe akaba yagize icyo asobanura kuri iyi foto .
Mu kiganiro na KT idols Safi yavuze ko iyi foto yashyize ku rukuta rwe ntacyo itwaye kandi ko ari ibintu bisanzwe asobanura ko yayifashe mu gikorwa baribarmo icyo gihe cyijyanye no gutunganya amashusho y' indirimbo yabo nshyashya yitwa Adam na Eve aho akomeza avuga ko kariya gace kazagaragara mu mashusho y' indirimbo ariko ko ubwiherero nyirizina ndetse na ruriya rupapuro rw' isuku aba afite bitazagaragara .
Avuga ku bantu bamubwiye nabi kuba yarshyize iriya foto ku karubanda , yavuzeko ubwiherere ari ikintu gisanzwe kandi kizwi na buri wese ndeste yemeza ko ntakosa ririmo kuba yarabikoze kuko ubwiherere ari ahantu buri wese akoresha buri munsi , urupapuro rw' isuku abantu bose bakaba baruzi .
Kuba ubwiherero ari ahantu umuntu ajya ari wenyine agakora ibyo akora ntabantu bamureba , Safi avuga ko nawe ku ifoto atagaragara yambaye ubusa ku buryo byafatwa nk' aho yakoze amahano .
Madiba akomeza avuga ko ntakindi kintu kidasanzwe yumva kirimo ahubwo ko byabaye mu buryo bwogukora amashusho y' indirimbo yafashe kariya gace akakerekana kuriya .

Buteera Andrew agiye kuvurizwa muri Maroc Yanditswe na Jah d' eau Dukuze Kuya 11 Gashyantare 2017 saa 07 :
13 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
0 0 Umukinnyi wo hagati w' ikipe ya APR FC ndetse n' ikipe y' igihugu Amavubi , Buteera Andrew , ni we utahiwe kwerekeza mu gihugu cya Maroc kuvurwa imvune amaranye iminsi , yakuye mu mikino ibanza ya shampiyona y' icyiciro cya mbere .
Ubuyobozi bw' ishyirahamwe ry' umupira w' amaguru mu Rwanda Ferwafa , butangaza ko Andrew Buteera yasabiwe gahunda yo kuvuzwa ubwo perezida wa Ferwafa Nzamwita Vincent De Gaulle yabonaniraga na mugenzi we wa Maroc , Lekjaa Fouzi mu gikombe cya Afurika cyabereye muri Gabon , maze bakemeza ko uyu musore azitabwaho n' abaganga hagati y' amatariki ya 18 Gashyantare na 7 Werurwe 2017 .
Buteera Andrew yunze mu rya Djamar na we akaba agiye kubagirwa muri Marooc Buteera wavunikiye mu ikipe ya APR FC , azabagirwa muri Maroc tariki ya 20 Gashyantare gusa akazaguma muri iki gihugu yitabwaho n' inzobere z' abaganga , zirangajwe imbere na Dr Abderrazak Hifti usanzwe avura ikipe y' igihugu .
Uyu ngo nyuma y' ibyumweru bibiri ( 7 / 3 / 2017 ) , ni bwo azagaruka mu Rwanda nkuko Ferwafa ibitangaza .
Andrew Buteera , akaba yiyongereye ku mubare w' abandi bakinnyi bakinana muri APR FC bavuriwe muri Maroc , barimo Mwiseneza Djamar na Twizerimana Onesme kuri ubu batangiye gukina bisanzwe , mu gihe Itangishaka Blaise agikurikiranwa n' abaganga .
Mu bandi bavuriwe muri Maroc mu minsi ya vuba kandi , harimo Muhire Kevin wa Rayon Sports na we watangiye gukina , cyo kimwe na Evode Ngabotsinze w' Isonga .
Biturutse ku bufatanye bwa Ferwafa n' Ishyirahamwe ry' imikino muri Maroc , hamaze kuvurwa abakinnyi benshi bakina mu Rwanda barimo Faustin Usengimana ukinira APR FC , icyo gihe abagwa yakiniraga Rayon Sports , Pacifique Uwimana wakiniraga Isonga FC , Ssentongo Farouk wa Bugesera FC , ( icyo gihe yakiniraga APR FC ) , Ndoli Jean Claude wa AS Kigali ( yakiniraga APR FC ) , Sebanani Emmanuel ' Crespo ' wa AS Kigali aho bose bagiye bakira neza , bakanagaruka mu kibuga .
Twizerimana Onesme , kuri ubu ari kumwe na bagenzi be muri Zambia , nyuma yo kubagirwa muri Marooc agakira Kwamamaza Kwamamaza Izindi nkuru wasoma Imikino Infatino uyobora FIFA ategerejwe mu Rwanda 2 0 0 Imikino Zanaco FC yifitiye icyizere gikomeye cyo kutazasezererwa na APR FC 0 0 Imikino Champions League :

Amatsiko ni yose ku biva mu matora muri Tanzania Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Biteganyijwe ko ibyavuye mu matora muri Tanzania mu buryo bw' agateganyo bitangazwa kuri uyu wa mbere , amatsiko ni yose hagati y' abashyigikiye ishyaka Chama Cha Mapinduzi ( CCM ) riri ku butegetsi ryamamaje John Pombe Magufuri na CHADEMA ryo ku rundi ruhande rifite umukandida Edward Lowasa .
Aba nibo bahanganye cyane .
Abantu benshi cyane mu karere bategereje kumenya uzasimbura Jakaya Kikwete .
Nyuma yo gutora kuri iki cyumweru , uyu arerekana ko yarangije gutora .
Photo / BBC Africa Eward Lowasa aherutse gutangaza ko bizeye cyane intsinzi y' aya matora yabaye kuri iki cyumweru mu mutuzo , gusa yavuze ko ashobora kwamagana ibiyavamo niharamuka habayeho kwiba amajwi .
Lowasa wigeze kuba Minisitiri w' intebe ndetse akava mu ishyaka rya CCM mu ntangiriro z' uyu mwaka ahanganye cyane cyane na John Pombe Magufuri w' ishyaka CCM ryari ryanze gutanga Lowasa ho umukandida .
Ngo barebe usimbura Jakaya Kikwete .
Dr John Magufuri inzobere mu butabire , avuga ko yizeye neza ko ishyaka CCM riza gutsinda amatora rikaguma ku butegetsi rigakomeza guteza imbere Tanzania .
Kugeza ubu ibikorwa byo gukusanya ibyavuye mu matora nibyo bikomeje , amakuru ari gutangwa ku byayavuyemo ni menshi cyane ariko yiganjemo abogamye bitewe n' uruhande ruyatangaje .
Hategerejwe Ibiza kuvugwa na Komisiyo y' igihugu cya Tanzania y' amatora kuri uyu wa mbere .

Imisazire y' ibiro by' umupaka wa Cyanika uhuza u Rwanda na Uganda iteye ishavu n' agahinda Bitewe no gusaza kw' iyi nyubako irimo ibiro by' abinjira n' abasohoka , abayibona n' abayisabamo Service , bavuga ko idakwiye gusa uko isa mu gihe mu Rwanda inyubako z' iterambere zimaze kwiganza , bityo ibyo biro nabyo byagakwiye kuvugururwa .
Sima yatangeye kumenagurika kuri iyi nzu irimo ibiro by' abinjira n' abasohoka ku mupaka wa Cyanika Aba baturage baganiriye n' itangazamakuru bavuga ko umunyamahanga winjiye mu gihugu akagera ku mupaka ari ho ahita abonera isura y' igihugu agiyemo , iyo ngo asanze hadasa neza ahita yiyumvisha uko igihugu cyose gisa gityo .
Iyi nyubako igaragaza amasaziro ku buryo bugaragarira buri wese , abaturage bavukiye muri ako gace bakomeza bavuga ko yubatswe mu 1983 , ariko ntivugururwe nk' izindi , ibi rero ngo bikaba bituma irushaho kugenda yangirika .
Abanya Uganda bakorera ingendo mu Rwanda , ni bamwe mu bagarutsweho n' abaturage bavuga ko akenshi hari abaza mu Rwanda bakuruwe n' isuku cyangwa imyubakire iri mu Gihugu , rero ngo iyo basanze aho binjirira hadasukuye , ni kimwe mu byabakumira bakigumira iwabo kandi wenda hari ibyo bari kuzana bifitiye igihugu akamaro .
Bamwe mu baturage batuye mu Murenge wa Cyanika Akarere ka Burera ibi babigereranyije no kuba ku muharuro w' urugo rw' umuntu haba hadasukuye maze abashyitsi bakibwira ko ari ko n' imbere hameze .
Umwe yagize ati " Gusukura mu rugo imbere ku irembo hasa nabi .
Abagusuye bahita babona inenge .
Icyifuzo cyanjye ni uko hano hagira imyubakire mishya , ikajyana n' igihe tugezemo . "
Mukwiye James ni umuyobozi w' uyu mupaka , avuga ko uyu mupaka uhiriweho n' ibihugu byombi , bityo kugira ngo umupaka uvugururwe bisaba ko ibihugu byombi bibyumvikanaho hagatangwa isoko ry' abazawubaka , agahamya ko basabye ubuvugizi aho ngo yizeye ko umwaka utaha hazaba hubatswe .

Nathan Byukusenge arifuza gukora agashya muri iyi Tour du Rwanda ye ya nyuma Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Kapiteni wa Team Rwanda , Nathan Byukusenge ari mu bakinnyi bake bamaze gukina Tour du Rwanda zose kuva yaba mpuzamahanga .
Uyu mwaka Nathan uri gukina iya nyuma avuga ko yifuza gukora icyo azibukirwaho .
Nathan Byukusenge amaze imyaka 11 akina Tour du Rwanda Hagati ya tariki 13 – 20 Ugushyingo 2016 , mu Rwanda hari Tour du Rwanda 2016 .
Iri siganwa riri kuba kunshuro ya munani ( 8 ) kuva ryaba mpuzamahanga muri 2009 .
Mu bakinnyi 73 batangiye , harimo n' umwe mu bakinnyi benshi bita intwari z' umukino w' amagare mu Rwanda , umwe mu batangiranye n' ikipe y' igihugu ' Team Rwanda ' , umwe mu bamaze gukina Tour du Rwanda zose kuva yaba mpuzamahanga , Nathan Byukusenge .
Uyu mugabo wavutse tariki 8 Kanama 1980 , uri mu bafite inararibonye , yabwiye Umuseke ko yifuza gukora ikintu kizibukwa muri Tour du Rwanda y' uyu mwaka . "
Ndumva iyi ariyo Tour du Rwanda ya nyuma nkinnye ndi mu bayimazemo igihe kinini , kuko kuva 2005 ( itaraba mpuzamahanga ) narayikinaga .
Igihe kirageze ngo mparire abakiri bato gusa nifuza gukora ikintu kizibukwa cyangwa agashya keza muri Tour du Rwanda y' uyu mwaka .
Mfite ikipe nziza ishobora kumfasha .
Imana nimfasha nzajya mu ba mbere bahembwa , kandi nibigenda neza ndifuza no gutwara etape . "
– Nathan Byukusenge Tour du Rwanda uyu munsi irakomeza hakinwa agace ka kabiri .
Abasiganwa barahaguruka kuri Kigali Convention Center ku Kimihurura basoreze mu mujyi wa Karongi ku ntera ya 124 , 7km .

2015 : Hagombaga kuvuka abana 300 000 ariko 105 000 nibo banditse mu irangamimerere Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments * Abanyarwanda 99 % ntibagira icyangombwa cy' amavuko * Iminsi 15 ngo umubyeyi abe yandikishije umwana wavutse ni micye * Amananiza abirimo atuma benshi babyihorera kuko binabafata amafaranga * Abayobozi b' ibanze ngo babwiye abadepite ko ari ikibazo babana nacyo uko nyine * Minisitiri w' ubutabera yasabye ko kwandikisha umwana mu irangamimerere byoroshywa * Mu 2015 hateganywaga kuvuka abana 300 000 ariko 105 000 nibo bari mu bitabo by' irangamimerere Mu kiganiro nyunguranabitekerezo cy' abagize Inteko Ishingamategeko baharanira imibereho myiza n' iterambere ry' abaturage mu Rwanda bakoze bari kumwe na Minisitiri w' Ubutabera ,
Umuyobozi w' Ikigo cy' Igihugu cy' Ibarurirashamibare n' izindi nzego , hagaragaye ko mu Rwanda kwandikisha abana mu rwego rushinzwe irangamimerere bikiri hasi cyane , abaturage bagaragaza inzitizi harimo no gusiragira .
Mu Rwanda kwandikisha abana mu bitabo by' irangamimerere ngo haracyarimo amananiza menshi ku babyeyi Umuyobozi w' ihuriro ry' Abadepite n' Abasenateri baranira imibereho myiza n' iterambere mu Nteko , Senateri Niyongana Galican , yavuze ko mu ngendo abagize iri huriro bagiyemo mu turere icyenda basanze abaturage benshi batitabira kwandikisha abana babo mu irangamimerere .
Zimwe mu nzitizi abaturage batanga ngo harimo kuba iminsi 15 isabwa n' itegeko ngo umubyeyi abe yandikishije umwana we akimara kuvuka ari mike .
Abaturage kandi ngo bumva ko uwakererewe acibwa amafaranga y' amande bigatuma babyihorera ibyo kwandikisha abana .
Indi nzitizi ikomeye ngo n' iy' uko uwacikanywe mu kwandikishwa , itegeko rimusaba gutanga ikirego mu rukiko agategereza igihe Urukiko ruzacira urubanza maze agahabwa icyo cyemezo cy' amavuko ( Birth Certificate ) .
Hon Niyongana Galican ukuriye ihuriro RPRPD yagize ati " Twasanze irangamimerere ririmo ibibazo .
Twasanze abantu batumva agaciro ko kuba buri munyarwanda uvuka agomba kwandikwa mu bitabo by' irangamimerere .
Twasanze ari ikibazo kiraho rwose cy' ikigugu , n' abayobozi bakizi ariko bakavuga bati ni ukubana nacyo uko … " Avuga ko abaturage bumva ko igihe cyose bazajya kwandikisha umwana batitaye ku gihe bizafata cyangwa ibiteganywa n' itegeko bikazabaviramo ko itegeko rizabasaba kubanza gutanga ikirego .
Nk' uko byari bikubiye mu mpamvu z' iki kiganiro zo kumenya ingaruka bigira ku mwana n' umubyeyi iyo atandikishijwe mu irangamimerere , ngo kutandikishwa bibuza umwana uburenganzira bwe ndetse akaba yabura zimwe muri serivisi yemerewe .
Minisitiri w' Ubutabera Johnston Busingye wari muri iki kiganiro mbere ya saa sita , yavuze ko irangamimerere ari dossier y' umuntu , ari icyangombwa kigaragaza ibyo yakoze ku Isi kuva abayeho bityo ngo iyo bitanditswe neza bigira ingaruka kuri we n' abazamukomokaho .
Busingye yavuze ko mu irangamimerere hakwiye kubaho ubufatanye bw' inzego zose zirebwa haba harimo Ministeri y' Imari n' Igenamigambi , Ministeri y' Ubuzima , MINALOC ndetse n' iy' Ubutabera , hakarebwa uko ibisabwa byose bitangwa ariko abaturage bakoroherwa no kwindikisha abana mu irangamimerere .
Yavuze ko hakwiye ko ikoranabuhanga ryifashishwa , amakuru y' abana bavukira kwa muganga agasesengurwa neza agatangwa mu rwego rw' irangamimerere ku murenge , umuturage ntazongere gusiragira ava kwa muganga ngo ajye kwandikisha umwana mu murenge .
Umuyobozi w' Ikigo cy' Igihugu cy' Ibarurishamibare , Murangwa Yusuf yagaragaje akamaro irangamimerere rigira mu igenamigambi ry' igihugu .
Avuga ko ibintu byose iyo bidafite amakuru ahagije mu irangamimerere hazamo amakosa mu gutegura igenamigambi .
Murangwa yavuze ko mu Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2015 ikigo ayobora cyateganyaga ko hazavuka abana 300 000 .
Gusa abana 142 000 nibo banditswe kwa muganga binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga bahawe n' Ikigo cy' Ibarurishamibare , ariko abana 105 000 nibo bemejwe mu irangamimerere ryo mu murenge ko bavutse .
Murangwa avuga ko bizeye ko mu mwaka utaha n' indi izakurikiraho hazabaho kwiyongera hakurikijwe uko byagenze muri uyu mwaka ari ku nshuro ya mbere bikozwe , ndetse n' amahugurwa n' ubukangurambaga bizatangwa mu gihe kizaza .
Abana 91 % mu Rwanda ubu bavukira kwa muganga Umunyamabanga wa Leta Uhoraho muri Ministeri y' Ubuzima , Solange Hakiba Itulinde nawe ntajya kure y' akamaro irangamimerere rigira mu igenamigambi ry' igihugu .
Avuga ko Ministeri y' Ubuzima imaze guterea intambwe mu kwandika abana bavukira kwa muganga ndetse ngo n' abavukiye mu ngo abajyanama b' ubuzima barabakurikirana .
Yagaragaje ko mu Rwanda , 93 % by' abana bafite amazi hagati ya 12 - 23 bapfa hamenyekana icyabishe .
Kandi ubu ngo abana bangana na 91 % mu Rwanda bavukira kwa muganga , naho abagore 99 % batewe nibura bajya kwisuzumisha kwa muganga inshuro imwe mbere yo kubyara .
Umuyobozi w' Ikigo cy' Igihugu cy' Indangamuntu ( NIDA ) , Nyamurinda Pascal yavuze ko uburyo bwa kera bwo kwandikishisha no kwiyandikisha kw' abaturage mu irangamimerere bwarimo ikibazo cyane .
Nyamurinda avuga ko ubu hagiyeho uburyo bwo kunoza amakuru mu irangamimerere no kuyasangira , Umunyamabanga Nsingwabikorwa n' Umukozi ushinzwe Irangamimerere bakaba bemererwa kwinjira muri System ya NIDA mu gihe bakeneye amakuru runaka ku muntu .
Avuga ko hazashyirwaho icyangombwa cy' amavuko gikomeye kijyanye n' igihe ( Unique Identification ) , bigakorwa nk' uko indangamuntu yahinduwe ikava mu mpapuro ikaba ikintu cy' ikoranabuhanga .
Ikindi ngo ni uko hakwiye kujyaho uburyo bwiza bwo kubika ibitabo byanditswemo irangamimerere kera bikabikwa neza .
Yavuze ko urebye mu Rwanda abaturage 99 % batagira icyangombwa cy' amavuko kandi ahandi mu bihugu byateye imbere iki cyangombwa nicyo giherwaho mu gutanga ibindi byangombwa nkenerwa by' umuturage .
Umwe mu myanzuro yafashwe harimo gukomeza gukora ubukangurambaga mu baturage kugira ngo bitabire irangamimerere .
HATANGIMANA Ange Eric UMUSEKE .

Ubu amazina yabo ari ku ' gilet ' nk ' uburyo bwo kwigengesera Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abari kwitegereza ku mwambaro w' abapolisi bo ku muhanda babonye ko ku kambaro kabo ka ' gilet ' ubu hariho amazina yabo .
Ni ikintu gishya kigamije kwigengeseera mu kazi nk' uko bitangazwa n' umuvugizi wa Polisi y' u Rwanda ishami ryo mu muhanda .
Ubu amazina yabo aragaragara , ibi ngo bituma bigengesera mu kazi .
Photo : Peter / UMUSEKE CIP Emmanuel Kabanda yabwiye umunyamakuru w' Umuseke ko kuba ubu abaplisi ku mihanda bagaragara kuri ' gilet ' hariho amazina yabo ari ukugira ngo byorohe kumenya umupolisi uri ahantu runaka mu gihe aguhaye serivisi mbi cyangwa akoze akazi ke neza .
Ati " Urebye nta kidasanzwe kirimo , ariko ni ukugira ngo umupolisi uri mu kazi amenyekane , ni uburyo bushobora gutuma umuntu yigengesera , mu gihe azi ko amazina ye aboneka ku mwambaro we .
nta kidasanzwe n' ubundi uwabaga yahohotewe twamumenyeraga kuri poste ( ahantu ) runaka , gusa uwabasha no kwitegereza azajya amenya n' izina ry' umupolisi . "
Kugabanya Impanuka ni uguhindura imyumvire CIP Emmanuel Kabanda yavuze mu kurwanya impanuka bakomeje ibikorwa ( operations ) bisanzwe .
Nubwo ngo hari abashobora kwibwira ko kugabanya impanuka bizashoboka ari uko Polisi ifite abakozi benshi ku muhanda ibi atari ko bimeze .
Ati " gushyira abapolisi benshi ku muhanda siwo muti urambye , umuti ni ukongera ibikoresho bigabanya impanuka no uguhindura imyumvire y' abantu , kuko ntabwo wagira umupolisi ku muhanda kuri buri 100m " CIP Kabanda yongeye kwibutsa ko impanuka ziri gutwara ubuzima bw' abantu ziraterwa no ' kudepasa ' ( guca ku yindi modoka muri mu kerekezo kimwe ) nabi , umuvuduko urengeje , imyitwarire mibi y' abashoferi , kugenda bavugira kuri telephone .
Aha ngo niyo mpamvu basaba abatwara ibinyabiziga kugerageza guhindura imyumvire , kubahiriza no kwitwararika amategeko y' umuhanda kugira ngo bagire uruhare rukomeye mu kugabanya impanuka .
Jean Paul NKUNDINEZA UMUSEKE .
