Bugesera : Abacuruzi bakanguriwe kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Polisi y' u Rwanda ikorera mu karere ka Bugesera yagiranye inama n' abacuruzi bo mu isoko rya Ruhuha ibakangurira kwirinda ibiyobyabwenge no kugira uruhare rufatika mu kubirwanya .
Mu karere ka Bugesera Iyo nama yabereye aho iri soko ryubatse mu kagari ka Ruhuha B ku itariki 3 Werurwe 2015 iyobowe na Mushenyi Innocent , umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w' Umurenge wa Ruhuha wabwiye abo bacuruzi ko ibiyobyabwenge bidindiza iterambere ry' umuryango n' igihugu muri rusange , kuko bigira ingaruka mbi ku buzima bw' uwakabaye akora ibibiteza imbere .
Mushenyi yagize ati : " Abanywa ibiyobyabwenge bakora ibyaha bitandukanye kuko , nk' uko byitwa , biba byayobeje ubwenge bwabo " .
Yabakanguriye kutabinywa , kutabicuruza kandi bagatanga amakuru ku babikora .
Yabakanguriye kandi kurangwa n' isuku haba mu isoko ndetse no mu ngo zabo nk' uko bitangazwa na Polisi y' u Rwanda .
Ushinzwe guhuza ibikorwa bya Polisi y' u Rwanda n' abaturage no gukumira ibyaha mu karere ka Bugesera , Assistant Inspector of Police ( AIP ) Cyprien Uwitonze , yagize ati : "
Ibyaha birimo gukubita no gukomeretsa , ubujura , ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina , gufata ku ngufu , gusambanya abana , biterwa ahanini no kunywa ibiyobyabwenge nk' urumogi n' inzoga zitemewe mu Rwanda zirimo kanyanga " .
AIP Uwitonze yavuze kandi ko bituma abantu bishora mu busambanyi , kandi ko ingaruka zabwo harimo gutwara inda zitateganyijwe , by' umwihariko bituma urubyiruko ruva mu ishuri no kwirukanwa , mu miryango imwe n' imwe .
Ati " Kubishoramo amafaranga ni ukuyapfusha ubusa kuko bishobora gufatwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose .
Abantu bakwiye gucuruza no kunywa ibyemewe n' amategeko kuko bihari byinshi " .
Yababwiye ko n' ubwo bitarafata intera ndende mu Rwanda , ko hari abantu batangiye kujya bagaragara mu cyaha cyo gucuruza abantu .
Yababwiye ko ababikora babeshya urubyiruko ko bashobora kuruha cyangwa kurushakira akazi mu bihugu by' amahanga kandi yagaragaje ko uwo babagejejeyo bamwaka ibyangombwa , bakamufata bunyago , maze bakamukoresha imirimo y' agahato nta gihembo no kumushora mu busambanyi .
Yakanguriye abantu kwirinda biriya byaha byose , kubirwanya no gutanga amakuru ku gihe ku babikora .

Uko yavuye ' mu bumayibobo ' kubera ' Girinka Munyarwanda ' Mukampeta hamwe n' inka yahawe muri gahunda ya Girinka , ahamya ko imaze kumugeza ku iterambere rirambye ( Ifoto / Umurengezi Regis ) Mukampeta , umugore w' imyaka 46 y' amavuko ufite abana 7 , aravuga ko Girinka Munyarwanda yamubereye umusemburo w' iterambere , aho yabagaho mu buzima agereranya n' ubw' abana bo ku muhanda .
Uyu mupfakazi avuga ko ubuhamya bwe na we abizi ko bitoroshye kubwizera , kuko ntawe bidatangaza kumva ko yavuye mu buzima bushaririye akaba amaze kwigeza kuri byinshi , kubera gahunda ya Girinka . "
Hari abazumva ibyo nakubwiye bakagira ngo wenda hari uwantumye kubikubwira kandi bidahari , ubishoboye waza nkakujyana mu rugo ukabyirebera ukarushaho kubisangiza Abanyarwanda ubihagazeho , nshaka ko na nyakubahwa Kagame abona ko gahunda ye njye hari aheza imaze kungeza , rwose igore uze njye kukwereka ! "
Umunyamakuru yemeye kujyana n' uwo mubyeyi mu rusisiro atuyemo ruherereye neza munsi y' Ikirunga cya Bushokoro , maze bafata urugendo rw' isaha n' amaguru burira umusozi berekeza mu Mudugudu wa Musingi , Akagari ka Kaguho , Umurenge wa Kinigi , Akarere ka Musanze mu Majyaruguru y' u Rwanda .
Mukampeta hamwe n' inka yahawe muri gahunda ya Girinka , ahamya ko imaze kumugeza ku iterambere rirambye ( Ifoto / Umurengezi Regis ) Dore ikiganiro Mukampeta yasangije Izubarirashe . rw ubwo twamusuraga iwe mu rugo akatugaragariza uburyo inka yahawe muri gahunda ya Girinka imaze kumuhindurira amateka … Wahoze umbwira ko inka wahawe muri gahunda ya Girinka hari ahantu heza cyane imaze kukugeza , ubundi mbere utarayibona wari ubayeho ute ?
Nabaga mu kantu kameze nk' inzu ariko atari inzu ; kari akazu kubakishije ibyatsi kandi gasakaje ibyatsi .
Kurya byari bingoye ; ntabwo nabonaga ibiryo byo guha abana , nabonaga ibiryo ari uko mvuye gukorera rubanda , byansabaga guca incuro !
Nkambara ari uko mvuye gukorera rubanda , nkabwirirwa nkaburara hamwe n' urubyaro rwanjye rwose ( … ) mbese nabarizwaga muri cya cyiciro bitaga icy' abahanya cyaje guhinduka icyiciro cya mbere cy' ubudehe , nabonaga ubuyobozi nkirirwa ndi kwiruka kugira ngo batamfata nkihishahisha kubera ko ntatanze mitiweli .
Ibyo uvuze byaje guhinduka gute ?
Byose byahinduwe n' inka nahawe na Perezida Kagame muri gahunda ya ' Girinka ' ; iyo gahunda igitangira hano iwacu ni njye bahereyeho , bampaye inka ndayiragira , inka imbyarira inyana , icyo gihe yakamwaga litiro itanu [ eshanu ] , amata abana bakanywa , nkagurisha , mbajyana mu ishuri , inka inkemurira ikibazo cya mitiweli ( … ) ubwo naje kwitura mugenzi wanjye muha ya nyana , nkomeza kuragira nyina ;
inka iza kubyara iyindi nyana , ya nyana ndayigurisha nkuramo amabati 31 , ubu nubatse inzu , ikibazo cy' inzu cyarakemutse .
Tubwire uko waje kwitura !
Njye kubera ko inka bari bampaye yari inyana , yahise yima ikimara kumbyarira inyana , iyo nyana narayireze neza nyuma yo kumva amabwiriza twahawe ku kwitura , ubwanjye nashatse umukuru w' umudugudu ndamubwira nti ' nshaka kwitura ' , ubwo abayobozi bahise baterana habaho gutoranya undi muntu ukwiye inka nuko inka ndayitanga ubuyobozi buri kureba n' umukuru w' umudugudu ahari na zegitifu [ umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa ] w' akagari n' uw' umurenge .
Ubuzima bwawe ubona bwarahindutse mu buhe buryo ?
Iyo ntekereje ako kazu nabagamo , nkabona iyo nzu y' amabati 31 ihagaze , ndi kuva mu cyumba nkajya mu kindi , ndavugaga ngo ' harakabeho ubuyobozi bwiza bw' igihugu ' kuko bwangiriye akamaro , nareba iki gitenge nambaye ntarambaraga igitenge nkavuga ngo ' harakabeho ubuyobozi bw' igihugu bwazanye Girinka ' nareba uko natanze mituweli abana narabarwazaga bakirirwa mu buriri kubera ko ntatanze mitiweli , umwana ubu ari kurwara nkamujyana ku bitaro nta kibazo nkavuga ngo ' harakabaho gahunda ya Girinka ' Mukamazimpaka yerekana inzu yiyubakiye abikesha inka yahawe muri ' Girinka ' ,
yagiye agurisha amata akabika amafaranga birangira yubatse iyi nzu ( Ifoto / Umurengezi R ) Watubwiye ko mbere wabarizwaga mu cyiciro cya mbere cy' ubudehe , ubu ho uri mu cya kangahe ?
Ubu ndi mu cyiciro cya kabiri cy' ubudehe kandi mbere nari naraheze mu cya mbere !
Iyi nka yawe uyiha akahe gaciro ?
Iyi nka yanjye nayise Inzirakurutwa kubera ko ikimara kugera iwanjye hari byinshi yangejejeho nari ntaragatunga bituma nyita iryo zina ; ba bandi bagendaga bari kunkandagira ubu ntibakinkandagira kubera ko nabonye inzirakurutwa ubu nkaba mfite agaciro gakwiriye Umunyarwandakazi .
Nzi neza ko Girinka ari gahunda igamije gukura mu bukene abaturage bameze nk' uko najye nari meze ntarahabwa inka muri iyo gahunda ( … ) perezida wankuye mu bwigunge , nari mayibobo kandi ndi umubyeyi , ndamushimira aragahoraho !
Aragahora ku ngoma !
Azahore arategeka iteka ryose !
Ndashima Perezida Kagame wampaye inka nari ndi mu bwigunge ; nta mwenda nagiraga , abana banjye ntibaryaga , sinabonaga mitiweli , inzu nari ndimo yaraturaga , ntabwo nabonaga umushyitsi ngo nifuze ko yaza iwanjye , ariko perezida akimara kumpa iyo nka iwanjye byose byarahindutse ubu rwose buri wese wahagera yavuga ati ' iki gihugu gifite iterambere ' ngira ngo nawe urabibona !
Gahunda ya ' Girinka ' irakomeje , ni iki wabwira abagenerwabikorwa bayo bashya ?
Ikintu nabwira umuturage ugiye guhabwa iyi nka agomba kuyitaho ; kugira ngo ibe yarangiriye akamaro ni uko nayiseho , njya ngaya abaturage bagenzi banjye bahabwa inka yamara kuyihabwa akajya kuyikoreshereza ibyo ashaka , akagenda akayigurisha amafaranga akirira bwa bukene bukagaruka mu rugo .
Icyo gihe rero ntabwo aba yubahirije gahunda ya girinka , ahubwo niba uhawe inka agenda uyiragire , uziturire mugenzi wawe , nawe iwawe inka ikomeze kubayo , niho ubukene uzaba uri kuburandura !
Mu bikorwa by' iterambere , ni iki waduhamiriza uko umaze kwigezaho bitewe n' iyi gahunda ya Girinka ?
Ntabwo nabonaga imbuto y' ibirayi , ariko ubu ngubu mpinga ibirayi ngahinga ibigori , ngahinga ibishyimbo mbese nta kintu kibuze iwanjye kubera iyo nka , ni yo mpamvu nayise ririya zina ' inzirakurutwa ' , ubu nta muntu unsumba mu kurya hano dutuye , inka ikigera iwanjye nahise mba umukire , nabaye umukire rwose Perezida Kagame yarankijije ; wowe se uko ubibona urabona hari icyo mbaye ?
Ubu mbasha kwigurira igisinde [ umurima wo guhinga ] , ngahinga nkeza neza ubundi nkarya nkihaza kandi ngasagurira amasoko !
Inka yahawe muri ' Girinka ' yatumye abasha guhinga ibirayi mu gihe mbere yabisabaga abaturanyi be ( Ifoto / Umurengezi R ) Intumbero ufite ni iyihe ?
Icyo ntumbereye ni ukurushaho gutera imbere mu mibereho , nk' uko namaze kwikura mu cyiciro cya mbere cy' ubudehe ubu ho nshaka kuva mu cyiciro cya kabiri ndimo nkajya mu cya gatatu , nihaye gusa uyu mwaka ubundi umwaka utaha nkaba nageze mu cya gatatu , bizanshimisha kandi ndasaba n' abandi Banyarwanda kunyigiraho .
Murakoze ! Murakoze namwe kuba mwemeye kurira ikirunga mu kaza kwirebera uko inka nahawe na perezida Kagame imaze kungira umukire .

Ruhango : Abana baracyahohoterwa ku buryo butandukanye Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Ruhango Mbabazi Froncois Xavier aravuga ko ihohoterwa rikorerwa abana rikigaragara no mu karere ka Ruhango ahakiri ababyeyi bataramenya uburenganzira bw' umwana .
Aba ni bamwe mu bana bafashwa n' umushinga wa Compession Yabivuze ubwo umushinga compassion Internationale wizihizaga umunsimpuzamahanga w' umwana w' umunyafurika mu karerekaRuhango .
Munsanganyamatsiko y' uyumwaka aho igira iti ' duteze imbere imibereho myiza twamagana imirimo mibi ikoreshwa abana " , umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Ruhango yatangarije UMUSEKE ko ikibazo cy' imirimo ikomeye cyane ku bana ikigaragara hamwe na hamwe mu karere ka Ruhango , kuko hari ibyo bakira ku buyobozi bizanywe n' abatinyutse kubitangaza cyangwa n' abana bahohotewe muri ubwo buryo .
Bimwe mu bibazo bikunze kugaragara mu karerekaRuhangobyumwihariko , ni ababyeyi babuza abana kujya mu mashuri no gutotezwa mu miryango babamo .
Mbabazi akaba asaba abantu bose n' inzego zinyuranye guhagurukira kurwanya icyo kibazo , kandi akanasaba abayobozi kwegera ababyeyi kugirango babakangurire kumenya uburenganzira bw' abana n' imirimo ikwiranyenabo .
Ababyeyi bibukijwe ko badakwiye gufata aba babo nk' abacakara babo Nzeyimana Jean umuhuzabikorwa w' umushinga Compassion Internationale , avuga ko uruhare rwabo mu kwirinda ibyo bibazo , ngo bafatanya nakomite zibazashyizweho muri compassion hamwe n' itorero bagakurikirana imirimo mibi ikoreshwa abana n' ibindi bibazo by' ihohoterwa ribakorerwa .
Icyo gihe ngo aho byagaragaye bihutira kubigeza ku babishinzwe bakareba icyo bamarira abo bana bitewe n' ikibazo bamusanganye .
Habineza Sangwa Olivier umwe mu bana b' abanyeshuri baganiriye n' UMUSEKE , avuga ko rimwe na rimwe akoreshwa imirimo imusumbije ubushobozi n' ababyeyi be , batitaye ko avuye ku ishuri .
Imwe muri iyo mirimo ni nko kwikorezwa ijerekani cyangwa kwahirira inka akanazikorera agasanga bidahura n' iyonsanganyamatsiko kuko iyo arangije iyo mirimo aba atakibashije gusubira mu masomo ye .
Mugenzi we Ngabo Aimable avuga ko hari nubwo babahingisha icyate cy' umurima kugirango babashe kujya kwiga cyangwa guhabwa ibyo bakeneye .
Mu gutegura igikorwa cyo kwizihiza uwo munsi , Nzeyimana Jean yavuze ko ikiba kigamijwe ari ugukora ubuvugizi ngo umwana atagira icyamubangamira mu myigire ye .
Ruzigura Samuel umuyobozi w' ihuriro ry' amatorero ya gikirisito afite imishinga iterwa inkunga na Compassion , yasobanuriye UMUSEKE ko kugeza ubu abana bafashwa na compassion binyuze mu mushinga wayo Peace Cluster bamaze kuba benshi kandi ibyo bigakorwa mu rwego rw' ubuzima , uburezi , ubukungu n' imibanire n' abandi .
Mu mwaka wa 2012 - 2013 hatanzwe inkunga ku bana ingana na miliyoni mirongo ine zisaga .
Naho mu mwaka wa 2013 - 2014 bakaba bateganya gufashisha abana barihirirwa n' uyu mushinga miliyoni maganatatu zisaga z' amafaranga y' u Rwanda .
Mu karere ka Ruhango compasiyo ikaba afasha abana barenga ibihumbi bibiri .
Umuyobozi wa Karere ka Ruhango Mbabazi Francois Xavier ( wa kabiri uvuye iburyo ) MUHIZI Elisée UMUSEKE .

Inama y' umuryango wa Mandela i Qunu ku rugo rwe Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Mu gihe uyu mukambwe arembye cyane mu bitaro i Pretoria , umuryango we usa n' uri kwitegura iruhuka rye .
Amakuru ari gutangazwa ni uko umuryango we ugiye gukora inama yaguye kuri uyu wa 25 Kamena i Qunu ku rugo rw' uyu musaza .
Mandela n' abakobwa be n' abuzukuru be Iyi nama yahuje aba " Chiefs " bo mu muryango wa cyami w' aba " Abathembu " ari nabo bo mu muryango wa Mandela ndetse n' abandi ba hafi bo mu muryango wa Mandela .
Nelson Mandela kugeza ubu amakuru aravuga ko amaze amasaha arenga 48 adafunguye amaso , abaganga ngo bari kumwitaho ku buryo budasanzwe n' ubwo arembye nkuko byatangajwe na Perezida wa Africa y' Epfo Jacob Zuma .
Iyi nama y' umuryango wa Mandela biravugwa ko yatumijwe n' umukobwa we mukuru Makazawie ( umukuru kuri uyu nawe yitwaga Makazawie yitabye Imana afite amezi 9 gusa ) .
Mu mico myinshi ya Africa , iyo umubyeyi ari hafi kwitaba Imana cyangwa yitabye Imana haterana inama y' umuryango ngo yige ku gikora cyo kumuherekeza .
Bitandukanye n' indi minshi , kuri uyu wa mbere tariki 24 Kamena , abanyacyubahiro benshi biganjemo abanyapolitiki n' abaministre baje kumureba .
Muri bo harimo Ministre w' ingabo n' abahoze ku rugerero Nosiviwe Mapisa - Nqakula umuyobozi w' ishyaka United Democratic Movement Bantu Holomisa n' abandi .
Abuzukuru ba Madiba , Ndaba , Zoleka na Zaziwe nabob amaze umwanya mu cyumba sekuru arembeyemo .
Aba bose ariko ntawabashije kumubona akanuye kuko bose basanze asinziriye arembye cyane nkuko byemezwa na Radio Jacaranda .
i Qunu kwa Mandela Mu gace uyu musaza akomokamo bamwe mu bahatuye ngo baba bari gutegura amazu yabo ngo bazayakodeshe n' abanyamakuru n' abakerarugendo bashobora kwitabira ari benshi cyane imihango yo kumuherekeza ( natabaruka ) bivugwa ko izabera i Qunu , aho kugirango ubone ihoteli cyangwa inzu zagenewe gucumbikamo ( guesthouse ) ari mu birometero 10 uvuye Qunu .
Iyi nama y' umuryango wa Mandela iteranye none kuwa 25 Kamena , biteganyijwe ko yitabirwa n' abana be bakuru , abagore Zenani ( Zeni ) , Zindziswa ( Zindzi ) na Makaziwe wayitumije .
Nelson Mandela yabyaye abana batandatu , abahungu be babiri umwe Madiba Thembi yishwe n' impanuka y' imodoka mu 1969 afite imyaka 25 , ise yari afunze ndetse ntiyemerewe kumuherekeza .
Undi Makagatho Mandela we yishwe na SIDA mu 2005 naho umukobwa mukuru ni Makaziwe witabye Imana afite amezi icyenda gusa .

Tanzania yisubiyeho ku cyemezo cyo gutangaza urutonde rw' abatinganyi Yanditswe na Cyprien Niyomwungeri Kuya 28 Gashyantare 2017 saa 09 :
34 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
2 0 Minisiteri y' Ubuzima muri Tanzania yisubiyeho ku cyemezo cyo gusohora urutonde rw' abatinganyi bakekwaho kwigurisha bakoresheje ikoranabuhanga , itangaza ko byaba ari ' ugukoresha nabi ibimenyetso .
' Minisitiri wungirije w' Ubuzima , Hamisi Kigwangalla , ejo kuwa Mbere yatumijeho ikiganiro n' abanyamakuru ngo abatangarize urwo rutonde nkuko yari yabisezeranyije mu ntangiro z' uku kwezi .
Yagize ati " Twakuyeho ikiganiro n' abanyamakuru .
Ntabwo dutangaza amazina y' abatinganyi bigurisha kubera ibibazo bya tekiniki . "
Daily Nation yanditse ko Kigwangalla yakomeje agira ati " Kubera impamvu z' uko byateguwe no kwirinda gukoresha nabi ibimenyetso , tuzabikemura mu bundi buryo kandi tuzakomeza kubamenyesha uko bizagenda . "
Icyemezo cyo gutangaza urutonde rw' abatinganyi cyari cyafashwe nyuma y' icyo kubuza ibigo nderabuzima byigenga bisaga 40 gutanga serivisi zifite aho zihuriye na virus itera Sida , bishinjwa gushyigikira abaryamana bahuje ibitsina .
Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zarakinenze zivuga ko gishobora kugira ingaruka kuri porogaramu zo kurwanya Sida itera inkunga muri Tanzania .
Mu gitabo cy' amategeko ahana cya Tanzania , ubutinganyi ku bagabo buhanishwa imyaka 30 y' igifungo , gusa iki gihano ntabwo gitangwa ku batinganyi b' abagore .
Umwaka ushize Minisiteri y' Ubuzima yatangaje ko 23 % by' abagabo b' abatinganyi muri Tanzania bafite virusi itera Sida .
Umuryango Amnesty International utangaza ko ubutinganyi butemewe mu bihugu 38 kuri 54 bigize Afurika .
Muri Mauritania , Sudani na Somalia bikaba bihanishwa igihano cy' urupfu .

Ubuzima ni bwiza nyuma y' imyaka 5 bavuye ku gucuruza ku gataro Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Remera – Mu kwa cumi 2009 nibwo abagore 18 bahoze bacuruza imbuto ku dutaro bazunguruka mu mihanda ya Remera bicaye bajya inama yo gushyira hamwe bakava mu muhanda bacururiza hamwe .
Iyo bavuze kwibohora bibuka aho bari mu myaka itanu ishize , ubu bamaze kwiteza imbere ndetse bamwe muri bo biyubakiye amazu kubera gucururiza mu ishyirahamwe .
Bamwe mu bagize Koperative " Tuzamurane2020 " bishimira kuvuga impinduka z' ubuzima bwabo bwabaye bwiza ubu " Tuzamurane 2020 " niko bise ishyirahamwe ryabo bakiva mu muhanda .
Byari bikomeye gutangira no gufatisha abakiliya aho bari batangiye gukorera , uko bari 18 ntibakomeje kuko bamwe bagowe n' intangiriro bagacika intege bakava mu ishyirahamwe bagasubira mu bucuruzi ku dutaro .
Abihanganye ni 10 bakiri kumwe , umunani muri bo bamaze kwiyubakira amazu yabo mu nyungu bavanye muri Koperative , ishyirahamwe ryabo ryateye imbere kugeza ubwo ubu umugabane bawugurisha 200 000Rwf ku ushaka kwinjira mu ishyirahamwe ryabo kubera aho bageze .
Bacuririza i Remera ku nzu izwi nka Gisimenti ku kibero cy' inzu iburyo bwayo uri ku muhanda ujya mu mujyi , ntabwo hagaragara cyane ariko abakiliya benshi bamaze kubamenya no kubateza imbere babahahira imbuto n' imboga bacuruza bikabatunga n' imiryango yabo .
Mbere ya 2009 ubuzima bwari bukomeye .
Bernadette Nyirabagenzi , umuyobozi wungirije w' iri tsinda rito ry' abagore yabwiye Umuseke ko ubuzima bwabo bwari hagati ya gereza n' impanuka zo kumuhanda .
Ati " Byari ibibazo , kubyuka ukagenda utazi uko biri bugende , gusa uziko bari bugufunge , bari bukumenere ibicuruzwa cyangwa uri buvunike wiruka uhunga abapolisi .
Bamwe twasigaga tubwiye abaturanyi ngo nibabona tutagarutse batumenyere abana . "
Nyuma y' ubukangurambaga butandukanye , baje kwicara ari 18 biyemeza gucururiza hamwe , ariko intangiriro zirabagora cyane kugeza ubwo umunani muri bo bafashe icyemezo cyo gusubira mu muhanda nk' uko Nyirabagenzi abivuga .
Ubu intambwe bamaze gutera iratangaje kuri bo , barizigamira bakanavanaho ayo kwitunga .
Bamwe muri bagenzi babo babasaba kubinjiza mu ishyirahamwe ariko ngo ntibigishobotse ku muntu utaguze nibura umugabane wa 200 000Rwf ubu bagezeho .
Mu ngo zabo hahoraga ubukene bagicururiza ku dutaro kuko inyungu yabonekaga rimwe na rimwe , abana bahoraga bamerewe nabi kubera imirire mibi ariko ubu bishyurira abana amashuri kuva ku y' incuke kugera mu yisumbuye , n' izindi nkuru bavuga inziza kuri bo n' imibereho yabo n' ababo .
Gutura agataro byatumye bagira ubuzima bwiza n' ubw' ababo ari bo barishimye n' abana bamerewe neza Nyirabagenzi agira inama bagenzi be bakiri mu muhanda ko nta rirarenga nabo bashobora kwishyira hamwe bakava ku nkeke bahoraho zo gucururiza ku gataro ku mihanda . "
Tuzamurane 2020 " ubu bafite umushinga wo kwagura aho bakorera kuko hamaze kuba hato bagashaka ahandi hanini hagendanye n' uko ubucuruzi bwabo bumaze gukura , ndetse bakongeramo abanyamuryango bashya babishoboye .
Mu mbogamizi bafite harimo abagore bagenzi babo bagicururiza ku mihanda ku dutaro badashaka kwishyira hamwe , aba ngo batari mu mihanda inyungu yabo yarushaho kuzamuka .
Bamwe mu bagore bagicururiza ku gataro i Remera baganiriye n' Umuseke kuri uyu wa 14 Kanama , bafite ishyari ryiza rya Koperative " Tuzamurane2020 " , bavuga ko ari abagore babashije kwihanganira ingorane zo gutangira ishyirahamwe .
Bavuga ko bifuza kuba abanyamuryango b' iriya koperative ariko igihe cyarenze kuko umugabane wo muri yo uhenze kubera agaciro bagezeho .
Ntibanze nabo kwishyira hamwe ngo bagere aheza ariko gutera intambwe ya mbere kuri bose nibyo bikibananiye … .

GroFin yahuguye abikorera ku bijyanye n' imikoreshereze y' imari Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ikigo cy' imari GroFin Rwanda gitanga inguzanyo ku bacuruzi na ba rwiyemezamurimo batandukanye cyahaye amahugurwa abo bakorana nacyo ku buryo bwo gukoresha neza inguzanyo bahabwa igamije kubateza imbere no kunoza ibikorwa byabo kugirango bidahomba .
Abakorana na GroFin Rwanda mu mahugurwa barimo kuwa gatanu w' icyumweru gishize Umuyobozi wa GroFin Rwanda avuga ko ibigo bito n' ibiciriritse mu Rwanda iyo bifunguye bimara igihe gito nyuma bigafunga kubera igihombo bahura nacyo .
Christian Bugabo umuyobozi wa GroFin Rwanda avuga ko iki kigo kigamije gukorana na sosiyete z' ubucuruzi na ba rwiyemezamirimo bagamije kubafasha kugera ku ntego zabo zo kwiteza imbere .
Amahugurwa bahaye bamwe mu bo GroFin yahaye inguzanyo kuwa gatanu w' icyumweru gishize ni arebana no kongera ubushobozi bwabo mu gukoresha inguzanyo babonye , gushyira mu ngiro imirongo migari ya business bakora ndetse no gutegura gahunda zigamije guteza imbere ibigo byabo .
Jean Clement Twamugabo umuyobozi wa Pharmacie la Reference , umwe mu banyamuryango barenga 30 bakorana na GroFin Rwanda , avuga ko mu myaka itanu amaze akorana na GroFin hari byinshi bifatika bamufashije cyane kugeraho muri business ye .
Ati " GroFin ntabwo imeze nk' ayandi ma banki , GroFin yoroshya cyane ibijyanye n' ingwate mu kugirango baguhe inguzanyo , iyo bamaze kuyiguha kandi bagufasha kuyikoresha neza mu mahugurwa nk' aya bategura .
Iyo ugize ikibazo muri business yawe GroFin iragukurikirana ikagufasha kugikemura kugirango umukiliya wabo ataza guhomba .
Ni bintu bidufasha cyane . "
Uyu mukiliya wa GroFin avuga ko yagiye ifasha abakiliya bayo kujya mu ngendo - shuri zitandukanye mu bihugu GroFin ikoreramo .
GroFin muri Africa ubu ikorera mu bihugu bya Mauritius , South Africa , Zambia , Kenya , Uganda , Tanzania , Egypt , Ghana na Nigeria .
Usibye muri Africa ikigo cya GroFin gikorera kandi mu bihugu bitandukanye nka Oman , Jordanie , Irak n' i Dubai muri UAE ( United Arab Emirates ) vuba kikaza gutangira no gukorera muri Arabia Saoudite .
Umuyobozi wa GroFin mu Rwanda avuga ko GroFin ifite abafatanyabikorwa ( Development investors ) bayifasha gukorana neza n' abayigana mu rwego rw' imari barimo ibigo bikomeye ku Isi nka Shell Foundation , International Finance Cooperation , European Investment Bank , Africa Development Bank , CDC Group yahoze yitwa Commonwealth Development Corporation yo mu Bwongereza na Fonds d' investissemnt et de soutien aux Entreprise en Afrique .
Bari guhabwa amahugurwa ku gutunganya neza business zabo Umuyobozi wa GroFin Rwanda ati " Ni amahirwe ku Rwanda kuba na hano hari ishami rya GroFin Rwanda , intego dufite nta yindi ni ukwagura ubucuruzi ku bantu bari muri secteurs zose , mu bukerarugendo , mu nganda , mu bucuruzi buciriritse , ku bantu bohereza n' abakura ibintu mu mahanga , ubwibatsi n' ibindi byose …
bitanga akazi ku bantu bikazamura imisoro , bizamura muri rusange ubukungu bw' igihugu n' imibereho myiza y' abaturage , mbere bitanga umusanzu mu iterambere ry' u Rwanda , ni ibyo dukora muri rusange . "
Icyo bashingiraho bakorana n' umuntu ubyifuza ni ukubanza kureba umusaruro ushobora kuva mu mushinga wa rwiyemezamirimo runaka , niba afite ibyemezo by' ubucuruzi akora , niba nta kibazo yigeze agira mu kwishyura inguzanyo yaba yarahawe , business plan ye n' ibindi .
GroFin ku Isi ifite imari shingiro yo gutangamo inguzanyo igera kuri miliyoni 310USD , imaze gutanga inguzanyo ku mishinga 450 ahatandukanye ikorera iyi mishinga ikaba imaze kugira " Economic impact " ingana na miliyari n' igice y' amadorari ya Amerika .
Christian Bugabo avuga ko GroFin Rwanda itanga inguzanyo kuva kuri miliyoni 70 kugera kuri miliyoni 700 z' amanyarwanda ku muntu wese w' ujuje ibisabwa .
GroFin Rwanda ikorera muri etage ya kane ku Gishushu mu mujyi wa Kigali mu nyubako ikoreramo Tele 10 munsi ya RDB .

Ahabanza » Uburinganire » Mu muco » Uko itegeko ry' umuryango riha inshingano abashakanye Uko itegeko ry' umuryango riha inshingano abashakanye Yanditswe kuwa 14 - 02 - 2017 Saa 02 :
06 Itegeko ry' Umuryango riha abashyingiranywe inshingano zo kwita ku rugo rwabo aho bose usanga bafite inshingano zingana haba ku mugore ndetse no ku mugabo bitandukanye n' ibyo abantu bamwe bafata inshingano zimwe bakaziha umugore izindi bakazita iz' umugabo .
Inshingano yo kwita ku bana no kubarera Kubera ugushyingirwa , abashyingiranywe bemera inshingano yo kwita ku bana bazabyarana , kubaha ibibatunga no kubarera bishingiye ku ndagagaciro z' umuco nyarwanda .
Iyo umwe mu bashyingiranywe ateshutse kuri iyo nshingano , uwo bashyingiranywe cyangwa undi muntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora kubimurega .
Inshingano yo guha uwo mwashyingiranywe ibimutunga Buri wese mu bashyingiranywe afite inshingano yo guha uwo bashyingiranywe ibimutunga iyo bikenewe .
Urugero ibitunga umuntu bitangwamo Ibitunga umuntu bitangwa mu rugero nyir ' ukubihabwa abikeneyemo kandi bigereranyije n' ubushobozi bwa nyir ' ukubitanga .
Ibitunga umuntu bitangwa mu mafaranga cyangwa mu bintu Uburinganire hagati y' abashyingiranywe Abashyingiranywe bafite uburenganzira n' inshingano bingana .
Abashyingiranywe bagomba kudahemukirana , gutabarana no gufashanya .
Inshingano yo kubana Ugushyingirwa biha abashyingiranywe uburyo bwo gushinga umuryango ndemyabuzima , kukanabaha itegeko ryo kubana .
Ugushyingirwa kutakurikiwe no kubana mu gihe cy' umwaka umwe ( 1 ) nta mpamvu zifite ishingiro guha umwe mu bashyingiranywe uburenganzira bwo gusaba ubutane .
Uburenganzira ku mutungo w' abashyingiranywe Uburenganzira ku mutungo w' abashyingiranywe butangira bakimara gushyingirwa imbere y' umwanditsi w' irangamimerere hakurikijwe uburyo bw' icungamutungo bahisemo .
Iyo ishyingirwa risheshwe cyangwa iyo riteshejwe agaciro mbere y' uko abashyingiranywe babana nta nkurikizi rigira ku mutungo w' abashyingiranywe keretse iyo bigaragaye ko hari uwo baribarafatanyije .
Ubuyobozi bw' urugo Abashyingiranywe bafatanya ubuyobozi bw' urugo rwabo harimo kurwitaho kugira ngo rugwize umuco mwiza n' ibirutunga no kurwubaka rugakomera .
Umwe mu bashyingiranywe yiharira iyo nshingano iyo undi adashobora kuyikora .
Iyo batabyumvikanyeho byemezwa n' inzego zibifitiye ububasha .
Kugira uruhare mu bitunga urugo Buri wese mu bashyingiranywe agomba kugira uruhare mu bitunga urugo rwabo bikurikije uburyo n' amikoro ye .
Kutubahiriza inshingano z' urugo Iyo umwe mu bashyingiranywe atubahirije inshingano ze , uwo bashyingiranywe ashobora kuregera urukiko rubifitiye ububasha kugira ngo hafatwe ibyemezo by' agateganyo birengera urugo cyane cyane ibyita ku bana .
Urukiko rufite ububasha mu manza zerekeye inshingano z' urugo Urukiko rufite ububasha mu manza zerekeye inshingano z' urugo rw' aho abashyingiranywe batuye cyangwa baba nirwo rusuzuma ibirego byerekeye inshingano z' urugo .

Umunsi w' abakundana uvuze iki ku byamamare muri muzika nyarwanda ?
( Amateka yawo ) Jay Polly , Eric Mucyo na Humble Jizzo bagize icyo bavuga kuri uyu munsi wahariwe abakundana Kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 14 Gashyantare 2017 , ni umunsi wahariwe abakundana ' Valentine ' s Day' .
Bamwe mu bahanzi bagize icyo bavuga kuri uyu munsi wa Saint Valentin Humble Jizzo umwe mu basore bagize itsinda rya Urban Boys yabwiye Izubarirashe . rw ko uyu munsi awufata nk' ukomeye kuko wizihizwa n' Isi yose , ariko ngo kuri we ibikorwa kuri uyu munsi abihoramo kuko yishimira umugore we , ati " njyewe n' umukunzi wanjye duhora muri uyu munsi kuko ibyo abandi bawukoraho tubikora buri gihe . "
Akomeza agira ati " Gusa nk' abandi bose kuri uyu munsi wahariwe abakundana dufata umwanya tukajya ahantu hadasanzwe tukishima . "
Humble Jizzo afite umukunzi ukomoka muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika witwa Army banaba nk' umugore n' umugabo .
Jay Polly we ngo azi ko ari umunsi abantu berekaniraho ko bakundana ati " nanjye mfite umuntu nkunda kandi cyane , uyu munsi ngomba gusangira nawe ibyiza . "
Abajijwe impano yamugeneye yagize ati " Buriya iby' abantu bakundana ni ibanga . "
Eric Mucyo we ngo uyu munsi usobanura ngo " Valentine ' s Day " bivuga ngo urukundo ni rwogere . "
Amateka ya Saint Valentin Umunsi wa Saint Valentin wakomotse ku mupadiri w' Umuromani witwa Valentin wabayeho ku gihe cy' umwami w' abami Claudius II ahagana mu myaka 269 na 273 mbere y' ivuka rya Yezu kirisitu .
Muri icyo gihe , tariki ya 14 Gashyantare habaga umunsi mukuru wo kwihiza umunsi w' umwamikazi Juno wafatwaga nk' imana y' abagore .
Kuri uwo munsi , abasore bandikaga amazina y' abakobwa bari mu kigero kimwe bakayashyira mu kintu , umusore yazamura izina ry' umukobwa guhera ubwo akamuherekeza bakajya kwizihiriza uwo munsi hamwe .
Ngo ibyo byatumaga abakobwa bahura n' abasore kuko mbere byabaga bibujije , ubushuti bwabo bugakomera bukava no kubana ubuziraherezo .
Ku ngoma ya Claudius igihugu cye cyaje kugarizwa n' intambara zikomeye , agira ikibazo cy' abasirikare bagomba kurwanira igihugu kubera ko abagabo bakiri bato bangaga gusiga abagore babo ngo bajye ku rugamba .
Umwami Claudius yafashe icyemezo cyo guhagarika gushaka , ariko Saint Valentin ntiyabyakira neza .
Afatanyije na Saint Marius batangira gusezeranya abantu bashaka kubana mu ibanga .
Amakuru yageze ku mwami Claudius ararakara ategeka ko Padiri Valentin afatwa agafungwa .
Padiri Valentin yarafunzwe , akatirwa urwo gupfa akubiswe amahiri akanacibwa umutwe .
Ngo igihe yarategereje iherezo rye , abantu bazanaga indabyo n' ubutumwa bwo kumukomeza bakazinyuza mu idirishya .
Uyu munsi uvugwaho byinshi .
Hari n' abavuga ko ubwo Valentin yari afunzwe , umukobwa w' umucungagereza yakomeje kumuba hafi , amusura kugeza igihe cyo kunyongwa .
Uwo mukobwa yari afite ubumuga bwo kutabona , ariko ibitangaza byabaye mu gihe yasengeraga Valentin yongeye kureba .
Ubwo haburaga umunsi umwe ngo Valentin anyongwe , bivugwa ko yanditse ku ruparuro amagambo agira ati : "
Love from your Valentine " ni ukuvuga " urukundo rwa Valentin wawe " amushimira urukundo n' ubudahemuka yamugaragarije .
Kuki St Valentin iba muri Gashyantare ( Février / February ) ?
Kera umunsi wo hagati mu kwezi kwa Gashyantare ufatwa nk' ikimenyetso cy' urukundo n' uburumbuke kuva mu bihe bya kera ( Antiquité ) .
Mu Bagereki , kwari ukwezi bibukagamo ubukwe bw' imana zabo zikomeye nka Zeus na Héra .
Mu Baromani , tariki 15 Gashyantare wabaga ari umunsi bizihizagaho Lupercales , aho baturaga ibitambo Lupercus , imana y' uburumbuke ( fertilité ) .
None se Saint Valentin ni nde ?
Muri Kiliziya Gatolika , habayeho ba Valentin 3 batandukanye bagiye bagirwa abatagatifu ( saints ) kubera ukwemera kwabo kutajegajega kwatumye bicwa nk' abahowe Imana ( martyrs ) n' ingoma z' igitugu zayoboraga Roma icyo gihe , hari mu kinyejana cya 3 .
Valentin wa Roma : Uyu yari padiri , yishwe mu kinyejana cya gatatu azira ukwemera kwe , ashyingurwa i Roma hafi y' inzira yitwa Via Flaminia ; Valentin wa Terni :
We yari umwepiskopi ( bishop ) , nawe akaba yarishwe , ashyingurwa aho uwa mbere yashyinguwe ; Valentin w' umumaritiri wo mu majyaruguru ya Afurika , amateka ye akaba atazwi neza .
Muri aba ba Valentin 3 rero , uwitirirwa uriya munsi ni Valentin w' i Roma , bivugwa ko ku ngoma y' umwami w' abami Claude w' umugome ( Claude Le Cruel ) , Roma yari mu ntambara abaturage batakundaga , maze afata icyemezo ko nta musirikari uzongera gushaka .
Hagati aho , Valentin we yakomeje gusezeranya rwihishwa abakundanaga , harimo n' abasore b' abasirikare .
Byaje kumenyekana ibukuru n' uko arafungwa , ku munsi wo kunyongwa we rero ( hari tariki 14 Gashyantare ) yoherereza umukobwa wari ufite se wacungaga iyo gereza agapapuro kanditseho ngo " biturutse kuri Valentin wawe " Uwo mukobwa ngo Valentin yamwibonagamo … Ng' uko uko Valentin yagizwe umurinzi w' abakundana ( le patron des amoureux ) .

Muhanga : Abahinzi b' umuceri barinubira igiciro bagurirwaho umusaruro wabo Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Mu muhango wo kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w' ibishanga wizihirijwe mu Karere ka Muhanga , kuri uyu wa gatanu tariki 31 Mutarama , abahinzi b' umuceri beruye bavuga ko badashimishijwe n' agaciro k' amafaranga bahabwa ku kilo cy' umuceri iyo bejeje kuko ngo bibateza igihombo .
Uyu muhango wabimburiwe n' igikorwa cy' umuganda .
Muri uyu muhango , abahinga umuceri mu gishanga cya Rugeramigozi ya mbere , kiri hagati y' Umurenge wa Nyamabuye , Shyogwe na Byimana yo mu Karere ka Muhanga , bibumbiye muri Koperative " Imparanira musaruro y' Abahinzi - borozi ba Rugeramigozi ( KIABR ) " bavuze ko imbaraga n' amafaranga bashora mu buhinzi bw' umuceri zidahwanye n' amafaranga y' u Rwanda 210 bahabwa ku kilo cy' umuceri .
Icyifuzo cyabo muri rusange ni uko Minisiteri ifite ubucuruzi mu nshingano n' ibindi bigo bifite aho bihurira n' ubuhinzi bakwicara bagasuzumana ubushishozi ikibazo cyabo kuko ngo barananiwe .
Umwe muri abo bahinzi witwa Kampire Primitive yagize ati " N ' aya maganabiri na cumi baduha barongera bakayakatamo , noneho hakiyongeraho umusanzu w' Akarere , ay' amazi n' ifumbire , aya mafaranga badutwara ni mbenshi .
Usanga umuhinzi ahubwo akorera mu gihombo , hari nabifuza kubireka . "
Kampire Primitive , wavugaga ko Igiciro cy' umuceri kiri hasi .
Guverineri w' Intara y' Amajyepfo , Munyantwari Alphonse wari uri muri uyu muhango yasabye aba bahinzi kubanza bakishimira ko babashije kongera umusaruro wabo , ugereranyije no mu myaka yashize .
Abizeza ko bagiye kubyigana n' izindi nzego zitandukanye zirimo Minisiteri y' ubuhinzi , Minisiteri y' bucuruzi n' ikigo cy' igihugu gishinzwe ubuhinzi n' ubworozi kugira ngo harebwe igiciro kinogeye abahinzi b' umuceri kuko ari kimwe mu gihugu hose .
Munyantwari Alphonse , Guverineri w' Intara y' Amajyepfo .
Igishanga cya Rugeramigozi ya mbere gihingwa ku buso bungana na hegitari 120 , muri zo 80 zihingwamo umuceri , naho 40 zisigaye zigahingwamo ibishyimbo n' ibigori .
Ibyerekeye n' umunsi mpuzamahanga wo kubungabunga ibishanga Kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe ibishanga mu Rwanda wari wahawe insanganyamatsiko igira iti " Ubuhinzi bwita ku bishanga , Inkingi yo kongera umusaruro . "
Dr Mukankomeje Rose , Umuyobozi mukuru w' Ikigo cy' Igihugu gishinzwe kubungabunga ibidukikije ( REMA ) yavuze ko kuba nibura 10 % by' ubuso bw' igihugu bugizwe n' ibishanga kandi ibyinshi muri byo bikaba bikorerwamo ubuhinzi byatumye umusaruro w' ubuhinzi wiyongera .
Dr Mukankomeje kandi asaba inzego zinyuranye kurushaho gufata neza ibishanga kugira ngo amazi abirimo adakama .
Yagize ati " Uyu munsi mpuzamahanga w' ibishanga washyiriweho mu rwego rwo kugirango buri wese atekereze ku kamaro ibishanga bifitiye abaturage by' umwihariko n' akamaro k' ibidukikije muri rusange .
Dr Rose Mukankomeje Umuyobozi mukuru wa REMA Imbere y' Abanyamakuru .
Amasezerano yo kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w' ibishanga yashyizweho umukono mu gihugu cya Iran mu mwaka w' 1971 .
U Rwanda rukaba rwaratangiye kuwizihiza kuwa 29 Ukuboza 2003 .
Abayobozi beretswe amazi yuhira umuceri .
Nyuma y' Ibiganiro Abayobozi bacinyanye akadiho n' Abaturage .
MUHIZI Elisée ububiko .

Areruya Joseph arasaba bagenzi be kumushyigikira agatwara Tour du Rwanda Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Tour du Rwanda 2016 irakomeje .
Agace ka mbere gasize Umunyarwanda , Areruya Joseph ari imbere ku rutonde rusange .
Uyu musore w' imyaka 20 , abona bagenzi be bamufashije ashobora kwegukana iri siganwa ry' icyumweru .
Areruya Joseph arasaba bagenzi be kumushyigikira no kumufasha kuko afite ubushobozi bwo gutwara Tour du Rwanda Kuri uyu wa mbere tariki 14 Ugushyingo 2016 , hakinwe umunsi wa kabiri , w' isiganwa rizenguruka u Rwanda ku igare , Tour du Rwanda 2016 .
Abasiganwa bahagurutse Centre Kicukiro , basoreza mu mujyi wa Kibungo , mu karere Ngoma ku ntera ya 96 , 4km .
Mu bakinnyi 73 batangiye isiganwa , 67 ni bo bashoboye gusoza .
Muri aba ntiharimo umunya - America Rugg Timothy wo muri Lowestrates . com yo muri Canada , wegukanye umunsi wa mbere wa Tour du Rwanda , basiganwa n' igihe umwe ku giti cye , ' Individual Time Trial .
Uyu mugabo w' imyaka 30 , yahise asezererwa muri Tour du Rwanda 2016 .
Umunyarwanda Areruya Joseph wa Les Amis Sportifs ni we uyoboye abandi ku rutonde rusange , amaze gukoresha 02h 16min 38 ' ' .
Nyuma yo kuba uwa kabiri muri Tour du Rwanda y' umwaka ushize , uyu musore w' imyaka 20 gusa , afite intego yo gutwara Tour du Rwanda uyu mwaka nk' uko yabitangarije Umuseke Areruya Joseph yagize ati : "
Ntibishobotse ko negukana iyi ' etape ' .
Kuko nari muri batatu ba mbere , nahagurutse mfite ikizere ko nintanatwara etape , nguma hafi ku rutonde rusange .
Twarenze i Rwamagana mbona abo duhanganye ku rutonde rusange basa n' abasigaye , nongera imbaraga cyane , byatumye nongera ibihe hagati yanjye nabo . "
Yavuze ko yishimiye cyane kwambara uyu mwenda w' Umuhondo , kuko ngo ni amateka kuri we .
Ati " Haracyari kare , sinakwemeza 100 % ko nzatwara Tour du Rwanda uyu mwaka .
Mpanganye n' abakinnyi bakomeye , bava mu makipe akomeye ku rwego rw' Isi .
Icyo nsaba bagenzi banjye , ni ugukomeza kunshyigikira , kuko uyu mwaka nitwaye neza mu masiganwa atandukanye nitabiriye , mfite n' ikizere ko na Tour du Rwanda nayitwara imana imfashije . "
Nyuma yo kwitwara neza k' uyu musore uvuka kuri Gahemba Jean Marie Vianney na we wasiganwaga ku magare , umuyobozi w' ishyirahamwe ry' umukino w' amagare mu Rwanda FERWACY , Bayingana Aimable , yabwiye abanyamakuru ko umunsi w' ejo yiteze ihangana rikomeye ku basiganwa , kuko ari inzira ziganjemo imisozi , umwihariko wa Tour du Rwanda 2016 .
Iminsi ibiri ya Tour du Rwanda yari uduce tutarimo imisozi , ejo kuwa kabiri tariki 15 Ugushyingo 2016 , abasiganwa barahaguruka kuri Kigali Convention Centre ku Kimihurura , bajya mu mujyi wa Karongi .
Umuhanda wiganjemo imisozi izagora abasiganwa .
Ni ku ntera ya 124 , 7km .
Aimable Bayingana avuga ko umwihariko wa Tour du Rwanda ari imisozi , kandi izatangira ejo , bivuga ko ihangana rigiye gukomera Ku kihanda abanyarwanda baba bategereje amagare ari benshi , bateze amaso uko Tour du Rwanda izarangira Rugg Timothy wo muri Lowestrates . com wegukanye Prologue yasezerewe mu isiganwa kuko yananiwe gusoza uyu munsi Uyu musore w' imyaka 20 ni ubwa mbere yambaye maillot jaune muri Tour du Rwanda Roben NGABO UMUSEKE .

Irebere amwe mumafoto atangaje y' umuhanzi kazi LADY Gaga , ukoyariyambaye muri Grammy award benshi banabifashe nko gushotora abagabo .
Stefani Joanne Angelina Germanotta uzwi cyane nka Lady Gaga , yavutse taliki ya 28 werurwe 1986 , kuri ubu ni umuririmbyi , umwanditsi w' indirimbo , umukinnyi wa filme , ndetse akaba akora nakazi ko gutunganya indirimbo .

Rwanda & France : Ubufatanye mu kazi muri Centre Africa Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Nta mwanzi iteka .
Ingabo z' Rwanda n' ingabo z' Ubufaransa mu myaka nka 20 ishize zigeze guhanganira mu majyepfo n' Uburengerazuba bw' u Rwanda .
Izi ngabo ubu ziri kugaragaza ubufatanye mu bikorwa muri Centre Africa nk' uko byagaragaye mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 21 Werurwe 2014 .
Muri iki gitondo , abasirikare b' u Rwanda mu butumwa bwiswe MISCA baganira n' uw' Ubufaransa uri mu butumwa bwiswe Sangaris Centre Africa imvururu ntizirashira neza , abiyise Anti - Balaka bo ku ruhande rw' abakiristu baracyashaka kwihorera ku baturage b' abaislamu bita ko ari abo muri Sélèka , barimo abakoze ubwicanyi ku baturage b' abakristu nyuma yo guhirika Francois Bozize ku butegetsi .
Ibikorwa byo kwihorera , ubusahuzi n' ubundi bugizi bwa nabi , guherekeza abaislamu bahunga ubugizi bwa nabi , guherekeza imodoka zigeza ibiribwa n' ubufasha ku babikeneye nibyo ahanini ingabo zatumwe kubungabunga amahoro ziri gukora .
Ingabo z' u Rwanda biciye muri Ministeri yazo zakomeje kugaragaza uburyo ziri gukoramo umurimo wazijyanye .
Zishimwa cyane n' amahanga ndetse n' abaturage ba Centre Afrique ubwabo , bavuga ko ingabo z' u Rwanda zikora neza ibyazizanye .
Abasirikare barenga 800 b' u Rwanda bagiye muri Centre Afrique bahasanga abasirikare bagera ku 1 600 b' Ubufaransa barimo abahageze nyuma gato y' ihirikwa rya Bozizé ndetse n' abari bahasanzwe .
Ingabo z' Ubufaransa ziri mu butumwa bo bise " Sangaris " ntizivugwaho rumwe ku byazijyanye muri iki gihugu cyahoze gikolonijwe n' Ubufaransa .
Amafoto y' umunyamakuru Pierre Boisselet amwe yagaragaje abasirikare b' umufaransa muri iki gitondo bahujwe n' akazi , ko kugarura umutekano , n' ingabo z' u Rwanda , bavugana icyo bagiye gukora .
Hari mu guhagarika ubugumutsi bw' abo bikekwa ko ari aba " Anti - Balaka " bo muri imwe muri quartier za Bangui ituwe cyane n' abakiristu .
Ingabo z' u Rwanda ziri mu butumwa bwo kugarura amahoro ahatandukanye zishimirwa uko zikora umurimo wazo , mu gitondo cya none hagaragajwe ibaruwa y' ubuyobozi bw' ingabo ziri mu butumwa muri Sudan bwa UNAMID , bushimira ingabo z' u Rwanda .
Iyi baruwa CONGRATULATORY NOTE - 2 ( 1 ) yandikiwe uyoboye ingabo z' u Rwanda muri Sudan , irashimira ibikorwa by' intangarugero n' imyitwarire mu guhosha imirwano yahuje amoko y' aba Aballa na Gamir mu ntangiriro z' uku kwezi mu gace ka Salaf Omra muri Darfur .
Ingabo z' Ubufaransa n' ingabo z' u Rwanda , ubu kandi zikaba zikorana mu kugarura amahoro mu majyaruguru ya Mali aho ubutumwa bwiswe MINUSMA , aho ingabo ziri muri ubu butumwa ziyobowe n' umusirikare w' Umufaransa yungirijwe na Maj Gen Jean Bosco Kazura .
Ingabo z' u Rwanda zafashe umugabo witwaje imbunda zinatabara umwe mu bakomeretse wajyanywe na ambulance ngo avurwe Mu gitondo kare , icyari kigambiriwe ni ugukuraho izi bariyeri zashyizweho n' abaturage mu mihanda Muri iyi quartier y' abakiristu ikunze kubamo ubugizi bwa nabi umusirikare w' u Rwanda aravugana n' abaturage uw' Ubufaransa nawe ku runhande hafi yabo Photos / Pierre Boisselet ububiko .

Icyo wakora ugatunga inzara zifite isuku Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abagore n' abagobwa cyane cyane bakunze gufata umwanya munini bita ku nzara zabo .
Kimwe mu binezeza umugore cyangwa umokobwa wese ni ukobana inzara ze zisukuye kandi zisize neza .
Menya ko hari byinshi byagufasha gutunga inzara zisa neza .
Gusiga inzara ni kimwe mubyo abagore n' abakobwa bakunda ( photo : internet ) .
Hari uburyo bwinshi bukunze gukoreshwa n' abagore ndetse n' abakobwa basukura inzara zabo , bamwe bahitamo gusiga Verini zitandukanye , abandi bagahitamo kuzikorera isuku bisanzwe .
Kugirira isuku inzara zawe si ibintu byo guhubukirwa ubikora uko wishakiye , kuko inzara ari kimwe mu byunganira ingingo z' umubiri nk' intoki n' amano kugaragara neza .
Hari uburyo butatu tugiye kugarukaho bwagufasha kugira inzara zifite isuku .
Uko wakwita ku nzara zawe ubaye ufite inzara zinjira mu mubiri Inzara zinjira mu mubiri kuri bamwe birababaza ndetse hari n' abandi bitera gukomereka nk' iyo bari kuzica , bagira ngo bazivane mu mubiri .
Akenshi iyo ugira inzara zinjira mu mubiri bishobora guterwa no gucibwa nabi , kwambara inkweto nto zikanda amano , kwambara amasogisi mato atagukwira neza bigatuma inzara zinjira mu mubiri .
- Icyo wakora rero ; ni ukwirinda kwambara inkweto zikwegereye cyane cyangwa amasogisi matoya .
- Nyuma yo kwiyuhagira , ni byiza gusiga inzara zawe umuti ' antiseptic ' urwanya udukoko ( bacteries ) twinjira mu mubiri .
- Abafite umubiri wo kuruhande y' urwara watukuye , ukubabaza ndetse rimwe na rimwe ukazana amashyira , ibi ushobora kubirwanya ukoresheje umuti bita iodine , utumbika ibirenge byawe mu mazi arimo uwo muti hagati y' iminota 10 na 15 , hanyuma nyuma ukaza kwisiga antiseptic .
- Ni byiza kandi kwibuka kujya kwivuza mu gihe ubona ufite ikibazo gikomeye cy' uburwayi buterwa n' inzara zinjira mu mubiri .
Ibireba abisiga Verini ku nzara Abagore ndetse n' abakobwa benshi bakunda kwisiga Verini cyane nk' iyo bagiye mu birori , iyo bagiye ku kazi ndetse n' ahandi .
Uretse ko hari n' abandi batita ku isuku y' abo , ugasanga bafite inzara zatangiye gushishukaho Verini , ibi akenshi usanga bigaragara nabi cyane .
- Icyo wa kora ; Mbere yo kwisiga Verini ni ngombwa kubanza ugakaraba inzara zawe ukoreheje amazi ndetse n' isabune bifite isuku , ndetse ukazivanamo imyanda , ukazica .
- Iyo inzara zawe zisanzwe zifite indi verini , mu gihe ushaka gusiga indi shya ubanza guhanagura iya mbere ukoresheje umuti bita disoruva .
- Ni byiza gukoresha ibikoresho bishya igihe ugiye gusiga inzara zawe , nk' inzembe , ipamba , disoruva n' ibindi .
- Si byiza gukoresha Verini ya ' pirate ' kuko iyi ituma inzara zangirika kurushaho , dore ko zishobora guhindura isura zigasa umukara .
- Si byiza gucugusa Verini yawe mbere yo kuyisiga ku nzara .
- Irinde kujya ku zuba igihe umaze kwisiga Verini .
- Si byiza gukaraba amazi ashyushye ndetse no kumesa igihe umaze kwisiga Verini kuko bishobora gutuma ivaho .
Guhitamo ibara rya Verini usiga ku nzara Ni byiza guhitamo Verini ukurikije uko uruhu rwawe rusa , uko imyambaro yawe isa ndetse ushobora no kujyanisha n' ibirungo ' make - up' byawe .
Satisfashionug . com dukesha iyi nkuru ikavuga ko ushobora kandi guhitamo ibara rya Verini bitewe n' amarangamutima , aho ugiye cyangwa ibihe urimo .
Robert Kayihura UMUSEKE .

Ese waba wibaza igihe inzovu isinzira ugereranyije nuko ingana ?
Ubushakashatsi byakozwe bugaragaza ko inzovu zo mu ishyamba zo muri Afurika zisinzira igihe gito cyane ugereranyije n' izindi nyamaswa zonsa zihakomoka .
Abashakashatsi bakurikirana ibijyanye n' imibereho y' inzovu bakoze ubushakashatsi ku inzovu ebyiri mu gihugu cya Botswana bagamije kumenya uko ziryama .
Mu bushakashatsi bakoze , basanze inzovu ziba ahantu hagenewe kuba inyamaswa hazwi nka " zoos " zishobora gusinzira igihe kiri hagati y' amasana ane n' atandatu ku munsi , ni mugihe iyo ziri aho sisanzwe ziba mu mashyamba asanzwe zisinzira amasaha agera kuri abari gusa ku munsi .
Aba bashakashatsi kandi bavumbuye ko inzobu zonsa zikuze zishobora kumara iminsi myinshi zidasinziriye .
Ibi ngo bikaba biterwa nuko mugihe ziri konsa zijya zigenda cyane zihunga abantu bazihiga .
Inzovu zo mu mashyamba ya Africa zisinzira igihe gito Nkuko Prof . Paul Manger ukora muri ishuri rya Witwatersrand ho muri Afurika y' Epfo yabitangarije BBC , inzovu zigira ibitotsi bike cyane .
Yagize ati " inzovu nizo nyamaswa zisinzira umwanya muto cyane mu bikoko byonsa .
Ibi bikaba bituruka kukuba inzovu ari inyamaswa nini cyane . "
Mu bushakashatsi bwakozwe n' umuhanga Eugene M .
McCarty , PHD , kubijyanye n' inzovu bwagaragaje ko inzovu nini cyane ishobora kupima 7000kg aribyo bihwanye na toni 7 .

Gushyira imbere umuziki nyarwanda byawugeza kure – umuhanzi w' Umunyarwanda uba muri Diaspora Umuhanzi David Diyen ntaramenyekana cyane mu Rwanda Umuhanzi w' Umunyarwanda Ndikumana David Diyen ukorera umuziki muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z' Amerika ashimangira ko Abanyarwanda bakomeje gushyigikira umuziki w' iwabo byawuteza imbere .
Diyen , w' imyaka 26 , afatira urugero ku bihugu nka Tanzaniya , Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo , Uganda , Nigeriya n' ibindi byagejeje umuziki wabyo kure ahanini bihereye kuri uyu muco wo gushyigikira ibihangano by' iwabo mu gihugu .
Uyu muhanzi agira ati " Abanyarwanda bakwiye kugira umuhate mu gukomeza kuba hafi abahanzi nyarwanda , bakabashyigikira , bakagira umuhate mu gukundisha ab' ahandi umuziki nyarwanda kugira ngo urusheho kumenyekana . "
Ibi Diyen avuga ko bikozwe umuziki nyarwanda warushaho kugira agaciro cyane .
Diyen asaba ko by' umwihariko nk' abanyamakuru , aba Djs , abamamaza ibikorwa by' umuziki n' abandi bafite aho bahuriye n' iterambere ry' umuziki mu Rwanda ari bo ibi bireba cyane .
Yitanzeho urugero , avuga ko nka we umuziki akora umuhenda nk' umuhanzi uba muri Diaspora , ku buryo bakenera gushyigikirwa n' abari imbere mu Rwanda by' umwihariko .
Agira , ati " hanze bikozwe ku buryo wishyura ku isaha , ugakorana n' abantu banyuranye byaba ari ugufata amajwi cyangwa amashusho biba bihenze .
Ibijyanye no kumenyekanisha ibikorwa udahari na none biragora cyane , bidusaba rero ko n' Abanyarwanda bagira urwo rukundo rwo gukunda iby' ab' iwabo . "
Uyu muhanzi aheruka gusohora amashusho y' indirimbo ye nshya yise ' Let Them Talk ' akorana na Studio ikomeye muri Miami yitwa Regulus Films Ent .
Avuga ko ahereye kuri iyi ndirimbo yiteze kwagura umuziki we akagera ku rwego mpuzamahanga , bityo nawe agahesha ishema Abanyarwanda .
Uretse ' Let Them Talk ' Diyen aheruka no gusohora indirimbo yise ' Icyemezo ' , anasohora indi yise ' Impanda ' ivuga ku butumwa bw' Imana .

Sanjeev wayoboraga BPR yahawe izindi nshingano muri Atlas Mara Sanjeev Anand , wari usanzwe ayobora Banki y' Abaturage y' u Rwanda ( BPR ) yahawe kuyobora ibijyanye n' imari n' amabanki muri Atlas Mara .
Sanjeev Anand , wari usanzwe ayobora Banki y' Abaturage y' u Rwanda ( BPR ) yahawe inshingano nshya muri Atlas Mara Ubuyobozi bwa Atlas Mara , ikigo cyaguze imigabane ingana na 62 . 1 % ya BPR , butangaza ko izo mpinduka mu buyobozi zikozwe mu rwego rwo kurushaho guteza imbere imikorere y' iyo banki .
Atlas Mara itangaza kandi ko John Vitalo wari usanzwe ari umuyobozi mukuru w' ikigo Atlas Mara yeguye ku mirimo ye .
Ibyo bivuze ko atazongera kuyobora inama y' ubutegetsi ya BPR .
Linda Kalimba Mulenga wari usanzwe ari mu buyobozi bukuru bwa BPR niwe wahawe kuyobora by' agateganyo inama y' ubutegetsi ya BPR .
Ikindi ni uko ubuyobozi bw' inama y' ubutegetsi ya BPR bwatangiye gushaka uzasimbura Sanjeev Anand , ariko mu gihe atarabona umusimbura azakomeza gukora imirimo yari ashinzwe .
Ubuyobozi bwa BPR buvuga ko bukomeje intego yo kugira iyo banki indashyikirwa mu Rwanda no ku isi mu rwego rwo guteza imbere ubucuruzi no gufasha u Rwanda kugera ku ntego rwiyemeje zo guteza imbere ubukungu .
Bunatangaza ko bashyize imbere gukorera abakiriya babo ibyiza , abanyamigabane , n' abakozi bayo muri rusange .
Atlas Mara ni ikigo cy' ubucuruzi n' ishoramari gikorera mu bihugu bya Botswana , Zimbabwe , Zambia , Tanzaniya , Mozambique , Nijeriya n' u Rwanda .
Iki kigo kivuga ko gishaka kuzaba ikigo cya mbere mu ishoramari muri Afurika yo mu nsi y' ubutayu bwa Sahara .
Kandi abakurikirana iby' imari n' iterambere bahamya ko Atlas Mara iri mu bigo bizamuka cyane ku isi muri iyi myaka .
Atlas Mara ishora imari mu by' amabanki , ikoranabuhanga , gucuruza imari n' imigabane no gushakira igishoro ibigo bikomeye na za Leta z' ibihugu , bakazajya bacyungukira .
Atlas Mara yaguze BPR , yegukana imigabane ingana na 62 % mu mutungo wa BPR wose .
Atlas Mara kandi yanaguze ishami ry' ubucuruzi rya Banki y' u Rwanda itsura amajyambere BRD .

Knowless yatangaje manager we Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Nyuma y' uko hari ababyiyitiriraga bikamutera ikibazo , Knowless yatangaje manager we .
Nyuma y' uko hagaragaye ukwiyitirira kuba manager w' umuhanzi kazi Knwoless , nyiru bwite yiyemeje gutangaza manager we wibihe byose kandi akanatangaza ko ntawundi mu manager afite uretse we gusa akanamushimira ibyo agenda amufashamo byose .
Umuhanzikazi nyarwanda Knowless Nubwo uyu muhanzi afashe iki cyemezo cyo gutangaza manager we ngo ntiyorohewe nagato nabamwe mubiyitirira uwo mwanya ngo kumpamvu nawe ubwe ataramenya kugeza uyumunsi akaba avugako manager we ari umwe ariwe Abdou KITOKO kandi ngo akaba ari manager we w' ibihe byose ntampamvu nimwe kugeza uyu munsi yatuma ahindura manager kuko manager we barikumwe ubu amufashe neza .
Knowless ati " ndashimira cyane manager wanjye Abdou KITOKO kandi ndanemeza ko nta wundi mu manager mfite uretse we gusa " knwoless mugutangaza ibi byaturutse ahanini no kuba yumva inkuru zitari impamo zavugaga ahanini kuri manager we .
Uretse iki cyemezo ngo uyu muhanzikazi kandi ubu aritegura kugaragariza umusaruro abafana be anabashimira cyane uburyo bamufasha mubikorwa bye .

Perezida Paul Kagame yafunguye inama mpuzamahanga yiga kubijyanye n' iby ' indege Kigali , 22 Gashyantare 2017 Abantu barenga 500 bahagarariye ibihugu 58 bakora mu mirimo itandukanye ijyanye n' iby' indege , kuri uyu wa gatatu tariki 22 Gashyantare 2017 bateraniye i Kigali muri Convention Centre mu inama Nyafurika ya 2017 ku bijyanye n' ubwikorezi bw' indege ( Aviation Africa 2017 Conference ) .
Iyi nama izamara iminsi ibiri , yafunguwe k' umugaragaro na Perezida wa Repuburika , Nyakubahwa Kagame Paul .
Iyi nama ikaba igamije gukora ubukangurambaga mu ishoramari ku bijyanye n' ubwikorezi bw' indege muri Afurika hamwe no guhuza abashoramari bo mu bihugu n' abo ku rwego mpuzamahanga , hakoreshejwe inzira zo mu kirere .
Nyakubahwa Perezida Kagame mu ijambo rye , yagarutse ku bwitange bw' ibihugu 44 by' Afurika mu myaka 15 ishize , bagize mu gukuraho amategeko ajyanye na serivisi z' indege no kuzamura urwego rw' ubucuruzi mu karere hakoreshejwe indege .
Ku bijyanye no kwitanga mu koroshya ubuhahirane , Nyakubahwa Perezida Kagame yagize ati : "
U Rwanda rwateye intambwe ikomeye mu gushyiraho uburyo bwo gutwara abantu n' ibintu hakoreshejwe inzira z' ikirere kw' isoko Nyafurika , mu rwego rwo gufungura ikirere cyacu no gukorana neza n' ibihugu dufitanye umubano , kugirango dukore ibintu bimwe .
Igihe ikirere cyacu gifunze , biba bikomeye kugirango dukore ubwikorezi bw' indege , bityo tugatakaza igihe no guhendwa " .
Minisitiri w' Ibikorwa Remezo , Nyakubahwa Musoni Jemes yavuze ko urwego rw' ubwikorezi ari kimwe mu bigenderwaho mu rwego rwo kuzamura ubukungu bw' igihugu .
Umugaba w' Ingabo zirwanira mu Kirere yagaragaje itandukaniro riri hagati y' urwego rushinzwe iby' indege za gisiviri n' urw' iza gisirikare mu bijyanye no gucunga umutekano w' ikirere w' igihugu yavuze ko kurinda umutekano w' ikirere cy' igihugu bidashobora gushingira ku mfashanyo z' amahanga nkuko mu zindi nzego za gisiviri bigenda kubera ingaruka zabyo ku mutekano w' igihugu .
Brig Gen Charles Karamba yasobanuriye abitabiriye inama agira ati : "
Ikigo cy' igihugu gishinzwe ibijyanye n' indege za gisiviri n' urushinzwe ibya gisirikare bitandukanye nubwo bifite aho bihurira kubijyanye n' akamaro k' umutekano n' ubukungu bw' igihugu " .
Iyi nama y' iminsi ibiri yiga ku bijyanye n' ubwikorezi bw' abantu n' ibintu mu ndege , yitabiriwe n' abantu baturutse mu ibigo bitanga serivisi z' ibijyanye n' indege , aribo :
Abatekinisiye b' indege , abashinzwe ibijyanye n' ubucuruzi muri service z' indege , abasirikare , hamwe n' abaturutse mu bigo by' amashuri yigisha iby' indege .
Iyi nama Nyafurika ya 2017 ku bijyanye n' ubwikorezi bw' indege ibaye ku nshuro ya kabiri , ikaba ari inshuro ya mbere ibereye k' Umugabane w' Afurika .
Chameleone yasuye urwibutso rwa Gisozi Kamonyi :

USAID / HIGA UBEHO mu kuzamura ubuzima bw' abatuye Kayonza Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abayobozi ba Global communities na Young Women Christian Association ( YWCA ) basobanuriye abayobozi b' inzego z' ibanze mu karere ka Kayonza ibijyanye n' umushinga wa USAID / HIGA UBEHO ugamije kuzamura imibereho y' abaturage ba Kayonza .
Inama yabereye muri Hoteli MIDLAND kuri uyu wa 14 Kanama 2013 .
Abitabiriye inama yo gutangiza umushinga USAID HIGA UBEHO muri Kayonza Umushinga wa USAID / HIGA UBEHO mu karere ka Kayonza uterwa inkunga n' abaturage ba Leta Zunze ubumwe z' Amarika binyujijwe mu kigega cy' Abanyamerika cy' iterambere mpuzamahanga ( USAID ) binyujijwe mu kigo cya Global Communities ( Icyahoze ari CHF International ) ugashyirwa mu bikorwa n' umuryango w' urubyiruko rw' Abakritukazi mu Rwanda – Young Women ' s Christian Association ( YWCA Rwanda ) .
Atangiza inama umuyobozi w' akarere ka Kayonza wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza , Madame MUTESI Anita yahaye ikaze umushinga kandi avuga ko uwo mushinga uje kunganira leta mu bikorwa ifite byo gufasha abaturage kwikura mu bukene .
Madame MUTESI yashimiye YWCA Rwanda ku bufatanye bafitanye kuko bafite indi mishinga bakorera muri aka karere .
USAID / HIGA UBEHO ni umushinga watangiye muri Nzeri 2009 ukaba ugamije kwita ku miryango ikennye cyane mu Rwanda mu birebana n' ubuzima , imibereho myiza , ubukungu no kubaka ubushobozi .
Uyu mushinga ugiye gutangira mu karere ka Kayonza , uzafasha Abanyarwanda bari mu miryango ibarirwa mu cyiciro cya mbere , icya kabiri n' icya gatatu by' ubudehe .
Ibikorwa byawo bizaba bigamije kubaka ubukungu biciye mu matsinda yo kwizigamira no kuguzanya , kwihaza mu biribwa binyuze mu bikorwa bitandukanye biha abagize amatsinda ubumenyingiro , no ku buhinzi bubyara umusaruro mwinshi ku butaka buto .
Ikindi hazajya hatangwa imbuto ibereye ubutaka bafite ndetse no kurwanya imirire mibi binyuze mu matsinda .
Ibi bikorwa byose bigamije gusigira aba baturage umurage wo guhindura imyumvire bakagera ku bukungu .
Mu ijambo rye umunyamabanga mukuru wa YWCA Rwanda yashimiye Ubuyobozi bw' akarere ka Kayonza n' abayobozi binzego z' ibanze ku bufatanye bakomeje kugaragariza YWCA mu bikorwa byose ikorera muri ako karere abasaba gufatanya na YWCA mu gushyira mu bikorwa uyu mushinga kandi abizeza ko USAID / HIGA UBEHO program izahindura imibereho y' abagenerwabikorwa bakava mu byiciro barimo bakerekeza mu bindi mu gihe bazaba bakurikiranye neza gahunda z' umushinga .
Umuyobozi wa Global communities mu Rwanda mu ijambo rye yabwiye abari mu nama ko akigera mu Rwanda akarere ka mbere yasuye ari Kayonza , aho yasuye ishuri ry' imyuga riri I Kayonza .
Yavuze ko ahantu uno mushinga wakorewe wagize uruhare mu guhindura imibereho y' abagenerwabikorwa , yizeza abanya Kayonza ko uyu mushinga ari umwe muri myinshi igamije iterambere bafite kandi bishimiye gukorera mu karere ka Kayonza .
Avuga ku kamaro k' umushinga yatanze ubuhamya bw' umugore umwe wagiye mu mushinga ananutse cyane , afite imyaka 70 kandi abana n' ubwandu bwa Virus Itera SIDA , ndetse akaba umukene ariko ubu avuga ko afite umuryango yumva akomeye arishoboye kandi afite icyizere cy' ubuzima .
Mu gihe cy' amezi 14 , ibikorwa byose by' uyu mushinga bizajya bikorerwa mu matsinda 175 yo kubitsa no kugurizanya , buri tsinda rizaba rigizwe n' abantu 20 .
Amatsinda 41 yo kwigiramo guhinga no kwihaza mu biribwa n' andi matsinda mato agamije kwigishirizwamo kurwanya imirire mibi no kwita by' umwihariko ku bana bafite mu nsi y' imyaka itanu , umushinga ukazakorana n' abantu bari hagati ya 3500 - 4000 HATANGIMANA Ange Eric UMUSEKE .

Uko itumanaho rizakorwa mu bitaro nyuma yo kubuza abaganga gukoresha telefoni ngendanwa Yanditswe na Mukaneza M .
Ange Kuya 12 Gashyantare 2017 saa 03 :
16 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
19 0 Tariki ya 9 Gashyantare 2017 nibwo amakuru yasakaye ko nta muganga uwo ariwe wese mu gihugu uzongera kwemererwa gukoresha telefoni igihe ari mu kazi .
Umwanzuro uzatangira kubahirizwa tariki ya 1 Werurwe 2017 wafatiwe mu mwiherero wahuje abakora mu nzego z' ubuzima barimo abagize inama z' ubutegetsi , abakozi b' uturere na Minisitiri w' ubuzima , Dr Diane Gashumba .
Nyuma yo gutangaza iki cyemezo , abantu batandukanye bibajije uburyo abaganga bazabaho nta tumanaho kuko uretse kuvugana n' imiryango yabo , hari ubwo biba ngombwa ko umuganga akenera kuvugana na mugenzi we ukora mu bindi bitaro .
Mu kiganiro yagiranye n' itangazamakuru tariki ya 10 Gashyantare 2017 , Minisitiri w' Ubuzima , Dr Diane Gashumba , yavuze ko itumanaho ritazahagarara burundu ndetse agaragaza uburyo bizajya bikorwa .
Ati " Gufata telefoni uvura umurwayi ni serivisi mbi .
Abanyarwanda bamaze iminsi babivuga ku maradiyo no ku mateleviziyo .
Ntabwo rero twaciye telefoni ku mavuriro neza neza kuko turemera ko turi mu gihugu gishyira imbere ikoranabuhanga , turemera ko mu buvuzi ushobora kuba uri mu bitaro bya Kirehe ugakenera kuvugana n' umuganga uri Faisal . "
Yakomeje avuga ko telefoni zizashyirwa muri serivisi zitandukanye aho zizahabwa abayobozi ariko nimero zazo zigatangazwa ku buryo umuntu wese amenya ngo ni nkenera umuganga uri mu bitaro runaka ndamubona .
Igihe umuyobozi atakoze azajya ayisiga undi mukozi ariwe ubasha guhuza abo hanze n' abaganga .
Ati " Itumanaho ntirizacika mu bitaro , icyo twaciye ni ya serivisi mbi , aho umurwayi aza aho kugirango umusuzume ugafata telefoni ukaganira ibitagize aho bihuriye n' akazi ukora . "
Dr Gashumba avuga ko bazafatanya n' abaganga mu gushyiraho amabwiriza y' uburyo itumanaho rizakorwa bitababangamiye kandi n' abarwayi bakarushaho guhabwa umwanya uhagije .
Minisiteri y' Ubuzima ivuga ko nta makosa yagiye ibona yaturutse ku burangare abaganga bagize bari kuri telefoni ahubwo ko ari ibisanzwe , umuntu uwo ariwe wese iyo ari ku kazi ari no kuri telefoni umutima uba utari hamwe .
Ibipimo byamuritswe n' Ikigo cy' Igihugu cy' Imiyoborere , RGB , kuwa 31 Mutarama 2017 , bigaragaza ko icyiciro cy' imitangire ya Serivisi cyagize amanota ari hasi ugereranyije n' ibindi , kuko cyagize 72 . 93 % mu gihe mu 2014 cyari kuri 72 . 00 % .

Nyuma y' iyegura rya ba gitifu ubu noneho inkundura igeze muri Dasso Mu mujyi wa Kigali bamaze kwegura bose uko ari 3 nukuvuga umuyobozi wa Dasso mu karere ka Gasabo , Nyarugenge na Kicukiro .
Umuyobozi w' akarere ka Nyarugenge Kayisiime Nzaramba Amakuru agera ku kinyamakuru imirasire . com yahawe n' abamwe mu bagize urwego rwa Dasso ariko batifuje ko imyirondoro yabo igaragara mu itangazamakuru , bavuze ko batazi ikihishe inyuma yo kwegura ku bayobozibabo dore ko hari na bamwe baba bacyeka ko ukwegura kwabo gufitanye isano na ruswa ishingiye ku myubakire y' akajagali ivugwa kuri bamwe mu ba Dasso .
Umwe mu bagize Dasso ukorera mu karere ka Nyarugenge yagize ati " kugeza ubu ntituzi icyatumye umuyobozi wacu yegura twagiye twumva ko yaba acyekwaho ruswa ikaba ariyo mpamvu yaba yaregujwe " Hari andi makuru nayo twari twabwiwe na bamwe mu ba Dasso ko uwahoze ari umuyobozi wabo witwa Mugabo Edouard , yaba yaregujwe kubera ko acyekwaho ruswa .
Ikinyamakuru imirasire cyashatse kumenya ibivugwa n' aba ba Dasso maze umunyamakuru w' imirasire . com avugana n' umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Nyarugenge Kayisime Nzaramba maze nawe yemeza ko Mugabo Edouard atakiri umukozi w' urwego rwa Dasso mu karere ka Nyarugenge .
Yagize ati " Nibyo koko Umuyobozi wa Dasso mu karere ka Nyarugenge Mugabo Edouard ntakiri mu mirimo ye kuko yanditse asaba kwegura ku mpamvu ze bwite " Ku kibazo cyuko byaba bivugwa ko yirukanywe mu kazi acyekwaho ruswa Mayor yavuze ko atari byo kuko mu ibaruwa bafite yanditse asaba kwegura ku bushake bwe .
Usibye kandi uyu muyobozi wa Dasso mu karere ka Nyarugenge bivugwa ko yegujwe , hari n' andi makuru avuga ko umuyobozi wa Dasso mu karere ka Kicukiro Haguma nawe yaba yaregujwe ku mpamvu zifite aho zihuriye na ruswa , twashatse kumenya icyo ubuyobozi bw' Akarere ka Kicukiro buvuga kuri ayo makuru , Tuvugana n' umuyobozi w' Akarere Dr Nyirahabima Jeanne mu magambo make yabwiye umunyamakuru wa imirasire . com ko ayo makuru ari ukuri ko Haguma atakiri mu kazi ariko ahakana ko yaba yaregujwe kuko yanditse asaba kwegura ku mpamvu ze bwite .
Yagize ati " yanditse asaba kwegura ku mpamvu ze bwite , ikindi nuko iyo umuntu asezeye haba hari impamvu ibyo mbabwiye birahagije " Umuyobozi wa Dasso mu karere ka Gasabo Ndirima Patrick mawe ntakiri muri uwo mwanya aho bivugwa ko yaba yarasezeye akajya gukomeza amasomo ye .
Mu bushakashasi buherutse gukorwa n' ikigo k' igihugu gishinzwe imiyoborere RGB cyerekanye ko urwego rwa Dasso rufitiwe ikizere n' abaturage ku kigero cya 86 % usibye ko bamwe mubaturage bavuze ko iyo mibare babona ari myinshi dore ko hari n' abavuze ko urwego rwa Dasso rutari kurenza 20 % .
Mugabo Edouard wari umukuru wa Dasso mu karere ka Nyarugenge Dore uko ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje , U bushakashatsi bugaragaza ko abaturage bafitiye inzego z' umutekano icyizere gikomeye , aho igisirikare cy' u Rwanda cyizewe ku kigero cya 99 % , Polisi y' u Rwanda ikaba yizewe ku kigero cya 97 . 4 % naho urwego rw' uturere rushinzwe umutekano ruzwi nka DASSO rwo rukaba rufitiwe icyizere ku kigero cya 86 . 1 % , hanyuma Inkeragutabara zo zikaba zizewe ku kigero cya 76 . 6 % .
Bagabo John Ego ko Imana izi byose gusa ibyayo birenze ibyacu !

Menya impamvu abagore bagira amarangamutima cyane bakaba banarira !
Abahanga mu bya Siyansi , bemeza ko abagabo ari bo bagira amarangamutima cyane kurusha abagore , gusa bakabarusha kuyahisha ku buryo ntawapfa kubimenya .
Nk' uko urubuga elcrema rubigaragaza hari impamvu abagore bo batabasha guhisha amarangamutima yabo nk' uko abagabo babigenza .
Dore impamvu abagore badahisha amarangamutima yabo :
1 . Sosiyete : Abahanga muri ibi bavuga ko biterwa na sosiyete umuntu abamo , ihora ishyira umugore hasi nk' umuntu woroheje ntimuhe agaciro akwiye .
Ibyo bituma abagabo na bo bumva ko barenze ku bagore babo maze bikaba ngombwa ko bahisha amarangamutima yabo banga gusuzugurwa .
Igitandukanye n' ibyo ku bagore ni uko bo bumva ko ibyo kugaragaza amarangamutima ntacyo bibatwaye maze bagahitamo kuyerekana aho baba bari hose nta cyo bikanga .
2 . Impuhwe za kibyeyi :
Abagore benshi bagira impuhwe nyinshi .
Abahanga bagaragaza ko impuhwe n' ibindi bikorwa byose bigamije kwita ku muntu biba ari amarangamutima adashobora guhishwa , bityo bikaba ari yo mpamvu amarangamutima y' abagore ahora yigaragaza , bitewe n' urukundo n' impuhwe za kibyeyi bahorana ahantu hose .
3 . Inshingano bahabwa : Imico y' ibihugu byinshi ndetse na za sosiyete usanga zifata umugore nk' umuntu woroheje ndetse n' inshingano zabo bagenerwa zikaba zoroheje , bitandukanye n' iziba zitegereje umugabo .
Ibyo bituma rero abagore bahinduka ba bantu batagira icyo bahisha kandi bafungutse mu kuvuga kurenza abagabo baruca bakarumira .
4 . Imisemburo : Abagore bagira imisemburo ( hormones ) myinshi kandi ihindagurika bitewe n' igihe ubuzima bwabo burimo cyane igihe batwite cyangwa bari mu mihango .
Amarangamutima rero aturuka kuri iyo mihindagurikire y' igihe barimo cyane ko umusemburo wa Oestrogène bihariye ugira uruhare muri ibyo byo kugira amarangamutima menshi bakaba banarira .
5 . Indangagaciro z' umuryango :
Mu muryango , umugabo ahora ari we mutware w' urugo bakavuga ko ari we ureberera urugo kandi akarukemurira ibibazo byose mu gihe umugore we afatwa nk' aho ari umuntu wo kumwunganira gusa .
Ibyo bituma abagore baba bashaka gukundwa , kwitabwaho no guhora bateteshwa bituma bahorana amarangamutima hafi mu abagabo babo bahora bihagazeho .
Niba utarabikora !
Dukunde unadukurikire ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ukomeze ubone amakuru mu buryo utamenyereye .

Theo Bosebabireba yihakanye Violette uvuga ko ari we wamuteye inda y' umwana afite Posted by :
Valentin Twiringiyimana February 17 , 2017 in FRASH NEWS Leave a comment Theogene Uwiringiyimana uzwi nka Bosebabireba arahakana kubyarana n' umukobwa w' imyaka 24 witwa Violette uturuka mu ntara y' Amajyepfo .
Ni mu gihe Violette amusaba kumufasha kurera umwana w' imyaka itatu avuga ko babyaranye nyuma yo kumuterera inda muri Lodge .
Nk' uko Violette abyemeza , ngo yahuye na Bosebabireba bwa mbere bataziranye , ubwo yamuhamagaraga akava mu Majyepfo akamusanga i Kigali hafi y' ahahoze isoko rya Nyabugogo muri lodge yari yakodesheje maze bakaryamana akaba ari na ho amuterera inda .
Theo Bosebabireba yihakanye Violette uvuga ko yatereye agati mu ryinyo ntamufashe kurera umwana babyaranye Mu kiganiro yagiranye n' umunyamakuru wa City Radio Oswakim , Violette yagize ati : "
Naturutse mu Majyepfo ndaza duhurira hafi y' ahahoze isoko dore ko Kigali ntari nyizi neza icyo gihe , yahise anjyana muri Lodge maze turaryamana antera inda . "
Nyuma yo guterwa inda , ngo Violette yagiye kurega Bosebabireba mu mudugudu atuyemo yemera ko umwana ari uwe kandi azamufasha kumurera gusa ngo kuva ubwo yatereye agati mu ryinyo .
Mu kiganiro Bosebabireba yagiranye n' ikinyamakuru Ukwezi . com , yahakanye yivuye inyuma ibimuvugwaho byose asa n' uwibaza impamvu abantu bakunze kumubeshyera .
Yemeje ko ari ukumuharabika no kumutera urubwa kubera ishyari baba bamufitiye .
Yagize ati : " Ariko noneho nararushye naragenderewe , reka reka ibyo bintu ni ukubeshya .
Ahubwo mujye mumbariza icyo abakunda kunsebya banshakaho .
Njye uwo muntu ntabwo muzi . "
Mu minsi ishize , Theogene Uwiringiyimana , Bosebabireba yashyizeho umujyanama we wihariye .
Uyu mujyanama akaba yaravuze ko mu byo aje gukemura harimo no guhangana n' ibibazo by' ubuhemu bivugwa ku mukoresha we aho yibandaga cyane ku bijyanye n' uko yahemukiraga abamutumiraga mu bitaramo .
Umuntu yakibaza niba n' ibibazo by' ubu bwoko azabasha guhangana na byo .

Ibicuruzwa byinshi bya ' pirate ' byafashwe na Polisi i Kigali Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Nido irimo ibarizo ( umurama ) ku bihumbi cumi na bibiri , Televisiyo za Sharp 15 , Imipira ya Nike na Lacoste , ibirungo bya Rayco ndetse na za Cartouche za HP zirenga 500 by' ibyiganano nibyo byafashwe mu mukwabu na Polisi kuri uyu wa 17 Kamena mu mujyi wa Kigali ku bufatanye na Polisi mpuzamahanga muri gahunda bise ' Wipe - Out' igamije kurwanya ibicuruzwa by' ibyiganano .
Ibicuruzwa byinshi by' ibyiganano byafashwe uyu munsi Nk' uko Spt Urbain Mwiseneza wari uyoboye uyu mukwabu yabivuze , iyi gahunda ishingiye ku itegeko rivuga ko umuntu ukora ibyiganano ahanishwa igihano kuva ku myaka ibiri kugeza ku myaka itanu n' ihazabu kuva kuri Miliyoni 2 kugeza kuri Miliyoni 10 , itegeko rihana kandi ubicuruza kuva ku ihazabu y' ibihumbi 20 kugera ku bihumbi 100 ndetse nabyo bigafatwa .
Uyu mukwabu wakozwe nyuma y' uko amasosiyete nka HP ( Hewlett Parkard ) , Sharp , Baygon , Lacoste na Nike n' izindi zitanze ibirego kuri polisi mpuzamahanga na polisi y' u Rwanda ko ibikorwa byabo byiganwa bikazanwa gucururizwa mu Rwanda .
Abahagarariye izi kompanyi bakaba ari nabo bafashije polisi kwerekana aho ibyo bicuruzwa bya ' pirate ' biherereye .
Mu byafashwe harimo Idebe rya Nido ririmo ibarizo ( umurama ) ryari ku giciro cy' ibihumbi 12 , amakarito 39 y' ibirungo , Televisiyo 15 za Sharp , Tonner HP ( Cartouche ) zirenga 500 , amakarito ya Baygon , imipira ya Lacoste na Nike , inkweto n' ibindi .
Abafatanywe ibi bicuruzwa ni abacuruzi bo mu Rwanda kandi ibyinshi byakorewe hanze .
Abacuruzi babyambuwe hazakorwa iperereza bazacibwe amande .
Uyu mukwabu wakorewe mu mujyi wa Kigali ariko ngo bizakomeza mu gihugu hose aho bizagaragara ko hari ibikorwa by' ibyiganano bizafatwa ndetse n' ababicuruza bahanwe .
Uyu mukwabu wakozwe na Polisi y' Igihugu ifatanyije n' Ibigo bireba nka MINICOM , RBS , PSF ndetse na RDB .
Polisi y' Igihugu irakangururira abantu kwitondera ibyo bagura ndetse bakamenya ko binujuje ubiziranenge .
Abacuruzi nabo ngo bakwiye kumenya ko ibyiganano bihanwa n' amategeko kandi bifashwe bikaba byabagusha mu gihombo kuko babyamburwa bagacibwa n' amande .
Nta giciro cyatangajwe ibi bintu byafashwe bihagazemo .
Ibi bicuruzwa byinjira mu Rwanda gute ?
Kamurase Jean De Dieu ushinzwe gukurikirana inganda mu kigo gishinzwe ubuziranenge ( RBS ) avuga ko kugirango ibicuruzwa byinjire mu gihugu RBS ireba niba byujuje ubuziranenge ariko itareba niba ari umwimerere w' inganda zibikora .
Ibicuruzwa by' ibyiganano ngo ni icyaha gihanwa ukwacyo .

Umuvugizi w' umukuru w' igihugu Amos Chanda yasabye ko indege z' ingabo zirwanira mu kirere zitangira gukoreshwa mu gutera umuti ahantu hose kugira ngo babashe guhashya utwo dukoko .
BBC dukesha iyi nkuru ivuga ko utwo dukoko two mu bwoko bw' ibinyabwoya ( army worms ) twangiza igihingwa icyari cyo cyose ku buryo dushobora kurangiza umurimo wose w' imyaka mu kanya nk' ako guhumbya .
Utwo dukoko ngo tumaze kwonona ibihingwa mu ntara esheshatu ku ntara icumi zigize icyo gihugu .
Umukuru w' igihugu nawe ngo atewe impungenge kuko ngo niba utwo tunyabwoya tutarwanyijwe byihuse umusaruro wa 2016 / 2017 ushobora kutazagenda bityo iki gihugu kikazajya mu bihe by' inzara idasanzwe .
Ibi byaherukaga mu myaka ine ishize ubwo na none utwo dukoko twangizaga imirima y' ibigori , iy' imyumbati , iy' amasaka ndetse n' iy' umuceri muri kiriya gihugu .
Ubusanzwe igihingwa cy' ibigori ni cyo kiribwa kiribwa cyane mu gihugu cya Zambiya bityo rero umusaruro waraganyutse kubera utwo dukoko .

Urukiko rwategetse ko Evode wari Minisitiri afungurwa agakurikiranwa ari hanze Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe amabuye y' agaciro , Imena Evode Kuri uyu wa 20 Gashyantare 2017 , Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge rwemeje ko uwahoze ari Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y' Umutungo Kamere , Imena Evode afungurwa agakurikiranwa ari hanze Ibi bije nyuma y' aho ubushinjacyaha busabye urukiko ko Evode ukekwaho ibyaha by' itonesha yafungwa by' agateganyo kuko aramutse afunguwe ngo bitakorohera bitakoroha gukora iperereza uko bikwiye , gusa umucamanza yateye utwatsi iki cyifuzo .
Kagabo Jacques na Kayumba Francis na bo bari bafunganywe na Evode , ubushinjacyaha bukaba bwari bwasabye ko nabo bafungwa by' agateganyo , umucamanza yavuze ko hari impamvu bwatanze bufite ishingiro , ategeka ko bafungwa iminsi 30 y' agateganyo .
Ku wa 15 Gashyantare uyu mwaka Imena Evode Imena na bagenzi be bakoraga mu Kigo cy' umutungo kamere , Kagabo Jacques na Kayumba Francis , bagejejwe ku Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge ruri i Nyamirambo , mu rubanza ku ifungwa n' ifungurwa ry' agateganyo , aho ibyaha ubushijacyaha bubarega babihakanye .
Icyo gihe ubushinjacyaha bwavuze ko Kagabo yagiye i Nduba mu Karere ka Gasabo mu butumwa bw' akazi bwo kugenzura ibikorwa by' ubucukuzi bw' amabuye y' agaciro na kariyeri , akahasanga ahantu hashobora gucukurwa , akora raporo , nyuma abwira umugore we n' umugore wa mugenzi we Kayumba ko bashobora gushinga kampani igahabwa uruhushya rwo gutangira ibikorwa by' ubucukuzi .
Nyuma ngo iyo kampani yaje gushingwa bayita JDJ , aho ngo yahawe icyemezo binyuze mu itonesha , aho ngo Imena Evode yari azi neza ko abo bagore ari ab' abagabo bakorana na cyane ko ngo Kagabo yari yabanje kubimugishamo inama , akamubwira ko nta kibazo .
Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko Evode yanasinye iteka riha uburenganzira iyo kampani kandi bitari bikiri mu nshingano ze kuko itegeko rimuha ubwo burenganzira ryari ryarahindutse .
Evode anashinjwa kandi icyaha cyo kwanga gutanga icyangombwa cyo gucukura amabuye y' agaciro kampani yitwa Nyaruguru Mining Combany , aho ubushinjacyaha bwemeza ko yagaragaje urwango rukomeye mu gihe yayimye ubwo burenganzira , ibyo bigaragazwa no kuba RNRA yo yari yamaze gutanga icyo cyemezo ariko Evode ngo abyitrambikamo uwagihawe ntiyabasha gukora ibyo bikorwa .
Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko Evode yandikiye umuyobozi wa Nyaruguru Mining Company amubwira ko agomba kubanza kwerekana uburyo ibyo yareegwaga mu nkiko byarangiye mbere yo guhabwa ub urenganzira bwo gucukura .
Aha ub ushinjacyaha bwagaragaje ko Evode atari akwiye guhuza ibiujyanye n' uburenganzirea bwo gcukura n' ibindi bidafitanye isano kuko ngo mu nshingano yari ashinzwe hatari harimo iz' ubugenzacyaha cyanwa kurangiza imanza .
Ngo byageze aho iyo kampani yamburwa ubwo burenganzira , buhabwa indi , aho nyirayo yandikiye inzego nkuru z' igihugu ngo zimurenganure .
Gusa Evode we avuga ko atari we wanze gutanga ubwo burenganzira kuko ngo n' uwahoze ayobora MINERENA , Stanislas Kamanzi ngo yari yarandikiye iyo kampani ayimenyesha ko icyo cyangombwa itacyemerewe .
Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko Kayumba nk' umuntu wari muri komite yemeza abahabwa ibyemezo byo gucukura , yumvishije bagenzi be ko JDJ ari yo kampani igomba guhabwa icyemezo , iremezwa .

Ruhango : Abagabo barasabwa ' gutanga Care ' mu rugo Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ku munsi mpuzamahanga w' abagore mu karere ka Ruhango ku cyumweru tariki ya 8 Werurwe , Umuyobozi w' aka karere Mbabazi Francois Xavier yasabye abagabo gufata neza abagore babo bakamenya ' gutanga care ' , hagamijwe gutahiriza umugozi umwe mu kubaka igihugu .
Umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Ruhango arashishikariza abagabo gutanga ' care ' .
Mu murenge wa Mwendo hahuriye abaturage b' akarere ka Ruhango batandukanye baturutse mu mirenge yo hirya no hino mu Karere , aho bifatanyije n' umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Ruhango , Mbabazi Francois Xavier wasabye abagabo kudakorera urugomo abagore babo maze bagatanga care nk' uko bivugwa mu mvugo z' ubu .
Ati " Ntabwo abagore bazira gukundwa no gukundwakaza , na bo barabikunda , ahubwo ikibazo ni uko batabibona ndabasaba rwose mu Kinyarwanda cyaje ubu baravuga ngo ni ugutanga ' care ' , abagabo bari aha ngaha niba batari bazi iryo jambo baryige . "
Yakomeje ahamagarira abagabo bose ko bakwiye kwita no guharanira amahoro mu ngo zabo , biteza imbere ndetse bakemura burundu ikibazo cy' amakimbirane mu ngo zabo Yagize ati : "
Abagabo mwese muhere uyu munsi ku wa 8 Werurwe mutanga ingero nziza , agatoki ku kandi , muharanira guteza imbere igihugu cyacu . "
Abagore bo mu karere ka Ruhango bagaragaje uburyo butandukanye bagiye biteza imbere , aho benshi bemeza ko Leta y' u Rwanda yabahaye amahirwe yo kwiga , kugira ijambo , guhabwa ubuyobozi n' izindi nshingano bari barabujijwe n' amateka .
Hon . Nyirabagenzi Agnes wari umushyitsi mukuru , yasabye abitabiriye ibirori by' umunsi mpuzamahanga w' abagore ko bose batahiriza umugozi umwe nk' umuryango haharanirwa guteza imbere umuryango nyarwanda .
Yongeye kwibutsa abaturage b' akarere ka Ruhango kuragwa n' isuku , barangwa n' imirire myiza , gutoza abana ikinyabupfura n' umuco nyarwanda , avuga ko ibi byose nibigerwaho aribwo bazaba bagaragaje gukunda igihugu cyababyaye .
