Ubu ushobora kwishyura Serivisi za Leta ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Mu rwego rwo kugabanya ingendo zakorwaga mu kwishyura ibijyanye na Serivisi za Leta , MTN - Rwanda ifatanyije n' ikigo Rwanda online ( Irembo ) bashyizeho uburyo bwo kwishyura hakoreshejwe MTN Mobile Money .
MTN na Rwanda Online batangije gahunda yo kwishyura serivisi za leta ukoresheje Mobile money .
Sosiyete y' itumanaho ya MTN - Rwanda ivuga ko basanzwe biyegereza abakiriya bayo mu kuborohereza mu kwishyura Serivisi zitandukanye hakoresheje Mobile Money , ariko ubu bongeyeho umwihariko ko ushobora no kwishyura Serivisi za Leta .
MTN Rwanda ivuga ko ubu ifite abafatabuguzi barenga Miliyoni enye ( 4 000 000 ) , muri bo 95 % bafite Konti muri Mobile Money , kandi 98 % bagerwaho neza na ' network ' ya MTN .
MTN Rwanda ivuga ko ikibazo cyo koherezanya amafaranga ku mirongo yayo kiri hasi , kuko 89 % by' abakoresha umurongo wa MTN bashobora koherezanya amafaranga mu buryo bworoshye kandi bwihuse .
Ubushakashatsi Finscope 2016 buherutse kugaragaza ko Abanyarwanda bizera cyane koherererezanya no guhererekanya amafaranga binyuze kuri Telefone kuko ngo aribyo bibabangukira cyane .
Norman Munyampundu , ushinzwe ubucuruzi muri MTN yavuze ko ingendo zakorwaga , umuntu agiye kwishyura Serivisi runaka za Leta kuri Banki ubu zigiye kugabanyuka .
Yagize ati " Serivisi nyinshyi ushobora kuzishyura ukoresheje Mobile Money kuko u Rwanda aho rugeze rushaka ko ibintu byose biba mu buryo bw' ikoranabuhanga ( Digital ) . "
Norman Munyampundu ushinzwe ubucuruzi muri MTN .
Ku ruhande rwa Rwanda Online ifasha abaturarwanda kubonera Serivisi zinyuranye za Leta ku rubuga rwa internet www .
irembo . gov . rw , bo bavuga ko ubufatanye na MTN batangiye ari uburyo bwiza cyane kuko hari byinshi buzafasha mu buzima bwa buri munsi bw' Abanyarwanda .
Mukayiranga Daniella , ushinzwe ibijyanye no kwishyura muri Rwanda online yavuze ko kwishyura ukoresheje Mobile Money bizagabanya umwanya umuntu yatakazaga yiruka ku cyemezo yifuza , ndetse binagabanye ruswa mu mitangire ya Serivisi za Leta , kandi bitumen abantu bahabwa Serivisi mu buryo bwihuse .
Yagize ati " Ubu n' uburyo bwiza buzatuma Serivisi yihuta kuko byose uzabikora mu buryo bw' ikoranabuhanga , no kwishyura hanyuma ukazajya gufata icyangombwa wasabye . "
Mukayiranga Daniella umuhuzabikorwa ushinzwe kwishyuza muri Rwanda Online ( Irembo ) .
Kugira ngo utangire gukoresha ubu buryo ugomba kwiyandikisha ku rubuga www .
irembo . gov . rw , hanyuma ugakurikiza amabwiriza , cyangwa se ukandika kuri Telefoni yawe * 909 # , ukemeza , ukiyandikisha , hanyuma ugasaba Serivisi ushaka ukishyura ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money , aho wandika * 182 # , nabwo ugakurikiza amabwiriza .
Ku bantu batazi gusoma no kwandi , ngo babashyiriweho imirongo ya Telefone yo guhamagaraho ( Call Centre ) igera kuri 800 , ikazajya ibafasha aho bari hose , ndetse mu minsi iri mbere no kuri MTN - Rwanda bagiye gushyiraho umurongo uzajya ufasha umuntu wese ukeneye Serivisi za Leta .
Iyi Serivisi yo kwishyura Serivisi za Leta ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money izajya ikorwa ku buntu , nta mafaranga MTN izajya ica abafatabuguzi bayo .
Ku muntu wese ubu buryo bwazananira , ashobora guhamagara umurongo utishyurwa wa 9099 bakamufasha .
Rwanda Online ivuga ko mu mezi atandatu bamaze bamaze , ubu bamaze kugera ku rwego rwo gutanga Serivisi za Leta 17 , bakaba bafite intego yo kugera kuri Serivisi 100 .
Clement Uwajeneza umuyobozi wa Rwanda Online .
Mr Gunter Engling umuyoboz wa MTN Rwanda .
Mu kiganiro n' abanyamakuru abayobozi ku mpande zombi basobanura uko iyi gahunda ikora .
Mu kiganiro n' abanyamakuru .

Ni iki kirimo gufasha REG BBC kwitwara neza igeze muri ½ cy' irushanwa ryitiriwe intwari ?
Muri iyi minsi ubwo harimo gukinwa imikino y' irushanwa ry' umunsi w' intwari wizihizwa tariki ya 01 Gashyantare , umutoza w' ikipe ya REG BBC , John Bahufite yatangaje impamvu bari kwitwara neza ubwo bari bamaze gutsinda ikipe ya Patriots yari imaze kubatsinda inshuro ebyiri zose zikurikiranya , dore ko bayitsinze ku kinyuranyo cy' amanota 29 yose .
Bahufite yagize ati : " Patriots yari imaze kudutsinda inshuro ebyiri , iyo idutsinda bwa gatatu byari kuba biteye ubwoba , gatatu mu rugo rw' umugabo urabyumva na Basket yabiha !
Mu byukuri muri rusange tuvugishije ukuri twajya tujya gukina abantu bavuga ngo Patriots irabatsinda , ikindi umukinnyi Kami Kabange yadufashije ku ruhande rwo kuzibira ndetse no gusatira , ikindi REG yarakoze kuko twakoraga kabiri ku munsi , ndetse nkaba mfite n' abakinnyi beza bakomeye . "
John Bahifite , umutoza wa REG BBC avuga ko gatatu mu rugo rw' umugabo bitaba ari byo kandi na Basket yabiha !
Bahufite kandi avuga ko yaba yihuse avuze ko azatwara iki gikombe , kuko imikino idasa ahubwo ngo bagiye gukora cyane bakosore amakosa amwe namwe yagiye agaragara , gusa ngo agereranije uko abona abakinnyi ba n' ubunararibonye bafite bashobora kuzitwara neza bakagera kure hashoboka .
Muri uyu mukino , umukinnyi Kami Kabange , ikipe ya REG yakuye muri City oilers yo mu gihugu cya Uganda yitwaye neza ndetse abasha gutsinda amanota 22 wenyine wanavuze ko yishimiye kugaruka mu Rwanda , ndetse n' uburyo yitwaye muri uyu mukino ndetse avuga ko ugereranije na mbere Basket ya hano yateye imbere , harimo abasore bakiri bato kandi ubona bazi Basket , yanaboneyeho gutangaza ko yasinye amasezerano y' imyaka 2 .
Kami Kabange ( ufite umupira ) avuga ko yishimiye kugaruka mu Rwanda kandi ko urwego rw' imikinire rwazamutse .

I Paris havukiye ishyaka rishya ritavuga rumwe na Leta y' u Rwanda Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Itsinda ry' abanyarwanda munani riyobowe na Padiri Thomas Nahimana , umwanditsi mukuru w' urubuga Leprophete . fr , ryatangaje kuri uyu wa 28 Mutarama ko nyuma y' iminsi itatu y' umwiherero i Paris muri France ryashinze umutwe wa Politiki bise ' Parti Ishema ' .
. Mu mpamvu zatumye bashinga iri shyaka , abo bagabo barindwi n' umugore umwe , bavuze ko bagamije kuvanaho ishyaka rya FPR - Inkotanyi bashinja kwikubira ubutegetsi .
Mu nyandiko bashyize ku rubuga bashinze , bavuze ko ngo " Igihugu cyacu gifite isura mbi mu ruhando rw' amahanga kubera umwiryane wakunze kuranga Abanyarwanda . "
Kuri aba munani ubuyobozi mu Rwanda ngo bwaciye mo ibice abenegihugu , ndetse ngo ubwo buyobozi birirarira cyane n' ibindi byinshi bagarazaga ko banenga mu nyandiko mvugo y' uwo mwiherero wabo wavuyemo iryo shyaka .
Icyo bagamije Padiri Thomas Nahimana , Mme Nadine Claire Kasinge , Jean Baptiste Kabanda , Dr Deogratias Basesayabo , Chaste Gahunde , Dr Joseph Nkusi , Venant Nkurunziza na Ernest NSENGA barishinze iri shyaka bavuze ko intego yabo ari ugukuraho ubuyobozi bw' u Rwanda mu gihe kitarambiranye mu nzira y' amahoro .
Mu nyandiko mvugo yabo bagize bati " Mu minsi iri imbere tuzashyira ahagaragara umushinga ufatika wo kuvugurura inzego z' ubutegetsi ( Institutions ) bw' u Rwanda kugira ngo zishingire ku mahame ya demokarasi isesuye .
Tuzagaragaza kandi n' imishinga inyuranye y' iterambere risangiwe duhishiye Abanyarwanda . "
Abandi babivugaho iki ?
Philbert Museminari , ni umwe mu bakurikiranira hafi ibya ibya Politiki waganiriye n' Umuseke . com , yavuze ko ibyakozwe n' abo bantu munani bidatangaje kandi ari uburenganzira bwabo .
Kuri we , ngo aho bari n' uko bo babona ibintu birabibemerera , ariko umunyarwanda uri mu Rwanda ubona uko igihugu kimeze akirimo ngo ni bacye cyane babona ibintu kimwe n' abo bantu umunani .
Muri byinshi banenga bavuga ko aribyo baheraho banshinga iryo shyaka ngo urebye byose ni amarangamutima yabo .
Museminari ati " Njyewe mbona biriya bakora ari urukumbuzi rwinshi bafitiye u Rwanda .
Nibatahe basure igihugu cyabo , basubireyo urebe ko hari icyo bazongera kuvuga .
Biriya ni amarangamutima yabo , baheruka mu Rwanda hari amacakubiri , baheruka mu Rwanda ari igihugu kidafite umurongo koko , njye ndabahamagarira gutaha bakareba yenda bagasubirayo . "
Emmanuel Munyemana wiga muri Kaminuza y' u Rwanda we yabwiye Umuseke . com ko yibaza ko icyo abanyarwanda ubu bacyeneye atari amashyaka , ahubwo ari uko ahari akomeza umurongo igihugu kirimo agakosora ibitagenda , agakataza mu bigenda neza .
Munyemana ati " Amashyaka twarayabonye , demokarasi bavuga nayo twarayibonye , abanyarwanda nyacyo tutabonye .
Icyo tutarabona ni amajyambere , ariko aho bigeze aha dutangiye nibura kubona ko u Rwanda ruri mu murongo mwiza wo kuba abanyarwanda yo bayabona , naho amashyaka abashaka gushinga andi bamenyeko twayabonye kandi twayahaze . "
Hanze y' u Rwanda , niho habarizwa amashyaka nka ANC , RDI - Rwanda Rwiza , PDR - Ihumure n' andi avuga ko agamije guhindura uko ibintu byifashe mu Rwanda .
Iri rya Parti Ishema rikaba rije ryiyongera kuri ayo .
Ubwanditsi UMUSEKE .

U Rwanda rusinya amasezerano menshi mpuzamahanga ariko abaturage ntibabimenya - CLADHO Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Impuzamiryango y' imiryango itari iya Leta mu Rwanda ( CLADHO ) iravuga ko u Rwanda ruri mu myanya ya mbere mu gusinya amasezerano mpuzamahanga , ariko iyo hajemo kuyashyira mu bikorwa hamamo imbogamizi y' uko abaturage batayazi nk' uko byatangajwe na Nkurunziza Alex Floris umwe mu bashinzwe igikorwa kiswe ' My African Union Campaign Rwanda ' .
Nkurunziza Alex Floris ukuriye igikorwa cya My African Union Campaign Iki gikorwa cy' ubukangurambaga ' My African Union Campaign Rwanda ' kigamije gukangurira abaturage kumenya umuryango wa Africa yunze ubumwe , inyungu ubafitiye n' uruhare rwabo muriwo .
Ku cyumweru tariki ya 8 Werurwe , nibwo ubu bukangurambaga buzatangizwa ku mugaragaro I Kigali , bikazahurirana n' umunsi w' abari n' abategarugori ku rwego mpuzamahanga .
Iki gikorwa kizafungurwa n' iserukiramuco ryo kumurika imideli nyafurika , bikazatangira ku isaha ya saa 17h00 - 23h00 muri Legacy Hotel .
Nkurunzi Alexis , avuga ko impamvu byahujwe n' umunsi mpuzamahanga kandi hakazabaho kumurika imideli , ngo ni uko u Rwanda ruza imbere mu kubahiriza amasezerano ya Maputo , aharanira iterambere ry' umwari n' umutegarugori .
Ariko ngo ku bijyanye n' ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry' andi masezerano menshi mpuzamahanga habaho ubushake buke bwa Leta .
Avuga ko u Rwanda ruhagaze neza mu gusinya amasezerano mpuzamahanga , ndetse ngo ugereranyije n' ibindi bihugu , u Rwanda ruri mu myanya myiza ariko ngo hakwiye gushyirwa ingufu mu gushishikariza Inteko Nshingamategeko , Minisiteri y' Ubutabera na Minisiteri y' Ububanyi n' Amahanga gufatanya kumenyekanosha mu baturage ibyo Leta iba yarasinye .
Iyo ngo ni yo mpamvu nyamukuru yatumye CLADHO itegura ubu bukangurambaga mu rwego rwo kwerka abaturage uburenganzira bafite , ndetse bakamenya aho bashobora guhera babuharanira igihe bwahutajwe .
Leta y' u Rwanda yasinye amasezerano mpuzamahanga ajyanye n' urukiko nyafurika ruharanira uburenganzira bwa muntu , ndetse nyuma yemera ko umuturage cyangwa umuryango runaka warenganyijwe ushobora kuyirega muri urwo rukiko .
Ubu bukangurambaga bwa CLADHO buzamara igihe cy' ibyumweru 12 , hakazabaho gusanga abaturage iwabo mu byaro bakigishwa ibijyanye n' amategeko y' Umuryango wa Africa yunze Ubumwe .
Uyu ni Neema Raissa Umwali uzaba ukuriye ibyo kumurika imideli ( African Fashion Shop ) , yitabiriye amarushanwa menshi y' ubu Miss mu Rwanda no hanze yarwo HATANGIMANA Ange Eric UMUSEKE .

Misiri : Senghor University bibutse Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abanyeshuri biga muri Kaminuza yitiriwe Senghor ( Université Senghor d' Alexandrie ) iherereye mu gihugu cya Misiri , bifatanyije na bagenzi babo b' Abanyarwanda kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 , uyu muhango wabaye kuwa gatatu tariki ya 16 Mata 2014 , kuri Kaminuza ya Senghor .
Emmanuel Nyandwi ubanza ibumoso na bamwe mu bayobozi n' abanyeshuri bitabiriye umuhango Nk' uko bisanzwe uyu muhango wari ugamije kunamira abazize Jenoside ndetse no gusobanurira abanyeshuri biga kuri iyi kaminuza , amateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi , uburyo yateguwe , uko yashyizwe mu bikorwa ndetse n' aho u Rwanda rugeze rwiyubaka mu myaka 20 ishize .
Iyi kaminuza yigamo abanyeshuri barenga 160 baturuka mu bihugu birenga 20 bya Afurika , biga mu cyiciro cya kabiri cya Kaminuza mu mashami atandukanye , arimo ibijyanye n' umuco , ubuzima , ubuyobozi , n' ibyo gukora no gucunga imishinga y' iterambere .
Emmanuel Nyandwi , umunyeshuri w' Umunyarwanda rukumbi wiga muri iyo Kaminuza yasobanuriye abitabiriye uyu muhango amateka ya Jenoside , uburyo yateguwe n' ubutegetsi bwariho icyo gihe bwaryanishije Abanyarwanda biturutse ku mateka y' u Rwanda yagoretswe n' abazungu b' abakolone bagamije inyungu zabo .
Muri uyu muhango kandi hagarutswe ku buryo nyuma y' imyaka 20 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ibaye u Rwanda rwiyubatse .
Abanyarwanda bakaba babanye neza nk' uko byahoze mbere ndetse ubu bakaba baharanira kwivana mu bukene .
Umunyeshuri uturuka mu gihugu cya Guinea Konacry , yasomye umuvuga yahimbye ujyanye na Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi , habaho gutanga ubutumwa mu buryo bw' umukino wateguwe n' abanyeshuri bo mu gihugu cya Tchad , Benin , Haiti ndetse n' Ibirwa bya Comores .
Umunyeshuri wo muri Guinea Telliano Fodé avuga umuvugo wz Uyu mukino muto ugaragaza uburyo Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi yakoranywe ubugome bw' indengakamere ndetse amahanga akanatererana abicwaga mu gihe yagombaga kubatabara .
Uyu mukino kandi ugaruka ku buryo Abanyarwanda bamaze gutera intambwe mu bumwe n' ubwyunge , bakavuga ko bikwiye kubera isomo ibihugu by' Afurika birimo intambara n' amakimbirane .
Abanyeshuri biga muri iyi kaminuza bavuga ko n' ubwo Jenoside yakorewe mu Rwanda , kuyibuka ari ngombwa kugira ngo bibere isomo , cyane cyane urubyiruko rwo cyerekezo cy' ejo hazaza cy' Afurika .
Bavuga kandi ko usanga mu bihugu byabo harimo amakimbirane n' amacakubiri , n' ubwo ataremereye , kumenya ibijyanye na Jenoside bikaba bibabera isomo ry' uburyo baharanira ko ayo macakubiri atazagera kuri Jenoside iwabo .
Umuyobozi w' ishami ry' Umuco , Dr Jean Francois Fau , akaba ari na we wahagarariye umuyobozi wa Kaminuza , yagarutse ku buryo kwibuka Jenoside bitareba u Rwanda cyangwa Abanyarwanda bonyine ahubwo ari amateka y' umugabane wose w' Afurika n' isi .
Dr Fau , umuhanga mu by' Amateka , avuga ko Jenoside iba bitewe n' amacakubiri ndetse no gupfobya ikiremwamuntu , ibi akaba asa n' ubihuza n' ibibera mu bigu bimwe na bimwe by' Afurika nka Centrafrique .
Ku bwe ngo abanyeshuri barasabwa kuzirikana isomo bakura kuri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda bagaharanira ko bitazongera ukundi .
Emmanuel Nyandwi atanga ikiganiro kuri jenoside n " aho u Rwanda rugeze rwiyubaka ububiko .

Nyamirambo : Ruhurura yorohereza abajura , uwibye akayijyamo ntakurikirwa Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ni ruhurura iri mu masangano y' umuhanda wa Nyamirambo umwe uca hepfo n' uca ruguru aho ihurira ikaba umuhanda umwe uzamuka i Nyamirambo urenze gato aho bita kwa Nyiranuma .
Abahaturiye bavuga ko nibura abantu hagati ya bane na batanu bahamburirwa buri munsi , abajura babibye bagahita binjira muri iyo ruhurura .
Muri iyi ruhurura umujura winjiyemo nta muntu umukurikira Iyi ruhurura iherereye mu kagali ka Rwezamenyo , abayobozi bako kimwe n' umuyobozi w' Umurenge wa Nyamirambo bavuga ko iki kibazo nabo bacyumva kandi bari gushaka uko gikemuka .
Ni ruhurura ndende uciye hepfo kureba aho igera , ariko irimo n' izindi nzira z' amazi ziyishamikiyeho , abajura bayinjiriramo mu kantu gato kari mu muhanda iyo bamaze kwambura umuntu , akenshi ni telephone .
Claudine Uwimana acuruza amakarita ya Telephone hafi hano , ari mu mwanya mwiza wo kubona ibihabera , avuga ko buri munsi abona abantu bahamburira , ababambura bagahita bihina muri ako kobo kinjira muri ruhurura itwara amazi .
Uwimana umaze umwaka akorera hano avuga ko abiba abenshi ari za mayibobo , ngo ziba zifite ibyuma cyangwa inzembe , biba ku manywa cyangwa nijoro , bagafata umuntu ugenda n' amaguru kuri telephone bakamukeba agahita ayirekura bakayitwara , bakirukira muri uwo mwobo munini .
Uwimana ati " Nta muntu wabakurikiramo kwinjiramo biragoye ariko bo barahamenyereye , mo imbere ngo harimo izindi nzira ku buryo bigoye kubafata . "
Aba bahemu ngo ntibatinya no gushinyagurira uwo bibye kuko ngo hari ugeramo akazamura umutwe akabwira uwo yibye ngo niba ari umugabo namukurikire mo .
Umusore uvuga ko yitwa Aime Dollar ba Beaute uba uri aha hafi buri munsi avuga ko aba bajura bababangamiye cyane , kandi babona n' ubuyobozi bwabananiwe .
Aime Dollar ati " Ubu ntabwo wakwitabira telephone munsi ya kiriya cyapa , baba bafite ibyuma n' inzembe kandi iyo bayikwambuye ntabwo wabakurikira . "
Uyu musore avuga ko aba bajura bagenda biyongera umunsi ku munsi ku buryo iki kibazo ubu giteye inkeke ku batuye hafi aha ndetse n' abantu benshi bahanyura n' amaguru .
Felix Masengesho Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w' Umurenge wa Nyamirambo yabwiye Umuseke ko iki kibazo nabo bacyumva gutyo ariko batangiye kugishakira ingamba .
Faustin Mupenzi Bagaza uyobora Akagali ka Rwezamenyo we yabwiye Umuseke ko kuri iyi ruhurura bahashyize abanyerondo bahakorera nijoro mu rwego rwo gukemura iki kibazo .
Abaturage ariko bo bavuga ko no ku manywa y' ihangu bahamburirwa cyane .
Bagaza avuga ko ku manywa batabona abanyerondo bo kuhirirwa bacungana n' izo mayibobo zambura , ariko bagiye kureba uko bakemura iki kibazo .
Ruhurura iri muri aya masangano y' umuhanda no hepfo yayo Abagendagenda hafi aha babizi baba bigengesereye guhamagara cyangwa kwitaba telephone Iyi ni inzira ya mbere yinjira muri iyi ruhurura , iyo bakwibye ngo bashobora kuzamura umutwe hano bakakubwira ngo niba uri umugabo bakurikire Hano hepfo gato ni ahandi binjirira Bakagana muri uyu mwobo Umunyamakuru w' Umuseke yinjiyemo , ni hagari kandi ni harehare Imbere cyane hari aho uba ubona utarenga harimo utuyira duto cyane Avuga ko yitwa Aime Dollard ba Beaute aha hafi niho akunze kuba ari ,
yemeza ko aba bajura ari ikibazo kuri bo Photos / DS Rubangura / UMUSEKE Daddy Sadiki Rubangura UMUSEKE .

i Ngoma : Umucuruzi udafite ' attestation médicale ' yafungiwe Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Bimwe mu bikorwa by' ubucuruzi mu mujyi wa Kibungo birimo utubari , resitora ( restaurants ) , n' inzu zogosherwamo kuri uyu wa kane zafuzwe n' ubuyobozi bw' akarare ka Ngoma , abafungiwe baritotombera iki gikorwa bavuga ko batanazi icyatumye bafungirwa ibikorwa ariko ubuyobozi bw' akarere bwo bukavuga ko aba bacuruzi basabwa kujya kwa muganga gushaka icyemezo hagamijwe kurinda ikwirakwizwa ry' indwara .
Iyi nzu yogosherwamo iri m' umugi rwagati wa Kibungo nayo irafunzwe Ku nzugi z' inzu zifunzwe handitseho " Uyu muryango urafunze kubera kutubahiriza amabwiriza y' isuku " , hariho umukono w' umuyobozi w' Akarere , Nambaje Aphrodise .
Abafungiwe baritotombera iki gikorwa bavuga ko kigayitse ngo kuko batunguwe nacyo , bamwe ngo ntibazi n' icyatumye bafungirwa .
Umwe mu bafite umuryango ufunze yatangarije Umuseke ko yogoshera mu Mujyi wa Kibungo , ati " Niba batubwira kujya kwipimisha ibiro ?
Niba ari iki ?
Njye nabonye baza ngo ninsohoke bafunge kandi ubu ukwezi dore kurashize ubu bazaza bavuga ngo ni dutange umusoro . "
Undi ucuruza muri ' Alimentation ' yagize ati " Nkubu bamfungiye mfite amata muri firigo , ubu se ntiyamaze gupfa koko ?
Ubu se iyi si imikorere mibi ? "
Umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Ngoma wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y' abaturage Kirenga Providence aravuga ko inzu z' ubucuruzi zafunzwe kubera ko bene gukoreramo badafite icyangombwa cyo kwa muganga ( Atestation médiacale ) cyerekana ko bafite ubuzima buzira umuze ngo kuko bahurira henshi n' ubuzima bw' abantu .
Iki gikorwa cyo kwipimisha kwa muganga , buri mucuruzi ngo agomba kwishyura 100 % by' ikiguzi .
Kuri iki kibazo umuyobozi wungirije w' Akarere yabyemeje avuga ko kwipimisha bisaba kwiyishyurira amafaranga 100 % ngo kuko ikarita y' ubwishingizi mu kwivuza , ibiciro byayo bikoreshwa ku muntu ugiye kwivuza .
Kirenga Providence yavuze ko kuba akarere katunguye abacuruzi byari byo kugira ngo badasanga hari ibyo bahinduye batari basanzwe bakora .
Ati " Ntabwo twagombye kubateguza kuko iyo uteguje ushobora kubona ibyo utagombye kubona kugenzura isuku nta mpamvu yo kubateguza . "
Gusa nubwo ubuyobozi bw' akarere ka Ngoma buvuga ko abacuruzi bose batujuje ibisabwa bagomba gufungirwa , abacuruza muri butike ( boutique ) bo ntibafungiwe , kandi ngo iki gikorwa kirakomeza mu karere hose .
Nyiri iki gipapuro banze kugisinya kubera ko yagiye yitwaje mutuelle bazi ko ikora Elia BYUKUSENGE UMUSEKE .

Polisi yataye muri yombi Umunyarwandakazi ufite ubwenegihugu bw' u Bwongereza , akekwaho ubugizi bwa nabi Yanditswe na IGIHE Kuya 3 Werurwe 2017 saa 02 :
09 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
0 0 Umunyarwandakazi Uwamahoro Violette ufite ubwenegihugu bw' u Bwongereza , yafashwe na Polisi y' u Rwanda , akekwaho ubugizi bwa nabi bivugwa ko yafatanyije n' abandi bantu bo muri icyo gihugu .
Uwamahoro yatawe muri yombi ubwo yari yaje mu Rwanda , gushyingura umubyeyi we .
ACP Theos Badege , Umuvugizi wa Polsi y' u Rwanda , yatangaje ko Uwamahoro akurikiranyweho kugira uruhare mu bikorwa by' ubugizi bwa nabi no gukangurira abantu kwitabira umutwe w' abagizi ba nabi .
Polisi y' u Rwanda yemeza ko abafatanyije na Uwamahoro muri ibyo bikorwa by' ubugizi bwa nabi bazakurikiranwa binyuze mu busabe izageza ku nzego z' ubutabera muri iki gihugu .
Uwamahoro Violette w' imyaka 39 ni umubyeyi w' abana babiri akaba yarashakanye na Rukundo Faustin , bose b' Abanyarwanda bafite Ubwenegihugu bw' u Bwongereza kuva mu 2014 ; batuye mu mujyi wa Leeds .

Abamugariye ku rugamba barasaba ko ibyo bahabwa ku kwezi byongerwa Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Itegeko nº 02 / 2007 of 20 / 1 / 2007 rirengera abamugariye ku rugamba rigategeka ko hari ibyo bagenerwa bitewe n' ibyiciro bashyizwemo .
Aba bahoze ari abasirikare bamwe muri bo babwiye Umuseke ko ibyo bagenerwa ari bike ugereranyije n' ubuzima bw' iki gihe .
Abamugariye ku rugamba bashyizwe mu byiciro kubera ubumuga bafite kugirango bahabwe ubufasha bwo kubaho buri kwezi / Photo PPU Bashimira cyane Leta y' u Rwanda kubitaho , kububakira no kubafasha gutangira imishinga ibyara inyungu .
Ariko bakaba ibyo bagenerwa bitabasha gutuma bakomeza kubaho mu buzima buboroheye nk' abantu bamugaye .
Imibare itangwa n' Urwego rushinzwe gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abahoze ku rugerero ruvuga ko abamugariye ku rugamba bahoze ari abasirikare bose hamwe bagera ku 2940 .
Aba bamugaye kugirango bahabwe ibyo bemererwa n' ibwirizwa rya Perezida wa Republika nº 41 / 01 of 06 / 11 / 2007 , bashyirwa mu byiciro bine ; Abamugaye bikomeye nko gutakaza amaboko cyangwa amaguru , ubuhumyi .
Ikiciro cya kabiri ni icy' abamugaye bidakomeye cyane ugereranyije n' ab' icya mbere .
Ibi byiciro byombi ababirimo ni abagendera mu magare y' abamugaye .
Aba bagenerwa 50 000Rwf ( imisoro itarimo ) nk' abafasha kubaho buri kwezi , abo mu byiciro bibiri bindi biri munsi y' ibya mbere bahabwa arengaho kimwe cya kabiri cy' aya .
Ibi babigenerwa kuva mu 2007 aho bavuga ko nyuma y' imyaka umunani ubu ibiciro byahindutse cyane ku masoko bityo ibi bagenerwaga bikaba byarabaye bicye .
Mu murenge wa Nyarugunga mu karere ka Kicukiro ahari imidugudu itatu ituyemo imiryango 58 y' aba bamugariye ku Rugamba , bamwe mu bahatuye babwiye Umuseke ko ubu bitakiboroheye kubona ibyangombwa by' ubuzima no gutunga imiryango yabo .
Umwe wo mu kiciro cya mbere cy' abamugaye ati " Ariya mafaranga ubu yabaye macye , biratugoye ubu gutunga imiryango yacu , kubasha kwishyura pourcentage kwa muganda badusaba abacu barwaye kuko hari n' abacu tubana hano batari mu bwisungane bwacu kandi tugomba kuvuza no kwitaho . "
Jean Sayinzoga umuyobozi w' urwego rw' igihugu rushinzwe gusubiza mu buzima busanzwe abahoze mu ngabo yatangaje ko iki kibazo bakizi kandi bakigejeje muri Minisiteri y' ubutegetsi bw' igihugu ibagenga .
Sayinzoga avuga ko koko byumvikana ko kuva mu 2007 ibiciro hose byahindutse .
Avuga ariko ko nubwo aba bamugariye ku rugamba ngo bagomba kwitabwaho , ariko hari n' ibindi byiciro by' abanyarwanda bitagomba kurenzwa ingohe .
Ati " Minisiteri ifite byinshi byo gukora .
Hari gahunda zo gufasha abantu bamugaye muri rusange , abageze mu zabukuru n' abandi … Aba bahoze ari abasirikare bamugariye ku rugamba nabo bari muri iyo gahunda ya Minisiteri . "
Miliyoni 73 z' amanyarwanda ava ku ngengo y' imari ya Leta niyo zikoreshwa buri kwezi mu guha aba bamugariye ku rugamba ikibatunga .
Sayinzoga avuga ko aba bamugariye ku rugamba bakwiye kwihangana kuko ikibazo cyabo kiri kwigirwa hamwe n' ibindi bias nacyo kugirango gikemurwe .
Alain Joseph MBARUSHIMANA UMUSEKE .

Abanyarwanda mu ndirimbo igiye guca agahigo ku Isi Angel Mutoni umwe mu bazaririmba muri iyi ndirimbo igiye guca agahigo Abahanzi nyarwanda Angel Mutoni na Deo Munyakazi bazumvikana mu ndirimbo iri gutunganyirizwa muri Kenya byitezwe ko izaba ari yo ndirimbo ya mbere ndende ku Isi ; ikazaba ifite igihe kingana n' amasaha 4 .
Iyi ndirimbo ivuga ku mahoro no kuba umwe iri gukorwa ngo izandikwe mu gitabo cy' abaciye uduhigo ku Isi kizwi nka " Guinness World Record " .
Abari kuyikora , aribo studio yitwa Artville Music , bavuga ko bifuza ko iyi ndirimbo yabo yazasimbura iyitwa " In The Garden " yaririmbwe na korari yitwa PC III label Pipe Choir ( yo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z' Amerika ) yo imara amasaha 3 umunota 1 n' amasegonda 50 .
Aba bahanzi nyarwanda bagiye muri iyi ndirimbo bitewe ahanini n' uko ari bo bahagarariye u Rwanda mu bitaramo bya Ongea biheruka kubera muri Kenya , aho bari kumwe na Eric Soul Kirenga .
Indirimbo isanzwe ari yo ndende kurusha izindi ku Isi Ni nayo ndirimbo igiye guca n' agahigo k' uko izaba ari indirimbo irimo abahanzi benshi mu ndirimbo zose zo ku Isi .
Ubwo aba banyarwanda baririmbagamo , basanze hamaze kuririmbamo abahanzi 110 .
Izaba irimo injyana zinyuranye nka Hip Hop , Reggae , Ragga , Dancehall n' izindi .
Benshi muri aba bahanzi baririmbye muri iyi ndirimbo baturuka mu gihugu cya Kenya , ariko harimo n' abandi bo mu bindi bihugu nka Cameroon , Kenya , Afurika y' Epfo , Tanzania , u Rwanda na Uganda .
Aganira n' Ikinyamakuru Izubarirashe . rw Deo Munyakazi usanzwe umenyerewe cyane acuranga umurya w' inanga , yavuze ko kuri we byamuteye ishema .
Yagize ati " Ni amahirwe akomeye kuri njye cyane ko Abanyarwanda twayiririmbyemo turi babiri gusa , n' abandi bo mu bihugu bitandukanye . "
Iyi ndirimbo iri gukorwa na ' Artville Music " ku bufatanye na Mdundo .
Irakorerwa mu nzu itunganya umuziki ya " Studio Transparent " hamwe n' iyitwa PHAT !
Intellectual Property .

Mu7 nadakemura ibibazo harakurikiraho intambara - Gen Ngendakumana Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Umwe mu bari bayoboye abateguye " Coup d' Etat " igapfuba mu Burundi ; Gen Leonard Ngendakumana yavuze ko mu gihe Museveni yaba azuyajeho gato mu kuzuza inshingano yahawe zo guhuza impande zishyamiranye mu buryo bwa politiki nta kindi kigomba gukemura ibi bibazo uretse intambara .
Gen Leonard Ngendakumana Gen Leonard Ngendakumana w' imyaka 47 yabitangarije ikinyamakuru Chimpreport aho yakibwiye ko ibibazo by' u Burundi bikomeye bityo bikaba bidakwiye kujenjekerwa n' uwo byashinzwe kubikemura .
Uyu mugabo wari wungirije Gen Niyombare Godefroid wari uyoboye itsinda ryari ryateguye " coup d' Etat " iherutse kuba mu Burundi ntigerweho , yavuze ko Museveni ari we mahirwe ya nyuma utezweho kugarura amahoro muri iki gihugu .
Ati " hamwe na Museveni twizeye ko ibintu bishobora guhinduka ; turatekereza ko ku bwa Perezida Museveni dushobora kubona amahoro .
Ariko igihe Museveni yaba atsinzwe ( atagaruye amahoro ) ikizakurikiraho ni intambara .
Niyo mpamvu tugomba kwitonda . "
Museveni akimara kwemezwa nk' umuhuza mushya mu mvururu zikomeje kubera mu Burundi ; bamwe mu badashaka ko Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza yongera kwitoza bavuze ko uyu muhuza mushya atari uwo kwizerwa kuko nawe yarengeje manda yagombaga gutegeka Uganda .
Museveni wamaze gusubira mu gihugu cye yasize leta n' amashyaka atavuga rumwe nayo ndetse na n' imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta bemeye gusasa inzobe bagashakira hamwe umuti w' ibibazo bikomeje gutuma bamwe mu banyagihugu bicwa abandi bagakomereka n' abakomeje guhunga .
Bamwe mu banyapolitiki bahunze igihugu cy' u Burundi ubu baherereye mu bihugu bitandukanye bavuze ko Museveni n' umuhuza mushya yavuye mu Burundi ntacyo akoze kuko yasize hari Abarundi bakomeje guhohoterwa .
Kuri uyu wa gatatu ; asoza ibiganiro byahuje impande zose ; Perezida Museveni yabijeje ko kuri uyu wa Kane yohereza Minisitiri w' Ingabo Dr . Crispus Kiyonga akaza kumuhagararira muri ibi biganiro bigomba kuvamo umuti urambye w' ibibazo byugarije u Burundi .
Martin NIYONKURU UMUSEKE .

' Made in Rwanda ' yakageze no muri muzika nyarwanda – Riderman Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abanyarwanda bose kuri ubu barajwe inshinga no gushyigikira ibikorerwa mu Rwanda , kugirango bakomeze kubihesha agaciro aribyo bita ' Made in Rwanda ' .
Riderman abona no mu muziki iyo gahunda itagombye kurenzwa ingoyi ahubwo ari iyo kwimakazwa .
Riderman asanga Made in Rwanda yakageze no mu muziki aho gukurikizwa mu bindi bikorwa gusa Umuhanzi Riderman akaba na nyiri nzu itunganya umuziki y' Ibisumizi , amaze kuba ubukombe mu muziki nyarwanda mu njyana ya HipHop .
Ni umwe mu bahanzi bamaze kwegukana ibihembo bitandukanye bibera mu Rwanda birimo ibya Salax Awards na Guma Guma .
Kugeza ubu amaze gushyira ahagaragara album esheshatu ndetse n' indi ya karindwi arimo gutunganya ngo ayishyire hanze tariki ya 25 Ukuboza 2016 kuri Noheli .
Yabwiye Umuseke ati " Ibihangano byacu bizaheshwa agaciro n' abanyarwanda ubwabo , tugomba kwigobotora ibituma turarikira umuziki wo hanze .
Ubundi tugashyigikira ibyacu tukiteza imbere " .
Yakomeje avuga ko kugirango umuntu agire icyo ageraho aba akeneye gushyigikirwa n' abamugaragiye cyangwa bishimira ibikorwa bye .
Ibyo mu gihe byaba bigezweho , bikaba byatuma n' abanyamahanga bazifuza kuza kuvoma inganzo yacu kuruta uko twajya kuvumba iyabo .
Ni ubwa mbere mu Rwanda umuhanzi azaba akoze igitaramo cyo kumurika album ye iriho indirimbo 30 .
Kuko usanga abandi bazikora bakazishyira ku isoko nta bitaramo bazikoreye .
Ku bijyanye n' ibitaramo bimaze iminsi bibera petit stade i Remera bigahomba ari naho nawe azagikorera , avuga ko buri umwe agira imitegurire ye n' abafana be .
Ubwo nibabura azabyakira gusa ngo ntabyo yiteze .
Nsanzimana Christopher UMUSEKE .

Abanyarwanda benshi ku rutonde rw' abaturage batishimira imanza zicyemurwa n' abunzi Mu bushakashatsi bwagaragajwe n' urugaga rw' abatanga ubufasha ( LAF ) nyuma yo kubaza abantu 5503 , bwagaragaje ko hari abaturage bangana 61 , 5 % batishimira imikemurire y' imanza zaciwe n' abunzi .
Abayobozi b' Urwego rw' Ubufasha mu by' Amategeko , LAF bamurika ubushakashatsi Ubu bushakashatsi bujya gukorwa icyari kigamijwe ni ukumenya niba abaturage babona ubutabera nkuko bikwiye cyangwa niba basanzwe babuzi iyo bashaka kurenganurwa igihe barenganye .
Abaturage bangana na 38 , 5 % bagaragaje ko ari bo bishimira uko abunzi baca imanza zo kunga .
Umuhuzabikorwa ku rwego rw' ubutabera muri Minisiteri y' Ubutabera , Ntabagira Anastase yasobanuye ko abaturage batiyumva neza muri serivisi n' imikorere by' abunzi bifite kubera imibanire ya buri munsi bagirana , ntibiyumvishe ko n' imyanzuro bafata yaba igendeye ku mategeko nk' uko abize abafite impamyabumenyi mu mategeko babikora .
Ati " Ni ibituruka ku kuvuga ngo umwunzi runaka ni umuntu tubana , twatikanyije amasambu , tujya tujyana kuvumba , tugarukana aha na hariya ; ako ntigashobora kuburamo .
Akomeza agira ati " Umurimo w' abunzi ntabwo ari nk' uw' abacamanza ; ariko kandi abantu barinda gushaka ababunga kubera ko haba habaye amakimbirane .
Akenshi haba harimo uwigiza nkana , uwo rero uko byagenda kose iyo atagize umutima mugari ngo yiyunge n' uwo bari bafitanye amakimbirane akabona ibyo yashakaga ntabigezeho ntihashobora kuburamo abatishima . "
Munyamahoro Rene , umwe mu bayoboye urugaga rw' abatanga ubufasha mu by' amategeko ( LAF ) yatangaje ko basanze ibyemezo byagiye bifatwa n' abunzi igihe byageraga mu nkiko ntacyo byahindutseho ari naho nawe ahera asaba abaturage kwiyumvamo abunzi .
Ati " Ibyemezo byafashwe n' abunzi twasanze ko kugera ku gipimo cya 90 % n' ubundi byagiye mu nkiko ntabwo byahindutse , uko byafashwe n' abunzi ni nako inkiko zabigenjeje .
Byaduteye urujijo kuko abaturage ntibabiyumvamo , ariko na bya byemezo bafashe iyo bigeze mu nkiko ntabwo bihinduka .
Ugasanga mu by' ukuri igikenewe ni uko abaturage babandi bagana abunzi bagakanguriwe , bagasobanurirwa neza urwego rw' abunzi , bakumva ko na wa muturage bari kumwe atanga n' ubutabera . "
Abaturage bo mu ntara zose z' igihugu n' Umujyi wa Kigali babajijwe nk' uko ubu bushakashatsi bwabyerekanye , bagaragaje ko banyurwa n' inzego z' ibanze za Leta kuri serivisi zo kubarenganura ku kigero cya 45 % , inzu itanga ubufasha mu by' amategeko iba kuri buri murenge ( MAJ ) ku kigero cya 95 % , imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta na sosiyete sivile ku kigero cya 96 % n' imyanzuro y' inkiko ku kigero cya 84 % , muri rusange bakanyurwa ku kigero cya 87 % muri serivisi z' ubutabera .

Amakuru | Mu Ntara | Intara Rusizi :
Abaturage bo mu tugari 4 barinubira kubura ubavura Abaturage b' utugari twa Cyendajuru , Ntura , Rwega na Gakomeye bivuriza kuri poste de santé ya Ntura mu murenge wa Giheke , mu karere ka Rusizi , baravuga ko umuforomokazi umwe iri vuriro rifite adahagije , bagasaba ko iki kibazo cyashakirwa umuti .
Aba baturage bavuga ko uyu muforomo abavura kugeza saa kumi z' umugoroba , ndetse agakora kuva kuwa mbere kugera kuwa gatanu gusa , ku wa gatandatu no ku cyumweru bakabura ubavura .
Bavuga ko iyi poste de santé isanzwe ikorera mu nzu y' umuturage yaje bayishakaga cyane kuko ikigo nderabuzima cyabo kiri ku ruhande cyane , kuba bari bayibonye akaba yari amahirwe akomeye bari babonye ariko ngo uburyo ikoramo bisa nk' aho umumaro wayo ari muke ugereranije n' uwo bari bayitezeho .
Twagiramariya Françoise utuye mu kagari ka Cyendajuru , usanzwe ari n' umujyanama w' ubuzima yagize ati " Yaje tuyikeneye cyane rwose ariko uburyo tuvurwamo tubona nta mumaro ukomeye itumarira kuko nk' umuforokazi umwe rukumbi uhahora atangira akazi akererewe agataha kare , bikaba gutyo no ku mukozi wo muri Laboratwari n' uwa mituweli , bakavuga ko babanza gukora inama ku kigo nderabuzima bakabona kuza , ariko twe bidutera ikibazo gikomeye . "
Yakomeje agira ati " Batubwira ko nta wemerewe kubyarira mu rugo cyangwa mu nzira ariko umugore ashobora gufatwa n' inda saa mbiri za mu gitondo akahabyarira yabuze umufasha kubera kuza batinze kuko abaturage bamwe batuye kure cyane y' ikigo nderabuzima akaza yari yizeye ko ahasanga umufasha akamubura .
Ikindi ni uko ku wa gatandatu no ku cyumweru cyangwa mu masaha y' ijoro urwaye ashobora no kugwa mu rugo kuko batavura kandi ikigo nderabuzima kiri kure cyane , tukifuza ko ubuyobozi bw' ikigo nderabuzima n' ubw' umurenge bwadufasha kigakemuka . "
Nzeyimana Eraste na we ati " Biriyongeraho ko no ku kigo nderabuzima abakozi ari bake cyane , ku buryo hari igihe umuntu ava hano yarambiwe yasindagira yanagerayo na bwo agasanga abarwayi ni benshi cyane , abaganga ni bake cyane na bwo ntavurwe akaba yahagirira ibibazo kandi muzi ko indwara zabaye nyinshi , hari n' izo umuntu aba agendana atabizi . "
Umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w' uyu murenge , Nsabimana Théogène , avuga ko iki koko ari ikibazo gikomeye cyane kandi bakimugejejeho , bakaba bagerageza gukorana n' akarere bya hafi ngo barebe icyakorwa .
Ariko ngo kuba abaforomo ku kigo nderabuzima ari bake cyane kandi bagomba kwitoramo uza kuri iyi poste de santé na byo bidindiza byinshi , ariko ngo birazwi n' igisubizo kirashakwa , cyane cyane ko n' izi poste de santé zigiye kwegurirwa abikorera .

Umuhanda wa gari ya moshi Mombasa - Kampala - Kigali muri 2018 Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ibihugu bitatu byo mu karere ka Afurika y' Iburasirazuba , U Rwanda , Kenya na Uganda byatangiye umushinga wo kubaka umuhanda wa gari ya moshi ( Standard Gauge Railway ) uzuzura utwaye akayabo ka miliyari 13 z' amadolari mu 2018 .
Umuhanda nk' uyu wihutisha ibicuruzwa n' abagenzi ukagira uruhare mu kuzamura ubukungu / photo internet Umuhanda uzahuza imijyi itatu , Mombasa , Kampala na Kigali , ukazaterwa inkunga n' ibi bihugu uko ari bitatu , ahi uzuzura mu mwaka wa 2018 .
Witezweho kuzoroshya ubucuruzi kandi ukazagabanya umubare munini w' amakamyo yakoreshwaga mu bwikorezi bw' ibicuruzwa .
Buri gihugu kizishakamo ubushobozi ku giti cyacyo .
Injeniyeri Abraham Byandaala , Minisitiri wa Uganda ushinzwe ibikorwaremezo n' ubwikorezi avuga ko ibihugu byemeranyijwe umusoro wa 1 , 5 % by' agaciro k' ibitwawe na gari ya moshi mu rwego rw' inkunga yo kubaka umuhanda .
Minisitiri Byandaala avuga ko igishushanyo cy' igice cy' umuhanda wa gari ya moshi Mombasa - Nairobi cyarangiye , imirimo y' ubwubatsi ikazatangira mu Gushyingo muri uyu mwaka .
Igihugu cya Kenya kirasa n' aho kiri imbere y' ibindi bihugu mu myiteguro .
Uburyo bwo kwiga igishushanyo cy' ikindi gice cy' umuhanda wa km 511 , Nairobi - Malaba igishushanyo kiri kwigwa na kompanyi Kenya Railway Corporation ku bufatanye n' inzobere zo mu karere , kikazarangirana n' ukwezi ku Ukuboza muri uyu mwaka .
Minisitiri Byandala igice cy' umuhanda Nakuru - Kisumu kireshya na km 250 , igishushanyo cyawo kizarangira mu Kuboza 2013 .
Ku ruhande rwa Uganda , imyiteguro naho irakomeje igishushanyo cy' igice cy' umuhanda Kampala - Malaba ureshya na km 250 kiri gukorwa kikazarangira mu Kwakira uyu mwaka .
Mu Rwanda mu mateka nta muhanda wa gari ya moshi wigeze uhaba , iyi yubatswe yaba ari iya mbere .
HATANGIMANA Ange Eric UMUSEKE .

Zanaco FC izacakirana na APR FC yasesekaye i Kigali Yanditswe na Manzi Rema Jules Kuya 16 Gashyantare 2017 saa 02 :
59 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
0 0 Ikipe ya Zanaco FC yo muri Zambia yamaze kugera i Kigali aho ije gukina na APR FC mu mukino wo kwishyura w' amarushanwa Nyafurika ahuza amakipe yabaye ya mbere iwayo ( CAF Champions League ) .
Iyi kipe yageze ku Kibuga cy' indege cya Kigali ku isaha ya saa 12 :
30 z' amanywa zo kuri uyu wa Kane , tariki 16 Gashyantare .
Bakigera i Kigali , umutoza w' iyi kipe Mumamba Numba , yatangaje ko ikibazanye mu Rwanda ari ugushaka intsinzi n' ubwo abona ko ikipe ya APR FC ikomeye .
Yavuze ko muri uyu mukino azibanda cyane ku busatirizi bw' ikipe ye kugira ngo azabashe kubona igitego cyo hanze cyazamufasha kwiyongerera amahirwe yo gusezerera ikipe y' ingabo z' u Rwanda .
Yavuze kandi ko uyu mukino uzaba umwanya wo gukosora amakosa abakinnyi be bakoze mu mukino ubanza wabereye muri Zambia , aho bagiye babona amahirwe yo gutsinda ibitego ariko ntibayabyaze umusaruro .
Umukino ubanza wabaye ku wa Gatandatu w' icyumweru gishize , warangiye amakipe yombi anganyije ubusa ku busa .
Uyu mukino wo kwishyura uteganyijwe kuba ku wa Gatandatu w' iki cyumweru kuri Stade Amahoro , ku isaha ya saa cyenda n' igice ( 15 : 30 ) .
Iyi kipe igeze i Kigali mu gihe APR FC bazahura yo iri gukorera umwiherero i Shyorongi , ari naho abakinnyi bayo bari gukorera imyitozo itegura uyu mukino bagomba gutsinda byanze bikunze kugira ngo bizere gukomeza mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho .
Ikipe izakomeza hagati y' izi zombi izahura n' izarakoka hagati ya Young Africans yo muri Tanzania na Ngaya FC yo mu birwa bya Maurices .

Rayon Sports izakina n' ikipe ya Onze Créateurs Mussa Camara wa Rayon Sports hagati ahatanira umupira na myugariro wa AL WAU SALAAM Rushdi Ekueldito ( Sam Ngendahimana ) Rayon Sports yasezereye ikipe ya Wau Salaam yo muri Sudani y' Amajyepfo iyitsinze ibitego 2 - 0 mu mikino Nyafurika ya " CAF Confederation Cup " ikaba izakina na Onze Créateurs yo muri Mali .
Igitego cya mbere cya Rayon Sports cyabonetse ku munota wa 26 gitsinzwe na Kwizera Pierrot kuri kufura mu gihe Moussa Camara yatsinze igitego cya kabiri ku munota wa 81 .
Muri uwo mukino Mutsinzi Ange myugariro wa Rayon Sports yabonye ikarita y' umutuku ku munota wa 19 nyuma yo gukinira nabi umukinnyi wa Al Wau Salaam .
Igice cya mbere cyarangiye Rayon Sports ifite icyo gitego kimwe nubwo yari yabuze uburyo bwinshi muri icyo gice .
Mu gice cya kabiri Rayon Sports yakomeje gushaka ibitego ariko rutahizamu Moussa Camara ntabashe gutsinda .
Ku munota wa 74 na 76 Moussa Camara wa Rayon Sports yasigaranye n' umuzamu wa Wau Salaam ariko akananirwa gutsinda ibitego .
Mu buryo bwo gushaka ibitego mu gice cya kabiri Irambona Eric yasimbuwe na Nshuti Dominique Savio , Nsengiyumva Moustapha asimburwa na Nova Bayama mu gihe Manishimwe Djabel yasimbuwe na Muhire Kevin .
Umutoza wa Rayon Sports , Massoudi Djuma yatangaje ko uwo mukino ubafashije mu rwego rwo kwitegura ukurikiyeho .
Minisitiri w' ingabo Gen James Kabarebe na Nzamwita Jean De Gaule , hamwe n' umuyobozi wa Rayon Gacinya Dennis bakurikiranye umukino Rayon Yatsinzemo 2 - 0 ( Ifoto / Ngendahimana S ) Ramzi Sebit , umutoza wa Wau Salaam yabwiye itangazamakuru ko abakinnyi be bari bagerageje gukosora muri uwo mukino wo kwishyura ariko bikaba bitabakundiye .
Uwo mukino wabaye kuri iki cyumweru tariki ya 19 Gashyantare 2017 kuri Stade Amahoro i Remera wari witabiriwe n' abantu batari benshi nk' uko biba byitezwe ku mukino ya Rayon Sports iba yakinnye .
Mu mukino ubanza Rayon Sports yari yatsinze Wau Salaam ibitego 4 - 0 mu mukino wari wabereye muri Sudani y' Epfo .
Abafana ba Rayon Sports berekana ko mu mukino yombi ikipe yabo itsinze ibitego bitandatu ( Sam Ngendahimana ) Kuva Rayon Sports isezereye Wau Salaam izakina n' ikipe ya Onze Créateurs yo muri Mali mu mikino y' icyiciro gikurikiyeho .

Umwarimu yibye memory card 487 za " One Laptop per Child " Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Mu Murenge wa Shyogwe , Akarere ka Muhanga , Umwarimu witwa Ndayizera Filemon wo ku kigo cy' amashuri abanza cya Ruli ADEPR , yahamwe n' icyaha cyo kwiba memory card zigera kuri 487 zo muri mudasobwa zatanzwe muri gahunda ya " One laptop per child " .
Ikigo cy' amashuri abanza cya Ruli ADEPR .
Photo / Ngendahimana S .
Izi memory card zibwe mu kwezi kwa Werurwe 2013 , ariko bimenyekana ku wa 16 Mata 2013 , zikaba zifite agaciro ka miliyoni 18 z' amafaranga y' u Rwanda , ariko ngo bamuhaye ibihumbi 400 . 000 Frw .
Avugana n' ikinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe dukesha iyi nkuru uyu mwarimu yagize ati " nziba zari 481 , rero sinavuga ngo nazibye nte , ariko kuko turi mu isi yanduye sinzi uko nazibye , mbese ni kwa kundi umuntu aba ari mu bibazo , nyine bikaba byatuma ukora ibyo utatekereje . "
Yakomeje avuga ko bimaze kumenyekana yafunzwe , ariko urukiko rukemeza ko afungurwa akajya azishyura buhoro buhoro .
Ati " ubu maze kwishyura memory card 70 , imwe nyigura amafaranga 1 , 700 frw .
Nemeye ko nzazishyura mu gihe kingana n' amezi abiri .
Gusa navuze ko nintashobora kuzishyura muri ayo mezi , bazagurisha isambu yanjye . "
Bizimana Yves Modeste , umuyobozi ushinzwe uburezi mu Murenge wa Shyogwe aho iki kigo kibarizwa , yavuze ko bamaze kumenya ko uyu mwarimu yazibye , babigejeje ku bashinzwe umutekano maze arafatwa arafungwa , ariko nyuma aza kurekurwa .
Ati " tubonye arekuwe urukiko rwavuze ko azazishyura ari hanze .
Gusa n' undi wese yakeka ko habayemo ruswa , kuko yaregwaga icyaha gikomeye . "
Umuyobozi w' iki kigo , Mukanyabyenda Emmanuellia , yatangaje ko nk' uko Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y' Uburezi yabivuze ubwo yabasuraga , ubujura nk' ubu buba burwanya gahunda nziza za Leta .
Ati " Filemon yitesheje agaciro , yatumye abana badindira , yahesheje ikigo ndetse n' abarimu isura mbi , ubona ko yakoze ibintu bitagakozwe n' umurezi nkawe " .
Akomeza avuga ko ubushinjacyaha butanyuzwe n' imyanzuro y' urukiko , ubu ngo bukaba bwifuza kujurira .
Yemeje ok uyu mwarimu wibye izi memory card 478 , amaze kwishyura 70 zo mu bwoko bwa Kingston .
Uyu mugabo wiyemereye ko yibye izi memory card yafunzwe ku wa 30 Gicurasi 2013 afungurwa ku wa 13 Kamena 2013 .

Uyu mukino ukaba waratambukaga kuri Radiyo Rwanda , Ubwo amakipe yombi yajyaga mu kiruhuko igice cya mbere kirangiye umunyamakuru wa Radio Rwanda yaje kubaza umunyamakuru wamenyekanye cyane hano mu Rwanda nawe wigeze gukorera iyo Radiyo witwa Yves Bucyana ubu akaba akorera Radio BBC mu ishami ry' igiswayili , umunyamakuru amubaza uko abona igice cya mbere cyagenze mu ri rusange .
Maze Yves amusubiza ko abo na ikipe ya Police iriho ikina neza kandi ko hatagize igihinduka ishobora kuza kwegukana amanota 3 iyakuye kuri Rayon Sport , nubwo atariko byaje kugenda kuko banganyije ibitego 2 - 2 .
Yves Bucyana umunyamakuru wa BBC Umunyamakuru yamubagije impamvu ki abona abafana batakitabira kujya ku bibuga nkuko mbere byabaga bimeze dore ko n' uwo munsi abafana b' amakipe bari bakeya kuri stade Amahoro I Remera , Yves yamusubije atazuyaje ko impamvu ituma nta bafana bakigaragara ku bibuga by' umupira biterwa n' impamvu ebyiri z' ingenzi yagize ati : "
impamvu ya mbere njye mbona ikibitera ari uko ntabakinyi dufite , bityo bigatuma n' abafana badashishikara kujya ku bibuga ngo barebe umupira mwiza kuko burya umupira uryoha bitewe n' ubuhanga bw' abakinyi " .
Indi mpamvu ituma nta bafana batakigaragara ku bibuga nanone biterwa n' icyemezo cyafashwe cyo kugabanya umubare w' abanyamahanga mu ikipe kuko mbere wasanga iyo ikipe yabaga ifite abanyamahanga benshi wasanga n' abafana baza kwitabira ari benshi ku kibuga .
Hashize igihe kitari gito havugwa ibibazo by' abanyamahanga mu mupira w' u Rwanda , abakurikiranira hafi iterambere ry' umupira wo mu Rwanda bemeza ko umubare munini w' abakinnyi babanyamahanga muri shampiyona y' u Rwanda udindiza abakinnyi b' abanyarwanda , iterambere ry' umupira w' u Rwanda n' ikipe y' igihugu by' umwihariko .

Nyarugenge : Abacitse ku icumu basaga 70 ntibafite amazu yo kubamo Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ku itariki ya 9 Mata , nibwo Akarere ka Nyarugenge kibutse ku nshuro ya 19 Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi , uyu muhango wabanjirijwe n' urugendo rwatangiriye ku ishuri ryitiriwe Mutagatifu Andereya kugera kuri stade Regional i Nyamirambo ahakomerejeumuhango nyamukuru cyo ku ibuka .
Bamwe mu bitabiriye umuhango wo kwibuka mu karere ka Nyarugege Ubuyobozi bwa Ibuka muri aka Karere ka Nyarugenge buvuga ko kugeza ubu hari abantu basaga 70 bacitse ku icumu badafite amazu yo kubamo kuburyo hagize igikorwa , bwaba ari uburyo bwo kurushaho kubafasha kwigira dore ko bashegejwe na jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi .
Rutayisire Masengo Gilbert , uhagarariye Ibuka mu Karere ka Nyarugende yagize ati " Abacitse ku icumu bahura n' imanza z' imitungo za Gacaca zitarangizwa , abahamwe n' ibyaha bya Jenoside bajuririra mu nkiko zisanzwe bityo bikabahoza mu manza , ndetse n' imiryango y' abacitse ku icumu yasenyewe itaratuzwa .
Hamaze kubakwa amazu 375 ariko ko hagikenewe nibura andi mazu 70 uyu mwaka mu gutuza abadafite aho kuba " .
Kuri iki kibazo , Senateri Gakuba Jeanne d' Arc wari umushyitsi mukuru muri uwo muhango yashishikarije abaturage b' Akarere ka Nyarugenge gukomeza gufasha abacitse ku icumu kwiyubaka kugira ngo nabo barusheho kwigira ndetse yasabye ko hashakwa mu buryo bwihuse uko imiryango 70 yacitse ku icumu itarabona aho kuba yubakirwa .
Senateri Gakuba Jeanne d' Arc kandi yasabye abaturage ba Nyarugenge kwibuka Jenocide yakorewe Abatutsi bafasha abacitse ku icumu guhangana n' ihungabana baterwa n' ingaruka za jenoside .
Ibumoso hari Umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Nyarugenge Solange Mukasonga na Visi perezida wa Sena Gakuba Jean d' arc i Buryo .
Ku ki bazo cy' imanza akarere ka Nyarugenge kavuga ko kugira ngo izo manza zirangizwe hakenewe imikoranire myiza hagati y' inzego z' ibanze n' ubutabera mu rwego rwo gukumira imanza zijyanwa mu nkiko kuko akenshi imanza zijyanwa mu inkiko , usanga nta makuru amenyesha inkiko ko izo manza ziba zaraciwe na Gacaca .
Umuhuzabikorwa w' ihuriro ry' abanyamadini mu Karere ka Nyarugenge Bishop Nzeyimana Innocent , yagarutse kruhare amadini , amatorero n' imiryango itari iya leta yagize muri Jenoside , agaragaza ko aho umupira warengeye ariho ugomba kurengurirwa ; uyu munsi izo nzego zikaba zigomba gushyira ingufu mu gukoresha abayoboke bazo mu kubaka igihugu nkuko bakoreshejwe mu kugisenya , yagaragaje ibikorwa bitandukanye birimo gukorwa mu kongera guteza imbere umunyarwanda harimo isana mitima , ubuvuzi ku basigiwe ibikomere na Jenoside ndetse no kubafasha kubaho bubakirwa bahabwa inka n' ibindi .
Bacana urumuri rw' icyizere .
Muyi uyu mwaka umuhango wo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi muri Nyarugenge wabaye ku manywa .

Umunsi w' umuganura ntugihabwa agaciro nk' ako wahoranye Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Buri mwaka tariki ya 1 Kanama mu mateka y' u Rwanda abantu bashyiraga hamwe gashaka amasaka bagashigisha ikigage bagasangira , ariko ubu ntabwo uyu muco ukibaho .
Umusaza Karambizi w' imyaka 74 ubwo yagiranaga ikiganiro na UMUSEKE ku bijyanye n' umuco wo kuganura , yadutangarije ko umuco yasanze mu gihe cye cya kera ubu utakibaho .
Yatubwiye ko umuganura yasanze ukorwa n' ababyeyi mu ngo , aho bafataga amasaka bagashigisha ikigage , bagakora umutsima bakarya bakishima ariko ubu nta bikibaho .
Karambizi Philip yavuze ko gusozwa ku mwaka byarangwaga no kwerekana imyaka yejejwe , abantu gagasangira bakishima , ariko ubu ntabwo bakibyubahiriza ahubwo byasigaye mu bitekerezo gusa .
Yagize ati " Ubu nta bwo bakibyubahiriza ahubwo byasigaye ari ibintu byo gutekerezwa nk' ibintu byakorwaga kera mu Kinyarwanda cyo hambere . "
Sogokuru Karambizi akomeza agura ati " Mbere yo gukora ikigage , umusaruro wabanzaga kumurikirwa umutware kuko abantu babaga ari umuryango , twarangiza tugakora umutsima , maze bakazana amata tugasabana n' Imana igatanga umugisha maze umwaka utaha ukazaba uw' uburumbuke " Uretse umusaza Karambizi , abadi bakuze baganiriye n' UMUSEKE bagiye batangaza ko umuco wo kuganura wakorwaga kera , ubu nta bwo bikibaho .
Muragizi Francois uri mu rungano rwa muzehe Karambizi , avuga ko mu gihe yari muto mu myaka ya 1945 - 1946 , kwa sekuru habagaho umuganura .
Yagize ati " Sogokuru icyo gihe nko muri uku kwezi yengaga amarwa akaduha , kuko twari tukiri abana bakatubwira ko ari umuganura .
Uko amasaka yeze twarasangiraga , ariko ubu byaracitse nta bwo tukigira umunsi w' umuganura . "
Muzehe Muragizi atunga agatoki umuco wa kizungu , aho kuri ubu umusaruro w' amasaka usarurirwa mu isoko mu rwego rwo kubona amafaranga .
Umukecuru Adele Mukandanga we asanga umuganura wasigaye ku mateka gusa .
Yagize ati " Umuganura waradushimishaga cyane ariko ubu ntabwo ukibaho , icyo gihe iyo twabaga twishimye hari n' igihe wafataga n' isambu ugaha utayifite . "
Nyogokuru Mukandanga yongeraho ko abaturage bafataga amarwa bakajyana ibwami , bityo kuri we ati " Ndateganya kuzajya ntumira abaturanyi tukajya dukora umuganura tukishima . "
Iyo urebye imvugo y' aba bakambwe bose bahuriza ko umuganura wari ubafitiye akamaro kanini cyane kuko byatumaga bishima , icyifuzo bafite " umuganura ugomba kugaruka . "

Kigali : Inkoko n' inyanya byabagejeje mu Rukiko rw' Ikirenga Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ku munsi w' ejo tariki ya 8 Gashyantare 2013 , Urukiko rw' Ikirenga rwakatiye Paul Bucyana , igihano cyo gufungwa amezi atanu rumuziza gukoresha amagambo y' iterabwoba yabwiye umuturanyi we Yankurije Saidat .
Inkoko zagiye kona inyanya nizo zabaye kabitera .
Photo : Internet Paul Bucyana ni umworozi w' Inkoko ukorera uwo mwuga mu Murenge wa Rusororo mu Karere ka Gasabo mu Mujyi wa Kigali , naho Umuturanyi we Saidat Yankurije ni umuhinzi w' inyanya nk' uko New times yabitangaje .
Bijya gukomera kugera n' aho bigera mu Rukiko rw' Ikirenga inkoko za Bucyana zagiye kona inyanya za Yankurije aramwiyama , ndetse biba ngombwa ko hiyambazwa inzego z' ibanze z' aho batuye , niko gutegeka Bucyana guha umuturanyi we amafaranga ibihumbi bitanu ( 5 , 000Rwfs ) nk' ihazabu .

Bucyana yahise ajuririra uru rubanza mu Rukiko rw' Ikirenga ; aho Umucamanza akaba na Visi Perezida w' urwo rukiko Kayitesi Sylvie Zainabu , yategetse ko uyu mugabo wari wakatiwe imyaka icumi agabanyirizwa igihano kugera ku mezi atanu kuko nta kimenyetso na kimwe cyagagajwe cy' uko yashakaga kwica Yankurije .
Nubwo yahanaguweho icyaha cy' uko yashatse kwivugana Yankurije , Paul Bucyana yahamijwe ko yamubwiye amagambo amutera ubwoba .

Abatoza 3 bazatoranywamo uzatoza Amavubi Raoul Savoy umwe mu batoza batatu bashobora kuvamo umwe uzatoza Amavubi ( Ifoto / Internet ) Abatoza barimo Antoine Hey wo mu Budage , Jose Rui Lopes Aguas wo muri Portugal na Raoul Savoy wo mu Busuwisi nibo bazatoranywamo uzaba umutoza w' Amavubi .
Ishyirahamwe ry' Umupira w' Amaguru mu Rwanda ( FERWAFA ) ryatangaje ko abo batoza nyuma y' uko bari bafite abagera ku 8 bamaze gutoranyamo 3 bazakora ikizamini cya nyuma kizemeza umutoza mukuru w' Amavubi .
Abo batoza 8 bakoze ikibazami cyo kuvuga ( interview ) mu mpera z' icyumweru gishize haza gusigara abo 3 nabo bazakora ikindi kimwe hakemezwa umutoza uhabwa iyo mirimo .
Nyuma y' icyo kizami abo batoza 3 basigaye biteganyijwe ko bazakora ikindi kizami kizemeza umutoza w' ikipe y' igihugu Amavubi mu cyumweru gitaha .
Muri abo batoza bose batanze ubusabe bwabo bwo gutoza Amavubi uko 52 ntiharimo umutoza n' umwe y' Umunyarwanda .
Kuri ubu ikipe y' Amavubi ibayeho itagira umutoza nyuma y' uko uwari umutoza w' agateganyo Jimmy Mulisa agiye muri APR FC .
Amavubi yari afite umutoza mu buryo buhoraho Jonathan McKinstry , ariko aza kwirukanwa mu mwaka ushize kubera kudatanga umusaruro .
Umwe muri abo batoza uzahabwa imirimo yo gutoza Amavubi byitezwe ko azatangira imirimo ye vuba , kuko ikipe y' igihugu izitabira imikino y' ijonjora ry' igikombe cya Afurika ku bakinnyi bakina muri shampiyona zabo ( CHAN ) ya 2018 .

Abahanzi baririmbira Imana ntibateze bazatungwa n' umwuga bakora ugereranije n' abakora indirimbo zisanzwe - Timamu Jean Baptiste Feb 14 , 2017 Onesphore Dushimirimana Abahanzi , Andi makuru 0 Share this on WhatsApp Kuririrmba ni umwuga udashoborwa na benshi kandi akaba ari impano itangwa n' Imana nyir ' ibiremwa .
Iyi mpano kuyibyaza umusaruro , usanga hari benshi byihishe cyane ko bisaba kubishyiramo imbaraga no kutabibangikanye kenshi n' indi mirimo kuko usanga bishobora gutsikamirwa .
Nubwo bishobora bake umuhanzi Timamu Jean Baptiste ni umwe mubabasha kubibangikanya n' indi mirimo kandi akaba afite ikizere ko hari aho bizamugeza .
Gusa yongeraho ko Abahanzi baririmbira Imana badateze bazatungwa n' umwuga bakora ugereranije n' abakora indirimbo zisanzwe .
Timamu Jean Baptiste , ni umuhanzi urirrimba indirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana , wamenyekanye mu ndirimbo nka Humura mwana wanjye , Turakomeje n' izindi .
Imyaka isaga icumi irashize yinjiye muri uyu murimo wo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana , akaba amaze gushyira ahagaragara album eshatu , arino gutegura album ya kane .
Mu rwego rwo kwishakamo ubushobozi bwamufasha mukuzamura umwuga w' uburirimbyi , Timamu yahisemo kwishakamo ibisubizo , kugirango arusheho gutera imbere .
Bimeneyerewe ko mu masoko rusange ya hano mu Rwanda usanga hari amaradio afasha abagenda n' abakorera muri aya masoko kwidagadura no kumenyekanisha ibikorwa bitandukanye biba bikorerwa muri ayo masoko .
Kuri ubu isoko rya Nyarugenge ( Kigali City Market ) kuri ubu rikaba riri kumvikanamo radio yiswe " Voice of Market " , kugeza ubu iyobowe na Timamu Jean Baptiste ubwe .
Umuhanzi Timamu Jean Baptiste Mu kiganiro na isange . com , Timamu Jean Baptiste yadutangarijeko ko iyi radiyo ari kimwe mubisubizo bizamufasha kwiteza imbere no kuzamura ubuhanzi bwe .
Tumubajije icyo iyi radiyo ifashya abayumva akaba yadutangarije ko ifasha abantu bakorera muri iri soko kumenya ibirikorerwamo , gufasha abakeneye kwamamaza ibikorwa byabo ndetse no gususurutsa abantu no kubamara irungu .
Si ibyo gusa kuko inafasha n' abantu bo hanze y' isoko nabo bashobora kwamamaza business zabo biciye kuri iyi radio , byongeye inafasha abagenda muri iri soko badakunze kubona umwanya wo kumva radio , babasha kuhumvira no gusobanukirwa gahunda za leta n' ibindi .
Iki gitekerezo Timamu avugako gifite aho gihurira n' ubuhanzi cyane kuko bimufasha kwagura ubuhanzi bwe mu buryo bumwe cyangwa se ubundi nko kumenyekanisha ibihango bye kuburyo bworoshye n' ibindi .
Iri soko rifite amazu agerekeranye agera kuri 7 ; imiryango isaga 700 ikorerwamo ubucuruzi ndetse n' abantu basaga 5000 bahoramo bahakorera .
Abasaga 25000 bakaba baryinjiramo buri munsi .
Timamu yatangiye umwuga wo kurirmba muri 2006 , album ye yambere yasohotse muri uwo mwaka , ikaba yaritwaga " Humura mwana wanjye " , iya kabiri yaje gusohoka muri 2009 , yitwa " Wirira ' , iya gatatu yasohotse 2013 yayise " Ni wowe byose " .
Iya kane kugeza ubu iri gutegurwa akaba ateganya kuyita " Turakomeje " , kugeza ubu akaba ageze ku ndirimbo ya karindwi imaze kuva muri sitidiyo .
Izi zose zikaba zari amajwi n' amashusho .
Timamu avugako agereranije na album eshatu zabanje , album ya kane izaza ifite umwihariko kubera ubunararibonye amaze kugira muri uyu mwuga .
Timamu asanga umuhanzi akwiye gutungwa n' umwuga we .
Avuga ko uburyo abahanzi bakoramo indirimbo hari ibyo badakora bitewe n' uko uyu mwuga utababeshaho mu buzima bwa buri munsi , we akaba avuga ko umuhanzi akwiye gutungwa n' ibihangano bye .
Yagize ati , " Umuhanzi aramutse atunzwe n' igihangano cye byamufasha gukora cyane no kwiteza imbere . "
Kubagamije kubibyaza inyungu ; Timamu we yabashyigikira kuko nawe abonye uburyo byo kubibyaza umusaruro nawe yabikora , ariko yongeraho ko atari byiza kwihutira kubibyaza inyungu kuko hari benshi bigusha mu mutima .
Kubirebana no kuba abahanzi baririmbira Imana batabasha kubibyaza umusaruro ufatika , Timamu yagize icyo abivugaho .
Yagize ati , " Igituma abahanzi baririmba indirimbo z' Imana batabona umusaruro ni uko abakurikira ibi bihangano babona abahanzi nk' abari k' umurimo w' Imana , bakwiye kubibonera ubuntu kuko ari umurimo w' Imana kandi abahanzi baba batakaje amafaranga yabo .
Mbese abakunda ibi bihangano bumvako umurimo aba bahanzi bakora badakwiye kugira icyo babona kuko bazagororerwa n' Imana , ibindi bikaba ubuntu . "

FERWAFA nayo yihanganishije ababuze ababo mu mpanuka y' indege muri Colombia Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Muri Colombia habereye impanuka y' indege yari itwaye ikipe yo muri Brazil , Associação Chapecoense de Futebol , kimwe n' abandi benshi ku isi , ubuyobozi bwa FERWAFA nabwo bwihanganishije ababuze ababo n' umuryango w' umupira w' amaguru muri Brazil .
Vincent de Gaulle Nzamwita wa FERWAFA yatanze ubutumwa bwo kwifatanya n' ababuze ababo Mu rukerera rwo kuwa kabiri tariki 29 Ugushyingo 2016 , mu gace ka La Union ho muri Colombia habereye impanuka y' indege yari itwaye abantu 81 , barimo abagenzi 72 , n' abakozi icyenda ( 9 ) bayo .
Iyi ndege yari itwaye ikipe yo mu kiciro cya mbere muri Brazil Chapecoense FC yari igiye gukina umukino ubanza wa Copa Sudamerica wari kuyihuza na Atletico Nacional yo muri Colombia , kuri uyu wa gatatu .
Ishyirahamwe ry' umupira w' amaguru mu Rwanda FERWAFA , ribinyijije mu ku muyobozi waryo Nzamwita Vincent Degaule yihanganishije imiryango yabuze abayo muri iyi mpanuka .
Nzamwita yagize ati : " Umuryango w' umupira w' amaguru mu Rwanda , tubabajwe cyane n' iyi mpanuka y' indege yatwaye ubuzima bwa benshi bo ikipe ya Associação Chapecoense de Futebol .
Twifurije ishyirahamwe ry' umupira w' amaguru muri Brazil gukomeza kwihangana .
Dufite ku mutima imiryango y' ababuze ababo . "
Abantu bane muri batandatu ( 6 ) bari barokotse iyi mpanuka kuri uyu wa kabiri , bajyanywe mu bitaro i Bogota muri Colombia nabo bashizemo umwuka .
Ubu abagihumeka ni babiri muri 81 bari mu ndege .
Imirambo n' abakomeretse bajyanywe mu bitaro bya Bogota Muri batandatu bari barokotse ubu babiri gusa nibo bagihumeka Iyi ndege yajyaga mu mujyi wa Medellin yarashwanyaguritse bikomeye Iyi kipe yose yatikiriye muri iyi mpanuka Roben NGABO UMUSEKE .

Telefoni ya Hitler yaguzwe ibihumbi 243 by' amadolari mu cyamunara Yanditswe na Evariste Nsengimana Kuya 20 Gashyantare 2017 saa 04 :

1 0 Telefoni yakoreshejwe na Adolf Hitler mu ntambara ya Kabiri y' Isi izwi nka " Red Phone " cyangwa telefoni itukura yashyizwe mu cyamunara mu mpera z' icyumweru gishize muri Amerika , igurwa akayabo k' amadolari ibihumbi 243 n' umuntu utatangajwe amazina .
Muri icyo cyamunara , amafaranga make yaherwagaho yari amadorari ibihumbi 100 .
Iyi telefoni yatoraguwe n' abasirikare b' Abarusiya mu ndake Hitler yabagamo bayiha umusirikare ukomeye w' Umwongereza witwa Brig . Sir Ralph Rayner .
Umuhungu we witwa Bill Panagopulos ni we wayiteje cyamunara .
Abayobozi b' inzu yakorewemo icyamunara cy' iyo telefoni babwiye BBC dukesha iyi nkuru ko ifatwa nk' intwaro yakoreshejwe mu koreka imbaga , aho Adolf yayifashishaga atanga amategeko n' amabwiriza ku ba Nazi mu gihe cy' intambara .

Ferwafa yahakanye Antoine Hey nk' umutoza wa Amavubi Yanditswe na Manzi Rema Jules Kuya 1 Werurwe 2017 saa 12 :
32 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
4 0 Ahazaza h' ikipe y' igihugu Amavubi hakomeje guhera mu kirere nyuma y' amasaha make hasakaye inkuru ivuga ko habonetse umutoza mushya usimbura Jonathan McKinstry .
Ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki ya 28 Gashyantare , nibwo amakuru yakwiriye hose ko Ishyirahamwe ry' Umupira w' Amaguru mu Rwanda ( Ferwafa ) , ryahisemo Umudage Antoine Hey nk' umutoza wa Amavubi , ariko nyuma y' amasaha make ryabihakanye ritangaza ko uwatoranyijwe azamenyekana mu gihe cya vuba .
Ikinyamakuru Jeune Afrique cyatangaje iyi nkuru y' uyu mutoza , cyanditse ko gifite amakuru ko Ferwafa yahisemo Antoine Hey ahanini bishingiye ku mubano mwiza u Rwanda rufitanye n' u Budage muri ruhago .
Ikindi kandi ngo ni uko uyu mutoza azajya agenerwa umushahara w' amadorali ya Amerika ibihumbi 20 ( asaga miliyoni 16 z' amanyarwanda ) ku kwezi , igice cyayo kikazajya gitangwa n' Ishyirahamwe ry' Umupira w' Amaguru mu Budage .
Gusa nyuma y' amasaha make , Ferwafa binyuze ku Muvugizi wayo Ruboneza Prosper yabwiye IGIHE ko aya makuru atari yo kuko umutoza watoranyijwe igihe cyo kumutangaza kitaragera .
Ati " Ntabwo twatangaza umutoza ngo tubibwire Jeune Afrique na hano iwacu batarabimenya ndetse bitarajya no ku ruburwa rwacu .
Kugeza ubu biri mu kanama gashinzwe gutoranya uzaba umutoza mukuru , baracyaganira ku masezerano n' ibindi biyagize . "
Ruboneza yemeye ko abatoza batatu bashakwamo umwe uzasimbura Jonathan McKinstry aribo Umusuwisi Raoul Savoy , Umunya - Portugal Rui Aguas hamwe n' Umudage Antoine Hey ; bose baje mu Rwanda mu kizamini hakaba hari bamwe bamaze n' abandi bagihari gusa yirinze kuvuga abo aribo .
Yakomeje agira ati " Ikindi kandi muzi ko gushyiraho umutoza mukuru w' Amavubi hazamo n' uruhande rwa MINISPOC .
Izi mpande zose ziracyabiganiraho , nibirangira muzamenyeshwa umutoza w' Amavubi .
Sinzi umunsi azatangarizwa gusa ni mu gihe cya vuba . "
Ku bijyanye n' umushahara uzatorwa azajya ahabwa , Ruboneza yahakanye ko azagenerwa amadorali ya Amerika ibihumbi 20 ku kwezi avuga ko biri mu byo bakiganiraho bityo impande zose nizimara kumvikana ari bwo ushobora kuzajya ahagaragara .

Uwizeyimana niwe munyarwanda uyoboye abandi muri " La Tropicale Amissa Bongo " Yanditswe na Manzi Rema Jules Kuya 2 Werurwe 2017 saa 07 :
55 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
0 0 Ikipe y' igihugu yo gusiganwa ku magare iri muri Gabon aho yitabiriye isiganwa rya La Tropicale Amissa Bongo ririmo kuba ku nshuro ya 12 , yari yongeye gukina kuri uyu wa Gatatu kimwe n' andi 13 bahanganye n' ubundi Uwizeyimana Bonavanture aba ariwe Munyarwanda uza hafi ku mwanya wa 12 mu gace kegukanywe na Stanislau Bazhkou .
Kuri uyu wa Gatatu abasiganwa 79 bari bahagurutse ahitwa Mounana berekeza Koulamoutou ku ntera ya kilometero 157 hasoza 75 gusa kuko abandi batabashije kurangiza aka gace kari kagizwe n' imisozi miremire .
Umunya – Belarus Stanislau Bazhkou w' imyaka 25 niwe wegukanye aka gace ka gatatu akoresheje amasaha 4 :
04 : 30 akurikirwa na Abderrahmane Mansouri wo muri Algeria naho uwa gatatu aba Umurusiya Eduard Vorganov bose bakoresheje ibihe bingana .
Kapiteni w' Ikipe y' Igihugu y' u Rwanda , Uwizeyimana Bonaventure niwe wasoje hafi muri iyi kipe kuko yabaye uwa 12 asizwe amasegonda 14 n' uwa mbere , Hakiruwizeye Samuel aba uwa 20 nawe asizwe amasegonda nk' ayo .
Ukiniwabo Jean Paul Rene yasoje ari uwa 32 , Nduwayo Eric aba uwa 33 , Karegeya Jeremie aba uwa 34 bose basizwe amasegonda 21 n' uwa mbere naho Nizeyimana Alex arangiza ari uwa 52 asizwe iminota 15 n' amasegonda 49 .
Ku rutonde rusange ruyobowe na Stanislau Bazhkou umaze gukoresha amasaha 10 :
06 : 42 , Uwizeyimana Bonaventure araza ku mwanya wa 15 akaba amaze gusingwa amasegonda 33 n' uwa mbere naho Nizeyimana Alex ari ku mwanya wa gatanu mu barusha abandi kuzamuka imisozi .

Ubuhinde : Umugore munini kw' isi yakorewe ibizamini Gurugram ni ivuriro ryo mu mujyi wa Mumbai mu gihugu cy' Ubuhindi ryakoreye ibizamini umugore munini cyane kwisi Eman Ahmed wo mu gihugu cya Misiri .
Eman Ahmed ntabasha kwivana aho aryamye Ubwo yagezwaga kwa muganga ari kumwe n' abavandimwe be Kuri uyu wa kane nibwo Emen Ahmed yakorewe ibizamini ku bijyanye ni misemburo yo mu mubiri we , ibyo bizamini byagaragaje ko igisubizo cyo kugabanuka ibiro kizaboneka hagati y' ibyumweru bine na bitandatu .
Eman Ahmed ufite ibiro 500 yajyanywe mu Buhinde kugirango abagwe kubice bimwe by' umubiri we kugirango ibiro bye bigabanuke .
Eman ahmed ni umugore ufite imyaka 36 y' amavuko ukomoka mu gihugu cya Misiri yari yazanwe mu Buhinde no kwivuza , ku wa Gatatu bamukoreye isuzuma basanga ntayindi miti akeneye uretse kubagwa .
Abaganga binararibonye bakomeje kumukorera ibizamini bitandukanye basanga mu maraso ye , yaravukanye ibibazo bitandukanye .
Muri ayo maraso ye basanzemo na none ubwoko bwa kabiri bwa diyabete , umuvuduko urenze w' amaraso ndetse n' indwara y' umutima .
Gusa icyiza nuko babonye ko naguma kwitabwaho ashobora kugira amahirwe yogutakaza ibiro bigera kuri 80 mu kwezi gutaha .

Imodoka zitwara abagenzi i Kigali zikubye kabiri mu myaka ibiri Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abatuye Kigali biyongera uko bucyeye uko bwije , abafite imodoka zabo bagendabo nibo bacye , akazi kanini n' inyungu bikajya ku batwara abagenzi muri rusange .
Ibibazo mu kubatwara nabyo bikarushaho kuba byinshi .
Gusa mu nama y' inzego zirebwa n' iki kibazo kuri uyu wa kabiri byatangajwe ko hari ibyagezweho bishimishije mu gukemura ibyo bibazo , nko kuba imodoka zigezweho z' ubushobozi bunyuranye zitwara abantu muri rusange i Kigali zari 265 ( hatarimo Minibus ) mu 2013 ubu zikaba ari 547 ( imibare ya 2015 ) .
Inama yavugaga ku byo gutwara abantu mu Rwanda no mu mujyi wa Kigali by' umwihariko Muri iki kiganiro ummwe mu bakozi ba RURA yatangaje ko hari intambwe yatewe mu gukemura ikibazo cyo gutwara abantu muri Kigali , atanga ingero mu mibare yavuze ko nko mu 2013 imodoka zigezweho zitwara abagenzi 60 zari 20 , zikaba zari 96 mu mpera za 2015 .
Ko Bus nini nazo zitwara abagenzi hejuru ya 60 mu 2013 zari eshanu ( 5 ) gusa ubu zikaba zimaze kuba 40 , naho za Toyota Coaster zitwara abagenzi hagati ya 25 na 29 mu 2013 zari 240 ubu zikaba ari 411 .
Imodoka za Toyota Hiace ( minibus ) zitwara abantu 18 zikaba mu 2013 zari 575 ubu zikaba zaragabanutse i Kigali hasigara 133 izindi zoherezwa gutwara abantu mu mihanda yo mu nkengero z' umujyi wa Kigali .
RURA ivuga ko hongerewe imihanga itari irimo serivisi zo gutwara abantu , mu 2013 ngo habarwaga imihanda ( lignes ) 43 ubu ngo iragera kuri 75 harimo n' imihanda mishya imwe yubatswe na Leta .
Harakorwa iki ku gutinda kw' imodoka zitwara abantu ?
Mu myanzuro yasomewe muri iyi nama harimo ko kugira ngo gutwara abantu muri rusange bigende neza harimo uburyo bugiye kuzanwa bwitwa BIS ( Bus Information System ) buzajya butanga amakuru ku mugenzi akamenya aho imodoka igeze ahagaze ku cyapa ayitegereje .
Iyi system ngo ikaba imaze gushyirwa muri Bus 200 .
Ngo hazashyirwaho kandi abagenzuzi b' imodoka bagomba kuba bazirimo bareba niba itagenda itinda cyane ku byapa mu gihe ikwiye kuba itaharenza iminota itanu nk' uko byagenwe .
Mu kunoza iby' ingendo kandi ngo hari gutangizwa ibijyanye na ' booking ticket ' ku buryo umuntu agura ticket mbere y' imodoka igenda ku isaha runaka , ibi nabyo ngo bizatangira mu gihe kiri imberecya vuba .
Kugeza ubu mu mujyi wa Kigali imodoka za KBS nizo zatangiye gukoresha uburyo bwa ' Smart Card ' mu kwishyuza abagenzi amafaranga y' urugendo , ibi ngo bikazagabanya imirongo miremire kandi ntibiteshe abagenzi umwanya .
Ku muntu uvuye mu Ntara cyangwa umunyamahanga udafite ' Smart Card ' y' urugendo ngo umushoferi w' imodoka azaba afite ikarita nk' iyo utayifite akazajya amwishyura akayikoresha .
RURA ikaba isaba abanyarwanda bose bakenera gutega kwihutira kugura ' Smart Card ' z' urugendo yenda ikibazo cyo gutega muri ubu buryo kikajya kigira abanyamahanga gusa bakaba ari bo bafashwa .
Muri iyi nama basabye abakora ibyo gutwara abantu muri rusange kwihutira kubahiriza iteka rya Perezida wa Republika ritegeka ko imodoka zose zitwara abantu zigomba kugira ' speed governor ' zituma imodoka itarenza umuvuduko wa 60Km / h .
Daddy SADIKI RUBANGURA UMUSEKE .

Tunisia igiye kubaka urukuta ruyitandukanya na Libya Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ubutegetsi bw' igihugu cya Tunisia bwemeje ko bugiye kubaka urukuta rugitandukanya na Libya ahavugwa ko haturuka ibibyehe byihungabanya Tunisia .
Ngo Tunisia igiye kubaka urukuta ruyitandukanya na Libya Uru rukuta ngo ruzaba rufite uburebure bwa kilometero 160 kandi ngo rugomba kuba rwarangiye mbere y' uko uyu mwaka urangira nk' uko Minisitiri w' intebe Habib Essid yabibwiye TV y' igihugu .
Mu minsi ishize umusore witwa Rezgui yinjiye ahantu ba mukerarugendo bakunda kuza gufatira amafu no kuruhuka mu mujyi wa Susse muri Tunisia arasa abantu 38 abenshi muri bo bakomokaga mu bihugu by' i Burayi .
Iki gitero kigambwe n' umutwe wa Islamic State ikorera muri Libya .
Muri Werurwe uyu mwaka abasore babiri bishe ba mukerarugendo 22 babasanze mu nzu ndangamurage ya Bardo .
Mu minsi mike iri imbere , Leta ya Tunisia arasohora itegeko rikumura kandi rihana iterabwoba .

Abaturage bakwiye gukurikirana uko Ingengo y' imari ishyirwa mu bikorwa - Min Gatete Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ubwo yashyiraga ahagaragara ibitabo bito bisobanura ingengo y' imari y' u Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2015 / 16 , kuri uyu wa gatatu tariki 28 Ukwakira , Minisitiri w' Imari n' igenamigambi Claver Gatete yasabye abaturarwanda kujya bakurikirana uko ingengo y' imari ishyirwa mu bikorwa kuko ingengo yimari ari iyabo .
Aka gatabo kashyizwe ahagaragara na Minisiteri y' Imari n' igenamigambi ( MINECOFIN ) kari mu Kinyarwanda , Igifaransa n' icyongereza ari nazo ndimi zemewe mu Rwanda ; karasobanura imiterere y' ingengo y' imari y' uyu mwaka w' ingengo y' imari .
Mu kugashyira ku mugaragaro , Minisitiri Claver Gatete yavuze ko aka gatabo kazafasha abaturage kumva ingengo y' imari byoroshye , mu buryo busubiza ibibazo byabo , kandi kakabagaragariza ukuntu ingengo y' imari itegurwa , uko yemezwa , n' ibindi .
Min . Gatete agasaba abaturage nabo gukurikirana kugira ngo barebe niba ibyo bateganyirijwe mu ngengo y' imari bishyirwa mu bikorwa .
Yagize ati " … aya mafaranga ni amafaranga y' Abanyarwanda , ava mu misoro y' Abanyarwanda , n' impano tubona ni impano iba ihawe Abanyarwanda , n' inguzanyo dufata tuyifata mu izina ry' Abanyarwanda , ni ukuvuga ngo Abanyarwanda bagomba kumenya uko aya mafaranga yakoreshejwe , ibyakozwe , uburyo byakozwe , n' igenzura kugira ngo uwakoze nabi abihanirwe . "
Minisitiri Gatete yavuze ko nubwo gushyira ku mugaragaro utu dutabo byabereye mu Mujyiwa wa Kigali , ngo MINECOFIN igiye gukorana n' Uturere n' Intara kugia ngo tugere kubaturage .
Akemeza ko mu cyumweru gitaha , Abanyarwanda bose bazaba batubonye , kandi badusobanuriwe .
Ati " Bazaba badusobanuriwe kugira ngo batangire bakurikirane ingengo y' imari yatowe uko ishyirwa mu bikorwa , ndetse batangire babaze ibibazo aho amafaranga yagenewe ibyiciro runaka ( ubuzima , ibikorwa remezo , … ) bigeze , … aho bigeze bishyirwa mu bikorwa . "
Abayobozi mu nzego zinyuranye , barimo abo muri Minisitire y' ubutegetsi bw' igihugu ( MINALOC ) , Umujyi wa Kigali n' Uturere tuwugize , na Sosiyete Sivile biyemeje gufasha MINECOFIN gusakaza utu dutabo , no kudusobanurira abaturage kuko ari uburenganzra bwabo .
Buri uko umwaka w' ingengo y' imari urangiye , urwego rw' umugenzuzi mukuru w' imari ya Leta rukora igenzura kugira ngo rumenye uko yakoreshejwe ; nyuma yo kurikora , rugeza raporo ku Nteko Ishinga Amategeko ari nayo iba ihagarariye Abanyarwanda bose .
Iyi raporo igaragaza aho ingengo y' imari yakoreshejwe neza , n' aho yakoreshejwe nabi kugira ngo ababigizemo uruhare babihanirwe .
UMUSEKE . RW Sangiza abandi iyi nkuru :

Uwase Bella Shalom yifuzaga kuzaba umuganga .
Yashyinguwe none Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments 29 Werurwe , Kigali – Abantu benshi bamenye urupfu rw' uyu mwana w' umukobwa w' imyaka 12 wishwe n' umukozi wo mu rugo i Nyamirambo .
Nk' uko byavuzwe mu buhamya butandukanye mu muhango wo kumushyingura kuri uyu wa gatandatu , uyu mwana yakundaga abantu bidasanzwe , yakundaga gusenga cyane ndetse mu nzozi ze harimo kuzaba umuganga .
Bella yaherekejwe ku gicamunsi cya none Uwase Bella Shalom yishwe kuwa gatatu w' iki cyumweru n' umukozi wo mu rugo wahise uburirwa irengero .
Saa tanu za mu gitondo abantu benshi cyane bari ku rusengero rwa ADEPR Gakinjiro mu muhango wo gusezera kuri uyu mwana , saa saba berekeje i Rusororo kuruhutsa umubiri we .
Mu buhamya bwatanzwe abavuze ku ruhande rw' umuryango we , abana biganaga na Bella , umuyobozi w' ishuri ESCAF Nyamirambo , ndetse no ku rusengero aho uyu mwana yaririmbaga , bose bagarutse ku rukundo rw' abantu rutangaje uyu mwana wishwe akebwe ijosi yagiraga .
Mu rusengero Mujiji Musafiri , se w' umwana , yatangaje ko umuryango we utababajwe no kuba bapfushije umwana , kuko ngo ' twese ariho tugana ' , ahubwo bababajwe cyane n' urupfu umwana wabo yapfuyemo .
Ati " Kubabara ko apfuye byaba ari uguhinyura icyizere dufite cy' ubuzima nyuma yo gupfa .
Ikitubabaje gusa ni urupfu yapfuye . "
Umuyobozi w' ikigo yigagaho yatangaje , mu rusengero , ko Uwase Simbi Shalom bitaga Bella yari mu bana b' intangarugero ku ishuri .
Uyu mwana ngo yari afite igikundiro kidasanzwe muri bagenzi be kandi ngo yakundaga cyane abana bigana ndetse n' abana baririmbanaga muri Korari y' abana ku rusengero rwa ADEPR mu Gainjiro .
Mu cyumweru gishize , ku ishuri ngo bakinnye agakinamico , maze Bella afata ' role ' yo gukina nka muganga kuko ngo yifuzaga kuzaba muganga akajya avura abantu .
Uwase Simbi Shalom bitaga Bella yashyinguwe mu irimbi rya rusororo ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa gatandatu ahari abantu benshi cyane , barimo ndetse n' abamenye inkuru y' urupfu rubabaje rw' uyu mwana bakaza gutabara gusa batari bazi uyu muryango wa Mujiji Deo .
Maman Bella , hamwe n' umugabo we , agerageza kuvuga ibya nyuma yaganiriye n' umukobwa we Bella yakundaga gusenga cyane Ku myaka 12 gusa , muri uyu muhango abo ku rusengero no mu rugo bavuze ko uyu mwana yakundaga gusenga bitangaje .
Mu masengesho y' abana aho basengera mu minsi yashize , basabye abana gutanga ibyifuzo bifuza ko byasengerwa , Bella ngo atanga icyifuzo cyo gusengera abana bangana nawe ko bakizwa .
Mu ijoro ryo kuwa kabiri buri bucye kuwa gatatu umunsi yishweho , byatangajwe ko Bella yaririmbanye indirimbo na nyina , ni indirimbo ya 164 mu zishima Imana mu gitabo cy' indirimbo .
Mpore Sylvere wishe uyu mwana , kugeza n' ubu aracyashakishwa na Police ngo akurikiranwe n' ubutabera .
Muri iryo joro rya nyuma mbere y' urupfu rwe bagiye kuryama ngo yabwiye nyina ati " Mama mujye musoma Petero wa mbere umurongo wa 8 kugeza kuri 13 " ( 1 Pierre 3 8 – 13 ) .
Mu gihe basomaga uyu murongo uyu mwana yasize asabye ko bazajya basoma , abantu benshi cyane baturitse bararira .
Musaza we Olivier , niwe yapfiriye mu maboko amujyana kwa muganga Aba ni abana biganaga na Bella batanga ubuhamya ku buryo bose bamukundaga Utwana baririmbanaga muri chorale y' abana twari twaguye mu kantu Deo Mujiji , wagaragaje gukomera muri uyu muhango , yavuze ko ikibabaje atari kuba yapfuye ahubwo ari uburyo yishwemo Bava ku rusengero bajya kuruhura umubiri i Rusororo Abantu benshi cyane baje kwifatanya n' uyu muryango mu kababaro Bamwe mu bagize Chorale Hoziyana iririmbamo ababyeyi ba Bella Mukuru wa Bella ,
Illuminée ( hagati ) mu gahinda kenshi Amarira n' imiborogo byari byinshi mu guherekeza bwa nyuma uyu mwana Yambuwe ubuzima agifite inzozi ndende z' ubuzima 1 Petero 3 :
8 – 13 " Ibisigaye , mwese muhuze imitima mubabarirane kandi mukundane nk' abavandimwe , mugirirane imbabazi mwicisha bugufi mu mutima .
Nti mukiture umuntu inabi yabagiriye , cyangwa igitutsi yabatutse , ahubwo mumwiture kumusabira umugisha , kuko aribyo mwahamagariwe kugirango namwe muragwe umugisha .
Kuko byanditswe ngo " Ushaka gukunda ubugingo no kubona iminsi myiza abuze ururimi rwe kutavuga ikibi , n' iminwa ye itavuga iby' uburiganya , kandi azibukire ibibi akore ibyiza ashake amahoro ayakurikire kugirango ayashyikire , kuko amaso y' Uwiteka ari ku bakiranutsi n' amatwi ye ari ku byo basaba ariko igitsure cy' Uwiteka kiri ku nkozi z' ibibi .
Mbese ni inde uzabagirira nabi nimugira ishyaka ry' ibyiza ? "

Ibisabwa kuri iyo myanya ni ibi bikurikira :
Kuba ari umunyarwanda ; Kuba abishaka ; Kuba afite nibura imyaka 18 y' amavuko kandi atarengeje imyaka mirongo itatu n' itanu ( 35 ) y' amavuko cyangwa kuba atarengeje imyaka 45 y' amavuko ku muntu ufite uburambe mu gucunga umutekano nibura bw' imyaka itanu ( 5 ) ; Kuba ari indakemwa mu mico no mu myifatire ; Kuba atarigeze akatirwa burundu igihano cy' igifungo cy' amezi atandatu ( 6 ) gusubiza hejuru ;
Kuba atarirukanywe burundu ku kazi ko mu butegetsi bwa Leta ; Kuba afite impamyabumenyi y' amashuri nibura atandatu ( 6 ) yisumbuye cyangwa nibura atatu yisumbuye n' uburambe bw' imyaka nibura itanu ( 5 ) mu gucunga umutekano ; Ku mwanya umwe w' Umuhuzabikorwa wa DASSO , agomba kuba afire impamyabumenyi ya A0 mu ishami iryo ari ryo ryose ;
Kuba afite ubuzima bwiza n' intege zibashije imirimo ya DASSO Uburyo bwo gusaba akazi :
Kuzuza ifishi isaba akazi iboneka ku rubuga nva interineti rwaa Komisiyo y' abakozi ba Leta no mu Bunyamabanga Rusange bw' Akarere ka Nyanza .
Iyi fishi igomba guherekezwa na fotokopi y' impamyabumenyi , fotokopi y' indangamuntu .
Dosiye isaba akazi igomba kuba yageze mu Bunyamabanga rusange bw' Akarere ka Nyanza bitarenze tariki ya 8 / 04 / 2014 saa kumi n' imwe z' amanywa ( 17H00 ) Ikizamini cyanditse kizakorwa tariki ya 11 / 04 / 2014 .
