Kubona inguzanyo mu Rwanda ntibigisaba kuba ufite konti muri Banki !
Kuri uyu wa gatatu tariki 15 Gashyantare 2017 , i Kigali hatangijwe uburyo bushya aho umuntu ashobora kubona inguzanyo bidasabye kuba afite konti muri Banki runaka .
Ni mu rwego rwo kurushaho gufasha abanyarwanda kugera kuri serivisi z' imari , sosiyete y' itumanaho MTN Rwanda ku bufatanye na CBA ( Commercial Bank Of Africa ) batangije Mokash izatuma abantu bakoresha MTN bizigama ndetse bakabasha no kwaka inguzanyo .
Umuyobozi mukuru wa MTN Rwanda , Bart Hofker yavuze ko icyo Mokash igamije ari ugufasha 74 % by' abanyarwanda bagera kuri serivisi z' imari ariko batagira konti muri banki , kuko hifashishijwe iyi serivisi bazabasha kubigeraho , igikenewe gusa ni ukugira umurongo wa MTN , ukaba waraniyandikishije muri Mobile money .
Bart Hofker , Umuyobozi mukuru wa MTN Rwanda yavuze ko Mokash izafasha 74 % by' abanyarwanda .
Umuyobozi wa CBA Group , Isaac Awuondo yavuze ko umuntu akoresheje Mokash yemerewe kwizigama guhera ku mafaranga 100 kuzamura , akazajya ahabwa inyungu ya 7 % by' amafaranga yizigamye buri mwaka mu gihe inguzanyo yemerewe kwaka itazajya irenga ibihumbi Magana atatu by' amafaranga y' u Rwanda ( 300 . 000FRWS ) , akayishyura yongeyeho inyungu ya 9 % .
Yakomeje avuga ko kugira ngo umuntu ahabwe inguzanyo nta ngwate cyangwa ibindi bintu bihambaye azajya yakwa , hazagenderwa ku buryo akoresha serivisi za MTN ; harimo mobile money , guhamagara , kwakira no kohereza ubutumwa bugufi SMS , ubundi hakagenwa amafaranga atemerewe kurenza nk' inguzanyo , aho azajya ayamenyeshwa ku butumwa bugufi azajya ahabwa .
Umuyobozi wa CBA Group , Isaac Awuondo avuga ko hazagenderwa ku buryo umukiliya akoresha serivisi za MTN kugira ngo ahabwe inguzanyo .
Abayobozi batandukanye bari bitabiriye uyu muhango barimo Minisitiri w' Urubyiruko n' Ikoranabuhanga , Jean Philbert Nsengimana na Guverineri wungirije wa Banki Nkuru y' Igihugu , Monique Nsanzabaganwa bagaragaje ko Mokash izatuma u Rwanda rugera ku ntego zarwo zo kugera ku bukungu butarimo ihererekanya ry' amafaranga mu ntoki .
Yaba Minisitiri w' Urubyiruko n' Ikoranabuhanga , Jean Philbert Nsengimana ndetse na Guverineri wungirije wa Banki Nkuru y' Igihugu , Monique Nsanzabaganwa basanga Mokash izatuma u Rwanda rugera ku ntego zarwo zo kugera ku bukungu .
Minisitiri w' Imari n' Igenamigambi , Ambasaderi Claver Gatete yagaragaje ko uruhare rwo guhererekanya amafaranga hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga mu musaruro mbumbe w' igihugu ari 16 % , kandi ko hari byinshi bigikeneye gukorwa .
Minisitiri Gatete kandi yavuze ko Minisiteri y' Imari n' Igenamigambi ifatanyije na Banki Nkuru y' Igihugu bari gutegura uburyo bushya bugena imikorere y' ibijyanye no kwishyura , igikorwa kitezweho kurushaho koroshya gahunda yo guhindura u Rwanda igihugu gifite ubukungu butarangwamo ihererekanya ry' amafaranga mu ntoki .
Minisitiri w' Imari n' Igenamigambi , Ambasaderi Claver Gatete avuga ko u Rwanda rugeze kuri 16 % mu guhererekanya amafaranga hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga .
CBA ikorera mu bihugu bitandukanye birimo Kenya , Uganda , Tanzania , u Rwanda n' ibindi aho ugeza ubu iri ku mwanya wa gatandatu mu ma banki ahagaze neza muri Afurika , ni mu gihe kandi Mokash atari nshya mu bihugu byo muri Afurika y' Uburasirazuba kuko CBA isanzwe iyikoresha muri Kenya , Uganda na Tanzania ariko ku mazina atandukanye , aho mu Rwanda miliyoni 12 z' amadorali ari yo yashowe muri iyi serivisi .
Kugira ngo utangire gukoresha Mokash , usabwa kuba ufite umurongo wa MTN kandi wariyandikishije muri MTN Mobile money , ubundi ugakanda * 182 # ugakurikiza amategeko n' amabwiriza .
Niba utarabikora !
Dukunde unadukurikire ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ukomeze ubone amakuru mu buryo utamenyereye .

Priscillah yihakanye umusore wa gatatu bamaze imyaka ibiri bavugwa mu rukundo Yanditswe na Munyengabe Murungi Sabin Kuya 22 Gashyantare 2017 saa 10 :
25 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
4 0 Imyaka itanu irashize Princess Priscillah avugwa mu rukundo bikarangira abihinduye impuha , umusore wa gatatu byari bimaze imyaka ibiri bishyushye na we yamwihakanye avuga ko ' ari wenyine ' .
Princess Priscillah ubusanzwe witwa Umuratwa Priscillah yahakanye yivuye inyuma iby' urukundo avugwamo na Producer Lick Lick bakorana muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika aho yagiye gukomereza amasomo ya Kaminuza .
IGIHE yatahuye inkuru y' urukundo rwakekwaga hagati ya Priscillah na Isaac Mbabazi [ Lick Lick ] muri Nyakanga 2015 , icyo gihe byavugwaga ko uyu mukobwa akigera muri Amerika bahise bunga ubumwe ariko bombi barabyamaganye .
Inkuru nshya yongeye kuvugisha benshi irahamya ko urukundo rw' aba bombi rwashinze imizi ndetse ko basigaye babana mu nzu imwe muri Leta ya Ohio .
Priscillah yahakanye iyi nkuru ndetse yongera gushimangira ko ' nta n' akanunu k' urukundo gahari ' .
Nubwo hari amagambo amaze iminsi acicikana ku mbuga nkoranyambaga no mu bitangazamakuru bitandukanye ko Princess Priscillah ari mu rukundo na Producer Lick Lick , uyu mukobwa yabyamaganiye kure avuga ko ' iyi nkuru amaze kuyimenyera ' .
Yagize ati " Biriya ni bya bindi bidafite aho bishingiye by' ibinyoma gusa .
Ukuri ni uko biriya ari ibinyoma , gihamya ihari ni yo yari kuba umutwe w' inkuru … " Uyu mukobwa usigaye wiyita ' Scillah ' azwi mu ndirimbo ' Nka Paradizo ' yakanyujijeho akiba mu Rwanda mu ndirimbo zamenyekanye nka " Mbabarira " , " Harabura iki " , " Bagupfusha ubusa " n' izindi .
Priscillah yagiye avugwa mu rukundo n' abasore b' ibyamamare mu Rwanda ariko bikarangira abigaramye .
Mu mwaka wa 2011 yavuzwe mu rukundo na Mani Martin , uyu mukobwa yarinze ava mu Rwanda ajya muri Amerika ataremera ko bakundana .
Nyuma hadutse King James na we aramwigarika .
Aba bahanzi bombi , haba Mani Martin na King James byavugwaga ko bakundana na Priscillah kubera uburyo basohokanaga na we ndetse bakagaragara mu ruhame bishimanye nyamara muri icyo gihe byabaga bigoye kubona uyu mukobwa ari kumwe n' umusore .
Mu mwaka wa 2013 King James yasohoye indirimbo yitwa ' Ndagukumbuye ' inkuru zitangira gucicikana ko yayihimbiye Priscillah .
Yagiye muri Amerika gukorerayo amashusho agezeyo ashakisha Priscillah aba ari we yifashisha gukina ubutumwa buri mu ndirimbo ye bityo benshi bemeza bidasubirwaho ko ' bakundana mu buryo buhishe ' .
Kuri ubu biravugwa ko uyu mukobwa akundana na Producer Lick Lick na we utuye muri Amerika .
Lick Lick yakundanye na Oda Paccy igihe kinini birangira urukundo rwabo rudakomeje gusa rwera imbuto nziza kuko babyaranye umwana w' umukobwa .
Princess Priscillah ngo yaba abana mu nzu imwe na Lick Lick Princess Priscillah yerekeje muri Amerika muri Nyakanga 2013 akaba yaragiye kuhakomereza amasomo ya Kaminuza ubu ari mu mwaka wa kabiri .
Narangiza amasomo ye yihaye intego yo kuzahita agaruka mu Rwanda gushyira mu ngiro ubumenyi ari guhaha mu mahanga .
Ubu ngo ari gutunganya album ya mbere ndetse indirimbo hafi ya zose zigiye kurangira .
Ati " Album izina ryayo nzaritangaza iri ku musozo nintangira ibikorwa byo kuyimenyekanisha aho niho nzaba nafashe imyanzuro idahinduka .
Ubu igeze kure indirimbo nyinshi zararangiye .
Abafana bitegure indirimbo nshya , ndi kubikoraho ku buryo ari vuba kandi bizaba ari ibintu bishimishije . "
Priscillah ageze mu mwaka wa kabiri wa kaminuza muri Amerika Princess Priscillah yavuze ko nta kanunu k' urukundo hagati ye na Lick Lick King James na Priscillah bavuzweho gukundana igihe kirekire ariko bakabihakana .

Amazi ya Kivu atera indwara ya Schisostomiasis - Dr Kanyankore William Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Dr Kanyankore William ukuriye ibitaro bya Gisenyi avuga ko hari abarwayi bamwe bakiri bacye cyane ariko bagaragaza ibimenyetso bw' indwara ya Schisostomiasis iterwa no kunywa amazi adatetse avomwa mu Kiyaga cya Kivu .
Dr . Kanyankore William Uyu muganga avuga ko iyi ndwara nta muntu irica ariko itera abantu kurwara indwara zica nk' umwijima , kurwara indwara zifata amaso n' izindi .
Muganga Kanyankore avuga ko iyi ndwara ipimwa ikavurwa kandi igakira neza .
Yagize ati : " Abaturage turabakangurira kutanywa amazi y' i Kivu adatetse ndetse n' ayandi yose . "
Uyu muganga avuga ko ubu Minisiteri y' ubuzima n' abafatanya bikorwa bayo bari mu gikorwa cyo gupima abaturage mu Rwanda mu rwego rwo kureba ibipimo by' iyi ndwara no kunonosora igenamigambi ryo kuyihashya .
Dr Kanyankore avuga ko abaturiye inkengero z' ikiyaga cya Kivu bari gupimwa umusarane ngo barebe niba nta wanduye iyo ndwara , bagashishikarizwa kandi kwirinda kunywa amazi y' i Kivu adatetse .
Ibimenyetso biranga indwara ya Schisostomiasis :
Umurwayi wafashwe n' iyi ndwara arangwa no kwishimagura , gucika intege , no kubyimba umwijima iyo igeze ku rwego rwo hejuru .
Iyo umuntu anyweye amazi yo mu Kivu adatetse udukoko tumwijira mu mubiri .
Iyo tugezemo tubyara utundi twinshi tukororoka … Kwiyongera k' utu dukoko gutuma twinjira mu mwijima ( umwijima ni inyama ikenera amaraso menshi ) maze tugatuma ubyimba .
Iyo umwijima ubyimbye umurwayi atangira gucika intege ndetse bikamuviramo kwitaba Imana .
Abahanga bavuga ko mu bantu miliyono 210 banduye iyi ndwara umwaka ushize ku Isi , abari hagati y' ibihumbi 12 na 200 yabahitanye .
Abibasirwa cyane ni abatuye imigabane y' Aziya na Afurika .
Kubera izi mpamvu , Dr Kanyankore araburira abaturiye ikiyaga cya Kivu kwirinda kunywa amazi ya Kivu adatetse neza ngo abirindure .
Abakoresha ikiyaga cya Kivu barasabwa kwirinda kunywa aya mazi adatetse Daddy SADIKI RUBANGURA ububiko .

08 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
2 0 Itsinda ry' abaririmbyi ryo muri Kenya ryanyuze mu Mujyi wa Kigali ryerekeza mu Mujyi wa Goma kuhakorera igitaramo , umwe muri bo witwa Mudigi yishingikirije imbago kubera imvune .
Sauti Sol yageze ku Kibuga cy' Indege cya Kigali ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki ya 10 Gashyantare 2017 .
Ni mu rugendo rwekeza muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo i Goma kwitabira iserukiramuco rya Amani Festival ryabaye kuva ku itariki 10 , 11 na 12 Gashyantare 2017 i Goma .
Sauti Sol igizwe na Bien - Aimé Baraza , Delvin Mudigi , Polycarp Otieno na Willis Austin Chimano , aba bose bagiye muri RDC nubwo mugenzi wabo [ Mudigi ] arwaye ukuguru nyuma y' impanuka yakoze mu minsi ishize .
Delvin Savara Mudigi kuri ubu uri kugendera mu mbago yabwiye IGIHE ko banyuze mu Rwanda nk' inzira nziza bahisemo ndetse ngo ' ni igihugu bafata nk' icyababyaye ' .
Yagize ati " Ni ahantu twisanga cyane , ni inzira ubwacu twahisemo kugira ngo twongere turebe abantu bacu , twumve uyu mwuka mwiza . "
Yabajijwe ku rukundo rwe na Kavi Pratt , mwishywa wa Perezida Kenyatta avuga atazuyaza ko ' bamaze kuba umwe ndetse bishimye ' gusa yahakanye ko atagiye guhita ashinga urugo nk' uko byatangajwe ahubwo ngo bari mu nzira izabageza ku cyo bifuje kuva bamenyana .
Savara Mudigi ati " Ntabwo ngiye gushinga urugo nk' uko bamwe bakeka , nzabikora ariko si none aha [ … ] Nanjye ndi umuntu , kuki ntakunda ?
Nanjye ndi umuntu kandi ndakunda nkanakundwa . "
Sauti Sol yaherukaga mu Rwanda mu mwaka ushize , yahakoreye igitaramo gikomeye cyo kumurika album ' Live and Die In Afrika ' .
Aba bahanzi bavuze ko mu mishinga ikomeye bafite muri iki gihe harimo indirimbo nshya bitegura gusohora no gutegura album yabo ya kane .
Iyo bakoranye na Meddy ngo ntirarangira neza gusa bijeje abafana babo ko izaza bidatinze .
Aba bahanzi bakunzwe cyane mu ndirimbo " Live and Die in Africa " , " Africa " , " Nerea " , " Isabella " , " Unconditionally Bae " , " Nishike " , " Shake Yo Bam Bam " , bafite n' indi nshya baherutse gukorana na 2Face Idibia bise ' Oya Come Make We Go ' .

DJ Pius na Charly & Nina basesekaye i Kigali bavuye muri Centre Afrique - AMAFOTO Mu ijoro ryakeye ryo kuwa 15 Gashyantare ni bwo abahanzi Charly & Nina na DJ Pius basesekaye i Kanombe bavuye muri Centre Afrique mu bitaramo bakoranye n' umuhanzi Big Farious ukomoka i Burundi .
Ni mu rugendo rumaze hafi ibyumweru bibiri batangiriye mu gihugu cya Uganda aho Charly & Nina bari mu bahatanira ibihembo bya Hipipo awards bakaza no kwegukanamo igikombe nyuma yaho bagakora igitaramo cyabo bafatanyije na DJ Pius .
Charly & Nina bahise berekeza mu gihugu cya Centre Afrique aho bahuriye na Big Farious bakorana ibitaramo bibiri mu mujyi wa Bangui .
Aba bahanzi bagera ku kibuga cy' indege i Kanombe wabonaga ko bishimiye kugaruka kuko ubuzima bwo muri Centre Afrique butaboroheye kubera imiterere n' ikirere cyaho , gusa bakaba barahagiriye ibihe byiza dore ko babashije no guhura n' umufasha wa Perezida wa Centre Afrique bakagirana ikiganiro .

Ibigo 12 birahatanira gutwara abagenzi mu Mujyi wa Kigali Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Muri gahunda nshya y' Umujyi wa Kigali n' ikigo cy' u Rwanda gishinzwe kugenzura ibikorwa n' imirimo itandukanye ifititiye igihugu akamaro ( RURA ) igamije impinduka n' amavugurura mu gutwara abantu , ibigo 12 birimo guhatanira gukora kujya bitwara abantu mu byerekezo bine by' Umujyi no mu Mujyi rwa gati .
Bimwe mu bigo birimo guhatana birimo Kigali Bus Services ( KBS ) , Volcano , Virunga Safaris , Prince Express , Gasabo , Royal Express n' impuzamashyirahamwe nyarwanda ryo gutwara abantu ( Rwanda Federation of Transport Co - operatives ) .
Emmanuel Asaba ushinzwe ibijyanye n' ingendo ( Public transport regulation ) muri RURA atangaza ko ibigo bizatsindira ayo masoko bizamenyekana bitarenze tariki 12 z' uku kwezi turimo kwa Kanama .
Ibigo bizaba byatsinze , bizasinya amasezerano y' imyaka itanu , hanyuma gahunda y' imikorere mishya mu gutwara abantu mu Mujyi wa Kigali ishyirwe ku mugaragaro tariki 30 Kanama .
Asaba akavuga ko ikigo kizatsindira gutwara abantu muri zone runaka , kizajya ibazwa ibijyanye no gutwara bantu muri iyo zone .
Agira ati " Mu gihe kitwaye nabi kizahanishwa ibihano bitandukanye birimo no guhagarika amasezerano cyangwa kwamburwa impushya zo gutwara abagenzi bitewe n' ibyabahamye . "
Ku ruhande rw' Umujyi wa Kigali nabo ngo babona iyi gahunda nshya ari igisubizo ku kibazo cy' akajagari kari kamaze igihe kirekire mu gutwara abantu .
Jean Claude Rurangwa , impuguke mu gutwara abantu abantu mu Mujyi wa Kigali agira ati " Ntitwakomeza kuvuga iterambere no kuzamuka mu bukungu tugifite akajagari mu gutwara abantu .
Abantu bakeneye kugenda byoroshye no gukera gahunda zabo kugihe . "
Muri gahunda nshya yo gutwara abantu , Umujyi wa Kigali wagabanijwe mu mazone :
Zone ya mbere igizwe n' umuhanda wa Remera , Kanombe ( Kabeza ) , Nyarugunga , Rusororo ( Kabuga ) , Masaka , Ndera na Niboye ( igice cya Alpha Palace ) .
Zone ya kabiri igizwe na Niboye , Kicukiro , Kagarama , Gatenga , Kigarama , Gikondo ( Nyenyeri ) and Gahanga .
Zone ya gatatu igizwe n' umuhanda ugana Gikomero , Bumbogo , Rutunga , Kimironko ( Kibagabaga ) , Kinyinya ( Deustch ware , Kagugu , Batsinda ) , Remera ( Nyarutarama , Rukiri II ) , Kimihurura , Kacyiru na Gisozi .
Naho zone ya kane ni Gitega , Nyamirambo , Kimisagara , Nyakabanda , Mageragere , Kigali , Gatsata , Jali , Jabana , Nduba and Rutunga .
Mu gihe igice cyo mu Mujyi rwagati ( Nyarugenge na Muhima ) bizafatwa nk' igice kidafite aho kibogamiye ( neutral zone ) bitewe ahanini n' uko usanga izi modoka zihahura Mu rwego rwo guca akajagari imodoka zijya muri zone runaka zizajya zirangwa n' ibara ry' iyo zone ryihariye .
Imodoka zizakora muri Zone ya mbere zizaba zisize ibara ry' ubururu , izo muri zone ya kabiri zizaba zisize umuhondo , izo muri zone ya gatatu zizaba zisize icyatsi kibisi naho izo muri zone ya kane zizaba zisize umukara .
Source : The newtimes UMUSEKE .

El Baradei wari vice perezida wa Misiri yeguye Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ibintu byafashe indi sura mu Misiri kuri uyu mugoroba ubwo uwari vice perezida w' agateganyo Mohamed El Baradei yeguye ku mirimo ye nyuma y' uko ingabo na Police zikoresheje imbaraga zidasanzwe i Cairo mu gutatanya abayoboke b' uwahoze ari perezida Mohamed Morsi .
Baradei ngo ntiyakomeza gufata imyanzuro adahamyanya nayo / photo sahilonline " Birankomereye gukomeza inshingano zanjye zo gufata ibyemezo numva ntahamyanya nabyo ubwanjye kandi nkemanga ingaruka zabyo . "
Biri mu ibaruwa yandikiye perezida Adly Mansour ubu uyoboye Misiri .
Yavuze ariko ko ababajwe n' uko abungukira mu cyemezo cye n' ibiri kuba ari abahamagarira abandi ubugizi bwa nabi n' iterabwoba ry' imitwe y' abahezanguni nkuko bitangazwa na Aljazeera .
Abashyigikiye perezida wegujwe Morsi bakomeje gutsimbarara ku kwanga kuva mu mihanda y' i Cairo , Leta nayo irashinjwa gukoresha imbaraga nyinshi mu kubavanamo .
Abageraku 460 ngo baba bamaze kwitaba Imana kuri uyu wa gatatu gusa .
Ministeri y' Ubuzima ya Misiri yemeje ko abantu 400 bapfuye kuri uyu wa gatatu ahatandukanye mu Misiri mu myigaragambyo .
Mohamed Mustafa El Baradei wahawe igihembo cy' amahoro kitiriwe Nobel mu 2005 we na AIEA ( International Atomic Energy Agency ) yari ayoboye , yari yahawe uyu mwanya mu ntangiriro z' ukwezi gushize .
Tariki 03 / 07 / 2013 ubwo batangazaga ihirikwa rya Morsi , El Baradei yari iruhande rwa General Abdel Fattah al - Sissi ufatwa nk' umuyobozi wa byose ubu mu Misiri kuko ariwe uyoboye ingabo .
El Baradei ari mu bagize uruhare runini mu mpinduramatwara zo mu 2011 zahiritse Hosni Mubarak , ndetse yari mu bashyigikiye kuvanaho Mohamed Morsi .
Baradei ni inzobere mu mategeko .
Abagera kuri 460 biganjemo abashyigikiye Morsi bitabye Imana kuri uyu wa gatatu gusa JP GASHUMBA UMUSEKE .

Suruduwire n' inzoga z' inkorano bigiye kujya ku rutonde rw' ibiyobyabwenge Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Hamaze igihe humvikana Polisi y' u Rwanda imena ibiyobyabwenge ndetse n' inzoga z' inkorano Minisiteri y' ubuzima ngo iri gukora urutonde rw' ibiyobyabwenge biziyongera ku bihanwa n' amategeko y' u Rwamda .
Inzoga z' inzaduka zigiye gushyirwa ku rutonde rw' ibiyobyabwenge bitemewe mu Rwanda Suruduwire , Kombuca , Karigazoki , Yewe muntu , Nyirantare , Muriture n' ibindi byinshi by' ibikorano n' inzaduka bimaze iminsi byumvikana mu nzoga zica cyane abazinywa mu dusantere no mu mijyi itandukanye mu gihugu ngo bigiye gushyirwa ku rutonde rw' ibifatwa nk' ibiyobyabwenge bitemewe .
Chief Supt Emmanul Ngondo uyobora agashami gashinzwe kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge muri Polisi y' Igihugu yabwiye Radio KFM ko ku rutonde rw' ibiyobyabwenge hari ibindi bigiye kwiyongeramo ndetse bigahanwa n' amategeko nubwo n' ubu iyo bifashwe bimenwa .
Chief Supt Emmanuel Ngondo avuga ko ibiyobyabwenge byongera ikibazo ku bwonko nubwo bamwe bibwira ko bibajyana mu nzira nziza .
Urutonde rwa bimwe mu biyobyabwenge bikomeye rutegurwa na Minisiteri y' Ubuzima ( MINISANTE ) gusa hakaba hari ibindi birimo bishyirwa ku rutonde .
Bimwe mu biyobyabwenge bisanzwe bizwi harimo Heroine , Cocaine , urumogi , imiti ikora nk' ibiyobyabwenge , Mayirungi , Kanyanga n' ibindi bitemewe .
Ku bijyanye n' izindi nzoga z' inzaduka nka Suruduwire , Karigazoki na Kombuca , n' inzagwa zikorwa zigahabwa amazina bitewe n' uko zica Polisi y' Igihugu ivuga ko Minisiteri y' Ubuzima hari iri kubyigaho ngo irebe ko yabyongera ku rutonde .
Ati " Icyo tubivugaho nuko birimo bitegurwa hariza Mukubitumwice , Yewemuntu , za Muriture n' izindi n' ubu ntibyemewe kunyobwa n' ubu hari amabwiriza abibuza kunyobwa ndetse uziko tujya tubimena ariko noneho Minisante iri kubitegura neza ngo byongerwe ku rutonde rw' ibiyobyabwenge bitemewe bizahanwa n' itegeko . "
Chief Supt Ngondo avuga ko ibiyobyabwenge nka Mayirungi , Heronine , Cocaine n' urumogi ngo bidakorerwa mu Rwanda .
Avuga ko n' abahingaga urumogi mu Rwanda bamaze kubarwanya bigacika .
Ni gute byinjira mu gihugu kandi umutekano ukajijwe .
Polisi y' Igihugu ivuga ko bica ku mipaka itemewe kandi ababyinjiza bakaba bafite amayeri menshi .
Ati " Iyo mvuga ngo bica ku mipaka itemewe niyo mpamvu ubona tubifata cyane mbere y' uko byinjira mu gihugu , aho niho twibanda kukabifatana n' ababizana . "
Avuga ko bisaba ubushishozi kubifata kuko hari n' ababyishyira mu nda ariko ngo bagerageza kubirwanya bigendanye n' amakuru babonye n' ubumenyi bafite .
BIRORI Eric UMUSEKE .

Pasiteri Hakizimana Stephen yatangaje aya magambo ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa gatanu tariki 24 Gashyantare 2017 , uri nawo munsi yizihizaho isabukuru ye y' amavuko .

Mu myaka 32 nujuje uyu munsi muri iyi myaka nahuye n' intambara nyinshi zikomeye cyane cyane kuva nahabwa Inshingano y' ubu Pasiteri ( Pastor ) muri Nzeri 2014 . "
Pasiteri Hakizimana Stephen avuga ko intambara ahura nazo zishaka ubugingo bwe .

Iracyandinze , Imana Ndayishima ku bw' ijambo ryayo iri kumpa riri kunkomeza .

Showbiz , benshi bamaze kumenya ko ari ubukungu bushya Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Ni ijambo rikoreshwa cyane ariko bamwe bashobora kuba batazi neza aho rikwiye gukoreshwa .
Ese ibikorwa n' abahanzi nko mu Rwanda byose ni Show Biz ?
Iri jambo rikoreshwa cyane mu bikorwa by' imyidagaduro byerekeranye na muzika , ariko nyamara Show Biz ( cyangwa Showbiz ) ni impine y' ijambo Show Business , bivuze ko ari ibikorwa by' inyungu biciye mu bitaramo na muzika bigatanga inyungu kuko bicishwa kuri rubanda rubyishyura rubikunze .
Ibyamamare muri muzika ku Isi kuva mu myaka ya 19930 byatangiye guhindura ubukungu bw' isi biciye mu guhuruza imbaga no kugurisha ibihangano byabo .
Nibwo hatangiye gukoresha cyane ijambo Show business .
Iri jambo rikoreshwa risa niryerekeye kubantu bagira uruhare muri urwo ruganda rw' imyidagaduro ariko biganisha ku bushabitsi cyagwa se ku kugira umutungo byinjiza .
Bikaba mu bisobanura ku buryo bwa nyabwo , kubyaza umusaruro w' amafanga ibikorwa by' imyidagaduro .
Muri uko kubyaza umusaruro ibikorwa by' imyidagaduro , hazamo abarengera inyungu z' ibyo byamamare bakunze kwitwa ba Managers , abashinzwe kubagurisha , aha ni nko kubakinnyi ba sport zitandukanye , abakora ibihangano by' abahanzi cyangwa se ababicuruza banashoramo umutahe wabo , aba bakunze kwita producers .
Kurundi ruhande haza abaririmbyi , abakinnyi ba cinema , abanditsi b' ibitabo n' abandi , aho abafanababa bafatwa nk' abakiriya b' urwo ruganda rw' imyidagaduro .
Abo bose mu bukungu bw' igihugu bashyirwa mu gice cy' ubukungu cya gatatu , nyuma y' ibikorwa remezo , ubuhinzi ndetse n' ubworozi aho bafatwa nk' ubutunzi bw' igihugu biciye mu bihangano , ibikorwa ndetse n' amasosiyete yinjiriza igihugu baba bakorana .
Kubungabunga ibikorwa by' ibyamarere , biba ari inshingano za Leta , abigenga ndetse n' abafana ubwabo .
Ibi bigakorwa bicishijwe mu nzira eshatu .
Izo nzira eshatu zirimo kwita kubakizamuka mu mpande zose zishoboka , gushaka impano mubakiri bato no kuzicungira hafi , ndetse no gutegura ibikorwa bitanga umusaruro kandi hiifashishijwe cyane itangazamakuru .
Aha hazamo nuko ababishinzwe baba bagomba guhora bashaka amasura mashya kandi azatanga umusaruro , gushimangira ibikorwa by' intagereranywa by' ababanjirije abandi ndetse no gutegura ibitaramo , ibiganiro , ibikorwa byo gufasha n' ibindi .
Nubwo ariko ngo iri jambo ryakuze ndetse rikanamenyekana guhera mu kinyejana cya 20 ngo ryaba ryaranabayeho mu myaka y' 1850 , maze iyi nyito ikaba ikinariho magingo aya .
Ibyamamare binyuze mu bikorwa by' ubwamamare bwabyo bikundwa n' abantu benshi , ari nako byinjiza amafaranga avuye mu byo bakora maze uko amafaranga , ibikorwa ndetse n' abakunzi biyongera , niko na showbiz ikura .
Imijyi myinshi mu bihugu bitandukanye yagiye yandika izina mukugira uruhare mw' ikura n' izamuka rya showbizz y' isi , nk' umujyi wa Mombai mu buhinde mu kitwa Bollywood , Cannes mu bufaransa ndetse na Los angeles ahitwa Holly wood , aho kugeza magingo aya iyo uvuze Hollywood , buri wese afite icyo yumva bitewe n' ubumenyi cyangwa se amakuru afite kuri aka gace gafatwa nk' inkingi muri show biz ku isi .
Ikinyamakuru FORBES MAGAZINE kerekanye ko mu mwaka 2011 , umunyamakuru kazi Oprah Winfrey yari ayoboye ibyamamare muri Showbiz byari bifite agatubutse aho yabarirwaga millioni zirenga 221 z' ama euros , uyashyize mu mafaranga y' u Rwanda , akaba asaga miliyari 205 na miliyoni magana atanu na mirongo itatu .
Mu myidagaduro yo mu Rwanda abantu benshi bemeza ko imaze gufata indi ntera , bakabihera kukuba hagaragara abanyamuziki , abakinnyi ba cinema , abasportifs , abanyamakuru ndetse n' abakinnyi b' amakinamico bafite abakunzi kandi batangiye kwinjiza amafaranga biciye mubyo bakora .
Ijambo showbiz risa n' iritagira igisobanuro mu Kinyarwanda cyane ko aho ryumvikana rikoreshwa riguma mururimi rw' icyongereza .
Abakunze kurigarukaho ariko akenshi baba babisanisha n' umuziki gusa nyamara atari byo , bigatuma n' abagakwiye kubarizwa muri showbiz twakwita nyarwanda biheza , aho usanga nk' abakinnyi b' imipira , aba ama kinamico bamwe bumva bari hanze y' iyo si .
Kwiyubaka ni ijambo rikunze kugaruka mw' itangazamakuru , ryumvikanisha ko iyo showbiz ya hano mu Rwanda irimo yiyubaka nyine .
Bamwe mubafite aho bahurira niyi showbiz nyarwanda bakaba nabo bemeza ko bakurikije aho uru ruganda rw' imyidagaduro rwavuye naho rugeze bo babona ko hari intwambwe igaragara imaze guterwa .
Ariko iyo urebye nabo uko batanga ibitekerezo , showbiz baracyayibonamo umuziki cyane kuruta ibindi biyibarizwamo .
Aho iri kosa rikunze kugaragara kuri benshi hano mu Rwanda .
Ese iyi ntambwe ivugwa n' abafana , bakaba n' abakiriya ba mbere b' uru ruganda rw' imyidagaduro ko yatewe , ba nyir ' ububwite barayibona ?
Mu kiganiro n' umwe mu bakora umuziki mu Rwanda akaba yaratangaje ko nubwo Umuziki , imikino itandukanye , abakinnyi b' amakinamico na cinema nyarwanda , aribyo bimaze kugaragaza ko byatangiye gutanga umusaruro w' amafaranga , bidasobanuye ko aribo babarizwa muri showbiz gusa , ntibinasobanuye kandi ko icyo bakuramo muri ikigihe gihagije .
Akaba abona ko Uruhare rwa Leta , itangazamakuru , abikorera ku giti cyabo , abaterankunga bakiyongeraho , ko bikenewe maze abakora showbizz bakongera ubunyangamugayo , gukorana umuhate ndetse bya kinyamwuga ko aribyo bizatuma urwo ruganda rukomera , rugatunga ba nyirarwo ndetse n' igihugu muri rusange .
Roger Marc Rutindukanamurego ububiko .

Umuhanzi Ildephonde Ready ukomoka i Burundi yashyize hanze amashusho y' indirimbo ' Akayaga ' - VIDEO Ndayishimiye Ildephonse ukoresha izina ry' ubuhanzi rya Ildephonse Ready , umuhanzi w' umurundi yamaze gushyira hanze amashusho y' indirimbo ye yise ' Akayaga ' .
Uyu muhanzi umaze imyaka irindwi akorera umuziki ku butaka bw' u Rwanda yatangarije Inyarwanda . com ko u Rwanda rwamufashije kugera ku ndoto z' umuziki we .
Ildephonse Ready winjiye mu muziki mu mwaka wa 2010 , kugeza ubu avuga ko afite indirimbo 30 harimo 20 z' amashusho n' izindi 10 akirimo gutunganyiriza amashusho yazo .
Mu bihangano bye yadutangarije ko yibanda cyane ku rukundo rwa Yesu Kristo watanze ubuzima bwe agapfira abatuye isi bose .
Abajijwe uko abanye n' abahanzi bo mu Rwanda ndetse n' icyo ateganyiriza abakunzi be , yadutangarije ko abahanzi nyarwanda bose baziranye .
Yagize ati " Mu Rwanda biragenda rwose ndabyishimira kuko nk' ama studio tubanye neza bankorera neza umuziki numva nanjye nkunda .
Abahanzi bose turaziranye nka Thacien Tutus ni inshuti yanjye , Theo Bosebabireba n' aba bose ba Torero .
Ubu ndimo ndategura umuziki ufite ingufu nyinshi cyane no gukora ibitaramo . "

Sobanukirwa n' ibintu 10 Abakobwa banga ku bahungu binshuti zabo .
Umukunzi n' i umuntu ukomeye kandi utapfa kubona uko wiboneye , kubasore hari udukosa twinshi tubagaragaraho dushobora gutuma ashobora guhomba umuntu w' ingenzi kuriwe .
izi nizimwe mu inama zagufasha gukomeza gusigasira urukundo rwawe n' umukobwa mukundana .
Abakobwa banga abahungu bakora ibintu biteye ishozi nko kuba wavuga cyangwa ugakora ibintu biteye isesemi igihe muri kumeza cyangwa se muri ahantu hari abantu benshi .
Uzirinde kuba wavuga inkuru isekeje imwerekeyeho imbere y' inshuti .
Ibyo biba umwaku igihe ubigize akemenyero , nubikomeza , umenye ko iminsi yanyu muri kumwe ibariye ku mitwe y' intoki .
Ntukifuze ko umukobwa yakwiyitaho nkawe .
Ni byiza kumenya ko uko umukobwa ashaka kugaragara muri rubanda bitandukanye n' uko wowe wumva wagaragara ( umusore uhamye , ufite ibigango ukuramo ishati ngo bose babone ko ari igikurankota koko ) .
Mureke yiyiteho bya gikobwa uko umutima we ubimubwiriza .
Ntuzatonganye umukobwa ngo yikoraho agakabya ( make up , maquillage ) .
Ibyo bituma yigiramo ikizere kandi akumva ari mwiza rwose kandi byose abikorera kugushimisha .
Ahubwo ujye nibura ushima uwo mwanya aba yataye yiyitabo kugira ngo aguheshe ishema umushimira mu magambo anyuze umutima .
Abakobwa banga kandi abahungu bambara imyenda iriho ibisemba cyangwa ibishushanyo biteye ubwoba ( dragon , shitani n' indi wumva biteye ubwoba ) .
Niba wari ufite inshati ugatekereza kuyisura cyangwa gusohokana nayo wambaye umwenda uriho ibyo bishushanyo , ibyiza nuko uwo mwenda ahubwo wareba aho uwujugunya .
Ibirori nk' isabukuru y' amavuko n' ugusohokana n' inshuti bishoboka kuba wowe ntacyo bikubwiye , ariko ku bakobwa bisobanuye ikintu kinini cyane .
Niyo umukobwa yakubwira ko ntacyo yifuza ku munsi mukuru wa Mutagatifu Valentino , si ibyo aba ashatse kuvuga , ugomba kugira icyo umuha .
Icyo abashatse kuvuga ni uko nta kintu kihariye yifuza ahubwo ko ugomba kwibwiriza ukamutungura maze ukamamwereka ko iteka umutekerezaho .
Ku mukobwa , inshuti nk' umuryango , ugomba kuzubaha kandi ukazitaho .
Nubwo atabigusaba cyangwa ngo abikwibutse urage wibuka kwitoza kuzikunda .
Nk' uko bita ku nshuti zawe , nawe ite ku zabo .
Mu makosa yose ushobora gukora , ntuzatinyuke kwita umukobwa umusazi cyangwa ngo akora nk' utagira ubwenge .
Uko waba ukeka ko yakabije mu buryo yitwaye mu kibazo , ntuzigere uvuga iryo jambo .
Ikindi kintu kibabaza umukobwa ndetse birengeje kuba wanamwita umusazi imbere ya rubanda , ni ukumugereranya n' abandi bakobwa .
Uzirinde kugira icyo uvuga ku ifoto y' umukobwa ubonye mu nzira cyangwa se muri filmi uvuga ngo yambaye neza cyangwa ngo ni mwiza .
Nubwo wowe uba utabibona , ahita yigereranya n' uwo mukobwa uba umaze kuvuga maze yasanga bigoranye kumushyikira umutima we ukababara .
Iteka aba ashaka kumva ko ari ikinege kuri wowe , ko ntawundi wamuganya nawe .
Mu makosa yose ushobora gukora ntuzigere wibagirwa iminsi mikuru ifite igisobanuro gikomeye mu buzima bwe nk' isabukuru y' amavuko cyangwa se isabukuru y' isezerano ry' ugushyingirwa kwanyu .
Ni ukosa risumba ayandi .
Ibyo byose ubyirinze kandi ukabikurikiza waba urimo w' ubaka ejo heza hawe n' umukobwa mukundana .

Riderman asanga abatangije gahunda yo kwishyuza abahanzi ku maradiyo ari ibisahiranda Mu kiganiro uyu muhanzi mu njyana ya Hip Hop yagiranye n' itangazamakuru , yavuze ko uwazanye iki gitekerezo cyo kwishyuza abanyamuziki ari uburyo bwo kunyunyuza abahanzi , ahubwo ngo amaradiyo niyo yakabaye yishyura abahanzi .
Riderman utavuga rumwe n' abazanye igitekerezo cyo kwishyuza abahanzi Impamvu ashimangira ibi ngo ni ko igihe abashoramari bishyuye abahanzi , ari bwo buryo bwiza bwo kugirango amaradiyo yumvwe na benshi , naho mu gihe abo bahanzi bashyujwe ni bake bakwitabira gutanga ayo mafaranga bigatuma radiyo zita umurongo w' ibiganiro zagenderagaho ( Content ) .
Yagize ati " Nibareke kuba ibisambo , ibyo ni ugushaka kwikubira amafaranga .
Ni gute aho kugirango ama radiyo yishyure abahanzi , ari bo bahindukira bakishyura ?
Ibyo rwose nta kuri kurimo . "

Radio Dix nk' imwe maradiyo akorana n' abanzi , mu minsi ishize nibwo hari hatangiye guhwihwiswa ko yatangije iyo gahunda yo kwishyuza , ndetse umuhanzi Mico The Best bikaba bivugwa ko ari mu bamaze gushyigikira icyo gitekerezo akishyura .
Kugeza ubu ubuyobozi bwa Feros Music bukaba buvuga ko atari radio dix byatangiriyeho gusa kuko n' izindi radio uwo mushinga batangiye kuwuganiraho .

0 0 Urukiko rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo rwahanishije Umuyobozi wa Sosiyete Top Service Ltd kwishyura Minisiteri y' Ubuhinzi n' Ubworozi ( MINAGRI ) akayabo ka miliyoni 430 ndetse ahabwa n' igifungo cy' imyaka irindwi .
Umuyobozi wa Sosiyete Top Service Ltd , Mwitende Ladislas wagemuraga ifumbire mvaruganda mu Ntara y' Amajyaruguru n' iy' Uburengerazuba yahamijwe n' urukiko rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo gukoresha impapuro mpimbano akishyuza Leta y' u Rwanda amafaranga y' umurengera adahwanye n' ifumbire yatanze ndetse no kwiha inyungu mu buryo bunyuranyije n' amategeko byose ngo akaba yarabikoze kuva mu 2013 kugera mu mwaka wa 2016 .
Abatangabuhamya barimo abacuruzi bato ba Top Service Ltd yahaga ifumbire , abakozi ba Top Service Ltd ndetse n' aba MINAGRI babwiye urukiko ko Mwitende Ladislas yahinduraga lisiti zabaga zijyanye n' ifumbire yatanzwe , akongeramo abantu batabonye ifumbire ndetse akongera n' ingano y' ifumbire yabaga yatanze agamije kwishyuza amafaranga menshi .
Urukiko rwatangaje ko kuri lisiti nyinshi byagaragaye ko Mwitende Ladislas yahinduraga imibare aho umucuruzi yahawe ibiro 100 by' ifumbire akandika ko yamuhaye ifumbire ibiro 1000 .
Umucamanza yagarutse ku mazina y' abatangabuhamya barimo abacuruzi bakoranaga na Mwitende , abaturage b' aho yakoreraga n' abakozi ba Minisiteri y' Ubuhinzi n' Ubworozi bose bavugaga ko hakorwaga ubujura bw' ifumbire .
Urukiko rwasomye ilisiti nini y' abatangabuhamya bavuga ko nta fumbire bafashe ariko ku malisiti yabaga yakozwe n' ubuyobozi bwa Sosiyete ya Top Service Ltd ikagaragaza ko bafashe ifumbire kuva ku biro 10 kugera ku 14 , 000 kandi ngo umuturage ntiyari yemerewe guhabwa ifumbire irenga ibiro 300 .
Mwitende ashinjwa gukoresha inyandiko mpimbano ajya kwishyuza Minagri miliyoni 454 859 694 Frw .
Amaze kwishyurwa agera kuri miliyoni 322 520 994 Frw nibwo hatangiye gukekwa ko hari ibyaha yakoze .
Urukiko rwahamije umuyobozi wa Sosiyete Top Service Ltd Mwitende ibyaha bibiri ; icyo gucura no gukoresha inyandiko mpimbano , n' icyo kwiha inyungu mu buryo bunyuranyije n' amategeko .
Uwari ukurikiye inteko iburanisha yavuze ko Mwitende Ladislas kuba ahamwa n' icyaha cy' impurirane agomba guhanishwa igihano gisumba ibindi mu biteganywa n' ingingo ya 609 ndetse n' iya 610 by' igitabo cy' amategeko ahana mu Rwanda .
Urukiko rwategetse ko Mwitende yishyura Minisiteri y' Ubuhinzi n' Ubworozi amafaranga y' u Rwanda 322 , 520 , 994 kongeraho 8 % by' inyungu yose hamwe akaba amafaranga 430 , 727 , 712 ndetse no gufungwa imyaka irindwi .
Umuyobozi wa Sosiyete Top Service Ltd , Mwitende Ladislas yatawe muri yombi ku itariki ya 3 Gicurasi 2016 .

Urumuri rutazima rugejejwe muri Stade ya Busogo Abaturage amajana n' amajana baje kwakira uru rumuri n' ubwo imvura yahereye mugitondo igwa ikaba igeze no mu masaha ya nyuma ya saa sita ikigwa .

Umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Musanze Winifride Mpembyemungu nawe wari witabiriye iki gikorwa yavuze ko i Busogo ubwicanyi bwatangiye mbere y' 1994 .

Abiga Kaminuza y' u Rwanda , ishami rya Huye babonye uburyo buborohereza guhanga udushya !
Muri kaminuza y' u Rwanda , ishami rya Huye kuri uyu wa kane tariki ya 23 Gashyantare 2017 , hatashywe Innovation Hub , iyi ikaba ari inzu izafasha abanyeshuri bahiga kwihangira udushya , no kugira inzozi zabo impamo nk' uko bamwe muri bo babitangaje .
Iyo nzu yubatswe ku bufatanye bwa Airtel Rwanda ndetse na Kaminuza nkuru y' u Rwanda ishami rya Huye .
Mu ijambo ry' uwari uhagarariye Kaminuza , Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe Imari n' Ubutegetsi Bwana Prudence Rubingisa yashimiye Airtel cyane uburyo yatekereje kubashyiriraho iyo nzu kuko bizafasha abanyeshuri kwiga byinshi no kumenya uko bashobora kuzajya bihangira imirimo , ndetse anashima Airtel ubufatanye idahwema kugaragariza iyi kaminuza .
Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe Imari n' Ubutegetsi muri kaminuza y' u Rwanda , Bwana Prudence Rubingisa yashimye cyane iki gikorwa .
Ibi kandi byanashimangiwe n' umuyobozi wa kaminuza y' u Rwanda ishami rya Huye , Dr Didace Muganga Kayihura aho nawe asanga iki ari igisubizo ku banyeshuri abereye umuyobozi ngo bagaragaze ibyo bashoboye bahanga udushya .
Dr Didace Muganga Kayihura , uyobora UR Huye asanga abanyeshuri be bagiye kugaragaza ibyo bashoboye .
John Magara ushinzwe kwamamaza ibikorwa bya Airtel nawe yashimangiye ko ari inshingano zabo mu guteza imbere ibikorwa by' uburezi nk' ikigo cy' itumanaho akaba ariyo mpamvu bubatse iyo nzu , kandi bakaba bafite gahunda yo kuzashyira inzu yo kwiga kwihangira udushya no mu yandi makaminuza .
Magara yagize ati : Twatangiriye hano i Huye ariko Airtel ifite gahunda yo kugeza iyi gahunda no mu zindi kaminuza , kuko icyo dushaka nk' ikigo cy' itumanaho ; ni uko abakiri bato bafunguka bagahanga udushya , bityo bakiteza imbere ubwabo ndetse n' igihugu muri rusange . "
John Magara ushinzwe kwamamaza ibikorwa bya Airtel avuga ko ari inshingano zabo mu guteza imbere ibikorwa by' uburezi nk' ikigo cy' itumanaho .
Ni mu gihe umuyobozi mukuru wa Airtel mu Rwanda , Michael Nii Boye Adjei muri uyu muhango wo gutaha icyo gikorwa , yavuze ko iyi Innovation Hub bayishyizeho kugira ngo abanyeshuri ba Kaminuza y' u Rwanda , ishami rya Huye bazabashe guhanga udushya bikazatuma nyuma yo kurangiza amasomo yabo bazamenya uko bihangira imirimo , aho kugira ngo bajye gushakisha ibyo gukora , aho yagiye abaha urugero rw' abantu bagiye bahanga udushya ku Isi kandi bakiteza imbere binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga ,
aha kandi yanashimiye KLab , iyi ikaba ari inzu y' ikoranabuhanga ikorera mu mujyi wa Kigali yabafashije kugira ngo habeho iyi Innovation Hub .
Uhereye ibumoso : Umuyobozi wungirije wa UR ushinzwe Imari n' ubutegetsi , umuyobozi wa UR Huye , uhagarariye KLab n' umuyobozi wa Airtel Rwanda bafungura ku mugaragaro Innovation Hub .
Gusa uyu muyobozi wa Airtel Rwanda ntiyatangaje agaciro k' iki gikorwa mu mafaranga , aho yavuze ko igifite agaciro cyane ari ibyo kizageza ku banyeshuri b' iyi kaminuza , nawe kandi ashimangira ko ubufatanye n' iyi kaminuza buzakomeza nk' uko bisanzwe dore ko hashize imyaka igera kuri itatu Airtel Rwanda ifitanye imikoranire myiza na kaminuza y' u Rwanda , ishami rya Huye .
Michael Nii Boye Adjei , uyobora Airtel Rwanda asanga icy' ingenzi ari icyo abanyeshuri bazakura muri Innovation Hub kuruta amafaranga yatwaye !
Abanyeshuri nabo bishimiye iki gikorwa , aho umuyobozi wungirije w' abanyeshuri b' iyi kaminuza , nawe yavuze ko iki ari igisubizo kuri bo , dore ko hari imishinga y' ikoranabuhanga usanga abanyeshuri bafite , ariko ntibabone uburyo bayinonosora neza ngo ijye mu bikorwa , aha rero asanga ari umwanya babonye kugira ngo bifashishe iyi Innovation Hub bakore imishinga yabo .
Bwana Rubingisa yereka umuyobozi wungirije w' abanyeshuri ba UR Huye uko imashini za Innovation Hub zikora !
Avuga ku buryo bazasaranganya iyi nzu dore ko bafite umubare munini w' abanyeshuri , ubahagarariye yavuze ko bazicara bagashyiraho ingengabihe izabafasha kuyuisaranganya , anavuga kandi ko n' ubusanzwe bari bafite ibindi byumba by' ikoranabuhanga , bityo iyi ikaba ari inyongera nziza kuri bo .
Hallellua Pacifique ( wunamye ) , uhagarariye KLab yereka abanyeshuri n' abayobozi uko bakoresha izi mashini .
Niba utarabikora !
Dukunde unadukurikire ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ukomeze ubone amakuru mu buryo utamenyereye .

Iradukunda Elsa azasubira mu rusengero rwa Apôtre Masasu wanga urunuka ibya Nyampinga ?
Yanditswe na Munyengabe Murungi Sabin Kuya 1 Werurwe 2017 saa 11 :
36 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
19 0 Apôtre Masasu uyobora Itorero Evangelical Restoration Church , ntiyemera na gato iby' amarushanwa y' ubwiza ndetse afata umukobwa wese witabira itorwa rya Nyampinga nk' uwanyuranyije n' amahame y' Imana .
Intumwa y' Imana Masasu nubwo itemera amarushanwa y' ubwiza , ubu umwe mu bakirisitu be Iradukunda Elsa yagizwe Nyampinga w' u Rwanda ndetse yahamirije IGIHE ko azakomeza kuba umukirisitu muri Restoration Church aho asanzwe asengera .
Miss Iradukunda Elsa yagize ati " Nkunda gusenga nakuze ndi umwana ukunda gusenga kandi narabitojwe , ndabikunda cyane kandi n' ubu ndabikora .
Ubusanzwe nsengera muri Restoration Church i Gikondo .
Ndi umukirisitu usanzwe , nta kazi kadasanzwe mfite mu itorero . "
Muri Mutarama 2014 Apôtre Masasu yatanze inyigisho mu giterane cyiswe Women Destiny abwira imbaga y' abakirisitu ko ' binyuranyije na Bibiliya ' ndetse ngo ' ntibikwiye ko umuntu yajyana ubwiza Imana yamuhaye mu marushanwa ' .
Icyo gihe Apôtre Masasu yagize ati " Nimumbwire , mubona dukwiye nk' abakirisito kujya imbere y' abantu ngo turimo turiyerekana ngo badutore ku bwiza Imana yaduhaye ?
Ni iki dukora kugirango duse uko dusa ubu ?
Ntihakwiye kubaho completion [ irushanwa ] kuko uwo Imana yaremye wese ni mwiza .
Ugasanga baramugaragura ngo reba hano , reba hirya [ … ] ntibikwiye ku bakirisito nubwo bamwe mwamaze kubyemera , ariko ntibikwiye kubaho rwose . "
Inyigisho za Apôtre Masasu zavugishije benshi ndetse itangazamakuru ryamugarutseho igihe kirekire kubera uburyo ibyo yavuze byaciye igikuba mu bantu .
Ubuyobozi bwa Minisiteri icyo gihe bwamaganiye kure amagambo y' iyi ntumwa y' Imana kuko ngo ' ibyo yigishije nta hantu wabisanga muri Bibiliya ' .
Makuza Lauren wari Umuyobozi w' Umuco muri Minisiteri yagize ati , " Ibyo Masasu yabwiye abakirisitu ni imyumvire ye , nta hantu wabisanga muri Bibiliya .
Sinavuga ko wabimuhanira kuko ni uburenganzira bwe gutangaza ibyo yifuza .
Gusa ntabwo bikwiye kuyobya Abanyarwandakazi cyangwa ngo bibace intege .
Icyiza ni uko atazajya ahabera ibikorwa bya Miss Rwanda ngo abuze abakobwa kwiyamamaza " Apôtre Joshua Masasu Ndagijimana ayobora insengero zirenga 57 ku Isi , nubwo bamwamaganiye kure bakavuga ko ibyo yigishije nta shingiro bifite , yaratsimbaraye avuga ko ' bikururira umukobwa wiyamamaza imyuka yo kwifuzwa ' .
Yagize ati " Nta cyubahiro cy' Imana kiba gihari kandi umwuka wa competition si mwiza tugomba kubivuga ni cyo tubereyeho nk' abashumba .
Ijambo ry' Imana riravuga ngo ntimukagire icyo mukora mwiremamo ibice , ntabwo ari byiza .
Ikindi kirebwa mu buryo bw' umwuka , iyo umuntu yashyizwe hariya mu buryo bwa competition bakureba wiyereka biragukurura cyane kuko bigukururira imyuka yo kwifuzwa no kukwambika ibara mu buryo bwumvikana neza " .
Apotre Masasu yamaganye kenshi ibikorwa byo gutegura amarushanwa y' ubwiza IGIHE yifuje kumva uko Apôtre Masasu yakiriye itorwa rya Miss Iradukunda Elsa umukirisitu we n' uburyo bazakomeza kumufata mu itorero dusanga amaze iminsi mike agiye muri Canada mu Mujyi wa Montreal .

Ruhango : Abana 134 bagiye gusubizwa mu mashuri Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Mu muhango wo kwizihiza umunsi ngarukamwaka w' umwana w' umunyafurika , Umuyobozi wungirije mu Karere ka Ruhango ushinzwe imibereho myiza y' abaturage , Niwemugeni Jolie Germaine yatangaje ko abana 134 bataye amashuri bagiye kongera kuyasubizwamo .
Abana baterwa inkunga n' umushinga Kompasiyo bahawe ubutumwa bwo kwirinda ibishuko Insanganyamatsiko y' uyu munsi uyu mwaka iragira iti : "
Abana inshuti y' ishuri " Yabigarutseho kuri uyu wa Gatandatu taliki ya 21 , Kamena , 2014 mu muhango wo kwizihiza umunsi w' umwana w' umunyafurika wateguye n' amatorero atatu yo muri aka karere asanzwe aterwa inkunga n' umushinga compassion internationale .
Niwemugeni yavuze ko Leta kuri ubu yashyizeho gahunda y' uburezi kuri bose inegereza ababyeyi amashuri y' imyaka 9 na 12 kugira ngo abana bose babone amahirwe yo kwiga ndetse hakiyongeraho n' amafaranga itanga ya buri mwana ku buryo hatari kuba hakiri umwana numwe uta amashuri .
Pasiteri Hategekimana Joseph ahagarariye Itorero ry' Abangirikani mu Karere ka Ruhango , yavuze ko bateguye umunsi w' umwana w' umunyafirika mu matorero kugira ngo abana baterwa inkunga n' umushinga wa Compassion internationale basobanukirwe neza n' ibyo abana bagenzi babo bahuye nabyo haba muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu 1994 ndetse n' ibyakorewe begenzi babo bo muri Afirika y' epfo .
Yagize ati : ' ' Mugomba kugira ishuri inshuti yanyu , kubera ko bagenzi banyu bataye amashuri badashobora kumenya izi ndangagaciro zose zumuco nyarwanda , icyo twifuza nuko nabo bakwigobotora ingoyi y' ubukene n' ubujiji ibaboshye ' ' Ntakirutimana Francoise Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w' Akagari ka Nyamagana Umurenge wa Ruhango mu Karere ka Ruhango yatangaje ko ukurikije ubuzima aho bugeze uyu munsi ari ukujyana umwana mu ishuri kubera ko ngo mbere wasangaga imiryango myinshi ifite amasambu n' amatungo menshi bazasigira abana nk' umurage ,
kuri ubu ngo ababyeyi bagombye kuzirikana ko umurage wa mbere ari kwigisha abana .
Umushinga Compassion internationale mu Murenge wa Ruhango , ufasha abana 840 unyujije inkunga mu matorero 3 ariyo ADEPR , Eglise Methodiste n' Itorero ry' Abangirikane mu Rwanda , buri mwaka uyu mushinga utanga miliyoni 130 zirenga z' amafaranga y' u Rwanda mu bikoresho by' ishuri bitandukanye .
MUHIZI ELISEE ububiko .
umusekehost . com / RUHANGO .

Amatora ntagomba gusimbuzwa izindi gahunda za leta " Gouverineri Musabyimana Jean Claude Jean Claude Musabyimana Guverineri w' intara y' Amajyaruguru Kuri uyu wa 5 mutarama 2017 umuyobozi w' intara y' Amajyaruguru Musabyimana Jean Claude mu kiganiro yagiranye n' umunyamakuru w' imirasire ku bijyanye n' imyiteguro y' amatora y' umukuru w' Igihugu ateganyijwe mukwezi kwa Kanama 2017 , Musabyimana yibukije abayobozi bu turere tugize intara y' Amajyaruguru ko badakwiye gufata gahunda y' amatora ngo isimbuzwe izindi gahunda zaleta kuko n' amatora ari muri zimwe muri gahunda zaleta ziteganyijwe muri uyu mwaka .
Muri icyo kiganiro umunyamakuru yamubajije ikibazo cya bamwe mu bayobozi b' uturere bashobora kwitwaza gahunda z' amatora bigatuma hari zimwe muri gahunda za leta zari ziteganyijwe gukorerwa abaturage zidakora ahubwo zigasimbuzwa amatora kugirango umuyobozi w' akarere azabashe kuza ku isonga mu kugira abaturage batoye neza , bityo bigatuma izindi gahunda zisa n' izirengagijwe doreko haba hateganyijwe n' ibihembo ku turere twi twaye neza mu matora .
Aha Musabyimana yagize ati " Mubyukuri ndumva nta muyobozi wafata amatora ngo ayasimbuze izindi gahunda za leta zari ziteganyijwe kuko buri kintu cyose kiba gifite umwanya wacyo , ikindi nuko n' amatora tutakwirengagiza ko nayo ari muri zimwe muri gahunda za leta " Musabyimana yavuzeko umuyobozi wafata gahunda zari zisanzwe ziteganyijwe akazisimbuza amatora byafatwa nko kutagira gahunda muriwe , aha akaba yatanze urugero rwuko buri mwaka haba hateganyijwe burikintu cyose kizakorwa doreko niyo ari iminsi mikuru nayo iba iteganyijwe ,
kandi muri uyu mwaka byari bizwi neza ko hateganyijwe amatora y' umukuru w' Igihugu .
Amatora y' umukuru w' igihugu ateganyijwe muri Kanama 2017 , ubu hirya no hino mu gihugu harakorwa ubukangurambaga bibutsa abaturage kureba ko bari kuri lisiti y' itora , ndetse na komisiyo y' amatora NEC nayo muriyi minsi iriho iroherereza ubutumwa bugufi muri telephone uburyo umuntu agomba kumenya ko ari kuri lisiti y' itora .

Umukambwe Nelson Mandela Madiba Perezida Zuma yagize ati " Nshimishijwe cyane no kubamenyesha ko Madiba yorohewe , yatangiye kumera neza kuva mu gitondo . "
Ibi bikaba byashimishije abakunzi ba Nelson Mandela , abenshi bafata nk' intwari y' impirimbanyi y' amahoro , akaba yarabaye na perezida wa Afurika Y ' epfo , bari bahangayitse kuva kuwa gatandatu w' icyumweru gishize ubwo yongeraga kujya mu bitaro .
Mandela yari yafashwe nanone n' indwara mu bihaha ndetse benshi bakaba bari batangiye kumubika ariko ariko kugeza ubu ngo arahumeka ndetse ari kuroherwa kubera imiti ari guhabwa .

Umugaba w' Ingabo wungirije muri Sudani y' Epfo yeguye Yanditswe na Rabbi Malo Umucunguzi Kuya 12 Gashyantare 2017 saa 05 :
04 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
2 0 Umusirikare ukomeye mu ngabo za Sudani y' Epfo , Lt Gen Thomas Cirillo Swaka wari Umuyobozi w' Ingabo Wungirije ushinzwe ibikoresho bya gisirikare ( Deputy Chief of General Staff for Logistics ) yeguye ku mirimo ye no mu ngabo za leta , ashinja Perezida Salva Kiir n' igisirikare cya leta kugendera ku moko .
Lieutenant General Swaka yari umusirikare wubashywe mu ngabo za leta ( Sudan Peope ' s Liberation Army , SPLA ) , akaba ari uwa kabiri weguye nyuma ya General Bapiny Monytuil , kuva imirwano yakubura hagati y' ingabo za leta n' abatavuga rumwe n' ubutegetsi , muri Nyakanga 2016 .
Ikinyamakuru Sudan Tribune yanditse ko mu ibaruwa y' amapaji atandatu Gen Swaka yandikiye Perezida Kiir kuwa 11 Gashyantare , yamushinje hamwe n' Umugaba Mukuru w' Ingabo General Paul Malong , kurenga ku masezerano y' amahoro yo muri Kanama 2015 .
Ibyo ngo nibyo byatumye hasubukurwa imirwano mu murwa mukuru Juba muri Nyakanga umwaka ushize .
Mu bwegure bwe , Gen Swaka yatanze impamvu 14 zirimo kuba SPLA yarateguye intambara y' amoko mu majyepfo y' igihugu , anakomoza ku kuba Perezida Kiir yarananiwe kuyigira igisirikare cy' umwuga , ahubwo agakora imitwe ishingiye ku moko , n' abaturage bagize uruhare mu kubohora igihugu ntibahabwe agaciro .
Yanavuze ko Perezida Kiir n' icyo yise agatsiko k' aba Dinka bahinduye igisirikare cy' igihugu ingabo zubakiye ku bwoko zigamije kwibasira abo badahuje , baninjizamo abantu bahuje ubwoko gusa , abandi barahezwa .
Gen . Swaka asoza ibaruwa ye asa n' uwibasira Perezida Kiir , ati " Nshingiye kuri ibyo mvuze haruguru nsoza Nyakubahwa , ndifuza kukubwiza ukuri kandi ntaciye ku ruhande ko nk' uko mbibona , witesheje agaciro ubwawe n' ibiro bya repubulika ; utesha agaciro aba Dinka ndetse utuma bangwa na basaza babo na bashiki babo bahuje ubwenegihugu ; ariko igikomeye kuruta ibindi ni uko wabaye ipfunwe ku gihugu cyacu kuko ubizi neza , ku bushake bwawe , wirengagije inama zose ,
watumye abaturage ba Sudani y' Epfo batsindwa . "
Yahise atangaza ko yeguye ku mirimo ye nk' Umugaba w' Ingabo Wungirije ushinzwe ibikoresho no mu ngabo za leta ya Sudani , kuko adashobora gukomeza kuba " umwe mu bagize igisirikare gikomeye ku gusenya igihugu cyacu dukunda . "
Uwari Umusirikare ukomeye mu ngabo za Sudani y' Epfo , Lt Gen Thomas Cirillo Swaka yari Umuyobozi w' Ingabo Wungirije ushinzwe ibikoresho bya gisirikare ( Deputy Chief of General Staff for Logistics ) Kwamamaza Kwamamaza Izindi nkuru wasoma Amakuru RDC :

Burundi : Abatavuga rumwe na Leta bishimiye ko amatora yigijwe inyuma Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abo mu mashyaka atavuga rumwe na Leta mu Burundi bavuze ko bishimiye icyemezo cyafashwe na Leta cyo kwigiza inyuma italiki y' amatora y' Abadepite n' abakuru baza Komini .
Aya matora yari ateganyijwe kuri uyu wa gatanu Kamena .
Ubu Komisiyo y' amatora ( CENI ) irateganya gukora indi ngengabihe y' amatora nshya izemeranywaho n' inzego bireba .
Hagati aho imyigaragambyo irakomeje Ku cyumweru abakuru b' ibihugu byo mu karera k' Africa yo mu Burasirazuba , basabye Leta y' u Burundi kwigizayo aya matora nayo irabyemera .
Hari amakuru avuga ko abatavuga rumwe na Leta ubu bamaze kwemera kugirana ibiganiro na Leta mu rwego rwo kurebera hamwe uko ubwumvikane bwagaruka .
Innocent Muhozi uyobora Radio Renaissance avuga ko ibiganiro biri hafi gutangira hagati ya Leta n' abatavuga rumwe nayo bikazibanda cyane kuri manda ya gatatu Nkurunziza ashaka kwiyamariza .
Muhozi avuga ko igitera abaturage kujya mu mihanda atari ukwanga manda ya gatatu ya Nkurunziza gusa ahubwo ari no kwerekana ko hari ibintu byinshi bitagenda neza mu buzima rusange bw' igihugu bityo abaturage bagakomeza kubaho nabi .
Yagize ati " Nkurunziza niwe kimenyetso cyerekana ukuntu Abarundi bamaze igihe bahohoterwa abandi bicwa ndetse n' ubukungu bukahazaharira .
Bityo rero iyo abantu bigaragambya nta kindi baba berekana uretse ibibazo byabazonze . "
Kugeza ubu abaturage baracyigaragambya ariko hamwe na hamwe batangiye gucogora nubwo mu cyaro naho byahageze .
Imyigaragambyo yageze no mu bice by' ibyaro i Burundi , aha ni ahitwa mw' Ijenda UMUSEKE .

Nyuma yo guhabwa impano ku munsi wa Saint Valentin abasohokeye muri Monaco barahavuga imyato Ubwo kuri uyu wa kabiri hizihizwaga umunsi w' abakundana muri Monaco Café abahasohokeye barahavuga imyato ko bahabonye serivisi ( service ) nziza hakaniyongeraho ko bahawe impano zitandukanye ku buntu .
Umwe mu bahasokeye witwa Murego , avuga ko ibyo ejo yaboneye muri Monaco Café nta handi yari yakabibonye , kuko we n' umukunzi we ubwo bageraga muri iyi bar yasanganijwe urugwiro ndetse atungurwa n' uko bahise bahabwa impano yamufashije kongera kurushaho kwigarurira umutima w' umukunzi we .
Yagize ati " Sinarinsanzwe nsohokera muri Monaco , ariko aho ngereyeyo ku munsi w' ejo nabonye ko aho hantu haje gukemura ibibazo bya serivisi mbi abakiliya ( Clients ) bakunze guhura na byo muri za restaurent " .
Yakomeje agira ati " Nkigerayo n' umukunzi wange , twakiranywe urugwiro , gusa naje gutungurwa n' impano twahawe yatumye nongera kwigarurira umutima w' umukunzi wanjye . "
Ubuyobozi bwa Monaco Café , Bar & Restaurent buvuga ko gutungura ababagana ari ibisanzwe no kubitaho , ariko ngo by' akarusho ku munsi w' abakundanye byari umwihariko kuko bagomba gushimisha abagenerwabikorwa mu rwego rwo kurushaho kunoza serivisi .
Ndayishimiye Yves ushinzwe kugenzura itangwa rya Service muri Monaco avuga ko ari inshingano zabo kunezeza ababagana ariko by' umwihariko ku munsi w' abakundanye bikaba byarabaye akarusho ubwo abakundana bahabwaga impano ndetse bakanasusurutswa n' abahanzi batandukanye baririmba mu buryo bwa Caraoke .
Ndayishimiye Yves ushinzwe kugenzura itangwa rya Service muri Monaco Yagize ati " Hano turushaho kwishima iyo abatugana banezerewe , niyo mpamvu tugerageza kubitaho kuko baba baje bizeye ubushobozi bwacu .
Ku munsi w' ejo wo byari umwihariko kuko twakiriye amakupule menshi ( Couple ) tukabagenera impano zitandukanye ziganjemo amavuta yo kwisiga . "
Si Ibyo gusa kuko muri Monaco baha rugari abana mu myidagaduro kuko ariho usanga ibyicungo byo ku rwego rwo hejuru , ibikinisho n' ibindi byinshi bibafasha mu bwisanzure .
Monaco Café ni Bar na Restaurant ifite umwihariko mu Mujyi wa Kigali ugereranyije n' izindi zihasanzwe .
Harimo umwanya wa Restaurant , umwanya wa Bar ndetse n' ahantu abana basohokanye n' ababyeyi bidagadurira .
Muri Restaurant ya Monaco cafe uhasanga amafunguro ateguranye ubuhanga kandi ari ku giciro buri wese yibonamo .
Bar yaho uyisangamo inzoga z' amoko yose ndetse abahasohokeye bemeza ko bigoye ko wahabaza inzoga ngo uyihabure .
Ku bakunda umupira w' amaguru nabo barazirikanywe .
Umukiriya wahisemo gusohokera muri Monaco cafe , ahafatira icyo kunywa no kurya anirebera imipira yo muri shampiyona zikomeye z' iburayi .
Monaco Cafe iherereye mu Mujyi wa Kigali , mu nyubako ya T 2000 , mu nyubako yo hasi , mu marembo magari ya T 2000 .

Sudani y' Epfo : Miliyoni enye bugarijwe n' inzara Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Kuri uyu wa kane raporo yasohowe n' Umuryango w' abibumbye yagaragaje ko Sudani y' epfo abantu babarirwa mu bihumbi byinshi bugarijwe n' inzara ikaze naho abagera kuri miliyoni enye bakaba batihaza mu biribwa mu buryo bugaragara .
UN yemeza ko iriya nzara ifitanye isano ya bugufi n' imirwano hagati ya Leta n' inyeshyamba ziyobowe na Riek Machar .
Inzara ngo yugarije abatuye Sudani y' epfo Ikindi giteye inkeke ni uko abagira neza batabasha kugeza imfashanyo y' ibiribwa , imiti n' ibikoresho by' isuku ku mpunzi ndetse no ku baturage aho baba mu midugudu yitaruye .
Ngo niba nta gikozwe hakiri kare ibintu bizakomeza kuba bibi cyane .
Muri raporo y' Umuryango w' abibumbye ngo agace kugarijwe n' inzara kurusha utundi ni akitwa Unity State , aho imirwano yakajije umurego .
Ngo muri aka gace hafi abantu ibihumbi 300 ugarijwe n' inzara ikabije ihitana bamwe muri bo .
Iyi Raporo yasinyweho n' abakuriye amashami atatu y' Umuryango w' abibumbye ariyo Ishami ryita ku biribwa n' ubuhinzi ( FAO ) , Ishami ryita ku bana ( UNICEF ) , ndetse n' Ishami ryita ku biribwa ( PAM ) .
Abanditse iriya raporo baratabariza abatuye Sudani y' epfo , bakavuga ko nubwo abantu ibihumbi 300 bamaze kugerwaho n' inzara ikomeye cyane ariko n' abandi babarirwa muri za miliyoni butabasha kwihaza mu biribwa .
Iriya raporo kandi ivugako mu myaka ibiri ishize hatangiye imirwano hagati y' ingabo za leta n' inyeshyamba abantu bagera kuri milyoni enye bugarijwe n' ikibazo cy' inzara .
Iyi raporo ivuga ko imirwano yo muri iki gihugu yagize ingaruka zikomeye cyane k' ubuzima bw' abaturage kuko ngo nta byo kurya bafite , ntibabone uko bakora imirimo yabo yabateza imbere harimo ubuhinzi , ubworozi n' ubucuruzi bityo ubuzima bugahenda .
Muri iki gihe Umuryango w' abibumbye wasabye impande zishyamiranye kureka abagiraneza bakageza imfashanyo ku baturage bayikeneye .
Callixte NDUWAYO UMUSEKE .

Amajyepfo : RCA ntiyemeranya n' urubyiruko ko amikoro arubuza kujya muri koperative Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments * Ngo umuzi w' ikibazo ushobora kuba ari amateka mabi yaranze amakoperative , Leta y' u Rwanda ikunze gukangurira Abanyarwanda by' umwihariko urubyiruko kwibumbira mu makoperative kugira ngo bahuze imbaraga barusheho kwihuta mu iterambere .
Ikigo cy' igihugu gishinzwe amakoperative ( RCA ) kivuga ko n' ubwo urubyiruko ari rwo rukunze gukangurirwa kwishyira hamwe ari na rwo rukomeje guseta ibirenge mu kubahiriza izi nama .
urubyiruko ruvuga ko rutanze wkibumbira mu makoperative ariko ko ruzitirwa n' amikore macye Mu nama y' urubyiruko mu karere ka Nyaruguru yo gutangiza ubukangurambaga mu gukoresha ikoranabuhanga , rumwe mu rubyiruko rwavuze ko kimwe mu bibabuza kwibumbira mu makoperative ari amikoro macye , bakavuga ko hishyira hamwe abafite icyo baheraho .
Hakuzweyezu Jean ati " Kwibumbira mu makoperative ni byo ariko bizitirwa n' ikibazo cy' ubushobozi .
Urugero dushobora gutangiza koperative yo kwizigama tugashyiraho umugabane shingiro wa 500 Frw mu cyumweru , icyi cyumweru nkayabona , icyumweru gitaha nkayabona ariko mu gikurikiraho nkayabira .
Ngirango ujya wumva abagiye bajya mu bimina byagiye bisenyuka kubera icyo kibazo nanjye nakibayemo rwose ngeraho amafaranga ndayabura kuko ntaho umuntu aba ayakura . "
Umugenzuzi mukuru w' ikigo gishinzwe amakorative ( RCA ) mu ntara y' Amajyepfo , Ntaganda Abdul Wahab ntiyemeranya n' ibi bitangazwa n' uru rubyiruko ko amikoro macye ari yo atuma batitabira kwibumbira mu makoperative .
Ati " N ' amafaranga ni ingenzi ariko mu by' ukuri igikomeye ni ibyo bitekerezo .
Ikibazo mbere na mbere ni ukudasobanukirwa , abantu bamwe ntibaramenya amahirwe arimo , icya kabiri ni amateka aho usanga mu bihe byashize hari amakoperative yagiye arangwa n' imicungire mibi n' imiyoborere mibi bikabaca intege . "
Ntaganda kandi yemera ko imicungire mibi yakunze kuvugwa mu makoperative igihari nubwo itagaragara cyane nko mu minsi ishize .
Ati " Kuri ubu ntabwo tukibona amakoperative menshi ashingwa agasenyuka gusa ntabwo twavuga ngo ni shyashya .
Haracyabonekamo utubazo hirya no hino cyane cyane dushingiye kuri icyo kibazo cy' imicungire mibi . "
Ku bajya bagira impungenge zuko amakoperative ashingwa ariko agakiza bamwe cyane cyane abayobozi , Ntaganda avuga ko ibi bibaho ariko bigaterwa n' abanyamuryango bashinga koperative ariko ntibakurikirane uko imisanzu yabo ikoreshwa .
Hakuzweyezu Jean avuga ko batapfa kubona aho bajya bakura imisanzu Ntaganda wa RCA ngo umuzi w' ikibazo ni amateka mabi yaranze imikorere y' amakoperative Callixte NDUWAYO UMUSEKE .

Habanabashaka Jean Baptiste umuyobozi w' ikigo cy' amashuli cya Kagugu yabwiye abanyamakuru ko yishimiye kuba ikigo cye ari cyo cyatoranyijwe gutangirizwamo siporo ngorukakwezi yo mu mashuli , siporo izajya iba buri wa Gatandatu wa mbere w' ukwezi . "
Mu by' ukuri ni ibintu twakwishimira nka Groupe Scolaire Kagugu Catholique kuba ari twe twatangije iyi gahunda igamije gukundisha abana siporo bakiri bato .
Iki kigo ( Kagugu ) dusanzwe dukora siporo zitandukanye zirimo ; Football , Basketball , Athletisme na Handball ariko ntabwo twakoreraga icyarimwe " .
Habanabashaka Jean Baptiste .
Uyu muyobozi yakomeje avuga ko babitse ibikombe bitandukanye bakuye mu marushanwa ahuza ibigo by' amashuli ( Interscolaire ) , kimwe mu bintu bimutera ingufu zo gukomeza guharanira iterambere rya siporo mu kigo abereye umuyobozi .

Ni ryari ibiciro by' ingendo bizahinduka kubera izamuka ry' ibikomoka kuri peteroli ?
Yanditswe na Cyprien Niyomwungeri Kuya 3 Werurwe 2017 saa 01 :
13 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
0 0 Guhera kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 3 Werurwe 2017 , i Kigali hatangiye gukurikizwa ibiciro bishya by' ibikomoka kuri Peteroli , aho lisansi itagomba kurenga amafaranga 1022 y' u Rwanda naho mazutu akaba 958 Frw kuri litiro .
Ibi biciro bije bisimbura ibyo kuwa 4 Mutarama uyu mwaka , byagenaga ko litiro ya lisansi itagomba kurenga 970 Frw , naho mazutu yo ikaba 932 Frw .
Abanyarwanda benshi iyo hatangajwe ibi biciro bakabona byatumbagiye bakoma agatima ku ngendo bakora batwawe n' imodoka rusange , ubwoba n' impungenge bikaba byinshi ko nabyo bigiye guhita byongezwa .
Mu matangazo ikigo cy' Igihugu kigenzura imirimo imwe n' imwe ifitiye igihugu akamaro , RURA , gitanga kivugamo ko ibi byose ntacyo bikwiye guhindura ku biciro by' ingendo , kuko hagikurikizwa ibyashyizweho kuwa 1 Ugushyingo 2015 .
Ni icyemezo kitanyura benshi mu batwara abantu bavuga ko niba ibiciro by' ibikomoka kuri peteroli bakoresha byiyongereye , bikwiye guhita bigendana no kongeza ibiciro by' ingendo kugirango nabo bunguke .
Umuyobozi ushinzwe ibijyanye n' Ubukungu muri RURA , Dr Benjamin Rutimirwa , aherutse gusobanura ko impamvu ibiciro bya lisansi na Mazutu bizamuka ariko iby' ingendo ntibizamuke mu Rwanda , bifite imvano ku mabwiriza yashyizweho ubwo hatangazwaga ibiciro bishya mu mwaka umwe ushize .
Yagize ati " Izi modoka zitwara abagenzi zinywa mazutu , ibiciro by' ingendo byashyizweho byatangiye gukirikizwa ku itariki 1 / 11 / 2015 , icyo gihe twemeranyijwe ko ibiciro bishobora gusuzumwa niba byasubirwamo , mu gihe igiciro cya litiro imwe ya mazutu cyarenza amafaranga 960 . "
Ibi bisobanuye ko kuri iyi nshuro ibiciro by' ingendo bitazahinduka , kuko igiciro cya litiro ya mazutu ari 958 .
Gusa biragaragara ko ariho bigana kuko habura amafaranga abiri gusa ngo RURA yongere kwicarana n' abatwara abantu bige ku zindi mpinduka zabaho mu biciro byo gutwara abantu .
Nta cyizere ko ibiciro byagabanuka kuko mu mpera z' umwaka ushize , Umuryango w' ibihugu bicukura peteroli ( OPEC ) , washyize umukono ku masezerano yo kugabanya ingano y' iyo byacukuraga ku munsi mu gihe cy' amezi atandatu , aho nibura ku munsi hagabanyijweho miliyoni imwe y' utugunguru .
Aya masezerano kandi yanashyizweho umukono n' ibindi 11 bitari muri OPEC , hagamijwe kuzamura ibiciro by' ibikomoka kuri peteroli byose byari byaramanutse kuva mu ntangiriro za 2015 .
Ibi byatumye igiciro cy' akagunguru ka peteroli karimo litiro 50 kizamuka cyane , ku buryo ubu kageze ku madolari 57 , bivuye ku madolari ari hagati ya 50 - 53 kariho mu mpera z' umwaka ushize .
Mu ntangiriro z' umwaka za 2016 kaguraga amadolari 27 .
OPEC yavuze ko yifuza ko igiciro ku kagunguru k' ibikomoka kuri Peteroli katarenza amadolari hagati ya 70 na 80 .
Bifite izihe ngaruka ku bukungu bw' igihugu Iyo ibiciro by' ibikomoka kuri Peteroli bizamutse , muri rusange bitera izamuka ry' ibiciro ku isoko kandi bikagabanya iterambere ry' ubukungu bw' igihugu .
Ku bijyanye n' izamuka ry' ibiciro , bigira ingaruka ku biciro by' ubwikorezi , inganda n' ibindi nkenerwa .
Ibi na byo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku biciro by' ibicuruzwa na serivisi bitandukanye kuko ababikora n' ababitanga bagorwa n' igiciro cyo kubikora no kubigeza ku masoko .
Bishobora kandi kugira ingaruka cyane cyane ku bindi bicuruzwa igihugu gikenera cyangwa kigurisha , kuko ingano yabyo ishobora kugabanuka .

Uganda : Police yataye muri yombi abasore bari mu bikorwa byo kwamamaza Trump Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Kuri uyu wa 25 Ukwakira , igipolisi cya Uganda cyataye muri yombi abasore babiri bahungabanyaga umutekano bagerageza kwinjira muri Ambasade ya Amerika I Kampala ngo bahakorere ibikorwa byo kwamamaza Donald Trump uri guhatanira kuba perezida wa Amerika mu matora ateganyijwe mu kwezi gutaha kwa Ugushyingo .
Batawe muri yombi bazizwa guhungabanya umutekano bamamaza Trump Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kabiri , abasore batanu bibumbiye mu itsinda ryitwa ' Uganda Youth Democrats ' bazindukiye kuri ambasade ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika muri Uganda , bahita batangira ibikorwa byo kwamamaza uyu mukandida uzaba ahagarariye Aba - Republican muri aya matora .
Aba basore bavugaga amagambo yuje ibigwi bisingiza Donald Trump , bari bafite ibyapa byanditseho amagambo ashishikariza abantu gutora uyu mukandida .
Bagira bati " Guha ijwi Trump ni ijwi ryo kurwanya igitugu muri Afurika . "
Ubwo abashinzwe umutekano kuri Ambasade y' Amerika muri Uganda bazaga kubakumira , aba basore batangiye gusaba uruhusa rwo kwinjira muri Ambasade bagakora ibikorwa byo kwamamaza bari imbere , ariko ntibabyemererwa .
Aba basore bari bamaze guterwa utwatsi ku kifuzo cyabo , ntibavuye ku izima dore ko bahagumye ndetse bagashaka gukoresha ingufu binjira , hahita hitabazwa police na yo itazuyaje igahita ihasesekara .
Igipolisi cya Uganda gitangaza ko cyahise gifata babiri muri aba basore , abandi batatu bariruka baracika .
Abafashwe ni Bigirwa Moses na Allan Kitonsa .
Ibiro by' Ambasade ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika muri Uganda ntacyo biratangaza kuri ibi bikorwa byakozwe n' aba basore bo muri Uganda no ku itabwa muri yombi ryabo .
Donald Trump waranzwe n' udushya mu bikorwa bye byo kwiyamamaza , yavuze ko naramuka atowe azahangana n' abayobozi yavuze ko bagundira ubutegetsi , akavuga ko ku isonga harimo Perezida Yoweli Kaguta Museveni wa Uganda na Robert Mugabe wa Zimbabwe .
Ngo gutora Trump ni ugushyigikira guca ubutegetsi bw' igitugu muri Afurika Dailymonitor Callixte NDUWAYO UMUSEKE .

Cômes yatinye kwicwa na FDLR ahitamo gutaha Brigadier General Cômes Semugeshi umwe mu bayobozi muri CNRD - Ubwiyunge , yishyikirije ingabo za UN zishinzwe kurinda amahoro muri Congo ( MONUSCO ) kuri uyu wa kabiri tariki 28 Gashyantare 2017 , avuga ko ahunze ibihano bikarishye birimo n' upfu .
Brig Gen Semugeshi yatorotse FDLR , ahunga ko yahabwa ibihano ndengakamere ( Photo : Internet ) .
Umukozi mu biro bishinzwe itahuka muri Monusco yabwiye Kigali Today ko aya makuru ari ukuri , avuga ko ubu Monusco iri kwegeranya amakuru amwerekeyeho , mbere yo kumufasha gutahuka mu Rwanda .
Uyu muyobozi muri Monusco ntiyasobanuye umubare w' abandi bantu baba bazanye na Brig . Gen . Semugeshi , ariko yavuze ko amakuru arambuye kuri uyu mu Jenerali bazayatangaza , amaze kwegeranywa neza kuri uyu wa kane mbere y' uko atahuka .
Yagize ati " Ikusanyamakuru rimwerekeye rizatinda gato , ubu nta makuru menshi twamuvugaho mbere y' uko tuyegeranya . "
Tariki 26 Gashyantare 2017 nibwo ubuyobozi bwa CNRD - Ubwiyunge bwatanze itangazo risaba ko ubona Brig Gen Semugeshi amufata akamushyikiriza ubuyobozi kugira ngo acibwe urubanza .
Brig . Gen . Semugeshi yashinjwaga ibyaha byo gusuzugura ubuyobozi bigatuma agandisha abandi , aho yari ahitwa Kinanira na Hanika muri Masisi .
Semugeshi yari ku ruhande rw' abasirikare batishimiye imikorere ya CNRD - Ubwiyunge .
Yatangiye ibizeza gusubiza mu Rwanda impunzi , guhemba abarwanyi , ariko ntibihinduke ahubwo bagahora mu ntambara y' urudaca bahanganye na FDLR - Foca .
Uyu mugabo wari usanzwe afite umuryango mu Rwanda , yahise ahungana na Lt Hakim Abdalah bakoranaga .
Ubu bategereje ko bagezwa Goma bakazanwa mu Rwanda .
Yahawe ipeti rya Brigadier General nyuma yo kuva muri FDLR Foca umwaka ushize , akihuza na Col . Wilson Irategeka wahoze muri FDLR ari nawe washinze CNRD - Ubwiyunge .
Abavuye muri FDLR Foca bose yahise abazamura mu ntera , bituma na Col . Semugeshi ahita abasanga agirwa Brig . Gen . Yahise agirwa umuyobozi ushinzwe amashuri , mu gihe muri FDLR yakunze gushingwa ubucamanza .
Yakoze ibikorwa bitandukanye muri FDLR Foca harimo kuyobora batayo yitwa Zodiac igizwe n' abasirikare baba biteguye kurwana aho rukomeye " Reserve force " .
Muri 2013 yafatanyije n' ingabo za Congo ( FARDC ) na Monusco kurwanya umutwe wa M23 mu bice bya Kanyarucinya na Kibumba afatanyije na Col . Karume Andre .
Col . Karume yari asanzwe ari Sake ahitwa Rangiro , naho Semugeshi yari mu misozi miremire ya Nyiragongo na Nyamuragira , nk' uko Kigali Today yabihamirijwe n' abahoze muri FDLR bari kuri urwo rugamba yari ayoboye .
Brig . Gen . Semugeshi yavukiye mu cyahoze ari Peregitura ya Kibungo .
Mu 1994 yari Umujandarume i Rwamagana , yatangiye amasomo ya gisirikare mu cyiciro cya 32 mu ishuri rikuru rya gisirikare ( ESM ) .

0 Abanyarwanda bize muri Kaminuza ya Gikirisitu ya Oklahoma muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika biyemeje kujya bafasha umunyeshuri umwe w' Umunyarwanda witwaye neza kurusha abandi mu bizamini bya leta na we akabasha kwiga aho bize .
Umukuru w' Igihugu Paul Kagame yabemereye ko we na Madamu Jeannette Kagame na bo bazatanga inkunga yabo muri iki kigega .
Ibi babitangaje kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 10 Gashyantare 2017 ubwo hizihizwaga isabukuru y' imyaka 10 ishize u Rwanda rutangiye umubano n' iyi kaminuza ya Oklahoma Christian University .
Kabanda Aline warangije icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu by' ubucuruzi ari na we wavuze mu izina rya bagenzi be , yavuze ko batangije ihuriro ry' abize muri iyi kaminuza ndetse banashyiraho ikigega kigamije gukusanya inkunga yo guha amahirwe umunyeshuri watsinze neza ibizamini bya leta bisoza amashuri yisumbuye na we akiga muri iyi kaminuza bizemo .
Yagize ati " Ubwo twizihiza umunsi mukuru uyu munsi turasubiza inyuma amaso ngo turebe ubumenyi twungutse .
Ubu dufasha igihugu gutera imbere .
Turi mu bucuruzi , mu ikoranabuhanga , mu ngabo z' igihugu , mu itangazamakuru , mu burezi n' ahandi . "
Ngo kubera ingufu igihugu cyabatanzeho ntabwo bashobora kuzipfobya , aho Kabanda agira ati " Twashinze umuryango natwe ngo twiture igihugu cyacu aho igikorwa cya mbere kizaba guha buruse umunyeshuri wa mbere mwiza w' Umunyarwanda akagira amahirwe nk' ayo twagize . "
Akomeza avuga ko uzabona aya mahirwe ashobora kuziga muri Oklahoma Christian University cyangwa ahandi muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika , ngo bakazabifashwamo na Minisiteri y' Uburezi mu Rwanda hamwe n' ubuyobozi bw' iyi kaminuza .
Kabanda avuga ko bahize gukusanya ubwabo amadolari ya Amerika 50000 kugira ngo iyi gahunda biyemeje izakunde neza .
Aha Perezida Kagame yahise abemerera ko na we na Madamu Jeannette Kagame bazatera inkunda ikigega cyabo kuko ngo nabo ari abanyeshuri b' iyi kaminuza dore ko bafite impamyabumenyi z' icyubahiro bahawe na Oklahoma Christian University .
Perezida Kagame yagize ati " Jeannette nanjye twageze muri iyi kaminuza nubwo ari iminsi mike kandi tubarwa nk' abize muri OCU .
Natwe twiyemeje gutanga inkunga yacu muri iyo gahunda yanyu .
Mukomereze aho kandi mukomeze kubakira kuri izi ngufu . "
Kugeza uyu munsi Abanyarwanda 341 bize muri Kaminuza ya Oklahoma aho 157 bakuriye amasomo yabo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika ku cyicaro cy' iri shuri , naho 184 biga icyiciro cya gatatu cya kaminuza mu bucuruzi mu ishami ry' iyi kaminuza i Kigali .
Umukuru w' Igihugu Paul Kagame yabemereye ko we na Madamu Jeannette Kagame na bo bazatanga inkunga yabo muri iki kigega .

Tumenye Intambara yiswe iy' Iminsi itandatu Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Iyi ni intambara Israel yagabye ku bihugu by' Abarabu .
Kuva Israel yabona ubwigenge muri 1948 , yahise itangira urugamba rwo kwemeza Abarabu ko ari igihugu gifite ubusugire ko ntawe ugomba kukivogera .
Ingabo za Israel zishimira ifatwa rya Yerusalem Kubera ko cyari kirimo kwiyubaka wasangaga ibihugu bituranye nacyo bidashaka kubona Israheli nk' igihugu gifite ingufu muri kariya karere .
Israel yagabye ibi bitero mu rwego rwo guca intege abanzi bayo muri kiriya gihe cyarangwaga n' urwicyekwe hagati y' Abarabu n' Abayahudi .
Hari impamvu nyinshi zitangwa nt' intiti zaba baratumye iriya ntambara iba .
Muri zo harimo gushotorana kwa hato na hato kwabaga hagati y' ibyo bihugu byombi .
Israel ikimara kuzamura Idarapo ryayo , hakurikiyeho kwirema k' udutsiko tw' insoresore tugamije kubuza Abayahudi amahoro .
Ariko no ku ruhande rwa Israel naho hari intagondwa zitari zoroheye Abarabu , ugasanga buri ruhande ruhora rucungira urundi hafi .
Ibi byatumaga amahoro agenda agerwa ku mashyi .
Ibyo byatumwe Umuryango w' Abibumbye wohereza ingabo zifite inshingano zo gukurikirana ukuntu amahoro ashobora gushinga imizi cyane cyane ko hari hashize iminsi Israel ifitanye ibibazo na Misiri bipfa Umuhoora wa Suwezi ( Canal of Suez ) .
Ariko kubera ko Israel itashaka ko hari igihugu cy' Abarabu cyayitanga kubarasa , yahisemo gufata iya mbere yohereza ba Maneko bayo .
Umwe imwohereza mu Misiri witwaga Refaat Al - Gammal .
Agezeyo yemeje ubutasi bwa Misiri ko Israel idashobora kuzigera itera Misiri inyuze mu kirere , ngo kuko nta ndege yari ifite zihagije kandi ngo ko ibyayibera byiza ari guca ku butaka .
Misiri yarabyemeye .
Israel nanone yohereje undi mutasi w' inararibonye witwaga Eli Cohen muri Siriya ngo yige agace k' ikibaya cya Golani , ikibaya kiri hagati ya Israel na Siriya , gifatwa nk' ahantu hafite agaciro mu mayeli ya gisirikare kandi koko byaragaraye igihe Israel yaterage Siriya .
Eli Cohen amaze kuba inshuti ikomeye n' Abanyasiriya bakomeye yabonye uburyo bwiza bwo kwiga ako gace maze akajya yoherereza amakuru Mossad ( ikigo cy' ubutasi cya Israel ) .
Yaje gufatwa aramanikwa i Damas arapfa .
Uko intambara yagenze muri make .
Israyeli imaze kubona amakuru ahagije no kumenya ibibuga by' indege bya Misiri ndetse n' ubumenyi ku kibaya cya Golani , Generali Yeshayahu Gavish yahise atangira gutegura uko ibitero kuri Misiri byazagenda .
General Yitzak Rabin we yitaye ku kuntu bazatera Misiri banyuze mu butayu bwa Sinayi .
Siriya nayo yari yaramze kwigwaho neza kubera amakuru Cohen yari yarahaye Mossad nayo ikayaha Tsahal ( Ingabo za Israel ) .
Imyiteguro yose imaze kurangira , ingabo za Israel zagabye ibitero bitunguranye kuri Misiri .
Siriya yo bari bayiteze iminsi .
Misiri niyo yabanje gukubitwa n' amabombe ya Israel .
Icyo gihe Misiri nicyo gihugu cyari gifite indege nyinshi zikomeye za Gisirikare mu bihugu byose by' Abarabu .
Ibi byatumye Israel ihitamo kubanza kurwana na Misiri .
Ku butaka hari ingabo zikomeye ziyobowe n' Abajenerali nka Ariel Sharon , Israel Tal , Shmuel Gonem , Yossi Peled n' abandi .
Izo ngabo zagiye zihura n' ibibazo kuko nk' izari ziyobowe na Ariel Sharon zari zigiye gutsindirwa mu majyepfo ya Sinayi ariko iza Yossi Peled ziramugoboka .
Ku rundi ruhande Israel yagiye kubona ibona ingabo za Yorudaniya zitangiye kuyigabaho ibitero .
Misiri yasabye Jorudaniya kubiyifashamo .
Kubera ko Israel yari imaze gukoresha imbaraga nyinshi itera Misiri byarayigoye kurwana na Yorodaniya ariko kubera ko nta kundi yari kubigenza Abajenerali bayo bakoze iyo bwabaga n' ingabo zabo barwana ku mpamde zombi kandi baratsinda .
Inama yAbaministri yarateranye yiga ku cyakorwa .
Haje gufatwa umwanzuro ko Yorodaniya nayo igomba guterwa .
Abajenerali nka Yigal Allon na Menahem Begin bo ndetse babibonyemo uburyo bwo guhita Israel yigarurira na Yeruzalemu .
Umusada w' intwaro bawukuraga muri Leta zu nze Ubuwe z' Amerika no mu bindi bihugu by' incuti .
Urugamba rero rwahise rufata indi ntera .
Nubwo bwose ibintu bagenze kuriya , Intambara yarangiye Israel itsinze urugamba .
Gusa ariko ntabyayibujije gukomeza gutinyako Abarabu bazihoorera .
Ubwo bwoba bwaje kuba impamo muri 1973 ubwo ibihugu by' Abarabu birangajwe imbere na Misiri naSiriya bwagabaga ibitero bikomeye kuri Israel mu Ntambara yitiriwe Yom Kippur , ( Ubundi Yom Kippur niwo Munsi Mutagatifu ukomeye mw' Idini ry' Abayahudi kurusha iyindi ) Muri make ng' uko uko Intambara y' Imisi itandatu yagenze .
Ntabwo twayiva imuzi yose ariko muri make ngibyo ibyayo .

Amagambo akomeye Aline Gahongayire yavuze kuri Diane wo muri True Promises na Healing arakirwa ate n' abandi bahanzi ?

COM February 28 , 2017 in FRASH NEWS 3 Comments Umuhanzi Aline Gahongayire yabwiye Ibyishimo . com ko ashimira byimazeyo imyitwarire y' umukobwa umaze kwamamara mu ndirimbo zihimbaza Imana mu matsinda atandukanye yo mu Rwanda ariyo ' True Promises Ministries ' na ' Healing worship Team ' .
Diane Nyirashimwe yamenyekanye mu myaka ine ishize bitewe n' indirimbo ' Mana Urera ' yaririmbwe na True Promises .
Uyu mukobwa utera iyi ndirimbo , amaze kuba ikimenya bose bitewe n' ijwi rye ryuje amavuta y' Imana , ariko igihebuje byose n' imyitwarire ye n' ibisubizo byumvikanamo ubwenge ntagereranywa asubiza abo baganira .
Aline aganira n' Umunyamakuru wa Ibyishimo . com yasobanuye uko yasanze Diane ahebuje abandi bahanzi b' igitsina gore baririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana mu Rwanda .
Ati : " Akariho karavuga , ibyiza bihari biravugwa .
Mureke twige gushima , njyewe nasobanukiwe neza y' uko gushima kandi ukavuga ukuri kw' ibihari ari byiza .
Naje kureba Diane ndamukurikirana .
Hari n' abandi bafite talent ( impano ) ariko Diane urebye nawe mu ruhando rwa Gospel Industry ari mu matsinda menshi . "
Alga ( Aline Gahongayire ) avuga ko kimwe mu byamweretse ko Diane ari mu bakozi b' Imana yibikiye ari igisubizo yamusubije ubwo yamubazaga impamvu atarakora indirimbo nk' umuhanzi uririmba ku giti cye .
Ati : " Nigeze no kuba namubaza ikibazo mu kiganiro ndamubwira nti ' ese Diane ko udasohora indirimbo yawe ' ?
Ansubiza neza , nibyo nshingiraho mvuga ngo n' Ibendera .
Arambaza ngo ndabishaka ?
Ndamubwira nti ndabishaka .
Nti nonese harabura iki ?
Arambwira ngo harabura igihe cy' Imana .
Kuva yansubiza gutyo [ … ] , ubundi uwundi uramubaza akakubwira ngo amafaranga , ntawe unyemera ariko Diane yasabye igihe cy' Imana ' .
Ohhh Mana yanjye , naravuze ngo Mana harabo wibikiye .
Rero ijisho ryanjye ntago ryanyeretse ibiri kure , ryanyeretse ibendera ry' umukobwa cyangwa se umwali mu ruhando rwa gospel y' uko bizakomeza bibeho kandi mufata nk' Ibendera ryo kuramya Imana mu gihugu . "
Kanda hano wumve ikiganiro twagiranye na Aline :
Ni kenshi bamwe mu bahanzi bakiri bato banenze imyitwarire y' abahanzi bakuru ibakandamiza , batinya ko mu gihe bazamuka bakagaragaza impano zabo bamenyekana hirya no hino bigatuma ibyo bakora bisubira inyuma .
Mu gihe haba habayeho gushima impano zikiri nto no kuzishyigikira byatuma hari umubare munini w' abahanzi bakiri bato ubohoka kandi bagakora umurimo w' Imana batishisha bakuru babo .
Aline aje yiyongera ku bahanzi bakuru bamaze gufata abakiri bato mu mugongo barimo Serge Iyamuremye na Patient Bizimana .
Diane Nyirashimwe n' inkingi ya mwamba mu baririmbyi ba True Promises izwi mu ndirimbo " Mana Urera " na Healing izizwi mu ndirimbo ' Amba hafi ' .

U Rwanda rwakiriye abashakashatsi bo hirya no hino ku Isi biga ku mahoro Inzobere n' abashakashatsi barungurana ibitekerezo mu Rwanda Abashakashatsi n' inzobere bagera mu ijana baturutse mu bihugu bitandukanye byo hirya no hino ku Isi bateraniye i Kigali , aho bari kwigira hamwe uko hakubakwa gahunda y' uburezi bugamije amahoro arambye .
Ni mu nama y' iminsi itatu , yafunguwe kuri uyu wa 20 Gashyantare 2017 , ku rwibutso rwa Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ruri ku Gisozi , mu gice cy' ahitwa Ishuri ry' amahoro .
Abitabiriye iyi nama ifite intego yo ' kubaka ubudahangarwa binyuze mu burezi bugamije amahoro :
imiterere , imikorere ndetse n' impinduka ' , baraganira ku bunararibonye bwabo ku bijyanye n' uburezi bugamije amahoro .
By' umwihariko barigira ku Rwanda uko mu nteganyanyigisho nshya y' amashuri , ubu hashyizwemo indangagaciro n' amahoro bikigishwa mu masomo yose , nk' uburyo bufatika bwo gutuma zishyirwa mu bikorwa mu gihe kirambye . "
The path from reconciliation to resilience is a continuous process with strong commitment " - Ex .
