ILIBAGIZA Immaculée ni umunyarwandakazi ukorera ku kicaro cy' Umuryango w' Abibumbye i New York , USA .
Nyuma y' urugendo rurerure rukomeye rw' ubuzima , ubu , ubwe yageze kuri byinshi anabigeza ku gihugu cye cy' u Rwanda .
Immaculée Ilibagiza / photo Internet Ni muntu ki ?
Ilibagiza Immaculee yavutse muri 1972 avukira ahahoze ari perefegitura ya Kibuye ubu ni Intara y' Iburengerazuba Akarere ka Karongi .
Yavukira mu muryango w' abakirisitu w' abana bane ; abahungu batatu Damascene , Vianney na Aimable nawe w' umukobwa .
Umuryango wabo wari umuryango wifashije kuko ababyeyi be bombi bari abakozi ba Leta .
Jenoside iba yari umunyeshuri muri Kaminuza y' u Rwanda aho yigaga ibijyanye na Electronic and mechanical engineering .
Genocide yakorewe abatutsi iba yari afite imyaka 22 , yatakaje umuryango we ; ababyeyi be na basaza be babiri ( Vianney na Damascene ) harokoka umwe ( Aimable ) wabaga mu gihugu cya Senegal .
Ilibagiza we yarokokeye muri Douche aho yari yihishe n' abandi badamu barindwi mu gihe cy' iminsi 91 ku mupasitori w' umuturanyi wari wabahishe .
Nyuma yo kuva muri iyo douche yagiye mu nkambi y' Abafaransa ( French camp ) yongera kuhava yerekeza i Kigali , aho yatangiye ubuzima bushya bwa nyuma ya Genoside aho yabashije gutekereza no kwakira urupfu rw' ababyeyi be na basaza be babiri .
Kubera ubushake n' umuhate , yageze ku ntego ye yo kuzakora muri Loni ( UN ) , yaje kubonamo akazi muri Loni ishami rya Kigali ari naho yahuriye n' umugabo we witwa Bryan Black , Umunyamerika wari waje mu Rwanda gufasha gutangira International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda .
Uretse kuvukira mu muryango w' abakirisitu Immaculee , ni umukirisitu gatulika yitagatifuza akoresha amasengesho , kwiga Bibiliya kuvuga ishapule ya rozari yisunze umubyeyi Bikiramariya , ibyo byose bimufasha kwegera Imana ari naho yakuye imbaraga zidasanzwe zo kubabarira abishe umuryango we .
Yamenyekanye cyane ku bitabo bitandukanye yagiye yandika mu bihe bitandukanye , icyakunzwe cyane cyitwa " left to tell " Igitabo cye " Left to Tell " cyagurishijwe cyane muri Amerika Nyuma y' imyaka ine muri 1998 nibwo yagiye muri Leta zunze ubumwe z' Amerika ( USA ) gukorera muri ku kicaro cya UN i New York .
Ubu ni Umuvugizi mbwiraruhame ( Public Speaker ) .
Akaba n' Umwanditsi ( Author ) w' ibitabo nka " Left to Tell " n' ibindi bishya bibiri ; " Led by faith " na " Our Lady of Kibeho " .
Mu mwaka w' 2007 yahawe igihembo cya Mahatma Gandhi International ( Mahatma Gandhi International Award ) cy' uruhare rwe mu bwiyunge ahabwa n' impamyabushobozi y' icyubahiro na Saint John ' s University .
Mu mwaka wa 2007 yashinze umuryango w' impuhwe ufasha abana b' imfubyi mu Rwanda witwa " Left to Tell Charitable Fund to support orphans in Rwanda " .
Ubu ni umubyeyi w' abana batatu kandi afite byinshi byo kwigirwaho nk' umunyarwandakazi wanyuze ahakomeye ubu akaba afite uruhare mu kubaka ubumwe bw' abanyarwanda n' iterambere ry' igihugu muri rusange .
Nyuma yo guhabwa impamyabushobozi y' icyubahiro na St John University i New York mu 2009 Source :

Ibya Dr Munyakazi mu rukiko byayoberanye , yise urukiko urubuga rw' ibiganiro Ari mu rukiko rwisumbuye rwa Muhanga , Dr Leopold Munyakazi yatangaje nta cyemeza ko ari mu rukiko kuko nta birango by' igihugu ahabona akaba atanabonamo ifoto ya Perezida wa Repubulika .
Yanavuze kandi ko bamwibeshyeho kuko umwirondoro bavuze atari uwe .
Dr Leopold Munyakazi yajujubije abacamanza mu rukiko Dr Munyakazi kugeza ubu ntafata iburanisha nk' urubanza , ahubwo aracyavuga ko ari ibiganiro nk' uko yakunze kubigaragaza mu rukiko rw' ibanze rwa Nyarugunga n' urwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge , ubwo yaburanishwaga ku bijyanye n' ifungwa n' ifungurwa ry' agateganyo .
Uru rubanza rwari rutangiye kuburanishwa mu mizi i Muhanga , ntabwo rwamaze igihe kirekire ahubwo impaka hagati y' ubushinjacyaha n' uregwa nizo zari ziganjemo .
Dr Munyakazi yitabye urukiko atari kumwe n' umwunganira mu mategeko , anavuga ko ari uwo yagenewe n' ubushinjacyaha .
Gusa ntanavuga ko ari uwo kumwunganira , ahubwo ngo ni nk' umufasha mu by' amategeko .
Muri uru rubanza , Dr Leopold Munyakazi yagaragaje ko hari imbogamizi nyinshi afite zituma ataburana , harimo no kuba atazi abagiye kumuburanisha abo ari abo n' imyirondoro yabo , aha ninaho yabasabaga ko bamuha ibyangombwa byabo ngo anamenye niba koko ari abacamanza .
Mu bindi yavuze , ni uko umwirondoro watangajwe atari uwe , uretse amazina ye gusa n' ay' ababyeyi , bityo akavuga ko hashobora kuba habayeho kwibeshya ku wo bashaka kuburanisha , aha yashingiraga ahanini ku gihe cy' amavuko cyatangajwe mu mwirondoro we .
Iki cyumba cy' iburanisha nacyo , Dr Munyakazi yavuze ko nta birango bya Repubulika y' u Rwanda birimo , ko nta kirango cy' ubutabera kirimo uretse indangaminsi ( Calendar ) ariko nayo igaragaraho urukiko rw' ikirenga .
Yavuze ko nta bendera ry' u Rwanda ririmo kandi nta n' ifoto ya Perezida wa Repubulika abonamo , bityo akavuga ko ntacyamwemeza ko aho bamuzanye ari mu rukiko .
Ubushinjacyaha bwahamije ko umwirondoro watanzwe ari wo kandi na Dr Munyakazi akaba yarawusinyiye , gusa ngo habayeho kwibesha gato ku bijyanye n' amatariki y' amavuko .
Dr Munyakazi kandi n' ubwo yavuze ko atemera umwirondoro we , yanavuze ko uw' ukuri atawuvugira aho kuko bikwiye gukorwa hakoreshejwe ibitabo by' irangamimerere , ikindi bikanakorwa n' abantu babihemberwa kuko we abivuze nta wabimuhembera .
Dr Munyakazi yasabwe n' abacamanza kudakoresha amagambo akomeye mu rukiko kuko ashobora kubihanirwa , maze asubiza ko Ikinyarwanda akoresha akizi neza nta kibazo gifite kuko agifitemo impamyabumenyi y' ikirenga kandi akaba ari inzobere mu by' iyigandimi n' icengerandimi .
Nyuma yo guharirana n' Ubushinjacyaha ndetse n' abacamanza , Urukiko rwanzuye ko rutakomeza kuburanisha umuntu utemera umwirondoro we , maze rwanzura ko urubanza ruzakomeza tariki 23 Werurwe 2017 .
Dr Munyakazi Leopold ushinjwa gukora ibyaha bya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Majyepfo y' u Rwanda ari naho aburanishirizwa , yashyikirijwe ubutabera bw' u Rwanda nyuma yo kwirukanwa muri Amerika mu mpera za 2016 .
Yakunze kuvuga amagambo adasanzwe mu miburanire ye , nk' aho yavuze ko adakwiye gucumbikirwa mu tuzu tumeze nk' ubwiherero kandi afite amazu meza mu mujyi wa Kigali .

ni ukuvuga : mu butabire , mu binyabuzima , mu bugenge , mu bukungu , mu mateka , mu iyobokamana n' ahandi .

18 , ugira uti : " Nahawe ubutware bwose mw' ijuru no mu isi " :
Pasiteri Desire Habyarimana yagaragaje ko Yesu afite ubutware mu bintu byose Abahanuzi bose beretswe Yesu mbere y' uko avuka bose bavuga ubutware bwe ariko bigeze kuri Yesaya ( 9 : 5 - 6 ) , aravuga ngo duhawe umwana w' umuhungu , ubutware buzaba ku bitugu bye , azitwa igitangaza , umujyanama , Imana ikomeye , Data wa twese Uhoraho , umwami w' amahoro …
. Umuhanuzi wa nyuma Yohana we yaravuze ngo njye sinkwiye no gupfundura udushumi tw' inkweto ze ; agiye kuvuka Imana yabyeretse abanyabwenge bava ku mpera y' isi baza gushaka aho yavukiye .
Umunsi inyenyeri zacu zatse , abami bazava ku mpera y' isi badushaka .
Abantu benshi aho kwita ku mubano wabo n' Imana ngo ibahuze n' umugambi Imana ibafiteho ahubwo biruka bashaka umugisha ujyanye n' ibifatika gusa nyamara iyo turi aho Imana idushaka umugisha urahadusanga .

Mu Butabire ( Chimie ) :
Yahinduye amazi divayi kandi Yesu yigeze gutanga inyigisho kuri divayi ko nta wafata vino nshya ngo ayishyire mu bibindi bishaje , yasobanuye ko byameneka akayihomba .
Ibyo bibindi bishaje ni imitima ya kamere itarahinduka .
Niba ushaka kuzura imbaraga z' Imana , hinduka mushya .
Ibihe tugiye kwinjiramo si buri wese uzapfa kubihagararamo niba tudahindutse ngo twuzure imbaraga z' Imana .
Benshi biyitirira ububyutse buzaza ariko hari abantu Imana iri gutegura bazabukoramo umurimo abo bahinduka bashya uko bukeye .
Yesu yavuze ko tuzabamenyera ku mbuto zabo , muri iki gihe ikintu gihenze kukibona n' umukristo wera imbuto z' abakijijwe .
Niba tunaniwe gukiranuka muri iki gihe ubwo ikizakurikiraho tuzaba tumeze dute ?
Buri munsi umubare w' amadini n' amatorero uriyongera ariko ibyaha ntibigabanuka mu bantu .
Ikibazo gihari n' uko abashumba badakora inshingano zabo ahubwo bafite irindi yerekwa rijyanye n' inyungu bategereje ariko atari ubwami bw' Imana . "
Ni byiza ko duhinduka muri kamere zacu kugira ngo twakire ubutware bwa Yesu .
Nawe uri umutware niwihana ibyaha byawe . "
2 . . Mu binyabuzima ( Biologie ) :
Yesu yavutse bidasabye guhura k' umugabo n' umugore .
Maria yabwiwe ngo Umwuka w' Imana azagukingiriza niyo mpamvu umwana azavuka azitwa umwana w' Ishoborabyose .
N ' ubu abana baravuka ( imigisha ) Iyo ikubwiye ngo ngukoreye igitangaza utangira kuvuga ngo nta mugabo , nta nzira ndeba , sinize menshi , ndi impfubyi , nta bakomeye tuziranye , nta bushobozi bw' amafaranga mfite ariko nemera ko Imana ishobora kurema ikintu igikuye mu busa kikabaho ; n' imibereho yawe izayirema ubeho ku bw' izina rye ryera .
3 . Mu bugenge ( Phyisique ) :
Yahinduye icyo bita la loi de la pesenteur kuko yarazamutse aragenda agumayo kandi iyo utereye ikintu hejuru kiragaruka .
Kuva icyo gihe inzira ni nyabagendwa , tuzajya mu ijuru ( Abafiripi 3 : 20 - 21 ) .
Twebweho iwacu ni mu ijuru kandi impanda izavuga abera bazamuke , kandi itorero rizava mu isi ntabwo rizatangirwa napesenteur .
Ikibazo dufite gikomeye ni ukutamenya ubutware twahawe muri Kristo ngo tubashe kubukoresha bituma Satani abudusuzugurana , akenshi tubyuka twiganyira , imirimo ya Satani irigaragaza buri munsi nyamara dukwiriye kumenya ko :
Ukora ibyaha ni uwa Satani , kuko uhereye mbere na mbere Satani akora ibyaha .
Ibyo Umwana w' Imana yerekaniwe ni ibi :
ni ukugira ngo amareho imirimo ya Satani .
1 Yohana 3 : 8 Ubuzima bw' abantu benshi burimo gukora kwa Satani haba mu Mwuka , mu bugingo no mu mubiri .
Iyo tutamenye inkomoko y' ibyo tunyuramo dutekereza ko ari ibisanzwe biri kutubaho ariko iga gukoresha ubutware uhabwa n' ijambo ry' Imana bizatuma utsinda imirimo ya Satani .
4 . Mu bukungu ( Economie ) :
Yagaburiye abantu barenga ibihumbi 5000 ifi 2 n' imigati 5 aba akemuye ikibazo cy' ubwiyongere bw' abaturage kandi mu nyigisho ze yari yarigishije ngo ' ntimukiganyire ngo tuzarya iki tuzambara iki ?
Kuko so wo mu ijuru azi ibyo mukena byose .
' Yashatse kukugaburira ntabura inzira anyuramo , erega ntabwo abantu benshi batunzwe n' imishahara batunzwe n' umugisha w' Imana kuko bike ubona Imana idashyizemo umugisha wayo wakumirwa ariko ubona ukwezi gushize hagashimwa Imana .
5 . Mu mateka ( Histoire ) :
Niwe tangiriro kandi niwe uzasoza , ni Alufa na Omega .
Nubwo wagize amateka avangavanze humura niwe uhindura amateka .
Kandi tuzi yuko ku bakunda Imana byose bifataniriza hamwe kubazanira ibyiza , ari bo bahamagawe nk' uko yabigambiriye … ( Abaroma 8 : 28 ) Uramutse umenye aho ubuki vuba byakugora kuburya kuko ntabwo inzuki zibukura ahantu heza gusa ariko zigira ubuhanga bwo kuvanga ubwo zakuye mu ndabyo , ahari imyanda , amazi zavomye zigakoramo ubuki , igitangaje buba ari bwiza burimo imiti myinshi nta mwanda na muke ubamo .
Imana izafata ahashize harimo ibikomere , imibabaro , ivange n' amasengesho uri gusenga bibyare ejo hazaza harimo ishimwe ryuzuye , ritsindagiye , ricugushije , risesekaye .
Satani aratubeshya tukabaho ubuzima butarimo ishimwe na rike kandi Imana itaraturemeye kuruha ahubwo Yesu yahamagaye n' abarushye ngo abaruhure ariko akenshi twigumanira imibabaro yacu .
Dusenge : Mana utubabarire amaganya y' isi uduhe ubuzima burimo ishimwe , binyuze mu butware utanga Satani ntazongera kudukandamiza kuko tumenye imbaraga zamutsinze , Amen 6 .
Mu miyoborere ( Gouvernance ) :
Niwe Mwami w' amahoro .
Ibihugu bikomeye kw' isi bishora amafaranga menshi mu mutekano barwanya ibyihebe ngo isi ibone amahoro byarananiranye ariko Yesu we afata ibyihebe nta mbunda akoresheje ku bw' ijambo rye gusa bagakizwa .
7 . Mu iyobokamana ( Religion ) :
Nta wujya kwa Data atamujyanye niwe nzira n' ukuri n' ubugingo , kandi nta rindi zina twahawe munsi y' ijuru ryo gukirizwamo uretse irya Kristo Yesu .
Ubwo butware yabuduhaye ngo tubukoreshe ariko ntabwo tuzi agaciro kabwo :
Umusambi umenye agaciro ufite muri Leta ya Uganda wahita ujya muri Hotel leta ikishyura kuko barawubaha ushushanije mu idarapo ry' igihugu ariko kuko utazi agaciro bawuha wirira iminyorogoto , ukibera mu gishanga , ukanywa amazi adatetse ukanyurwa .
Ingagi imenye agaciro tuyiha mu Rwanda n' ibyo yinjiza uko bingana yahita iva mu birunga hakonje ikaza kuba mu mahoteli akomeye kandi leta yayishyurira ariko kuko itazi agaciro kayo iba mu mbeho , ikarya ibyatsi ikanyurwa .
Igihe tuzamenyera agaciro dufite muri Kristo Yesu , imibereho yacu izatangira guhinduka kuko twamenye abo turi bo .
Dusenge : Mana nsengeye amatorero ya gikrsito ngo uduhe guhumuka amaso yacu tumenye impamvu waje kudupfira tumenye imbaraga zakuzuye uduhe kuzikoresha , Amen .

Mourinho arashaka kongera gukora agashya agura umukinnyi wa miliyoni 80 z' amapawundi !
Umutoza w' ikipe ya Manchester United Jose Mourinho arashaka kongera guca agahigo akagura umukinnyi uhenze , nyuma y' aho yifuzaga umufaransa ukinira ikipe ya Atletico Madrid , Antoine Griezman .
Griezmann mu masezerano ye , harimo ingingo ivuga ko ikipe izamushaka kugira ngo ave muri Atletico Madrid , izishyura akayabo ka miliyoni 85 z' amapawundi , ariko igiteye impungenge Mourinho si ayo mafaranga , ahubwo uyu mufaransa yemeje ko ameze neza kandi yishimye mu mujyi wa Madrid , yirinda kugira icyo avuga ku kujya mu ikipe ya Manchester , n' ubwo hakiri icyizere ko Paul Pogba nk' inshuti ye kandi bakinana mu ikipe y' igihugu y' Ubufaransa , yatuma aza bagakinana no mu ikipe imwe .
Icyizere kuri Griezmann , Manchester igisigaranye ku kuba Pogba bakinana mu ikipe y' igihugu y' Ubufaransa yabigiramo uruhare !
Nk' uko ibinyamakuru byo mu Bwongereza nka Starsport byatangiye kubitangaza , ngo ikipe ya Manchester United nibura uyu musore , Mourinho azahita yerekeza mu ikipe ya Tottenham , ikazana rutahizamu wayo Harry Kane , kuri miliyoni 80 z' amapawundi n' ubwo Woodward , umuyobozi wungirije muri Manchester United yatangaje ko bigoye kuko Kane aherutse gusinya amasezerano mashya mu ikipe ya Tottenham , gusa iki kinyamakuru cyakomeje gitangaza ko ibi bitabuza Mourinho gukomeza kugerageza kumushaka kubera amafaranga yaba yamushyizeho , yanamugira umwe mu bakinnyi bahenze ku isi .
Harry Kane , miliyoni 80 z' amapawundi zishobora gutuma aba umwe bakinnyi bahenze ku isi .
Eddy Woodward asanga bitoroshye gusa birashoboka .
Ikindi kandi biteganijwe ko Wayne Rooney ashobora kuva muri iyi kipe mu mpeshyi z' uyu mwaka , bivuze ko Mourinho atamufite mu mishanga ye iri imbere , ukongeraho na Zlatan Ibrahimovic utarongera amasezerano dore ko uyu mugabo w' imyaka 35 y' amavuko ari no hafi yo gusezera ku mupira w' amaguru .
Wayne Rooney na Zlatan Ibrahimovic ntabwo aribo Mourinho yashingiraho mu minsi iri imbere .
Mourinho rero akaba abona ko Harry Kane ariwe ushobora gutuma agera ku byo yiyemeje muri kipe izwi nk' amashitani atukura , aho ngo afatanije n' Umwongereza mwene wabo ukiri na mutoya Marcus Rashford , baba bafite ubusatirizi bukomeye cyane .
Ni mu gihe ariko ari ugutegereza kureba niba Daniel Levy , uyobora Tottenham azemera kurekura uyu musore agakora ubu bucuruzi na Manchester , dore ko byagaragaye ko ajya arekura abakinnyi bakomeye bakajya mu makipe akomeye , aho yaretse Gareth Bale akajya mu ikipe ya Real Madrid , amugurishije miliyoni 86 z' amapawundi mu mwaka wa 2013 .
Daniel Levy , uyobora Tottenham afite ihurizo ryo kuba yarekura Kane , n' ubwo byagaragaye ko ajya arekura abakinnyi bakomeye !
N ' ubwo Tottenham iba idaharanira ibikombe , ikaba kandi ikaba igomba no kwerekeza kuri stade yayo nshya , Daniel Levy afite ihurizo rikomeye ku kurekura Kane kuko ni umwe mu bo iyi kipe itezeho ejo hazaza heza , ikindi kumurekura bishobora gutuma abafana bayo batabyishimira bigateza umwuka mubi .
Niba utarabikora !
Dukunde unadukurikire ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ukomeze ubone amakuru mu buryo utamenyereye .

Burundi : Icyunamo hibukwa Ntaryamira Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Imyaka 17 irashize perezida Ntaryamira yitabye Imana Kuri uyu wa gatatu taliki ya 6 Mata 2011 wari umunsi w' ikiruhuko mu Burundi , hari mu gihe bibukaga imyaka 17 ishize perezida Cyprien Ntaryamira ahanuwe mu ndege yarimo .
Uyu nyakwigendera perezida Ntaryamira Yahanuwe mu ndege ku kibuga mpuzamahanga cy' i Kigali cya Kanombe , akaba yari kumwe na mugenzi we w' u Rwanda , perezida Juvenal Habyarimana hari na none kuwa gatatu tariki ya 06 Mata 1994 .
Iyi ndege yarimo kandi n' abaminisitiri babiri b' u Burundi aribo Simbizi Cyriaque na Ciza Bernard .
Photo : Perezida Cyprien Ntaryamira Leonce Ngendakumana ayoboye ishyaka Sahwanya - Frodebu , akaba n' umwe mu bari muri uyu muhango , yatangaje ko kuva nyakwigendera Sipiriyani Ntaryamira yitabye Imana n' abo bari kumwe bose ko nta ndishyi y' akababaro yigeze igenerwa abo mu miryango y' abo bose babuze ababo .
Akaba yasabye yasabye ko amaleta y' u Burundi n' u Rwanda yakorana kugira ngo ukuri gushyirwe ahagararagara .
Kuri Uyu munsi kandi habaye misa yo kwibuka Nyakwigendera Sipiriyani Ntaryamira , hanabaye n' igikorwa cyo gushyira indabo ku mva ya Nyakwigendera Sipiriyani Ntaryamira .
Bimwe mu byibukijwe muri iyi misa n' imvugo yamuranze aho yagize ati « Ndasaba Abarundi bose kurangwa na disipulini » Ntaryamira Cyprien yavukiye mu Burundi ku musozi wa Gitwe i Mageyo muri Komini Mubimbi ya Bujumbura , ku itariki ya 6 Werurwe 1955 .
Yayoboye u Burundi mu gihe cy' amezi 2 gusa , kuva kuwa 5 Gashyantare 1994 kugeza kuwa 06 Mata 1994 ari nabwo yahanuwe mu ndege .
Uyu muhango ukaba wari witabiriwe na perezida w' uburundi Pierre Nkurunziza , abayobozi bakuru b' iki gihugu n' abahagarariye amashyaka atandukanye muri iki gihugu .

Impuguke zasabye gushyiraho ingamba zihangana n' ubuhezanguni Publish Date :
jeudi 23 février 2017 Inama y' iminsi ibiri ku kurwanya iterabwoba yarangiye kuri uyu wa gatatu taliki 22 Gashyantare , aho impuguke zo mu karere zanzuye ko ibihugu bihuriye muri EAPCCO , umuryango uhuje abayobozi ba Polisi zo mu bihugu byo muri Afurika y' Iburasirazuba , bishyira imbaraga mu kurandura ibikorwa by' ubutagondwa .
Zemeje ko , buri gihugu , gikwiye kwigisha no gukangurira abayobozi b' ibanze bacyo , imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta by' umwihariko , impuguke n' abandi bafatanyabikorwa mu kurwanya iterabwoba , mu gufatanya ubukangurambaga n' ibindi bikorwa birirwanya .
Indi myanzuro irimo ko , buri gihugu gisabwa gutegura no gushyigikira amahugurwa y' abazigisha abandi ibijyanye n' imyitozo yo kurwanya iterabwoba n' uburyo mpuzamahanga bugezweho mu kongera ubushobozi mu bashinzwe umutekano ; gushyiraho imitwe yihariye yo gutahura no kuburizamo ibisasu ndetse no gushyiraho ingamba zihamye mu guhanahana amakuru afite aho ahuriye n' iterabwoba .
Umuyobozi mukuru wa Polisi y' u Rwanda ushinzwe ibikorwa bya Polisi , DIGP Dan Munyuza asoza iyi nama yagize ati : "
Imwe mu mbogamizi ikomeye mu rugamba rwo kurwanya iterabwoba ni ukumenya igihe , ahantu n' ubushobozi abakora iterabwoba bafite iyo bashaka kugira aho bagaba ibitero byabo . "
DIGP Munyuza yagize ati , " Iyi myitozo igamije kongera ubumenyi no kwihugura mu bijyanye no gukumira no kurwanya ibikorwa by' iterabwoba nk' imwe mu ngamba zafashwe n' ibihugu byo muri aka karere . "
Yakomeje avuga ko aka karere gatewe inkeke n' iterabwoba ; kandi ko hadafashwe ingamba zihamye zo kurikumira umutekano wako ushobora guhungabana .
Yongeyeho ko kurwanya ibikorwa by' iterabwoba bisaba ubufatanye mu kubitahura , kubigenza no guhanahana amakuru ku gihe atuma bikumirwa no gufata abafite imigambi yo kubikora .
Iyi nama ya gatatu ku kurwanya iterabwoba ihuje impuguke zavuye mu bihugu icumi byo muri aka karere .
Yari ifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti : "
Gushimangira ubufatanye mu kurwanya iterabwoba n' ubuhezanguni . "

Iki gikorwa kikaba cyahuriranye n' umunsi w' umuganda .
Abafundi mu Rwanda ngo sendikayabo irashaka guca akajagari mu mikorere yabo / photo JD Ntihunyuzwa Imihango yo gutangiza uku kwezi kwahariwe umufundi mu Rwanda yateguwe na sendika y' abafundi mu Rwanda ariyo STECOMA .
Iki gikorwa kizihijwe ku rwego rwa buri karere , ku rwego rw' igihugu gikorerwa mu karere ka Kirehe .
Ku rwego rw' akarere ka Kicukiro uku kwezi kwa hariwe umufundi kwatangirijwe mu murenge wa Kagarama , abayobozi munzego za Leta zitandukanye na bamwe mu bagize inteko nshingamategeko mu Bwongereza bagize ishyaka ryitwa Conservative party mu bwongereza bitabiriye uyu muhango .
Abafundi bo mu karere ka kicukiro basobanuriwe akamaro ko kuba muri sendika ibahuza ku rwego rw' igihugu yitwa STECOMA banabwirwa ko hagiye gushyirwaho Amashyirahamwe afitanye imikoranire na STACOMA muri buri murenge kugirango bibafashe gutera imbere binyuze mu mwuga wabo .
Mutatsineza Clementine wo muri iri shyirahamwe yatangarije Umuseke ko bibafitiye akamaro kwishyira hamwe .
Nshimiyumuremyi Deo umunyamabanga wa STECOMA mu karere ka Kicukiro avuga ko iri shyirahamwe ryabo rigamije guca akavuyo k' abafundi bakora muburyo bw' akajagari , anavuga ko ariyo mpamvu hashyizweho uku kwezi kwahariwe umufundi .
Nshimiyumuremyi avuga ko sendika yabo iriho ngo iheshe isura nziza umwuga wabo , ubusanzwe ujya uvugwamo amanyanga no ' kurya ' kubyo baba bagenewe gukoreshamu bikorwa baba bahawe gukora .
Yagize ati " STECOMA ni Sendika mpuzamahanga , ubu duteganya ko kuwa 18 Kanama 2014 hazasinywa amasezerano ku rwego rwa Africa y' iburasirazuba kuburyo kuva icyo gihe umufundi azaba afite gukorera mu gihugu icyo aricyo cyose muri ibi bigize umuryango w' Africa y' uburasirazuba yerekanye ikarita y' uko ari umunyamuryango wa STECOMA " Nshimiyumuremyi aganira n' Umuseke yagize ati " sendika yacu yashyizweho mu 2009 ariko yabonye ubuzima gatozi muri uyu mwaka wa 2014 mu kwezi kwa mbere . "
Uku kwezi bashyizeho kwahariwe abafundi kuzasozwa kuwa 26 Kanama .
Kuwa 11 Nzeri hazaba ibirori byo kumurika ibyagezweho muri uk kwezi batangiye kuri uyu wa 26 Nyakanga nk' uko bitangazwa na Nshimiyumuremyi .
Ibikorwa byo gutangiza ukwezi kwahariwe umufundi , ku Kicukiro Bamwe mu bashyitsi baje kwifatanya n' abafundi gutangiza uku kwezi barimo n' abo mu nteko ishinga amategeko u Bwongereza Senateri Bernard Makuza yari yitabiriye iki gikorwa .
Deo Nshimiyumukiza , Umunyamabanga wa STECOMA mu karere ka Kicukiro Mutatsineza Clementine ni umufundi ukora Ubukotezi mu murenge wa Kagarama Joselyne UWASE UMUSEKE .

Abakomoka i Rubavu batahaba bahafitiye ishyaka , hari ugamije kuhubaka ibitaro Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Muri iyi week end abantu bakomoka i Rubavu n' inshuti zabo bateraniye muri Petit Stade i Remera ngo barebe icyo bakora bakarushaho guteza imbere aho bakomoka bahereye cyane cyane ku byo Akarere kifitemo nk' ubukererugendo no kuba ari agace k' ubucuruzi cyane kuko gahana imbibi n' umujyi wa Goma .
Abakomoka i Rubavu banyuranye batanze ibitekerezo byiganjemo ishyaka ry' icyo bakorera mu rugo hakarushaho gutera imbere Jerome Twahirwa akomoka mu murenge wa Kanama , ariko akora ubucuruzi i Musanze , avuga ko hakiri imbogamizi zimwe zituma atari gushora imari iwabo i Kanama .
Twahirwa ngo yifuza kuhashora mu guteza imbere ibyo gusudira n' imyuga , ariko ngo abona Umurenge utarashyirahamwe ababikora , ubu ngo ababikora baratatanye mukajagari , ibintu bitatuma batera imbere .
Mu biganiro byabereye aha , benshi bagaragaje ishyaka bafitiye Akarere k' iwabo , Twagirubusa Claudine ukomoka i Rubavu wize ubuganga , avuga ko abonye ubushobozi yahashinga ivuriro .
Ati " Uretse gukomeza gushishikariza bagenzi banjye gushora imari mu karere k' iwacu ndateganya ko mbonye n' ubushobozi nashyigikira ubuvuzi nshinga ivuriro rinini kandi rigezweho ryakoreshwa n' abaturanyi b' Abanyekongo . "
Umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Rubavu Sinamenye Jeremie yavuze ko bihuje kugira ngo bamenyane banahuze imbaraga batari basanzwe babyaza umusaruro , kuko igenamigambi akarere gasigaye gakora riba rishingiye ku baturage ari nabo bagomba kurigiramo uruhare .
Iyi nama yari yanitabiriwe na Guverineri mushya w' Intara y' Iburengerazuba Alphonse Munyantwari , wayitanzemo ibitekerezo byo guhuza imbaraga bagakora ibikorwa bikomeye by' iterambere .
Minisitiri w' Umuco na Siporo , Uwacu Julienne yavuze ko iyi nama ari ingenzi kuko guharanira guteza imbere Akarere biba biganisha ku guha umuturage imibereho myiza n' igihugu muri rusange .
Mu izina ry' abanyarubavu bari batumiwe muri iyi nama yavuze ko kugira ngo bazabashe kugera ku bikorwa bifatika bidakwiye ko bazongera guhura ari uko batumiwe ahubwo hakwiye gushyirwaho uburyo bwo gukurikirana ibikorwa mu buryo buhoraho .
Minisitiri Uwacu atanga ibitekerezo muri iyi nama Minisitiri Julienne Uwacu nawe ukomoka i Rubavu ari mu bitabiriye inama y' abahakomoka Iyi nama yanitabiriwe na Sheikh Bahame Hassan wahoze ayobora aka karere Guverineri w' Iburengerazuba atanga ibitekerezo muri iyi nama Abantu banyuranye barimo n' abayobozi bitabiriye iyi nama Biyemeje gushyiraho uburyo bwo gukurikirana ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry' ibyo baganiriye Minisitiri Julienne Uwacu nawe ukomoka i Rubavu ari mu bitabiriye inama y' abahakomoka Daddy SADIKI RUBANGURA UMUSEKE .

Ngororero : Ababaga mu manegeka bahawe inzu zirimo Tereviziyo Imiryango 11 itishoboye yo mu Karere ka Ngororero yari ituye mu manegeka , yahawe inzu nshya zubatse mu mudugudu , zirimo televiziyo na radiyo .
Inzu zahawe abatishoboye babaga mu manegeka muri Ngororero , buri nzu ifite agaciro ka Miliyoni 5RWf Izo nzu 11 zubatswe ku bufatanye bwa Minisiteri yo kurwanya ibiza no gucyura impunzi ( MIDIMAR ) , Ishami ry' umuryango w' abibumbye ryita ku miturire ( UN Habitat ) n' Akarere ka Ngororero , zatashywe mu mpera z' icyumweru gishize .
Buri nzu ifite agaciro ka Miliyoni 5RWf .
Ifite ibyumba bine , igikoni , ubwiherero hakiyongeraho televiziyo na radiyo .
Sekabanza Francois , umwe mubahawe inzu n' ibyishimo bigaragara ku maso , amwenyura agira ati " Nabaho nibwo nakandagira mu nzu nziza noneho ikaba ari n' iyanjye .
Nzayifata neza ku buryo nzanayisigira abanjye imeze neza . "
Izo nzu uko ari 11 zubatse mu Mudugudu wa Kimiramba , Akagari ka Nyenyeri , Umurenge wa Kabaya .
Izo nzu zahawe ababaga mu manegeka muri Ngororero zirimo Tereviziyo na Radiyo Umuyobozi w' Akarere ka Ngororero , Ndayambaje Godefroid avuga ko imiryango 11 yahawe izo nzu ari iyatoranyijwe yari ibabaye kurusha iyindi .
Agira ati " Ntabwo abayakeneye bose bayabonye ariko hari abari babaje kurusha abandi nibo twahereyeho . "
Uhagaririye Umuryango w' abibimbye mu Rwanda , Lamin Mane avuga ko batazahwema gukora ibikorwa biteza imbere Abanyarwanda .
Agira ati " UN ishimishijwe no gukorana n' umuntu nka Perezida wanyu ushyira imibereho myiza y' abaturage imbere y' ibindi , kandi ntituzahwema gushyigikira ibikorwa bituma Abanyarwanda barushaho kubaho neza . "
Avuga ko uretse izo nzu 11 zubakiwe abaturage bavuye mu manegeka mu Murenge wa Kabaya , hari n' izindi 10 zizubakwa mu Murenge wa Sovu nazo ziri kuri urwo rwego .
Buri nzu ifite ibyumba bine Mukantabana Seraphine , Minisitiri wa MIDIMAR avuga ko ibyo bikorwa byose bituma Abanyarwanda batura heza babikesha imiyoborere myiza .
Agira ati " Ibi byose bituma mutura neza kandi heza tubikesha imiyoborere myiza .
Leta izakomeza gufasha abatishoboye kunoza imiturire kuko ari inshingano zacu kandi zishyigikiwe n' Umuyobozi mukuru w' igihugu . "
Uretse kubaka ngo hari n' amabati azahabwa imiryango 250 mu Karere ka Ngororero mu kuyifasha kuva mu manegeka .

Burundi : Nkurunziza yatanze iminsi 15 ngo abafite intwaro babe bazitanze Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Mu rugendo yakoreye muri Komini ya Makamba , Perezida w' u Burundi yahavugiye ijambo riha umuburo abaturage batunze imbunda mu ngo zabo mu buryo budakurikije amategeko kuba bazisubije mbere y' iminsi 15 bitaba ibyo bagafatirwa ingamba zidasanzwe .
Inama yari iyobowe na Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza yabimburiwe no gusenga Hashize igihe agace ka Makamba karahindutse indiri y' ibikorwa by' ubugizi bwa nabi bwakorwaga n' abantu bitwaje intwaro , ibi bikaba bihangayikishije abategetsi b' u Burundi .
Perezida Nkurunziza yagize ati : " Duhaye iminsi 15 abaturage bashobora kuba batunze intwaro mu ngo zabo kuba bamaze kuzisubiza abashinzwe umutekano kandi abazazitanga ku neza ntacyo bazaba ariko abazarenza igihe cyatanzwe tuzabata muri yombi . "
Yabasabye kubigenza nk' uko bagenzi babo muri Bujumbura babigenje bagasubiza intwaro bari batunze , ngo umutekano kakaba karabonetse .
Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza yabibukije ko atari abanyamahanga baza kwica abaturage ahubwo ko aribo ubwabo biyicanira , kandi ngo barabizi .
Uyu mukuru w' igihugu yari aharejwe n' abandi bayobozi bakuru muri Leta cyane cyane abayobora Intara za Mwaro , Bujumbura Rural na Bururi .
Muri iriya komini basuye imiryango y' abantu 11 bamaze kwicwa n' abantu bitwaje intwaro .
Kugeza ubu abakekwaho uruhare mu bwicanyi buhabera bagera kuri 36 batawe muri yombi .
Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza ubwo yari ageze ahabereye inama Abayobozi bakuru mu Burundi bategereje ko Perezida ahagera Inama yitabiriwe n' abasirikare bakuru mu ngabo z' U Burundi SOS Media Burundi UMUSEKE .

Ntibisanzwe ! Habonetse Itorero rikoresha Ibiyobyabwenge ku igaburo ryera .
Feb 25 , 2017 admin Amakuru ashyushye 0 Share this on WhatsApp Nkuko tubibona mu nkuru ya jessilyne Justice , itorero ryo muri Leta ya Oklahoma ho muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe Za Amerika , ubu rirakoresha ibiyobyabwenge mu mwanya w' umugati na Vino , cyangwa se umutobe kuri bamwe , mu gihe cy' ifunguro ryera nkuko byari bimenyerewe .
Nkuko bitangazwa n' umwe mu bagize iri torero Onac Inner Light , Christopher Rushing , iri Torero ngo niryo ryonyine mu yemerewe gukorera muri USA , ryahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge , mu muhango w' ifunguro ryera .
Rushing we avuga ko kuri we ibyo bita ibiyobyabwenge atari ko abibona .
Avuga ko ibyo bakoresha bitagira icyo byangiza kandi ko bitica , ahubwo atangaza ko bifasha ababikoresheje kwegera Imana neza kurushaho , kandi ngo bigafasha kumenya kamere y' Imana nyayo by' Ukuri .
Ubundi iri torero rigizwe ahanini naba kavukire bo muri USA , rihuza uburyo bwabo bw' imisengere ya gakondo , n' inyigisho za Kristo .
Abagize iryo Torero bahamya ko bakunda Imana kandi bakubaha n' amategeko yayo .
Bavuga ko bakunda abandi , bityo bagashyira imbere kubafasha mu gufasha nk' abishwe n' agahinda , abatwawe n' ubusinzi , n' abandujwe n' ibindi biribwa .
Ibyo babikora bashyiraho uburyo bwo kubavura bakoresheje ijambo ry' Imana , nubwo buvuzi bwabo bwa karande , burimo ibiyobyabwenge .
Icyo bagamije ngo ni ugushyiriraho abo ahantu bamara igihe gito cyangwa kirekire babona ubwo bufasha .
Rushing nkuko asoza abivuga , ngo abona iyi si irimo ibintu bya ngombwa , kandi bikenewe gufasha abandi , bikanabafasha kumenya neza Kamere y " Imana .
Ngayo nguko , ngibyo ibyo muri Oklahoma .

Ibaze Chameleone aririmbanye na Patient Bizimana , iyo ndirimbo yagufasha ?
Apôtre Gitwaza Yanditswe na Umutoni Rosine Kuya 28 Gashyantare 2017 saa 12 :
30 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
15 0 Abahanzi baririmba indirimbo zo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana babajije Apôtre Gitwaza niba baramutse bakoranye indirimbo n' umuhanzi uririmba indirimbo zisanzwe nta kibazo kirimo , abakurira inzira ku murima .
ApôtrePaul Gitwaza ubwo yari yitabiriye amasengesho yari yahuje abahanzi baturutse mu matorero atandukanye ya gikirisitu mu Rwanda tariki ya 20 Gashyantare 2017 , umwe muri bo yamubajije icyo atekereza ku muhanzi uririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana aramutse akoranye indirimbo na mugenzi we wo mu cyiciro cy' indirimbo zisanzwe abenshi bita iz' Isi .
Mu kumusubiza , ApôtreGitwaza yavuze ko atiyumvisha impamvu umuhanzi uririmbira Imana yakorana indirimbo n' umuhanzi usanzwe gusa ngo byaterwa n' icyaba cyabateye gukorana indirimbo .
Yagize ati " Njye sinabyemera kuko bariya bahanzi baririmba indirimbo zisanzwe iyo baririmbye gospel biba bitabarimo . "
Yabahaye urugero rw' ukuntu byaba bibusanye nko kubona umuramyi Patient Bizimana aramutse asubiyemo indirimbo ye ' Menye neza ' akayiririmbana n' umuhanzi ukomeye muri Uganda Jose Chameleone .
Gitwaza yahamije ko iyo ndirimbo itapfa gufasha abayumva .
Apôtre Gitwaza ati " Ibaze Chameleone arimo kuririmbana na Patient Bizimana ' Menye neza ' kandi uzi ko ( Chameleone ) yasinze , mu by' ukuri iriya ndirimbo yabo yagufasha ? "
Yakomeje avuga ko hari abakozi b' Imana baba bashaka kumenyekana bagakorana indirimbo n' abahanzi baririmba indirimbo zisanzwe , ibi ngo amaherezo byangiza ubugingo bwabo .
Yakomeje asaba abahanzi kuba inyangamugayo bagasenga Imana ikabafasha kumenyekana .
Muri aya masengesho kandi hari n' uwamubajije niba abahanzi baririmba indirimbo za zihimbaza Imana bakwiye kujya kuririmba mu bitaramo byateguwe n' abahanzi basanzwe .
Mu kumusubiza Apôtre Gitwaza yavuze ko bidakwiriye kujya kuririmba mu gitaramo cy' abantu badakijijwe , gusa ngo igihe umuhanzi yabanje kuganira n' umushumba we akamwemerera kujyayo akamuha n' impamba ngo nta kibazo abibonamo .
Yagize ati " Sinifuza kukubona urimo kuririmbana n' aba Koffi Olomide [ … ] Ngira ngo aho ngaho natwe ( abashumba ) twaba dutandukiriye , gusa pasiteri wawe akugiriye inama yo kujya kuririmba yo nta kibazo . "
Intumwa y' Imana Gitwaza Paul ubwo yari mu masengesho n' abaririmbyi Hari bamwe mu bahanzi baririmba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana bagiye bakorana indirimbo n' abaririmba basanzwe bigateza impagarara , abandi bakavumirwa ku gahera .
Mu babigerageje harimo Theo Bosebabireba waririmbanye na Senderi , Ama G The Black ndetse yanaherukaga gutangaza ko yifuza kuzaririmbana na Fireman .
Aline Gahongayire na we yakoranye n' abahanzi batandukanye barimo Oda Paccy n' aband , Regy Bank wakoranye na Bruce Melody , Brian Blessed yakoranye na Jules Sentore na Alpha Rwirangira .

Inka 1 654 z' abanyarwanda birukanwa Tanzania zangiwe kwinjira muri DRCongo Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Inka 1654 ziherereye ahitwa Kigongo , muri km 7 gusa uvuye mu mujyi wa Uvira ( Kivu y' Epfo ) zikaba ari iz' abanyarwanda bamaze iminsi birukanwa mu gihugu cya Tanzania .
Nk' uko Radio Okapi ibitangaza izi nka zambukiye ku mupaka wa Congo n' Uburundi ahitwa Kiliba zishaka kwerekeza mu ntara ya Katanga muri Congo ziva muri Tanzania .
Abanyarwanda bari kwirukanwa muri Tanzania benshi ni aborozi Izi nka ziracyari ku isoko rya Kigongo mu mujyi wa Uvira , kugira ngo zigere Katanga zagombaga guca mu gace ka Fizi .
Banyir ' izi nka baravuga ko ibyangombwa by' inka zabo babyambuwe n' umutwe w' abarwanyi ba Mai - Maï ahitwa Makobola , igihe biteguraga kujya mu gace ka Fizi .
Imirwano iherutse gushyamiranya ingabo za leta ya Congo FARDC n' imitwe y' abarwanyi , nayo yaba yarabangamiye izi nka kugezwa mu gace ka Fizi nkuko bivugwa .
Kijanda Lulege umutegetsi ushinzwe ibijyanye n' inka muri Uvira , avuga ko abashumba b' izo nka barimo n' Abakongomani bari bagiye kuzishakira ibyangombwa .
Uyu muyobozi yatangaje ko banyiri inka ari aborozi bazwi muri Ruzizi bashaka kugishira ( kwimura ) inka zabo muri Kigongo .
Kijanda avuga ko bitewe n' urwuri ruto mu kibaya cya Ruzizi , aborozi bahora mu makimbirane n' abahinzi bityo inka 7 000 zimaze kwimurwa muri ako gace zijyanwa muri Katanga .
Radiookapi yo ivuga ko izi nka ari iz' abanyarwanda bari kuva muri Tanzania bizeye urwuri muri Congo .
HATANGIMANA Ange Eric UMUSEKE .

Amakuru | Mu Ntara | Intara Gakenke :
Bajujubijwe n' abatekamutwe biswe ' Abahigi ' biyitirira REG Abaturage bo mu mirenge inyuranye yo mu karere ka Gakenke , batangaza ko babangamiwe n' abatekamutwe bazwi ku izina ry' abahigi , biyitirira ko bakorera ikigo gishinzwe gutanga amashanyarazi mu Rwanda , bakabiba amafaranga .
Aba batekamutwe ngo babizeza ko bazabazanira imiyoboro y' amashanyarazi ndetse bakabafasha no kuyageza mu ngo zabo mu buryo bworoshye , ariko ngo ibi bigakorwa ari uko babanje kwishyura amafaranga .
Umwe mu baturage bo murenge wa Mugunga yagize ati " Rwose uyu mutwe w' abahigi muri kano karere utumereye nabi , nawe se umuntu araza yiyitirira ikigo cy' igihugu gishinzwe gutanga amashanyarazi akakumvisha ukuntu azabagereza umuriro w' amashanyarazi mu murenge wanyu wose , ariko ngo bikaba bisaba ko nibura buri muryango wikura amafaranga atari munsi y' ibihumbi 50 , aba mbere twarayatanze , dutegereza umuyoboro mu kagari kacu turaheba .
Aba bantu kandi uko ubareba bahinduranya amanimero ya Telefone zigendanwa , hari ukubwira ngo akuriye REG mu rwego rw' intara , yamara kubona ibintu bitinze , akazana undi ngo ni umuyobozi mu rwego rw' igihugu , iyo ubonye rero umuyobozi mu rwego rw' igihugu n' uwari usigaye ataratanga imisanzu ahita ayatanga " .
Uyu muturage yongeraho ko ngo hari n' ubwo aba bahigi bajya bitwaza za kamera n' ibyuma bifotora ngo bagamije kwereka abaturage ko imirimo iri hafi yo gutangira kugira ngo imiyoboro y' amashanyarazi ibagereho , aha rero ngo we na bagenzi be basaba ubuyobozi kugira uruhare mu gufata abo bahigi , binyuze mu guhanahana amakuru kuri ibi bikorwa .
Yagize ati " Ikigo cy' igihugu gishinzwe gutanga umuriro w' amashanyarazi mu Rwanda ( REG ) , buriya abaturage bakiyumvamo , upfa kuba gusa uje muri kano gace wambaye umwenda w' iki kigo ndetse ufite n' ibikoresho bigaragara ko ukora amashanyarazi hano turakwakira .
Ibi rero ni bimwe mu biha abahigi imbaraga zo kutwiba , twabise abahigi kubera ko nyine usanga baza kutwishakira mu ngo zacu , bagamije kurya utwacu , Leta nidufashe ibahige " .
Umuyobozi w' akarere ka Gakenke Nzamwita Déogratias , yemeza ko iki kibazo ubuyobozi bwamaze kukimenya , ubu bakaba bari kugishakira umuti .
Yagize ati " Ikibazo cy' abahigi na twe twakimenye nko mu murenge wa Kamubuga , aho ngo hari abatekamutwe biswe abahigi bavuga ko bakorera ikigo cy' igihugu gishinzwe gukwirakwiza umuriro w' amashanyarazi , ubu natwe tugiye kubahiga , kandi tuzarwanya uwo ari wese , urya imitsi y' abaturage agamije kubiba .
Ibi tugiye kubikurikirana rwose , kandi mu gihe gito biratanga igisubizo cyiza ku baturage , ariko nanone sinabura gusaba abaturage kujya bashishoza abo baba bagiye gukorana na bo , birumvikana ko bitewe n' imyumvire y' abaturage yazamutse bamwe banyotewe umuriro aho utaragera , ariko nanone si ngombwa ko batakaza imitungo yabo k' ubusa batazi n' aho igiye " .

Intumwa Paul Gitwaza arahumuriza abakristo bo muri Zion Temple Belgique Posted by :
Valentin Twiringiyimana February 13 , 2017 in AMAKURU YO MU RWANDA 6 Comments Umuyobozi w' itorero Zion Temple Celebration Centre ku isi , Apostle Dr . Paul Gitwaza yahumurije abakristo bo muri Zion Temple ryo mu Bubiligi abinyujije ku rukuta rwe rwa Facebook , aho yabasabaga gushikama mu bibazo barimo bibakomereye .
Apostle Paul Gitwaza , umuyobozi wa Zion Temple ku isi Mu magambo ye yatangaje mu ndimi eshatu ari zo igifaransa , ikinyarwanda n' icyongereza , Apostle Gitwaza yasabye Zion Temple Belgique gukomeza kwihangana no gushikama mu bigeragezo bikomeye barimo .
Akomeza abibutsa ko uko byamera kose Umwami akiri ku ngoma .
Yasoje abahumuriza ko nawe arimo kubasengera , kandi abashyigikiye cyane ko ndetse ari mu nzira ajya kubasura , anabifuriza umugisha uturutse ku Mana .
Mu magambo ye yanditse ku rukuta rwe rwa Facebook yagize ati : "
Shalom bwoko bw' Imana muri ZTCC Belgique .
Ndimo kubasengera kandi ndabashyigikiye mu bihe bitoroshye murimo kunyuramo .
Mukomeze mushyigikire umurimo w' Imana na gahunda z' itorero .
Ndi mu nzira nza kandi Kristo aracyari ku ngoma .
Muhabwe umugisha . "
Mu gihe twateguraga iyi nkuru twagerageje guhamagara umuvugizi w' Itorero Zion Temple Celebration Centre mu Rwanda k' umurongo wa telefoni ngendanwa , maze Bwana Nzabakira Floribert ntiyabasha kutwitaba ngo tumusobanuze iby' ibyo bigeragezo biri mu Bubiligi n' igihe Gitwaza azagirayo .
Iyi nkuru turacyayikurikirana … .

Radio Isango Star yafashwe n' inkongi Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abakunzi ba 91 . 5 batunguwe n' inkuru mbi y' inkongi yatwitse ahakoreraga iyi Radio kuri Saint Paul mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 12 Mutarama 2013 .
Bazimya hejuru ahari izingiro ry' umuriro Ndererehe Emmanuel umwe mu batechnicien b' iyi Radio wari yaharaye yemeje ko iyi nkongi yaturutse hejuru mu gisenge mu nsinga z' amashanyarazi zakoze ' cours circuit ' .
Nta muntu wakomerekeye muri uyu muriro kuko nta banyamakuru bari muri Radio igihe yafatwaga n' umuriro ahagana saa kumi n' ebyiri za mugitondo .
Ibyuma byo muri Studio bimwe na bimwe byabashije gukizwa igihe umuriro wari ukiri mucye .
Police yatabaye nyuma y' iminota 30 umuriro utangiye .
Umwe mu bakuru ba Police wari yatabaye yavuze ko iyo kuri iyi Radio baza kugira agakoresho gato kazimya umuriro inkongi itari kwangiza bingana uko byagenze .
Ikipe ya Police irwanya umuriro mu butabazi Ibyumba abanyamakuru bicaramo bavuga amakuru , nibyo byangiritse cyane , ahanini bitewe n' ibikoresho bikoze mu mifariso ( sound proof ) bitiza imbaraga cyane umuriro .
Umutechnicien wari kuri Radio nawe ahamya ko nta gakoresho na kamwe ko kuzimya umuriro kaharangwaga , ndetse ibyo bagiye gutira hirya muri Saint Paul umuriro ugitangira babibonye inkongi yabaye yose bikaba ngombwa ko bahuruza Police .
Uyu muriro ushobora gutuma iyi nsakazamajwi itumvikana mu gihe kitari kinini cyane kuko ibyuma by' ingenzi nka ' emeteur ' , za mudasobwa , microphones , mixeur n' ububiko bwa Radio ' disks ' byabashije gukizwa umuriro utarakomera .
Mugabo Justin umwe mu banyamigabane ba Isango Star yatangaje ko Radio izaba itangiye gukora hifashishijwe ibikoresho bihari mu gihe bitegura gusimbuza ibyangiritse .
Aha ni muri Studio ya Isango Star mukanya ubwo bari bamaze guhosha umuriro Barinze kumena inzugi n' amadirishya ngo bakize ibyari ahafunze Insinga z' amashanyarazi ngo zaba arizo ntandaro Muri Studio aho abanyamakuru bicara bavuga amakuru Mu gisenge cya Studio hakongotse Muri Studio habaye umuyonga Imodoka irwanya umuriro yazamuraga amazi hejuru Police iyo idatabara iyi nyubako yose ngo yajyaga gufatwa n' inkongi .

Hashize imyaka umunani mbanye n' umugabo wanjye ariko nta mwana twari twagira kuko umugabo wanjye afite ikibazo cy' intanga .
Mbere yabanje kujya avuga ko arijye utabyara ndetse arantoteza cyane ariko nkomeza kwihangana .
Yari yaranze ko tujya kwa muganga nabimubwira akanga ngo ninjye kwivuza ninjye ufite ikibazo .
Nageze aho njya kwa muganga njyenyine mbimuhishe ariko bambwira ko ndi muzima .
Nakomeje kumuhendahenda tumuranye imyaka itanu nibwo yemeye ko yajya kwivuza .
Twarajyanye twese baza gusanga intanga ze arizo zifite ikibazo .
Kuva icyo gihe amenye ko afite ikibazo yarahungabanye cyane , ananirwa kwiyakira kuko yari yizeye neza ko ariwe muzima .
Umuganga yaduhaye inama amwizeza ko yavurwa agakira ariko ubu ngo yarambiwe .
Yari amaze imyaka hafi itatu yivuza bakamubwira ko bigenda bifata intera nziza nanjye nkumva mfite icyizere ko azakira .
Ubu rero ikibazo mfite nuko avuga ko atazongera kwangiza amafaranga ngo arivuza .
Ngo niba nshaka umwana nzashaka undi mugabo muzima tumubyarane .
Yageze aho yita abanganga abatekamutwe ngo bamubeshye bakamurira amafaranga .
Najyaga numva nihebye ariko nkizera ko azakira nkuko abanganga babitubwiraga ariko ubu noneho nashobewe .
Nta kiganiro agishaka ko tugirana kerekeye ibyo kwivuza .

Ngoma : Amashyamba yugarijwe n' udukoko dutuma yuma Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Abaturage bateye amashyamba bo mu Karere ka Ngoma mu Ntara y' Uburasirazuba baratabaza abo bireba bose ko babafasha guhashya udukoko tubononera ibiti by' amashyamba bateye ubu akaba yatangiye kuma .
Ubuyobozi bw' Akarere bwo buravuga ko iki kibazo bakizi kandi bukaba burimo gushaka igisubizo cyacyo .
Inturusu zatangiye kuma Utu dukoko abaturage bavuga tumeze nk' inda .
Ngo uretse kurya inturusu ngo n' abantu turabarya .
Utu dukoko twatangiye kugaragara mu Karere ka Ngoma muri Kamena ngo dukomoka muri Australia ahakomotse igiti cy' inturusu bwa mbere , abaturage bakavuga ko utubugarije bo ubwabo ndetse n' amashyamba bateye .
Kayinga Janvier ati : " Utu dukoko tumeze nk' inda iyo tukugezeho turakurya kuburyo wumva tubabaza cyane twagera kugiti cy' inturusu cyo cyigahita cyuma " .
Mukamana Ernestine nawe yagize ati : "
Utu dukoko twatumariye inturusu kuko zose zatangiye kuma zihagaze " .
Ku ruhande rw' ubuyobozi bw' Akarere ka Ngoma Uwiragiye Venant ni umukozi w' aka karere ushizwe amashyamba .
Avuga ko iki kibazo bakizi ngo ariko baracyashaka uko bagikemura .
Yagize ati : " Twagerageje kwitabaza Ikigo cy' igihugu cy' umutungo kamere gifite amashyamba mu nshingano nabo bitabaza RAB dusanga nta buryo bwo kubirwanya bwari buhari .
Nabo batubwira y' uko iyo imvura iguye utu dukoko tugenda duhunguka ariko turacyashakisha ukundi twacyemura iki kibazo " .
Abahanga mubijyanye n' amashyamba bavuga ko utu dukoko twagaragaye bwa mbere ku Isi mu gihugu cya Australia .
Ku mugabane w' Afurika twagaragaye bwa mbere muri Afrika y' epfo muri 2005 tuza kugera no hirya no hino muri Afurika kugeza ubwo tugaragaye no mu Rwanda by' umwihariko mu Karere ka Ngoma .
Amashyamba yafashwe n' utu dukoko usanga ibiti byose byuma bihagaze amababi agahunguka .
Mu karere ka Ngoma ibiti by' inturusu bigize 80 % by' amashyamba yose muri rusange kandi ikibabaje ni uko utu dukoko twibasiye ibi biti by' inturusu .
Elia BYUKUSENGE UMUSEKE .

Umuyobozi wa FIFA Gianni Infantino atangiye gukabya inzozi za Nzamwita Vincent ' de Gaulle ' Written by Moses Collon Kuwa Gatandatu taliki ya , 25 Gashyantare 2017 21 :
55 Print Email @ Add new comment Tora iyi nkuru 1 2 3 4 5 ( 0 : Inshuro imaze gutorwa ) Gianni Infantino ashyira ibuye ry' ifatizo ahazubakwa hoteli y' inyenyeri 4 Foto :
RwandaSport . com Umuyobozi w' Ishyirahamwe ry' umupira w' amaguru ku isi ( FIFA ) , Gianni Infantino yashyize ibuye ry' ifatizo ahatangijwe umushinga wo kubaka hoteli ya Ferwafa , mu muhango wabaye ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu , tariki ya 25 Gashyantare 2017 I Remera iruhande rwa FERWAFA .
Umuyobozi wa FIFA Infantino ageze I Remera ahagiye kubakwa hoteliUmuyobozi wa FIFA Infantino ageze I Remera ahagiye kubakwa hoteli Uyu muyobozi wageze mu Rwanda ku gicamunsi cy' uyu munsi , yabanje kwitabira umukino waberaga kuri stade Amahoro areba iminota 20 gusa y' umukino aho Rayon Sports na Police Fc zanganyije ibitego 2 - 2 .
Infantino yari yateguriwe aho atambukira agana mu byicaro bye agenda asuhuza abagize inteko ya FERWAFA .
Infantino yari yateguriwe aho atambukira agana mu byicaro bye agenda asuhuza abagize inteko ya FERWAFA .
Umuyobozi wa FERWAFA Nzamwita Vincent wahaye ikaze Infantino , yatangiye ashimira Infantino kuba yabashije kubahiriza isezerano yamuhaye ryo kuza mu Rwanda ko akabije imwe mu nzozi ze yarafite .
Yamushimiye kandi ko FIFA yemeye gutanga miliyoni 4 n' ibihumbi ijana byamadorali ya Amerika agize inkunga ingana na 65 % by' ingengo y' imari izubaka iyi hoteri FIFA yemeye kuzatanga andi akazaturuka mu nguzanyo .
Infantino asuhuza anasobanurirwa abagize inteko ya FERWAFAInfantino asuhuza anasobanurirwa abagize inteko ya FERWAFA Umuyobozi wa FIAFA Infantino yasobanuriwe anerekwa igishushanyo mbonera cya hoteli izubakwa na sosiyete y' Abashinwa CCECC Rwanda Ltd aho izayubaka mu gihe kingana n' amezi 18 .
Nzamwita kandi yibukije ko bashakaga kubaka iyi hateli kunguzanyo yabanki ntoya kuko inyungu z' inguzanyo mu Rwanda ndetse no muri Afurika ziri hejuru , akaba ariyo mpamvu mu izina ry' abagize njyanama ya FERWAFA yasabye Infantino ko FIFA yatanga ubufasha bishoboka bwose muri uyu mushinga .
Nzamwita yavuze ko asigaranye inzozi z' igera kuri ebyiri ; izo kuba u Rwanda rwakwakira inama njyanama ya FIFA yaba ibereye bwa mbere mu mateka mu gihugu kitarimo amarushanwa ya FIFA .
Nzamwita yemeje ko Infantino yabimwemereye ko inama yo mu Kwakira uyu mwaka yaza mu Rwanda , Aha ariko Infantino mu kiganiro n' abanyamakuru yirinze kubyemeza aho yaje kuvuga ko biri muri gahunda bazakomeza kubyigaho .
Inzozi zindi za Nzamwita ni ukuba u Rwanda rwazakira inama rusange ya FIFA ( Congress ) kuko asanga u Rwanda ruzi kwakira abantu ariwo mutungo uhambaye rufite kuko nta zahabu twigirira .
Umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri ya Siporo n' Umuco , Lt . Col . Patrice Rugambwa wari uhagarariye minisitiri w' umuco na siporo nawe yagaragarije Perezida wa FIFA intambwe igihugu kimaze gutera mu kwakira amarushanwa mpuzamahanga akomeye ndetse agaragaza ko iyi hoteli niramuka yuzuye izatera ingabo mu bitugu kurushaho kunoza iyi ntego ari nako nawe yemeza ko u Rwanda rufite byose ngo rwakire izi nama za FIFA .
Infantino waje guhita ashyira ibuye ry' ifatizo ahazubakwa iyi nyubako , wabonaga ko yakurikiranaga cyane ibyo yabwirwaga anyuzamo akemera akoresheje umutwe , agakoma amashyi ndetse akanasekamo .
Infantino asobanurirwa igishushanyo cya hoteliInfantino asobanurirwa igishushanyo cya hoteli Iyi hoteli igomba kuba yuzuye mugihe cy' amezi 18Iyi hoteli igomba kuba yuzuye mugihe cy' amezi 18 Nyuma yo gushyira ibuye ry' ifatizo ahazubakwa iyi hoteli , Gianni Infantino yafashe ijambo aho yatangiye yishimira uburyo u Rwanda rwateye intambwe ifatika mu guteza imbere umupira w' amaguru muri rusange .
Yagize ati " Ndashimira u Rwanda umurava rugaragaza mu iterambere ry' umupira w' amaguru , ariko by' umwihariko Perezida Paul Kagame utera inkunga irushanwa rya CECAFA Kagame Cup , rihuza amakipe yo mu Karere ka Afurika y' Iburasirazuba . "
IInfantino n' abayobozi bari kumwe bambaye gifundi bajya mu kaziIInfantino n' abayobozi bari kumwe bambaye gifundi bajya mu kazi Infantino ashyira ibuye ry' ifatizo ahazubakwa hoteliInfantino ashyira ibuye ry' ifatizo ahazubakwa hoteli Uyu muyobozi waherukaga mu Rwanda muri Mutarama 2016 , ubwo yatangiraga ibikorwa byo kwiyamamariza kuyobora FIFA , yijeje u Rwanda ubufasha mu bikorwa bitandukanye bijyanye no guteza imbere umupira w' amaguru mu gihe cyose azaba akiyobora iri shyirahamwe .
Infantino yavuze ko yanyuzwe n' umupira yarebye kuri stade Amahoro ndetse yemeye ko azagaruka mu Rwanda aje nawe kurara muri iyi hoteli yatangije kubakwa .
Iyi hoteri igizwe n' ibyumba 44 izatwara akayabo ka miliyari eshatu na miliyoni 85 z' amanyarwanda , aho ifite ibyumba 4 bizaba bigenewe kwakira abantu bafite ikibazo cyo kuba batazamuka hejuru , ikaba ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira amakipe abiri y' ibihugu icyarimwe cyangwa ikakira amakipe yamaclub atatu icyarimwe .
Mulindahabi Olivier wafunzwe azira iyi hoteli ubwo yari umunyamabanga muri FERWAFA niwe wafunguye shampanye yahanyoreweMulindahabi Olivier wafunzwe azira iyi hoteli ubwo yari umunyamabanga muri FERWAFA niwe wafunguye shampanye yahanyorewe Ihagiye kubakwa inyubako hamenyweho amazi y' uruganda !

Gambia : Perezida Adama Barrow yababariye izindi mfungwa 98 Yanditswe na IGIHE Kuya 4 Werurwe 2017 saa 09 :
00 Yasuwe : XX Yavuzweho :
0 0 Perezida mushya wa Gambia , Adama Barrow , yahaye imbabazi izindi mfungwa 98 ziyongera ku 174 yababariye mu kwezi gushize .
Izo mfungwa ziganjemo izari zifungiye muri gereza eshatu ari zo ; Mile Two , Old Jeshwang na Janjanbureh .
Bamwe muri bo bari bafungiwe ibyaha by' ihohoterwa , ububandi , ubujura no gutunga intwaro .
VOA yanditse ko imfungwa 16 mu barekuwe ni Abanya - Senegal , Abanya - Guinea n' Abanya - Sierra - Leonne .
Kuwa 18 Gashyantare uyu mwaka Perezida Barrow yahaye imbabazi izindi mfungwa 174 , mbere yaho yari yarekuye abantu benshi bari batawe muri yombi n' ubutegetsi bwa Yahya Jammeh .
Muri Gashyantare kandi Minisitiri ushinzwe umutekano , Mai Fatty , yasuye gereza ya Mile Two , asangamo ibibazo by' uburyo bw' imifungire budakwiye n' iyicarubozo , aho gereza eshatu nini zifungiyemo abantu 1200 kandi zigenewe abantu 650 .

Ban Ki Moon yohereje intumwa i Burundi yo guhuza abashyamiranye Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Umunyamabanga wa UN , Ban Ki Moon yohereje Said Djinnit ngo amubere intumwa yihariye yo guhuza President Nkurunziza n' abadashaka ko yiyamamariza Manda ya gatatu mu matora azaba muri Kamena uyu mwaka .
Said Djinnit hamwe na President Nkurunziza uyu munsi baganira Photo :
Presidence Burundi Said Djinnit arajya mu Burundi kureba uko yahuza uruhande rwa President Nkurunziza n' abagize amashyaka atavuga rumwe nawe badashaka ko yakwiyamamariza kungera kuyobora Uburundi ngo kuko Itegenshinga n' amasezerano ya Arusha bitabimwemerera .
Umunyamabanga wa UN , Ban Ki Moon yasabye ko ubutegetsi bwareka abantu bakigaragambya bakerekana ibyo babona ko bidakwiriye , kandi bukareka abaturage bakabasha guhurira mu makoraniro manini nk' inama n' ibindi .
Itangazo ryatanzwe n' Ibiro bya UN rirasaba kandi ko habaho iperereza ku bwicanyi bwakozwe n' impande zombi mu bushyamirane bwabanjirije kwemezwa kwa Nkurunziza nk' umukandida wa CNDD - FDD ndetse n' ubwakurikiyeho .
Iri tangazo rivuga ko umuntu wese uzagaragaraho uruhare urwo arirwo ryose muri biriya bikorwa , azabibazwa n' amategeko .
Ban Ki Moon yasabye impande zihanganye kwirinda amagambo akarishye yatuma habaho imyiryane mu baturage kandi bakirinda gutuma amasezerano y' amahoro bagezeho biyushye akuya aba impfabusa .
Ejo hashize , Ibiro bihagarariye Ubwongereza mu Rwanda no Burundi nabyo byahaye gasopo abantu bose bazabuza abaturage kwerekana uko babona ibintu binyuze mu myigaragambyo .
Guhera ku wa Gatandatu ushize , Abarundi batuye mu mijyi barahagurutse bajya mu mihanda kwamagana ikemezo cya CNDD - FDD cy' uko Nkurunziza ariwe uziyamamaza ahagarariye ririya shyaka .

Hagiye gukorwa ibarura ngo harebwe za baringa z' abarimu mu gihugu hose Mulindwa Samuel , Umunyamabanga uhoraho muri MINEDUC Minisiteri y' Uburezi ivuga ko igiye gukora ibarura ry' abarimu mu mashuri yose ya Leta n' afashwa na Leta nyuma y' aho hagaragaye ko hari za baringa nyinshi z' abarimu .
Iri barura riteganyijwe guhera ku itariki ya mbere Werurwe rigeze tariki ya 10 uyu mwaka .
Ibaruwa yandikiwe abayobozi b' uturere bose dufitiye kopi , igira iti " Minisiteri y' Uburezi iramenyesha ko igiye gukora ibarura ry' abarimu bose mu bigo byavuzwe ruguru .
Iryo barura rizaba rigamije kugaragaza imibare nyayo y' abarimu kuko byagaragaye ko mu bigo by' amashuri hakirimo abarimu ba baringa .
Iyi baruwa ikomeza ivuga ko buri muyobozi w' ikigo cy' ishuri asabwe guteguza abarimu bose bigisha ku kigo ayobora kandi buri mwarimu ngo asabwe kuzaba yitwaje irangamuntu ye n' ikarita y' ikigo cy' ubwiteganyirize ( RSSB ) kandi ngo ntawemerewe guhagararirwa .
MINEDUC yasabye abayobozi bose b' uturere kumenyesha ibigo byose butegura abarimu ndetse no korohereza abazakora ibarura no kubafasha mu kazi batumwe gukora kugira ngo kagende neza .
Iyi baruwa ikaba yashyizweho umukono n' Umunyamabanga uhoraho muri MINEDUC , Murindwa Samuel .
Ibi bije nyuma y' aho mu Karere ka Nyagatare hagaragaye ikibazo cy' abarimu 129 ba baringa bahembwaga kandi badakora .
Ubwo bitabaga Komisiyo ishinzwe imibereho myiza mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko , mu mpera za Mutarama 2017 , Ikigo cy' Igihugu gishinzwe uburezi REB cyasobanuye ikibazo cy' abarimu ba baringa bagaragajwe muri raporo ya komisiyo y' abakozi ba Leta aho byagaragaye ko abagera mu 129 bahembwaga badakora .
Icyo gihe REB yasobanuye Icyo gihe Umuyobozi Mukuru wa REB , Gasana Janvier , yanavuze ko wasangaga mu gitabo umwarimu afite amashuri yisumbuye gusa , ariko bajya guhembesha bakamuhembera kaminuza , aha ngo hakaba habaho ikinyuranyo cy' amafaranga menshi ndetse ngo hari n' aho babaraga ku bigo batahakorera .
Gasana yahamije ko kugeza ubu iki kinyuranyo cy' abantu 129 nta muntu n' umwe ugifitiye ibisobanuro kandi aba bantu barahembwe kuko n' umuyobozi w' akarere ngo yamenye iki kibazo akibwiwe na REB .
Gusa nta ngano izwi y' amafaranga yahembwe abo barimu ngo kuko hagikorwa igenzura kugira ngo amenyekane .
Ntabwo ari mu barimu ikibazo cy' abakozi ba baringa kimaze kugaragara kuko mu mpera z' umwaka ushize muri Komisiyo y' Igihugu yo kurwnaya Jenoside iki kibazo cyuahagaragaye , aho hari umukozi wahembaga za baringa hashira imyaka irenze 3 , aho ngo yanyereje miliyoni 36 .
Ntagengerwa Vestine , wari ushinzwe abakozi muri CNLG yaje kugezwa imbere y' ubutabera , Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge ruza kumuhamya icyaha akatirwa igifungo cy' imyaka 2 ndetse ategekwa ko agomba kwishyura miliyoni 108 z' amafaranga y' u Rwanda .

Yari yagizwe umuntu w' umwaka yitabye Imana kubera bamurangaranye Salome Karwah w' imyaka 28 yagizwe intwari kubera kurwanya icyorezo cya Ebola , yari yibarutse umwana w' umuhungu kuwa 17 Gashyantare , yari yabyaye abazwe .
Uyu mubyeyi wari wasezerewe agataha mu rugo iwe yaje kongera kumererwa nabi kuko yari yabyaye abazwe mu ijoro ryo kuwa 19 Gashyantare asubizwa kwa muganga ariko ntiyasubizwa ku bitaro yari yabyariyemo .
Agejejwe ku bitaro bya Eternal Love Winning Africa ( ELWA ) byari bimwegereye yasanze muganga wita ku barwayi ba Ebola adahari undi wari uri ku izamu yanga kumwegera ndetse amubwira ko bamujyana ku bindi bitaro .
Umugabo wa nyakwigendera witwa Harris yihutiye gutabara umugore we wari umeze nabi agerageza kumwinjiza muri ibi bitaro ariko uyu muganga ntiyagira icyo amufasha ahubwo ngo yibereye kuri facebook .
Uyu mubyeyi utarahawe ubutabazi bwihuse yakomeje kumererwa nabi nyuma y' iminsi ibiri ashiramo umwuka .
Umufasha w' uyu mubyeyi usize abana bane avuga ko icyamubabaje ari uko umuganga wagombaga gutanga ubutabazi bw' ibanze yanze kwita ku mugore we ahubwo yibereye kuri Facebook .
Umuyobozi mukuru w' ibi bitaro yaguyemo yatangaje ko bahise batangira iperereza kugira ngo bamenye ko hari uburangare bwabayeho ababigizemo uruhare babiryozwe .
Uyu mubyeyi asize umugani mwiza dore ko uretse kuba yararanzwe no kwita ku barwayi ba Ebola ngo yanakundaga kurangwa no kwita ku babaye ariko we ntiyabyituwe .

Nyamata : 166 basabye imbabazi abo biciye ababo muri Jenoside Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments * N ' imbere y' Imana ngo bababariwe * Claudette yababariye uwamutemye ntapfe * Bose ngo babohotse ubwoba n' ipfunwe n' ikimwaro byabatanyaga Mu gitambo cya Misa kuri iki cyumweru muri paruwasi ya Nyamata abakirisito 166 bakoze Jenoside basabye imbabazi abo biciye ababo ndetse bongera kwakirwa mu muryango w' Imana nyuma yo kwigishwa inyigisho z' isanamitima na Padiri Rugirangoga .
Uwitwa Ntambara wafunguwe kubera ibi byaha we n' abo yiciye bongeye kwiyunga bose bemeza ko babohotse , umwe ipfunwe abandi ubwoba bamugiriraga .
Padiri Ubald Rugirangoga atera amazi y' umugisha kuri bamwe mu basabye imbabazi bakazihabwa Aba bantu 166 barangije urugendo rw' isanamitima bamazemo amezi atandatu bahabwa inyigisho .
Ngo barutangiye barenga 300 gusa bamwe bajyenda bananirwa .
Hari hasigaye 252 ariko 86 muri bo kuri iki cyumweru ngo hari ibyo bari bataruzuza ngo bahabwe impano y' imbabazi imbere y' Imana n' abantu .
Gusa ngo bizagera muri Mata uyu mwaka biteguye .
Jean Claude Ntambara wahoze ari umupolisi yemera ko yishe Abatutsi muri Jenoside yabakorewe , ndetse yari yarabifungiwe igihano kirangiye ararekurwa , ariko yari atarabohoka , avuga ko yishe benshi ku buryo atamenya umubare .
Kugeza ubu usibye we wemera ko yari akiboshywe n' ibyo yakoze , n' abo yiciye ababo bari bakimutinya bikomeye cyane .
Impande zombi zari zifitanye urwikekwe .
Nta bwiyunge bwari hagati yabo kuko bemeza ko bari bakimubonamo umwicanyi .
Yabasabye imbabazi ndetse uyu munsi abikorera mu nzu y' Imana n' imbere y' abantu , abo yahemukiye bamubabariye bavuga ko nabo babohotse kandi bagiye gukomezanya hamwe urugendo rugana ku mana .
Claudette Mukamanzi uretse kwicirwa abe , nawe yatemwe inshuro zirindwi , igikomere kinini mu mihoro bamutemye yagikize mu 2007 cyari umupanga Ntambara yamutemye .
Mukamanzi avuga ko yumvaga nta na rimwe azababarira aba bamuhemukiye cyane nka Ntambara , ariko nyuma y' iyi myaka byarashobotse .
Mukamanzi avuga ko kuva Ntambara yafungurwa yahoranaga ubwoba .
Asa numubwira yagize ati " Ataraza kunsaba imbabazi naramubonaga nkihisha .
Ariko nashimye Imana ko uru rugendo rutangiye Ntambara yaje kunsaba imbabazi .
Ariko ku mutima wanjye kubera ko ariwe wabimburiye abandi narazimuhaye .
Naraziguhaye tuzafatanya urugendo rwo kujya mw' ijuru .
Kandi tuzijyanire mu ijuru . "
Umunyamabanga mukuru wa Komisiyo y' igihugu y' ubumwe n' ubwiyunge Fidel Ndayisaba atanga ubutumwa bwe muri Kiliziya ya Nyamata Mukamanzi avuga ku nyigisho bahawe na Padiri Ubald Rugirangoga yagize ati " Koko tuzabazwa ibyo twakoze ntituzabazwa ibyo twakorewe " iri jambo ngo niryo ryamuyoboye mu kugirira imbabazi Ntambara akaba aniteguye kuzigirira n' abandi azi bamwiciye ariko bataraza kumusaba imbabazi .
Ibi bikamutura umutwaro kuko n' ubu ngo iyo ababonye yihisha .
Padiri Rukizangonga yavuze ko ashimira Imana kuba aba basabye Imbabazi n' abazitanze bakoze igikorwa gikomeye , aba ngo bazabera abandi ikitegererezo nabo batere iyi ntambwe yo gusaba imbabazi no kuzitanga maze umuryango nyarwanda ukiyunga nyabyo .
Fidel Ndayisaba Umunyamabanga mukuru wa Komisiyo y' ubumwe n' ubwiyunge yashimiye abo bateye intambwe yo gusaba imbazi nabo bazitanze kuko bose babohotse ubu bakaba babonye amahoro yo mu mutima yo soko y' ibintu byose .
Muri Paruwasi ya Nyamata ni aha gatatu hakorewe iyi gahunda y' isanamitima yatangijwe na Padiri Ubald Rugirangonga nyuma ya Paruwasi ya Mushaka na Mibirizi muri Diyoseze ya Cyangugu .

PGGSS IV : Abahanzi bageze i Rusizi .
Amafoto Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Updated 03 / 21 5PM :
Abahanzi bageze mu mujyi wa Rusizi ahagana saa kumi n' imwe z' amanywa , bacumbikiwe kuri The Frank Hotel mu mujyi wa Rusizi , bagiye ku ruhuka bitegura igitaramo kizaba kuri uyu wa gatandatu saa munani z' amanywa kuri stade 03 / 21 10AM :
' Road show ' ya mbere y' iri rushanwa rya PGGSS IV ritegurwa na BRALIRWA ku bufatanye na EAP igiye kubera i Rusizi , imodoka ebyiri nini imwe ihagurukanye abahanzi indi abanyamakuru zerekeza mu muhanda Kigali – Huye – Rusizi .
Christopher asohoka mu modoka bageze i Butare aho baruhutse Abahanzi 10 bakomeje muri iri rushanwa ntawasibye bose babukereye .
Jules Sentore , Bruce Melody , Teta Diana , Young Grace , Dream Boys , Senderi International Hit , Active , Jay Polly , Christopher na Amag the Black bose nta numwe ubura .
Bakinjira mu modoka yabo , wabonaga baganira uko iminota yicumaga bategereje guhaguruka ku kicaro cya EAP mu mujyi wa Kigali bagendaga batuza , ubwoba buragaragara ku maso ya bamwe binjiye bwa mbere muri iri rushanwa .
Active , Bruce Melody , Teta Diana na Jules Sentore ni ubwa mbere bagiye kuririmbira imbaga y' abantu bazaba bateraniye kuri stade Kamarampaka ahitwaga cyera mu Gisaka na Migongo kwa Kimenyi , i Rusizi ubu .
Igitaramo cya mbere kizaba kuri uyu wa gatandatu tariki 22 Werurwe ku gicamunsi , mukazagikurikirana kiri kuba k' Umuseke .
Imwe mu modoka ebyiri zihagurukanye abahanzi n' abanyamakuru , aha ni i Kigali bagiye guhaguruka Imodoka yari itwaye abahanzi igeze mu mujyi wa Huye BAha ni kuri Hotel Ibis aho bagiye kwica isari Bruce Melodie mu idirishya ry' imodoka areba abantu baje kubareba Mu modoka , Jules Sentore , Bruce Melody na Olivis , umwe mu bo mu itsinda Active Jules Sentore na Senderi International Bari gufata amafunguro ngo bakomeze Abambaye ingofero ni Platini ( inyuma ) na TMC ( hagati ) bagize Dream Boys Urugendo rwerekeza i Rusizi rurakomeje ,

Rubavu : Ikiraro cyubatswe kuri Sebeya ntikivugwaho rumwe Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments * Iki kiraro cyubatswe ku mugezi wa Sebeya mu murenge wa Kanama , * Cyubatswe ku bufatanye n' akarere ka Rubavu na Kompanyi ya OTP , * Bamwe mu baturage bavuga ko cyabakuye mu bwigunge abandi bakavuga ko OTP ariyo yungutse , * OTP n' ubuyobozi bemeza ko cyubatswe mu nyungu rusange .
Ikiraro cyubatswe ku mugezi wa Sebeya mu murenge wa Kanama gihuza utugari twa Musabike na Kamuhoza , ntikivugwaho rumwe n' abagenerwabikorwa kuko n' ubwo bamwe bemera ko cyakemuye byinshi , abandi bavuga ko ari icya kompanyi OTP yafatanyije n' akarere kucyubaka .
Imikoreshereze y' iki kiraro ntivugwaho rumwe n' abaturage ndetse n' ubuyobozi Mu gihe hari abavuga ko cyabakuye mu bwigunge bagaragaza byinshi cyakemuye nko kuba hari abararaga nzira mu gihe imvura yaguye .
Abakerensa akamaro k' icyo kiraro bavuga ko kompanyi icukura umucanga ari na yo yacyubatse ariyo gifitiye inyungu kuko yihariye isoko ryo gucukura umucanga yonyine ngo kuko kukinyuzaho imodoka itari iyakompanyi yikoreye umucanga bitemewe .
Umwe mu bavuga ko iki kiraro gifite akamaro ati : "
Imvura yabaga yaguye umwe agacumbika hakurya undi hakuno ndetse n' abana bavuye ku ishuri bagacumbika mu ngo ziri hakurya y' umugezi . "
Undi na we ubona akamaro k' iki kiraro ku baturage , ati : "
Iki kiraro cyakemuye byinshi kuko nkatwe abanyonzi cyatumye tubona uko tujya kuzana amata hakurya mu misozi .
Uyu mucanga mubona aha wahaye benshi akazi , imodoka zirambuka zigapakira amakara , imbaho n' ibindi . "
Bashimangira ko iki kiraro ari bimwe mu bigaragaza iterambere agace batuyemo gakomeje kugenda kageraho .
Ku ruhande rw' abagaragaza ko ikiraro nta kamaro kibafitiye , bavuga ko ngo umuyobozi wa kompanyi OTP yagiye akibirukanaho ndetse ngo anababuza kugira ibintu banyuzaho , ndetse ngo umucanga ufatiwe mu yindi modoka ahita awushyira ku woyacuye .
Umwe yagize ati : " Iki kiraro nta kamaro kidufitiye ahubwo nyiri uriya mucanga ni we gifitiye akamaro , ntabwo napakira imodoka umucanga ngo nanjye nyuzeho .
Ahita awufata akawusuka ku we ngo nta nkunga twamuteye acyubaka . "
Umuturage uvuga ko yirukanywe kuri iki kiraro na Clement uyobora OTP , ati : "
Nari mpahagaze , araza arambwira ngo nimuvire ku kiraro .
Ntabwo ari icy' abaturage ahubwo ni icye kuko tuvuga ko ari ikiraro cya Clement ntabwo ari ikiraro gifitiye abaturage akamaro . "
Kimenyi Clement ushinjwa kwiyitirira ikiraro , ntiyemera ibyo kwikubira inyungu z' iki kiraro , yemeza ko amasezerano bagiranye n' akarere harimo ko kigomba kuba inyungu rusange ku baturage .
Ati : " Iki kiraro cyubatswe ku bufatanye n' akarere kugira ngo gihuze abaturage bo mu kagari ka Musabike ndetse na Kamuhoza , kuba bavuga ngo ni icya Clement ni uko ari njyewe uhagarariye kompanyi ya OTP .
Uwo ariwe wese aratambuka nta nkomyi , Leta ni yo isoresha cyangwa ababiherewe uburenganzira .
Iki kiraro ni inyungu rusange . "
Asaba ubuyobozi bw' akarere kubafasha kumvisha abaturage ko iki kiraro ari icyabo kugira ngo barusheho kugikoresha ku nyungu z' abo bataretse no kukibungabunga , yemeza ko abavuga ko ntacyo kimaze ari abo cyahombeje .
Ati : " Hari abajaburaga umucanga mu kajagari bahagaritswe nyuma yo gukora imirimo yo kubungabunga ibidukikije kuri uyu mugezi , hari n' abandi bakoraga imirimo yo kwambutsa abantu ku mugongo mu gihe imvura yabaga yaguye , abo bose kuko batakibikora nibo usanga bavuga ngo ntacyo kimaze . "
Bizimana Epimac , umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w' agateganyo w' umurenge wa Kanama yemeza ko impamvu abaturage bitirira iki kiraro Clement , ari uko ari we wakurikiranye imirimo yo kucyubaka aha akemeza ko ari ikibazo cy' imyumvire y' abaturage .
Ati : " Abaturage mu myumvire yabo iyo babona umuntu akurikirana ikintu bakunda kukimwitirira kandi atari ko bimeze .
Ubu hari gahunda ihari n' ubwo twagiye tubaganiriza , turakomeza kubikora kugira ngo bumve neza ko ikiraro ari icyabo bakibyaze umusaruro ndetse bakomeze no kukibungabunga . "
Yemeza ko iki kiraro gifitiye abaturage akamaro ku buryo budashidikanywaho kuko uretse kukinyuraho ubwabo , imodoka zitwara umucanga , umusaruro wiganjemo amakara n' imbaho zigikoresha bityo bikazamura ubukungu mu gace kirimo .
Iki kiraro cyuzuye mu ntangiro za Nyakanga uyu mwaka cyubatswe ku bufatanye bwa Kompanyi ya OTP ikora ubucukuzi bw' umucanga muri aka gace n' akarere ka Rubavu cyatwaye amafaranga y' u Rwanda asaga miliyoni 71 .
uyu ni umucanga wa OTP ivugwaho kwiharira inyungu z' iki kiraro yafatanyije n' akarere kubaka RUKERA Placide UMUSEKE .

Abayobozi b' u Buhinde bagiye gusura u Rwanda Perezida Kagame ubwo yahuraga na Minisitiri w' Intebe w' u Buhinde Narendra Modi muri Mutarama 2017 Itsinda ry' abayobozi baturutse mu gihugu cy' u Buhinde rigiye gukorera urugendo rw' akazi mu gihugu cy' u Rwanda , ku matariki ya 19 - 24 Gashyantare 2017 .
Aba bayobozi bazaba bayobowe na Visi Perezida w' u Buhinde ari we Mohammad Hamid Ansari , akazaba aherekejwe n' abandi bayobozi bakuru , abakozi b' inteko ishinga amategeko n' abandi .
Muri bo uwatangajwe urimo ni depite Muthuvel Karunanidhi Kanimozhi uri mu ishyaka rya DMK .
Ikinyamakuru cyo mu Buhinde cyitwa indianexpress . com cyanditse ko uru rugendo rw' akazi rw' iminsi itanu ruzahera mu Rwanda , ariko aba bayobozi bakajya no mu gihugu cya Uganda .
Ntacyo igihugu cy' u Rwanda kiratangaza ku by' uru rugendo .
Uru rugendo ruje rukurikira uruzinduko rw' iminsi itatu Perezida wa Repubulika y' u Rwanda , Paul Kagame , aheruka kugirira mu Buhinde , mu nama ya Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit yabereye mu Ntara ya Gujarat ku matariki ya 10 - 13 Mutarama 2017 , aho yabonanye na Minisitiri w' Intebe w' iki gihugu Narendra Modi .
Mu biganiro bagiranye bagarutse ku bufatanye mu bikorwa by' iterambere hagati y' ibihugu byombi ; binatuma u Buhinde bwiyemeza gutera inkunga u Rwanda mu bikorwa bitandukanye by' iterambere .
Mu byo aba bayobozi bemeranyijeho harimo amasezerano y' ubufatanye hagati ya Polisi y' u Rwanda na Kaminuza ya Gujarat Forensic Sciences .
Ubuhinde bugiye gufasha u Rwanda kubaka imihanda U Buhinde bwiyemeje gutera inkunga u Rwanda miliyoni 2 z' Amadolari mu bikorwa by' ubuvuzi , n' inguzanyo ya miliyoni imwe yo kugura bimwe mu bikoresho byo kwa muganga .
U Buhinde kandi bwiyemeje guha u Rwanda inguzanyo ya miliyoni 81 z' amadorali ajyanye no kubaka imihanda .
Mu mihanda byitezwe ko izahita itangira gusanwa vuba harimo umuhanda Huye - Nyaruguru - Kibeho , ureshya na kilometero 63 , uzatangira gutunganywa hashyirwamo kaburimbo , ku buryo uzaba wuzuye bitarenze mu kwezi kwa Kamena uyu mwaka wa 2017 .
Uyu muhanda ujya kungana n' umuhanda Kigali - Rwamagana ( 60 km ) .
gukorwa kwawo bizaba ari ugushyira mu bikorwa isezerano Perezida wa Repubulika yari yemereye abaturage b' Akarere ka Nyaruguru mu mwaka wa 2013 .
Uyu muhanda wari uteganyijwe kubakwa guhera mu mwaka wa 2015 ariko ntibyashoboka .
Umuhanda uzatunganywa uzaturuka mu Karere ka Huye ugere ku biro by' Akarere ka Nyaruguru unyuze i Kibeho , uzakomeza unyure mu mirenge ya Cyahinda na Nyagisozi uhure n' umuhanda Huye – Kanyaru ( ugera mu Burundi ) .
Hari kandi n' agashami kazava ku biro by' Akarere ka Nyaruguru ugezwe ku Bitaro bya Munini biherereye muri aka Karere ka Nyaruguru .
Uyu muhanda wari ubangamiye abantu benshi baganaga i Kibeho , ahafatwa nk' ubutaka butagatifu hasurwa n' abantu benshi bajya kureba no gusengera aho Bikira Mariya yabonekereye abakobwa batatu hagati y' imyaka 1981 - 1989 .
Abaturage bageragezaga kuwusana mu gihe wabaga wangiritse , izuba ryava ukarangwa n' ivumbi ryinshi ibyo byatumaga abagore bambara ibitambaro mu mutwe , ndetse ugasanga barwanira imyanya y' imbere , mu gihe imvura yagwaga nabwo wuzuragamo ibyondo .
Imodoka zijya muri ako gace nazo wasangaga zibangamiwe no kwangirika .
Uyu muhanda ucibwamo n' abantu baturutse mu bice byose by' Isi bajya gusengera i Kibeho tariki ya 15 Kanama , ubwo haba iyihizihizwa ry' ijyanwa mu ijuru rya Bikira Mariya , ndetse by' umwihariko n' umunsi wa tariki 28 Ugushyingo wizihirizwaho amabonekerwa ya Kibeho .
Uretse imihanda , aba bakuru b' ibihugu kandi bemeranyije gutangiza ingendo z' indege za sosiyete ya RwandAir , iva i Kigali mu Rwanda yerekeza Mumbai mu Buhinde .
Ikigo cy' igihugu cy' iterambere mu Rwanda ( RDB ) kivuga ko ubufatanye hagati y' u Rwanda n' u Buhinde bwazamutse cyane mu myaka itanu ishize .
Muri iyi myaka , ni ukuvuga kuva mu mwaka wa 2011 kugeza 2015 , u Rwanda rwanditse imishinga y' ishoramari 66 yavuye mu Buhinde , ifite agaciro ka miliyoni 317 . 5 z' amadorali .

Gusinzira neza byongera ubushobozi bwo kwiga no kwibuka Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Itsinda ryabashakashatsi b' Abashinwa n' Abanyamerika bakoresheje icyuma kireba utuntu duto cyane bita Microscopy bize isano iri hagati yo gusinzira neza ko kubasha kwiga neza no kwibuka vuba .
Abanyamerika bo muri Kaminuza ya New York University School of Medicine bafatanyije n' Abashinwa bo muri Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School bafashe imbeba bazitoza kugendera ku kintu kikaraga .
Nyuma baje gukoresha Microscopy bareba uko izi nyamaswa zibuka kugendera kuri cya kintu iyo zabujijwe gusinzira neza .
Baje gusanga imbeba zabujijwe gusinzira neza zitabasha kwiga kugendera kuri kiriya kintu neza nk' uko bimeze kuzasinziriye neza .
Ibi ngo biterwa n' imikoranire y' udutsi duto two mu bwonko ( neurons ) dukorana neza bigatuma havuka ibyo bita synapses mu bwonko arizo zituma bwiga vuba kandi bukibuka cyane .
Aba bahanga kandi baje kubona ko gucamo ibitotsi kabiri bigora ubwonko kuko bibusaba kongera gutangirira kuri zero mbere y' uko umuntu asinzira neza nka mbere .
Umwaka ushize abahanga bavumbuye ko iyo umuntu asinziriye neza bifasha ubwonko koza imyanda iburimo yatewe n' imihangayiko yiriwemo mu kazi ke ka buri munsi .
Ikintu gihangayikisha abahanga mu mikorere y' ubwonko n' umubiri ni uko abantu b' iki gihe bafata ibitotsi nk' ububwa cyangwa ubugwari , bigatuma banga kuryama ku bushake ngo barahuze cyane ntibaryama ngo baruhuke !
Mu mijyi itandukanye ku isi abantu basinzira amasaha macye cyane kandu nta n' ikintu kigaragara bari gukora , uretse kure amafilime y' uruhererekane abatwaraigihe bagambye gukoresha baruhuka .
Kudasinzira neza ni intandaro y' indwara nyinshi zica kandi zimwe zidakira harimo amoko atandukanye ya Kanseri , indwara z' umutima , Diyabete yo ku rwego rwa kabiri , kurwara ibisebe bitinda gukira ndetse n' umubyibuho ukabije ( obesity ) .
Niba wumva unaniwe kandi ukaba wakoze ibyo wasabwaga gukora , ruhuka usinzire .
Zimwe amatara yose , ukureho interineti kuri telephone yawe ndetse na mudasobwa uyizimwe .
Niba ubishoboye wiyuhagire kandi urare mu buriri bufite isuku kandi mu cyumba gisukuye gifite umwuka mwiza .
Niba waboze ibitotsi , soma igitabo ukunda kandi igisome ushishikaye bityo urunguka ubumenyi kandi ubone n' ibitotsi ukeneye .
Rwose ntabwo kuryama ukaruhuka ugasinzira ari ubugwari .
Byaba ububwa n' ubugwari ari uko umuntu ahora mu gitanda kandi atarwaye .
